Mars.greeting: This island is so cute! I'm gonna battle you right here, okay?
Mars.trainerLoses: Not cute! Not cute at all!

Jupiter.greeting: Commander Jupiter of Team Galactic. You've got some nerve challenging me.
Jupiter.trainerLoses: Hmph. Maybe you've got more than nerve.

Jupiter.greeting: I don't care about Alola. I'm here because the strong ones are here.
Jupiter.trainerWins: And you're not one of them. Next.
Jupiter.trainerLoses: Fine. You're one of them. Don't let it go to your head.

Jupiter.greeting: Our boss has a vision for a new world. I just make sure nobody gets in the way.
Jupiter.trainerWins: Nobody gets in the way. Not even you.
Jupiter.trainerLoses: You got in the way. The boss won't like that.

Saturn.greeting: Commander Saturn. I prefer to settle things calmly. Shall we?
Team Galactic's goals don't concern you. This battle does.
Saturn.trainerWins: Battle concluded. Our goals remain unconcerned.
Saturn.trainerLoses: Perhaps you should concern yourself with our goals after all.

Saturn.greeting: I've been thinking about what a better world looks like. A battle helps me think.
Saturn.trainerWins: Thinking done. A better world includes my win.
Saturn.trainerLoses: Food for thought. I'll think on it.

Charon.greeting: Hohoho! A Team Galactic Commander, and a scientist besides! Let us experiment!
Charon.trainerWins: Hohoho! The experiment confirms my genius!
Charon.trainerLoses: Hohoho... the data must be wrong. Surely.

Charon.greeting: Power is everything, child. Power and knowledge. Do you have either?
These Alolan legends are fascinating. Imagine the power... hohoho!
Charon.trainerLoses: The power slipped away. Hohoho... I'll find more.

N.greeting: I'm N. I want to hear your partners' voices. Will you let them speak through this battle?
N.trainerWins: Their voices are kind, but they're tired. Let them rest.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners are happy with you. I can hear it.

N.greeting: Truth, ideals... I still don't know which is right. Maybe this battle will tell me.
N.trainerWins: This time, the battle didn't give me an answer.
N.trainerLoses: Maybe your way is the answer. I'll think about it.

N.greeting: Alola's people live so closely with their partners. I wanted to see it for myself.
N.trainerWins: Close bonds, but not close enough. Not yet.
N.trainerLoses: Close bonds, and real strength. Thank you.

Ghetsis.greeting: I am Ghetsis. You'll find I don't lose gracefully, so I simply don't lose.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: As I said. I don't lose.

Ghetsis.greeting: Power belongs to those who know how to use it. Let me demonstrate.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You dare use power against me?!

Ghetsis.greeting: I am merely a humble Sage, here to enjoy the islands... and crush whoever I meet.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Crushed, as planned. How humble of me.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Not as planned. Not at all as planned.

Zinzolin.greeting: I am Zinzolin, one of Team Plasma's Sages. I find the tropics dreadfully hot.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Defeat and heat. A terrible combination.

Zinzolin.greeting: Ice is patient. It waits, and then it shatters everything. Shall we wait together?
Zinzolin.trainerWins: The ice shatters. As it always does.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma had grand plans once. Today, I plan only to win.

Lysandre.greeting: I am Lysandre. I want a beautiful world. Show me whether you belong in it.
Lysandre.trainerWins: You don't belong in it. Yet.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You belong in it more than I do. How bitter.

Lysandre.greeting: Those who take without giving make the world ugly. Which are you?
Lysandre.trainerWins: You took a chance and gave me a win. Thank you.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You gave everything. I respect that deeply.

Lysandre.greeting: A café owner, a scientist, a dreamer. Today, simply a challenger.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Simply a challenger, and simply a winner.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm... Xerosic, Team Flare's finest scientist. You'll make a fine test subject!
Xerosic.trainerWins: Data collected! Thank you, test subject!
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Hmm?! The data... contradicts my hypothesis!

Xerosic.greeting: Science has no morals. Only results. Let's get some results!
I built many gadgets in my time. None as satisfying as a good battle.
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Back to the lab, I suppose.

Bryony.greeting: I'm Bryony, a Team Flare admin. Let's make this quick; I have a fitting later.
Bryony.trainerWins: Quick, as promised. Off to my fitting.
Bryony.trainerLoses: I'll be late for my fitting now. Thanks a lot.

Bryony.greeting: Elegance is a weapon. Most people don't know how to wield it.
Alola's fashion is so... casual. I'll bring a little class to this battle.
Bryony.trainerLoses: Even class can't save every look.

Mable.greeting: I'm Mable, Team Flare admin. Blue suits me, and so does winning.
Research is my specialty. Let's research your weaknesses.
Mable.trainerLoses: Research says I'm the weak one. How annoying.

Mable.greeting: Team Flare is gone, but my ambition isn't. Let's see yours.
Mable.trainerLoses: Your ambition is bigger. For now.

Lusamine.greeting: I love all Pokémon, truly. That's why I'll show you how beautiful they are when they win.
Lusamine.trainerWins: Beautiful, weren't they? I love them so.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You made my beauties lose? How cruel of you.

Lusamine.greeting: As President of the Aether Foundation, I protect what I love. Don't make me protect it from you.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You've hurt what I love. I'll remember this.

Lusamine.greeting: My children say I'm too much. I say there's no such thing as too much love.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Even love isn't enough sometimes. How painful.

Faba.greeting: I, Faba, Branch Chief of the Aether Foundation, will grace you with a battle. Be grateful.
Faba.trainerWins: You should be grateful. That was a privilege.
Faba.trainerLoses: This is... a temporary setback for a genius like me!

Faba.greeting: My research will change the world. A battle with you will barely change my afternoon.
Faba.trainerWins: As predicted. My afternoon remains unchanged.

Faba.greeting: Do you know how important I am? Very. Let me show you.
Faba.trainerLoses: Important people lose sometimes too... rarely.

Izzy.greeting: One moment I was at my laptop, the next I was here. I've been researching this world ever since. Prodigious!
Izzy.trainerWins: Just as my calculations predicted! I'll add this battle to my research notes.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Fascinating... I clearly overlooked a few variables. Back to the data!

Izzy.greeting: My partner was reformatted the moment we crossed over. Same heart, all-new data. Let me show you what we learned!
Izzy.trainerWins: Knowledge is power, and today's data proves it!
Izzy.trainerLoses: Your strategy didn't fit any of my models. I'll have to revise my theory.

Izzy.greeting: Tai and the others were pulled into this world too. They explore it; I study it. Care to be my next data point?
Izzy.trainerWins: Wait till I tell Tai! He never believes my theories until he sees them work.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Tai would say I overthought it. Please don't tell him he was right.

Kaito.greeting: I don't give orders. I give information. My partner decides what to do with it. Your move.
Kaito.trainerWins: Three seconds. That's all it took. ...Good battle, though.
Kaito.trainerLoses: You read us better than most. My partner will want a rematch. So will I.

Kaito.greeting: People see my team and assume the worst. Fine. Battle us, then decide for yourself who we are.
Kaito.trainerWins: Labels don't win battles. Choices do.
Kaito.trainerLoses: You didn't judge us. You just beat us. I can respect that.

Kaito.greeting: Nobody owns my partner. We fight beside each other because we chose to. Don't mistake that for weakness.
Kaito.trainerWins: We chose this fight, and we chose to win it.
Kaito.trainerLoses: We'll be back. Not because anyone told us to. Because we want to.

Takato.greeting: One second I was drawing dinosaurs in class, the next I was here! At least my partner came too. Let's battle!
Takato.trainerWins: We did it! I'm drawing this battle in my notebook tonight!
Takato.trainerLoses: Aw, man... You were awesome, though. Can I draw your team?

Takato.greeting: I don't know how we ended up in this world, but if there's a battle, my partner and I won't run from it!
Takato.trainerWins: Yes! My partner's going to want bread to celebrate. Lots of bread.
Takato.trainerLoses: We'll get stronger. That's what Tamers do. Good battle!

Takato.greeting: I'm not the bravest guy around, but my partner believes in me. That's enough to make me try!
Takato.trainerWins: We actually won! I mean, of course we did. ...We did, right?
Takato.trainerLoses: I froze up a little. Next time I'll be braver. Promise!

Rika.greeting: Digi-Modify! Poké Matrix Activate! ...What? A card slash works in any world. Let's go.
Rika.trainerWins: Too easy. Next time, bring a real challenge.
Rika.trainerLoses: Fine. You won. Don't let it go to your head.

Rika.greeting: I was winning a card tournament when this world dragged me in. Lucky you. Now you get to lose to the Queen.
Rika.trainerWins: Queen of this world too, apparently. Shocker.
Rika.trainerLoses: Hmph. I'll find my way home. Right after I beat you in a rematch.

Rika.greeting: No idea how I got here, and I don't care. My partner's with me. That's all I need to win.
Rika.trainerWins: My partner and I don't need anyone else. ...Okay, that was a good battle.
Rika.trainerLoses: ...Not bad. My partner thinks so too. Don't expect me to say it twice.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: I was fixing my dad's code when the screen flashed, and now I'm here. I'd rather talk, but I'll battle if I must.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: I'm glad nobody got hurt. You fought with honor.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Well played. My partner would just say "Momentai." Take it easy.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: One minute I was home with my little sister, the next I was in this world. Let's keep this a fair fight.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: A clean win. That's how my martial arts teacher taught me.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: You read my moves well. I'll train harder and come back calmer.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Fighting should never be just for fun. But a fair battle, with rules and respect? That I can do.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Balance and patience. That's all it takes.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Patience lost to passion today. I'll think about that.

Mildred.greeting: I chased legends across a frozen tundra and back through time itself. You climbed this far, so show me you're one too.
Mildred.trainerWins: Legends don't fall to the merely persistent. Climb again, and bring more than stubbornness next time.
Mildred.trainerLoses: So you are a legend in the making. I've only ever lost to those. Keep climbing.

Mildred.greeting: They call me a veteran. I call it a lifetime spent listening to the wind of a cold, wild land. Ready?
Mildred.trainerWins: The wind picked my side today. Out here, it usually does.
Mildred.trainerLoses: A gale I never saw coming. It's been years since anyone blew me off course like that.

Mildred.greeting: Some of my partners are older than any history book. They've waited ages for a worthy fight. Don't make them wait more.
Mildred.trainerWins: Patient as stone and twice as old. Come back when you can outlast that.
Mildred.trainerLoses: Ancient, and still they fell. Remember today; few trainers ever get one like it.

Ivor.greeting: I dug something up in a ruin that shouldn't exist. It's been itching for a battle for a few million years.
Ivor.trainerWins: Old bones, old stones, and still the strongest thing here. History wins again!
Ivor.trainerLoses: Beaten by someone younger than my oldest fossil. I'll file this under 'unexpected finds.'

Ivor.greeting: Every ruin tells a story. Today's chapter: you, buried under a stampede.
Ivor.trainerWins: Another layer of sediment on your hopes. I'll label you carefully.
Ivor.trainerLoses: Well, that's one dig site I won't be returning to. You've excavated me completely.

Ivor.greeting: Mind the dust. My team has been waiting since before maps were drawn.
Ivor.trainerWins: Prehistoric might, modern results. Not a bad day in the field.
Ivor.trainerLoses: Even the mightiest tusks crack eventually. Mine just cracked today.

Axel.greeting: Turn it up! My band's lead singer has a scream that echoes back from the dawn of time!
Axel.trainerWins: That's a wrap! Encore? Nah, you couldn't handle a second set.
Axel.trainerLoses: You drowned out my whole band. Respect. That was one heavy solo.

Axel.greeting: Check, one, two... This next track is called 'Your Losing Streak.' Hit it!
Axel.trainerWins: Feedback squealing, crowd roaring, opponent down. Perfect gig!
Axel.trainerLoses: Broke a string, lost the beat, lost the battle. Rough night on stage.

Axel.greeting: Plug your ears or don't, either way you'll be hearing this battle for weeks!
Axel.trainerWins: Ringing in your ears? That's the sound of my victory lap.
Axel.trainerLoses: Total silence. Guess the crowd's cheering for you now.

Morella.greeting: Breathe deep. The forest's oldest spores are drifting your way, and they're hungry.
Morella.trainerWins: Sweet dreams. My garden thanks you for the nourishment.
Morella.trainerLoses: You cut through my whole garden. I'll need a season to grow back.

Morella.greeting: Do you smell that? Damp earth, wild mushrooms... and a battle you've already lost.
Morella.trainerWins: Everything in the forest returns to the soil eventually. You included.
Morella.trainerLoses: Wilted, every last bloom. Your aroma was simply stronger today.

Morella.greeting: My flowers are lovely, but some of them bite. Shall we find out which ones?
Morella.trainerWins: Pretty petals, sharp teeth. Never judge a garden by its colors.
Morella.trainerLoses: Even a carnivorous garden can starve. I'll replant and come back.

Ophelia.greeting: Hehe... My partners whisper in voices older than this tree. They've been asking about you.
Ophelia.trainerWins: The whispers are satisfied. They'll remember your name... forever.
Ophelia.trainerLoses: The spirits went quiet. They respect you now. That's... unsettling.

Ophelia.greeting: I read your fortune before you arrived. It said 'loses at the Battle Tree.' Hehe...
Ophelia.trainerWins: The cards are never wrong. Well, almost never.
Ophelia.trainerLoses: My fortune was wrong? I need to have a long talk with my crystal ball.

Ophelia.greeting: Something ancient drifts beside me, shrieking softly. Do you hear it too?
Ophelia.trainerWins: Shh... Listen to the silence after a curse lands. Lovely, isn't it?
Ophelia.trainerLoses: You walked right through my hexes. Something stronger must be haunting you.

Darwin.greeting: I chased a moth so ancient it predates the evolution charts. Want to see what nature used to be?
Darwin.trainerWins: Survival of the fittest! And today, the fittest has six legs.
Darwin.trainerLoses: Out-evolved! I'll have to update my field notes on you.

Darwin.greeting: Bugs ruled this world long before us. Let me show you why.
Darwin.trainerWins: Natural selection at work. Write that one in your journal!
Darwin.trainerLoses: My specimens met a bigger predator. Fascinating, really.

Darwin.greeting: Careful where you step. The tall grass of the past was full of giants.
Darwin.trainerWins: Wings beating, enemies fleeing. What a beautiful ecosystem!
Darwin.trainerLoses: Every species has a natural enemy. Looks like mine is you.

Sandor.greeting: I hiked across a desert where the sand crackles with lightning. Brought a souvenir, too!
Sandor.trainerWins: Ha! Grit in your face, static in your hair. Classic desert welcome.
Sandor.trainerLoses: Buried in my own sand dune. I'll dig myself out and keep hiking.

Sandor.greeting: My compass spins wildly around my partner. Must be that old magnetism! Let's rumble!
Sandor.trainerWins: The ground shook and the needle pointed straight to my victory!
Sandor.trainerLoses: Lost my bearings completely. Even my compass is pointing at you now.

Sandor.greeting: Grit in your teeth, sparks on your skin... welcome to the dunes!
Sandor.trainerWins: A long trek, but the view from the top of this win is worth it!
Sandor.trainerLoses: Shocked and sandblasted. I need a canteen and a long sit.

Ragnar.greeting: Hear that roar? My dragon still howls at a moon only the ancients ever saw.
Ragnar.trainerWins: Dragons bow to no one. And now you know why.
Ragnar.trainerLoses: Tamed... by you? My dragons will never let me hear the end of this.

Ragnar.greeting: Dragons are wild, proud and hungry. I'm the only one they listen to. Most days.
Ragnar.trainerWins: Raw power, perfect control. That's the life of a tamer.
Ragnar.trainerLoses: My dragons roared, but you roared louder. Well fought!

Ragnar.greeting: Under a crimson moon, the old dragons hunt. Tonight, they hunt you.
Ragnar.trainerWins: The hunt is over. My dragons have feasted on victory.
Ragnar.trainerLoses: Even dragons fall from the sky sometimes. Today was my day to fall.

Ferris.greeting: Hard hats on! My partner rolled off an assembly line from the future, and it doesn't do brakes.
Ferris.trainerWins: Job done, site cleared, and you got flattened in the process.
Ferris.trainerLoses: Total breakdown! Somebody call the repair crew.

Ferris.greeting: This battlefield's due for some demolition. Stand back, I'm bringing the heavy equipment.
Ferris.trainerWins: Built tough, built to last. You were built to lose this one!
Ferris.trainerLoses: My whole crew's off the clock. Guess the job's not getting finished.

Ferris.greeting: Gears grinding, treads turning... Let's get to work!
Ferris.trainerWins: Another shift, another victory. Time for a lunch break.
Ferris.trainerLoses: Outworked on my own site? I'll be pulling overtime to make up for that.

Neve.greeting: I swim in freezing water every morning. My partner skims over it at impossible speed!
Neve.trainerWins: Brr! Hope you brought a towel. That was a cold shower of a loss.
Neve.trainerLoses: Swept away by the current! The sea isn't on my side today.

Neve.greeting: Dive in! The water's freezing and my team is even colder.
Neve.trainerWins: Frozen solid! Try a warm-up lap next time.
Neve.trainerLoses: I sank like a stone. Time to train in even colder water.

Neve.greeting: Laps in the glacier pool, then battles at the top of the tree. Ready to get chilled?
Neve.trainerWins: A clean finish and a perfect splash. Gold medal performance!
Neve.trainerLoses: You outpaced me lap after lap. Even my frosty partner melted.

Takeo.greeting: Hah! My partner's palms hit like a sumo champion forged of steel! Brace yourself!
Takeo.trainerWins: Oss! Your guard broke, and so did your streak!
Takeo.trainerLoses: My stance crumbled! I must return to the dojo and train harder!

Takeo.greeting: A true fighter strikes with the full weight of the body. Allow me to demonstrate!
Takeo.trainerWins: One clean strike and it's over. That's the discipline of the dojo!
Takeo.trainerLoses: Pushed out of the ring! Your strength is the real deal!

Takeo.greeting: Ten thousand slaps a day builds an unbreakable will. Show me yours!
Takeo.trainerWins: My training paid off! A thousand more slaps tonight to celebrate!
Takeo.trainerLoses: I bow to you. That was a battle worthy of the dojo walls.

Malcolm.greeting: My research points to a three-headed machine from the future. Today you'll help me test it.
Malcolm.trainerWins: Hypothesis confirmed! Your defeat was entirely predictable.
Malcolm.trainerLoses: Unexpected results... I'll need to rerun this experiment a few hundred times.

Malcolm.greeting: Fascinating. Your team would make excellent test subjects. Shall we begin the trial?
Malcolm.trainerWins: Data collected, conclusion reached: I win. Thank you for your participation.
Malcolm.trainerLoses: My calculations had a flaw. Specifically, they didn't account for you.

Malcolm.greeting: Precision, calibration, overwhelming firepower. That's good science.
Malcolm.trainerWins: Peer review complete: my machines are superior.
Malcolm.trainerLoses: Failure is just data. Very painful data, in this case.

Blaise.greeting: Feel that heat? My partner glows like a reactor and sheds toxic sparks! Let's light it up!
Blaise.trainerWins: Up in smoke! That's what happens when you play with fire.
Blaise.trainerLoses: Doused! Somebody hand me a match, my fire went out.

Blaise.greeting: I've tended bonfires since I was little, but nothing burns like the light of tomorrow!
Blaise.trainerWins: Ashes, ashes, you all fall down! Ha!
Blaise.trainerLoses: Smothered my flames completely. That's a cold way to lose.

Blaise.greeting: Fumes and flames, the perfect pair! Step closer if you're brave.
Blaise.trainerWins: Burning bright and burning hot. My fire never fades!
Blaise.trainerLoses: Just embers left now. I'll rekindle and come back blazing.

Rex.greeting: In my long career I've faced monsters. Now I command one, crackling with lightning.
Rex.trainerWins: Experience and thunder. A combination youth has yet to master.
Rex.trainerLoses: Hmph. My old bones felt that one. Well battled, young one.

Rex.greeting: A wise trainer knows when to strike. And when my monster strikes, everything shakes.
Rex.trainerWins: Every stone in place, every bolt where it belongs. That is mastery.
Rex.trainerLoses: I've lost before and I'll lose again. Today, I lost to someone special.

Rex.greeting: Mountains crumble and storms fade, but a true expert endures. Begin!
Rex.trainerWins: The earth trembles, the sky splits. That's how an expert closes a battle.
Rex.trainerLoses: Even an expert can be humbled. Thank you for the lesson.

Hanzo.greeting: Fwoosh! You didn't see me coming, and you won't see my partner's blade either!
Hanzo.trainerWins: In and out like a shadow. Ninja victory!
Hanzo.trainerLoses: My smoke bomb fizzled... You saw right through my tricks!

Hanzo.greeting: A ninja strikes from the shadows, but my partner strikes like a falling boulder!
Hanzo.trainerWins: Swift as the wind, hard as stone. That's the ninja way!
Hanzo.trainerLoses: Caught out in the open! I need to practice my vanishing act.

Hanzo.greeting: Ninja rule number one: never fight fair. Rule number two: never lose!
Hanzo.trainerLoses: I broke rule number two... My master is going to be so mad.

Gwendolyn.greeting: En garde! My knight was built for honor, and it never retreats from a duel.
Gwendolyn.trainerWins: A fair duel, a clean victory. Rise, and face me again someday.
Gwendolyn.trainerLoses: My blade is lowered. You fought with real valor today.

Gwendolyn.greeting: Chivalry isn't dead. It just got an upgrade. Shall we cross blades?
Gwendolyn.trainerWins: Victory with honor! That's the code I live by.
Gwendolyn.trainerLoses: Defeated, but with honor intact. I salute you.

Gwendolyn.greeting: An Ace Trainer's duty is to protect the weak and topple the strong. You're the strong one, right?
Gwendolyn.trainerWins: The strong have fallen. My oath is fulfilled.
Gwendolyn.trainerLoses: You toppled me fair and square. My knightly pride stings a bit.

Sylvie.greeting: The forest has its own guardians. Mine wields a blade of leaves from a future you can't imagine.
Sylvie.trainerWins: One for all, and all of you defeated! The forest is safe.
Sylvie.trainerLoses: My blade dulled before yours did. The forest will grow back stronger.

Sylvie.greeting: A swordswoman of the woods never flinches. Draw your weapon!
Sylvie.trainerWins: Clean cuts, every one of them. Swordplay is an art.
Sylvie.trainerLoses: Disarmed! Your swordsmanship is beyond mine today.

Sylvie.greeting: Leaves fall, blades flash, and the duel is over before you blink.
Sylvie.trainerWins: Did you blink? That's when you lost.
Sylvie.trainerLoses: I blinked first. Well fought, truly.

Regina.greeting: Kneel before the crown! My team rules this tree, and their queen rules them.
Regina.trainerWins: Long live the queen! You may leave the throne room now.
Regina.trainerLoses: Dethroned? Unthinkable... but you've earned the crown today.

Regina.greeting: Royalty demands respect, and respect is earned in battle. Show me yours.
Regina.trainerWins: My court is pleased. Your audience with the queen is over.
Regina.trainerLoses: The crown is heavy, and today it slipped. Well played, challenger.

Regina.greeting: A crown of steel, a mind like a blade. Few are worthy to face my court.
Regina.trainerWins: Unworthy, as expected. Next challenger, please.
Regina.trainerLoses: Worthy after all. My court will speak your name with respect.

Lillie.greeting: I made up my mind to be strong. This look is my promise. Please, battle me with everything you have!
Lillie.trainerWins: I did it! I'm not the girl who used to hide behind everyone anymore.
Lillie.trainerLoses: You're amazing, as always. I'll keep training until I can stand beside you.

Lillie.greeting: Professor Kukui says battles teach you about yourself. I'd like to learn a lot today!
Lillie.trainerWins: That was a good lesson, wasn't it? For both of us, I hope.
Lillie.trainerLoses: I learned plenty. Mostly that I still have a long way to go!

Lillie.greeting: I've studied every page of my notebook for this. I won't freeze up. Not this time!
Lillie.trainerWins: My notes were right! I'll have to write this battle down.
Lillie.trainerLoses: Hmm... I'll need a whole new page for everything I got wrong.

Hau.greeting: Woo! A battle at the top of the tree! Win or lose, we're grabbing malasadas after, right?
Hau.trainerWins: Yeah! That was awesome! Malasadas are on you, though!
Hau.trainerLoses: Aw man! You're too good. Malasadas will cheer me up!

Hau.greeting: Tutu always says battles should be fun. So let's have the most fun ever!
Hau.trainerWins: Ha! Tutu would be proud. I gotta tell him all about it!
Hau.trainerLoses: You beat me again! I'm not even mad, that was a blast!

Hau.greeting: I'm gonna be a kahuna someday. Beating you would be a good start!
Hau.trainerWins: One step closer to kahuna! Thanks for the practice!
Hau.trainerLoses: Guess I've still got a lot to learn before I'm a kahuna. Rematch soon!

Lana.greeting: I caught a fish this big once. Okay, maybe not that big. But this battle is no fish story!
Lana.trainerWins: Reeled in! You were a pretty good catch, though.
Lana.trainerLoses: The big one got away. That's okay, there's always another cast.

Lana.greeting: Shh... The water's calm. That's when the biggest bites happen.
Lana.trainerWins: Hook, line and sinker. Just like I planned.
Lana.trainerLoses: You snapped my line clean through. I'll get a stronger one.

Lana.greeting: My little sisters are watching, so I can't lose. That's not a tall tale, by the way.
Lana.trainerWins: I won! My sisters will want me to tell this story a hundred times.
Lana.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll tell my sisters a slightly different version of this one...

Marley.trainerLoses: ...I lost. ...But I'm glad it was you.

Marley.greeting: ...I don't talk much. My team talks for me.
Marley.trainerLoses: ...They had nothing left to say. ...Neither do I.

Marley.greeting: ...Battle Zone. Fight Area. ...This tree is quieter. I like it.
Marley.trainerLoses: ...Not so quiet now. ...You're loud in battle.

Celeste.greeting: Speed wins battles. I'll be three moves ahead before you've picked your first.
Celeste.trainerWins: Three moves ahead, like I said. Try to keep up next time.
Celeste.trainerLoses: You outpaced me? That almost never happens. Almost.

Celeste.greeting: Every Ace Trainer studies the stars of the battle world. Tonight, I'm the brightest one here.
Celeste.trainerWins: Shooting stars fall fast. So did you.
Celeste.trainerLoses: Eclipsed... I'll shine brighter next time.

Celeste.greeting: You've climbed past battle 100? Impressive... and kind of cute. Win, and maybe I'll give you my number.
Celeste.trainerWins: No number for you today. Train harder, and maybe I'll reconsider.
Celeste.trainerLoses: Fine, you earned it. Don't make me wait too long for that call.

Juliet.greeting: Slow and steady? No. Slow and devastating. Let me twist the room around.
Juliet.trainerWins: When the room turns, so does the battle. You never stood a chance.
Juliet.trainerLoses: You won even in my twisted room... Remarkable.

Juliet.greeting: Patience is my weapon. I'll wait for the perfect moment, then strike all at once.
Juliet.trainerWins: Patience rewarded. Thank you for waiting so politely.
Juliet.trainerLoses: I waited too long. Lesson learned.

Juliet.greeting: Wherefore art thou, my perfect rival? Oh, there you are. Shall we make this a romance or a tragedy?
Juliet.trainerWins: A tragedy, I'm afraid. Parting is such sweet sorrow.
Juliet.trainerLoses: A romance after all! You've swept me off my feet, challenger.

Paige.greeting: Hear that? Rain on the leaves. When it pours, my team floods the field.
Paige.trainerWins: Washed away! Grab an umbrella on your way out.
Paige.trainerLoses: The storm passed you right by. Unbelievable.

Paige.greeting: Forecast for this battle: heavy showers and a guaranteed loss for you.
Paige.trainerWins: Forecast confirmed. I'm never wrong about the weather.
Paige.trainerLoses: My forecast failed. Clear skies for you, I guess.

Paige.greeting: Want to share my umbrella? Only if you can beat me first. Fair warning: I don't lose.
Paige.trainerWins: Guess you're walking home in the rain. I'd have shared, you know.
Paige.trainerLoses: Okay, okay, you can share my umbrella. Just stand a little closer.

Aurora.greeting: Hail, frost and a veil of northern lights. My team was built for the cold, and so was I.
Aurora.trainerWins: Frozen in place. That's the north wind for you.
Aurora.trainerLoses: The ice cracked... and you walked right through it.

Aurora.greeting: The colder it gets, the sharper I battle. Let's bring the temperature down.
Aurora.trainerWins: Chilled to the bone. Bundle up next time.
Aurora.trainerLoses: You melted my whole strategy. How embarrassing.

Aurora.greeting: They say I'm cold, but you might just warm me up. Prove it in battle, okay?
Aurora.trainerWins: Still cold. Maybe a rematch will warm things up between us.
Aurora.trainerLoses: Okay, you've definitely warmed me up. My cheeks are burning.

Vivian.greeting: The sun is shining on my side of the field. You might want sunglasses.
Vivian.trainerLoses: Clouds rolled in on my sunny day. Rude, but fair.

Vivian.greeting: Bright skies, blazing fields, blooming flowers. My team thrives in the light.
Vivian.trainerWins: Everything grows best in the sun. Including my win streak.
Vivian.trainerLoses: My garden wilted under your heat. Impressive.

Vivian.greeting: Is it the sun, or is it getting warm because you walked in? Let's find out.
Vivian.trainerWins: Must've been the sun after all. Better luck next summer, sweetie.
Vivian.trainerLoses: Definitely you, then. I need a cold drink and a minute to recover.

Seraphina.greeting: Grace, elegance and a touch of magic. That's how a lady battles.
Seraphina.trainerWins: Gracefully done, if I may say so myself.
Seraphina.trainerLoses: Oh my, I've broken a nail. And lost. How terribly rude.

Seraphina.greeting: My team sparkles brighter than any jewel in my collection. Shall I show you?
Seraphina.trainerWins: Dazzled you, didn't I? They always are.
Seraphina.trainerLoses: You outshone me. I didn't think that was possible.

Seraphina.greeting: Oh, aren't you charming? I usually make challengers blush. Let's see if you're the exception.
Seraphina.trainerWins: There's that blush. Don't worry, it suits you.
Seraphina.trainerLoses: Now I'm the one blushing. Well played, darling.

Delphine.greeting: The sea is graceful and merciless at once. So is my team.
Delphine.trainerWins: Swept out to sea. Do swim back for a rematch.
Delphine.trainerLoses: The tide turned against me. It happens to the best of us.

Delphine.greeting: I spend my mornings on the beach and my evenings at the top of this tree. Both are breathtaking.
Delphine.trainerWins: Breathtaking, wasn't it? I do love a good view.
Delphine.trainerLoses: That was the most breathtaking loss I've ever had.

Delphine.greeting: You have lovely eyes, you know. Shame I'll have to make them water a little.
Delphine.trainerWins: Here, take my handkerchief. You did look lovely trying.
Delphine.trainerLoses: My, my. Skilled and charming. Call me sometime, won't you?

Esmeralda.greeting: Beautiful things are often poisonous. Consider yourself warned.
Esmeralda.trainerWins: I did warn you. Beauty bites.
Esmeralda.trainerLoses: Immune to my poison? How curious.

Esmeralda.greeting: Darkness suits me better than any gown. Let me show you why.
Esmeralda.trainerWins: Lost in the dark. It happens to everyone eventually.
Esmeralda.trainerLoses: You found the light in my darkness. Annoying.

Esmeralda.greeting: Careful, darling. Get too close and you might fall for me. Many have.
Esmeralda.trainerWins: Another heart broken. I really should feel worse about it.
Esmeralda.trainerLoses: You stole the win and maybe something else. Hmph, don't look so smug.

Margaux.greeting: Refined steel and ancient dragons. My collection is the finest in the Battle Tree.
Margaux.trainerWins: Exquisite, wasn't it? Quality always wins.
Margaux.trainerLoses: You've scratched my finest pieces. Unforgivable... and impressive.

Margaux.greeting: A true lady never raises her voice. She lets her team do the shouting.
Margaux.trainerWins: There, not a single hair out of place.
Margaux.trainerLoses: I'm raising my voice now. You beat me fair and square!

Margaux.greeting: I only accept dates from trainers who beat me. Lucky for me, nobody ever has.
Margaux.trainerWins: Still undefeated, and still single. Perhaps next time?
Margaux.trainerLoses: Well, that's a first. I suppose I owe you dinner now.

Camille.greeting: I already know how this battle ends. Would you like me to spoil it for you?
Camille.trainerWins: Exactly as I foresaw. Shall I tell your fortune next?
Camille.trainerLoses: My visions failed me. You must be something special.

Camille.greeting: Spirits whisper to me, and minds open like books. Yours is an easy read.
Camille.trainerWins: An open book, cover to cover. Thank you for the read.
Camille.trainerLoses: You hid a chapter from me. Clever.

Camille.greeting: I read your mind just now. You were thinking about me, weren't you? Don't deny it.
Camille.trainerWins: I knew you'd lose. I also know you'll come back to see me.
Camille.trainerLoses: I didn't see that coming... or the way you smiled. Come back soon.

Isabella.greeting: Passion burns brightest at the top. Feel the heat of my team!
Isabella.trainerWins: Burned to a crisp! Passion always wins.
Isabella.trainerLoses: You doused my fire. I need to rekindle my spirit.

Isabella.greeting: Every battle is a dance of fire. Shall we tango?
Isabella.trainerWins: You missed a step, and the flames caught you.
Isabella.trainerLoses: You led the dance beautifully. I'm almost flattered.

Isabella.greeting: You've got a spark in your eyes. Let's see if it can survive my flames, hot stuff.
Isabella.trainerWins: Too much heat for you, hot stuff? I'll go easier next time. Maybe.
Isabella.trainerLoses: Now I'm the one getting burned. You're trouble, aren't you?

Odette.greeting: Like a swan on a still lake, I glide above the battle. Watch closely.
Odette.trainerWins: A graceful finish. Do clap if you liked the performance.
Odette.trainerLoses: My wings faltered. Even swans stumble sometimes.

Odette.greeting: Ballet taught me balance. My team learned it from me.
Odette.trainerWins: Perfect balance, perfect victory. Bravo to me.
Odette.trainerLoses: You knocked me off balance. Impressive footwork.

Odette.greeting: Shall we waltz across the battlefield? I'll lead. Try not to step on my feet.
Odette.trainerWins: You stepped on my feet, darling. But you're cute, so I'll forgive you.
Odette.trainerLoses: You led after all... and I didn't mind one bit. One more dance?

Percival.greeting: A knight answers every challenge. Draw your blade, and let's see whose resolve is sharper!
Percival.trainerWins: Steel tested, resolve proven. Train hard, and challenge me again.
Percival.trainerLoses: I yield. Your blade was sharper than mine today.

Percival.greeting: My partner came back from the future with a blade of light. I intend to be worthy of it.
Percival.trainerWins: Worthy, today at least. The future and I fought as one!
Percival.trainerLoses: Not worthy yet. I'll keep training until I am.

Percival.greeting: Honor first, then victory. If I'm lucky, both.
Percival.trainerWins: Honor and victory, both! A rare and splendid day.
Percival.trainerLoses: Honor intact, victory lost. I'll take that trade... this time.

Elio.greeting: Alola! I'm the first Champion Alola ever had. I still remember every trial on the way to the top.
Elio.trainerWins: Every trial taught me something. Today, that lesson was you!
Elio.trainerLoses: You'd have breezed through the island challenge. Alola, new rival!

Elio.greeting: Hau taught me to battle with a smile, and Lillie taught me to be brave. Ready to see both?
Elio.trainerWins: Smiling and brave, just like they taught me. Thanks for the battle!
Elio.trainerLoses: Still smiling! Hau would say that's the most important part.

Elio.greeting: I've crossed Ultra Wormholes and climbed Mount Lanakila. This tree is just one more summit.
Elio.trainerWins: Another summit reached! The view from up here never gets old.
Elio.trainerLoses: Looks like this summit belongs to you. I'll climb back up.

Kris.greeting: I chased a legend across all of Johto once. Compared to that, catching up to you will be easy!
Kris.trainerWins: Caught you! Johto's roads taught me never to slow down.
Kris.trainerLoses: You slipped away like the north wind... I'll catch you next time.

Kris.greeting: From New Bark Town to the Indigo Plateau, my team and I never backed down. Let's go!
Kris.trainerWins: New Bark Town spirit wins again!
Kris.trainerLoses: Wow... You'd fit right in at the Indigo Plateau.

Kris.greeting: I keep my radio tuned to the Johto charts while I battle. Got a beat in your step?
Kris.trainerWins: Perfect rhythm! That one's going straight to the top of the charts.
Kris.trainerLoses: You kept the better beat. I'll retune and try again!

Brendan.greeting: My dad's Professor Birch, so I've been doing fieldwork since I could walk. Let's study your strength!
Brendan.trainerWins: Data recorded: my team wins! Dad's going to love this report.
Brendan.trainerLoses: Data recorded: you're incredible. That's going in my field notes.

Brendan.greeting: I've seen Hoenn's land and sea clash and settle down. A little battle like this won't faze me.
Brendan.trainerWins: Calm as the ocean after the storm. Good battle!
Brendan.trainerLoses: Okay, that one fazed me a little. You're strong!

Brendan.greeting: Littleroot Town's finest, reporting for battle! Don't hold back on my account.
Brendan.trainerWins: Littleroot pride! Thanks for not holding back.
Brendan.trainerLoses: Littleroot's finest got outdone today. Respect!

May.greeting: I'm Professor Birch's daughter, and I've charted every route in Hoenn! Let's see where this leads.
May.trainerWins: New entry for the map: my victory! Thanks for the adventure!
May.trainerLoses: You're off my map entirely! What a trainer!

May.greeting: Battles are like Contests to me: beauty, cleverness and a big finish. Ready for my big finish?
May.trainerWins: And that's the big finish! Take a bow with me!
May.trainerLoses: You stole the show! I'll practice my finale.

May.greeting: Brendan always says I'm reckless. I prefer to call it fearless!
May.trainerWins: Fearless pays off! Don't tell Brendan I said that.
May.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe a little reckless. Don't tell Brendan!

Dawn.greeting: No need to worry! My team's been polished for Contests and battles alike.
Dawn.trainerWins: Polished to perfection! See? No need to worry.
Dawn.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe a little need to worry. You're amazing!

Dawn.greeting: Twinleaf Town girl, all grown up! Let's make this battle sparkle.
Dawn.trainerWins: Sparkling finish! Twinleaf Town would be proud.
Dawn.trainerLoses: You outshone me. That's a first since Twinleaf!

Dawn.greeting: I've helped Professor Rowan fill the Sinnoh Pokédex. Let's add your team to my notes!
Dawn.trainerWins: Notes complete! Your team was fascinating.
Dawn.trainerLoses: I need a lot more notes on you. Wow.

Rosa.greeting: Lights, camera, battle! I've starred in plenty of Pokéstar Studios films. This is my best scene yet.
Rosa.trainerWins: That's a wrap! Best take of my career.
Rosa.trainerLoses: Cut! You stole the spotlight right out from under me.

Rosa.greeting: Aspertia City's own! Cheren was my first Gym Leader, and I still follow his lessons.
Rosa.trainerWins: Lesson learned and applied! Cheren would be proud.
Rosa.trainerLoses: Looks like I need a refresher course from Cheren.

Rosa.greeting: Hugh always charges in. Me? I read the script first. Let's see if I've read yours.
Rosa.trainerWins: I read your script cover to cover! Great performance, though.
Rosa.trainerLoses: You went off-script on me! Impressive improvisation.

Gloria.greeting: The whole stadium's watching, so let's give them a match to remember! Galar's Champion is ready.
Gloria.trainerWins: The crowd goes wild! Thanks for a match worth remembering.
Gloria.trainerLoses: Even Champions lose sometimes. The crowd loved you!

Gloria.greeting: Hop and I left Postwick on the same day. He's a professor now, and I'm the Champion. Impress me!
Gloria.trainerWins: Impressed? Maybe. Beaten? Definitely! Good match.
Gloria.trainerLoses: Consider me impressed. I'll tell Hop all about you.

Gloria.greeting: Nothing beats a camp curry after a hard battle. Let's work up an appetite!
Gloria.trainerWins: Appetite worked up! Fancy some curry? My treat.
Gloria.trainerLoses: I've lost my appetite... no, wait, I'm starving. Curry?

Bronson.greeting: Hear that rumble? That's not the weather. My partner remembers a storm older than any mountain.
Bronson.trainerWins: The ancient storm rolls on, and you're caught in it.
Bronson.trainerLoses: Even ancient storms pass. You weathered this one well.

Bronson.greeting: Patience. Thunder always follows the flash. You'll understand when it reaches you.
Bronson.trainerWins: There it is. The thunder always arrives.
Bronson.trainerLoses: The flash came, but the thunder never did. Hm.

Bronson.greeting: Dragons and lightning, as old as the first rain. Brace yourself, challenger. It's going to be loud.
Bronson.trainerWins: Loud, wasn't it? Ha! My ears are ringing too.
Bronson.trainerLoses: Quiet now. You silenced the whole storm.

Ignatius.greeting: Feel that heat? My partner's fury burned long before this tree ever grew. Let's see if you can stand it!
Ignatius.trainerWins: Scorched! That's what primal fire does!
Ignatius.trainerLoses: You stood in the fire and didn't flinch. I respect that!

Ignatius.greeting: I don't do calm. I don't do careful. I do FIRE, and lots of it!
Ignatius.trainerWins: Lots of fire, like I promised! Hah!
Ignatius.trainerLoses: Too much fire, not enough sense. Lesson learned... maybe.

Ignatius.greeting: The sun's out and my blood's boiling! Perfect battling weather!
Ignatius.trainerWins: Boiling blood, blazing win! What a day!
Ignatius.trainerLoses: My blood's cooled off. You did that. Impressive.

Delta.greeting: Rain wakes old things. My partner walked out of a river that dried up ages ago. Let's see where the current goes.
Delta.trainerWins: The current took us to victory. It usually does.
Delta.trainerLoses: The current carried you instead. Rivers are like that.

Delta.greeting: Listen to the rain. It always knows which way the battle will flow.
Delta.trainerWins: The rain knew. It always does.
Delta.trainerLoses: The rain changed its mind. So did the battle.

Delta.greeting: Calm water, sudden flood. That's how I battle. Ready?
Delta.trainerWins: Calm, then flood. You didn't see it coming.
Delta.trainerLoses: You stayed above the flood. Nicely done.

Tate.greeting: Hehehe! Did you think you'd face us one at a time?
We can feel each other's thoughts...

Liza.greeting: Our teamwork is out of this world!

Tai.greeting: Me and Matt, together again! Courage and Friendship, just like old times on File Island!
Tai.trainerWins: See, Matt? Charging in works! ...With you covering me, anyway.
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, that one's on me. Matt, don't say it.

Tai.greeting: Our partners fought side by side to save two worlds. One tree's nothing! Right, Matt?
Tai.trainerWins: Two worlds, one tree! Fist bump, Matt!
Tai.trainerLoses: We've lost before and come back stronger. Right, Matt?

Tai.greeting: Matt and I fought each other plenty as kids. Fighting alongside him is way better. Ready?
Tai.trainerWins: Best rivals, best friends, best team! That's us!
Tai.trainerLoses: Ugh! We'll get 'em in the rematch. I'll lead this time... again.

Matt.greeting: Try not to run ahead this time, Tai. ...Fine. Let's show them what the DigiDestined can do.
Matt.trainerWins: You ran ahead. Again. Good thing I was there. ...Nice job, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: I wasn't going to say anything, Tai. ...Your plan was terrible, though.

Matt.greeting: Two worlds, and he still forgets to plan. Stay sharp, Tai. These two are good.
Matt.trainerWins: ...Fine. One fist bump. Don't make it weird, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: Right. And next time, we follow my plan.

Matt.greeting: Tai's the sun, I'm the moon. Annoying, but it works. Let's go.
Matt.trainerWins: Don't let it go to your head, Tai. ...It was a good win.
Matt.trainerLoses: You always lead, Tai. Maybe that's the problem. ...Kidding. Mostly.

multiNote: Lines for trainers who always battle together as opponents in a Multi Battle (Tate and Liza; Tai and Matt): the same set index is used for both, so they answer each other. Used only when they battle together.
pairsNote: Greetings for two special trainers drawn together in a Multi Battle who share a region or a type (written for this app). Each entry has three sets of lines per trainer, in matching order (the same set for both, so they answer each other): a greeting and both closing remarks, all about battling together (closing remarks added 2026-10-19; three sets instead of one, 2026-10-23, on request). To add a pair, add an entry with both trainers' names and three sets for each. The Elite Four and Champions (added 2026-10-10) also greet partners they have a relationship with (Koga and Janine, Lance and Clair, Wallace and Juan, Flint and Volkner, Iris and Drayden...), other Champions, and a few kindred spirits (Siebold with the Striaton chefs and Mallow, Diantha with Brycen, Kukui with Crasher Wake; and Mallow with every one of the younger female Gym Leaders, added 2026-10-19 on request). The evil teams' leaders and admins (added 2026-10-11) follow the region rule too, plus Giovanni with his Rocket Executives; trainers with two versions (Archie, Maxie) are listed by their key ("Archie (ORAS)") and never paired with themselves. The younger female Gym Leaders (Misty, Erika, Sabrina, Janine, Whitney, Jasmine, Clair, Roxanne, Flannery, Winona, Gardenia, Maylene, Candice, Elesa, Skyla, Roxie; added 2026-10-18, on request) greet each other too, as friends, whatever their region or type. Lillie, Hau, Lana and Marley (added 2026-10-22, on request) follow the region rule (Lana also the Water specialists), and Lillie, Lana and Marley join the young female trainers' circle (the 16 Gym Leaders and Mallow) and greet each other. Courtney only teams up with female trainers (on request, 2026-10-19), so her pair lines with male characters were removed.

Brock.greeting: Misty and I go way back. Pewter and Cerulean, rock and water. We know each other's moves by heart.
Brock.trainerWins: Moves we know by heart, and a win we earned together. Nice work, Misty!
Brock.trainerLoses: We knew each other's moves by heart. Guess you learned them too.

Brock.greeting: Misty and I used to travel the whole region together. Old habits: I'll set up camp, she'll start the argument.
Brock.trainerWins: Just like old times! And not a single argument. Well, one.
Brock.trainerLoses: We lost, but we're still a great team. Right, Misty? Misty?

Brock.greeting: My rocks hold the line, Misty's waves crash over the top. Pewter and Cerulean have a plan.
Brock.trainerWins: The plan worked! Solid rock, crashing waves. Textbook.
Brock.trainerLoses: The plan held for a while. Then you washed right over it.

Misty.greeting: Brock, if you start flirting with the Pokémon Center nurse mid-battle, I'm soaking you myself!
Misty.trainerWins: Not one soaking needed! Brock behaved, and we won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Fine, we lost. And no, Brock, it wasn't the nurse's fault.

Misty.greeting: Brock still cooks for me before every big battle. If we lose, I'm blaming the stew.
Misty.trainerWins: We won! The stew was perfect, Brock. Don't let it go to your head.
Misty.trainerLoses: Okay, that was not the stew's fault. That was all you, challenger.

Misty.greeting: Brock says rock and water is a classic combo. For once, I agree with him!
Misty.trainerWins: Classic combo, classic win! Write that down, Brock.
Misty.trainerLoses: Fine, maybe not so classic. Don't say it, Brock.

Brock.greeting: Surge says his Electric types will carry us. My Rock types say they'll be the ones standing at the end.
Brock.trainerWins: Rock and lightning, still standing at the end. Just like I said.
Brock.trainerLoses: My Rock types didn't stand at the end this time. You earned that one.

Brock.greeting: Surge keeps calling me a recruit. I'm a Gym Leader, Lieutenant. Let's both act like it.
Brock.trainerWins: Mission complete, Lieutenant. Even you have to admit I pulled my weight.
Brock.trainerLoses: Retreat isn't my style, but you earned this one.

Brock.greeting: Pewter's walls and Vermilion's thunder. Whatever gets past one runs right into the other.
Brock.trainerWins: Nothing got past! Not the walls, not the thunder.
Brock.trainerLoses: Something got past both. That something was you.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Hey, kid! Pewter's rock wall and Vermilion's lightning, together. Your team won't know what hit it!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Told ya, kid! Rock wall and lightning! Your team never knew what hit it!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! Even rock and lightning can crumble. Good fight, kid!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Rock-solid defense and shock-and-awe offense! That's how we won battles back in my unit!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Textbook operation! Brock, you'd make a fine soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: We got outmaneuvered, soldier. Back to boot camp for both of us!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Brock, keep 'em busy behind that rock wall. I'll handle the fireworks!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Boom! Fireworks delivered! Nice cover, Brock!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Fireworks fizzled! Good fight, kid.

Brock.greeting: Erika keeps watering the plants by the stairs. Rock and Grass get along better than you'd think.
Brock.trainerWins: Rock and Grass, getting along just fine. Thanks for the teamwork, Erika.
Brock.trainerLoses: Rock and Grass couldn't hold you back. Impressive.

Brock.greeting: Erika brought tea for the whole team. Celadon hospitality and Pewter grit, ready to go.
Brock.trainerWins: We won, and the tea's still warm. Perfect timing, Erika.
Brock.trainerLoses: We lost, but the tea's still good. Want some? You earned it.

Brock.greeting: Erika fell asleep on the bench, so I'll do the greeting. She's ready, trust me.
Brock.trainerWins: She woke up just in time to win. That's Erika for you!
Brock.trainerLoses: She's awake now... and a little disappointed. Good battle.

Erika.greeting: Brock offered to carry my flower arrangements up the tree. Such a sturdy gentleman. Now, shall we?
Erika.trainerWins: A sturdy gentleman and a quiet garden. A lovely win, Brock.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh my. Even sturdy gentlemen fall sometimes. Shall we rest?

Erika.greeting: Brock says flowers can grow between stones. I think that describes our team rather well.
Erika.trainerWins: Flowers between stones, blooming beautifully. Thank you, Brock.
Erika.trainerLoses: Even stones can't shield every flower. You battled splendidly.

Erika.greeting: Brock is so dependable. I could rest my eyes and trust him with everything. But I won't. Not today.
Erika.trainerWins: I kept my eyes open the whole time, and look! We won.
Erika.trainerLoses: I should have rested my eyes. It might have gone better. Well done.

Brock.greeting: Janine was standing behind me this whole time? Kanto's ninja is good. I'll handle the front line.
Brock.trainerWins: I held the front line, and Janine did the rest. Never even saw her.
Brock.trainerLoses: The front line broke. I'll train harder... and so will she, knowing Janine.

Brock.greeting: Janine says a good ninja is never seen. Good thing I'm big enough to block your view.
Brock.trainerWins: You never saw her coming, did you? Neither did I.
Brock.trainerLoses: You saw right through both of us. That's rare.

Brock.greeting: Kanto's quietest Leader and its sturdiest. You'll hear nothing and break against everything.
Brock.trainerWins: Silent and sturdy wins the day. Great work, Janine.
Brock.trainerLoses: Sturdy, silent... and beaten. You're something else.

Janine.greeting: Brock never even noticed me. Kanto's rock is strong, but my poison strikes from the shadows!
Janine.trainerWins: The shadows struck true! Brock never knew I was there, and neither did you!
Janine.trainerLoses: You saw through the shadows. Father would be impressed. I'm annoyed.

Janine.greeting: Brock's the wall, I'm the shadow behind it. You'll be too busy with the rocks to notice me.
Janine.trainerWins: Hah! Never noticed me, did you? Nice wall, Brock!
Janine.trainerLoses: You spotted me... Father would make me train twice as hard for that.

Janine.greeting: Brock promised not to get in my way. I promised not to poison him by accident. Deal's a deal!
Janine.trainerWins: Deal kept, battle won! No accidents!
Janine.trainerLoses: Deal kept, battle lost. At least nobody got poisoned... on our side.

Brock.greeting: Sabrina says she already knows how this ends. As a Kanto Leader, I prefer to earn it the hard way.
Brock.trainerWins: We earned it the hard way, Sabrina. Even if you saw it coming.
Brock.trainerLoses: Sabrina, did you see THAT coming? ...Don't answer.

Brock.greeting: Sabrina won't tell me how this ends. Says it would ruin the fun. Fine by me.
Brock.trainerWins: Turns out it ends with us winning. I like that ending.
Brock.trainerLoses: Sabrina knew, didn't she? She could have warned me.

Brock.greeting: Rock-hard defense and a mind that sees every move. Kanto's covered from every angle.
Brock.trainerWins: Every angle covered! Thanks, Sabrina.
Brock.trainerLoses: Every angle but one. You found it.

Sabrina.greeting: Brock's defense and my foresight. I have seen this battle, and Kanto does not lose it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: As foreseen. Kanto does not lose this battle.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: My foresight failed. Brock's way, the hard way, it seems.

Sabrina.greeting: Brock asked me not to look ahead. I will respect his wish... mostly.
Sabrina.trainerWins: I did not need to look ahead. Brock's defense was enough.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: I glimpsed this ending and chose not to tell him. He took it well.

Sabrina.greeting: Brock's strength is simple and honest. My power is neither. Together, we are complete.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Simple strength and hidden power. A fine balance.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Our balance tipped toward you today. Impressive.

Brock.greeting: Blaine asked me a quiz question on the way up. I got it wrong. Let's hope my battling goes better.
Brock.trainerWins: Battling went better than the quiz! Thanks, Blaine.
Brock.trainerLoses: Wrong answer on the quiz, wrong moves in battle. Rough day.

Brock.greeting: Blaine's been heating up the rocks on my side of the field. Says it's for extra damage.
Brock.trainerWins: Extra damage delivered! Thanks, Blaine.
Brock.trainerLoses: Extra damage, but not enough. You're tough.

Brock.greeting: Blaine says fire and rock were made together in the same volcano. That makes us family, I guess.
Brock.trainerWins: Volcano family wins! I'll take it, Blaine.
Brock.trainerLoses: Even volcanic family can lose. Well battled.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Brock's rocks don't melt, but my fire will melt your hopes! Kanto's quiz is in session!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz complete! Your hopes melted, just like I said!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! You answered my quiz correctly. Bravo, challenger!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Brock, you're the only Leader who knows my volcano's ground is solid rock! Quiz bonus!
Blaine.trainerWins: Bonus points for both of us! Another quiz victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Wrong answer for both of us! Hah! Next round's mine!

Blaine.greeting: Quiz! What's harder than Brock's rocks and hotter than my flames? Nothing! Let's battle!
Blaine.trainerWins: Correct answer: nothing! Hah! What a team!
Blaine.trainerLoses: New answer: you! I'll have to rewrite my quizzes!

Brock.greeting: I'm teaming up with Giovanni? Viridian's Gym Leader... and Team Rocket's boss. Just this once.
Brock.trainerWins: A win's a win... even with Team Rocket's boss. Just this once, though.
Brock.trainerLoses: Losing with Giovanni. I'm not sure which part I like least.

Brock.greeting: Giovanni and I run Gyms an hour apart. I'll keep an eye on him and an eye on you.
Brock.trainerWins: Kept both eyes open, and we won. Don't get used to it, Giovanni.
Brock.trainerLoses: Kept both eyes open, and still lost. Good battle.

Brock.greeting: Viridian and Pewter, side by side. I don't trust him, but I trust our strength.
Brock.trainerWins: Strength won out. Nothing more to say, Giovanni.
Brock.trainerLoses: Strength wasn't enough. You've earned my respect.

Giovanni.greeting: The Pewter Gym Leader. Reliable, like the bedrock under Viridian. He'll do as a shield.
Giovanni.trainerWins: The bedrock held, and the challenger fell. As expected.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: My shield cracked. A rare miscalculation on my part.

Giovanni.greeting: Brock's Gym stands at the start of every journey. Mine stood at the end. Today, you face both.
Giovanni.trainerWins: The beginning and the end. You had no chance.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Even endings can surprise me. Remarkable.

Giovanni.greeting: The ground beneath Viridian, the stone of Pewter. A foundation you cannot break.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: You broke it. I may have underestimated you.

Misty.greeting: Surge, if your Electric attack hits my Water Pokémon, you're buying the whole team dinner!
Misty.trainerWins: No zaps on my team, and we won! Surge, you're off the hook for dinner.
Misty.trainerLoses: Not one hit landed on my team... from Surge. The rest? From you.

Misty.greeting: Surge promised he'd aim at the opponent this time. If he doesn't, I'm soaking his whole jacket!
Misty.trainerWins: No soaking needed! Good aim, Surge!
Misty.trainerLoses: Your jacket's safe, Surge. Our win wasn't.

Misty.greeting: Vermilion's right down the coast from Cerulean. We're practically neighbors, Surge!
Misty.trainerWins: Neighbors who win together! Nice!
Misty.trainerLoses: Neighbors who lose together. Not as nice.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Ha! Misty's afraid I'll zap her team. Don't worry, kid, I only aim at the enemy. Mostly!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Ha! Aimed at the enemy, just like I promised! Mission complete!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! You out-soldiered a soldier, kid! Respect!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Misty's team packs a punch! Just keep your splash zone away from my circuits, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Circuits dry, battle won! Great work, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Circuits dry, battle lost! Can't win 'em all!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Water conducts electricity, so Misty and I are a power plant! Ha!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Power plant at full output! Ha!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Power plant's offline! You shut us down, kid!

Misty.greeting: Erika's Grass types and my Water types? Cerulean and Celadon's cutest combo. Let's go!
Misty.trainerWins: Cerulean and Celadon's cutest combo wins again!
Misty.trainerLoses: Cutest combo, but not the strongest today. Next time!

Misty.greeting: Erika promised me flowers if we win. I'm holding her to it!
Misty.trainerWins: Flowers for me! We did it, Erika!
Misty.trainerLoses: No flowers today. Can I at least have one?

Misty.greeting: Cerulean's waves and Celadon's flowers. Pretty, and pretty dangerous!
Misty.trainerWins: Pretty dangerous, pretty victorious!
Misty.trainerLoses: Pretty... beaten. You're good!

Erika.greeting: Misty keeps my garden watered and my battles lively. Kanto's flowers bloom brightest together.
Erika.trainerWins: Watered and lively, and victorious. Kanto's garden is in full bloom.
Erika.trainerLoses: Our flowers wilted a little today. They'll bloom again.

Erika.greeting: Misty waters my garden, and my garden gives her the prettiest bouquets. It's a lovely trade.
Erika.trainerWins: The garden will bloom brighter after this. Thank you, Misty.
Erika.trainerLoses: The garden will wait for another day. Well battled.

Erika.greeting: Misty has so much energy. I'll let her take the lead, and I'll follow with grace.
Erika.trainerWins: A graceful finish to Misty's brave start.
Erika.trainerLoses: Grace alone wasn't enough today. Congratulations.

Misty.greeting: Janine snuck up on me in the lobby! I almost threw a Water Gun at her. We're on the same team, right?
Misty.trainerWins: Good thing I didn't Water Gun my own teammate! We did it!
Misty.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I should have aimed that Water Gun at you instead.

Misty.greeting: I keep checking behind me for Janine. She's there. She's always there.
Misty.trainerWins: Okay, she was there for the win, at least. Nice, Janine!
Misty.trainerLoses: She was there for the loss too. We'll get you next time!

Misty.greeting: Janine's poison and my water. Toxic tides, coming right at you!
Misty.trainerWins: Toxic tides win! Great teamwork, Janine!
Misty.trainerLoses: The tide went out. You win this one!

Janine.greeting: Misty's temper is louder than a thunderstorm. Good. It keeps you looking at her while I strike.
Janine.trainerWins: Misty kept you busy, and I struck. A perfect plan.
Janine.trainerLoses: My strike missed. Misty was loud enough, it's my fault.

Janine.greeting: Misty's splashing gives me the perfect cover. Nobody watches the ninja while the waves are crashing.
Janine.trainerWins: Nobody saw me coming! Thanks for the splash, Misty!
Janine.trainerLoses: You watched the ninja anyway. Sharp eyes.

Janine.greeting: Misty's the loudest girl in Kanto. I'm the quietest. Perfect partners!
Janine.trainerWins: Loud and quiet, a perfect win!

Misty.greeting: Sabrina gives me the chills, but she's on my side today. Saffron and Cerulean. Bring it!
Misty.trainerWins: Saffron and Cerulean, unbeatable! Sabrina, you can smile now.
Misty.trainerLoses: You beat Saffron AND Cerulean? I'm soaking myself in shame.

Misty.greeting: Sabrina doesn't talk much, but I know she's rooting for us. I think. Right, Sabrina?
Misty.trainerWins: See? She's smiling! Kind of! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: She's not smiling now. Well done, challenger.

Misty.greeting: Saffron's psychics and Cerulean's water! Nobody can read our next move!
Misty.trainerWins: Nobody read it! Except Sabrina, probably.
Misty.trainerLoses: You read it. How did you read it?

Sabrina.greeting: Misty's fire burns hotter than her Water types. I foresee her splashing you out of this battle.
Sabrina.trainerWins: I foresaw the splash. It was magnificent.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: The vision was clouded. Misty's fire wasn't enough today.

Sabrina.greeting: Misty's spirit is strong. Stronger than she knows. I will guide it toward victory.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Your spirit carried us, Misty. As I foresaw.

Sabrina.greeting: Misty's tide and my mind. One you can see coming. The other, you cannot.

Misty.greeting: Blaine's fire and my water. We'll make so much steam you won't see a thing!
Misty.trainerWins: All that steam, and you still couldn't see us coming!
Misty.trainerLoses: So much steam, and you saw right through it.

Misty.greeting: Blaine keeps calling my team a hot spring. They're Water Pokémon, Blaine, not bathwater!
Misty.trainerWins: Not bathwater, but definitely hot stuff! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe we cooled down a bit too fast.

Misty.greeting: Cinnabar's volcano and Cerulean's cape. Fire and water, the strongest opposites!
Misty.trainerWins: Strongest opposites, strongest team!
Misty.trainerLoses: Opposites attract... defeat, apparently.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Water and fire, side by side! Even my hot springs can't match Misty's temper!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire, water, and victory! What a recipe!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! My hot springs are cooler than this loss!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Misty's water and my flames make the best steam room in Kanto! Quiz: who's sweating now?
Blaine.trainerWins: You are! Hah! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: We are! Hah! Wrong answer!

Blaine.greeting: Misty's temper burns hotter than my fire! That's why she's my favorite partner!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hotter than fire, and victorious! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Even our heat couldn't melt you! Impressive!

Misty.greeting: Giovanni? You'd better not try anything funny. I'll be watching you, Team Rocket!
Misty.trainerWins: We won, Giovanni. Now hands where I can see them.
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost, and I still don't trust you, Giovanni.

Misty.greeting: I'm keeping one eye on Giovanni and one eye on you. Don't let either of us down!
Misty.trainerWins: Nobody let me down! Not even Giovanni. Shocking.
Misty.trainerLoses: You beat us, but at least Giovanni behaved.

Misty.greeting: Viridian's boss and Cerulean's tomboy mermaid. Weirdest team in Kanto, toughest too!
Misty.trainerWins: Weird and tough wins!
Misty.trainerLoses: Weird, tough, and beaten. Huh.

Giovanni.greeting: The Cerulean Gym Leader has a fiery spirit. Aim it at our opponent, and we'll get along.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Your spirit was aimed well, Cerulean. We got along after all.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Hmph. Even our alliance couldn't stop this challenger.

Giovanni.greeting: Cerulean's Gym Leader eyes me like a thief. Fair. Today, I steal only your victory.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Your victory is mine, as promised.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: You kept your victory. Well done.

Giovanni.greeting: Misty's passion and my discipline. An unusual alliance, but a dangerous one.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Not dangerous enough. You surprise me.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Erika, take a nap if you want. I'll electrify 'em before you wake up! Kanto's strongest, coming through!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Electrified 'em before you woke up, Erika! Mission accomplished!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! I couldn't electrify 'em fast enough! Wake up, Erika, we lost!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Erika moves slow, but when her team moves, it's like a jungle ambush! Respect!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Jungle ambush, lightning strike! Mission accomplished!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: We got ambushed instead! Good fight!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Celadon's garden and Vermilion's power grid. Plant some seeds, I'll provide the lightning!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: The garden's glowing! Great work, Erika!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Garden flooded, grid's down! You got us!

Erika.greeting: Lt. Surge is so loud. Still, Vermilion and Celadon make quite the bouquet. Let's battle.
Erika.trainerWins: What a lovely bouquet we made. And quite a loud one.
Erika.trainerLoses: Even our bouquet wilted. Perhaps I should have stayed awake.

Erika.greeting: Lt. Surge promised to battle quietly today. That promise lasted until the elevator.
Erika.trainerWins: He wasn't quiet, but he was effective. A lovely win.
Erika.trainerLoses: He wasn't quiet, and we lost. Still, a lovely battle.

Erika.greeting: Surge says thunderstorms help plants grow. How thoughtful of him. Shall we begin?
Erika.trainerWins: The storm helped indeed. Thank you, Lieutenant.
Erika.trainerLoses: The storm passed, and you remained. Well done.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Janine's a sneaky little ninja. Me? I come in loud, like a thunderclap. Kanto covers both!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Loud and sneaky, the perfect combo! Kanto wins!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Thunderclap couldn't drown you out, kid. Good fight!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Janine snuck past my security detail. Twice. Kid, you should be in special forces!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Special forces approved! Great op, Janine!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Mission failed! Back to the barracks!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Vermilion's thunder and Fuchsia's poison! Shock first, sting second!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Shock and sting! Perfect execution!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: They shocked and stung us back! Ha!

Janine.greeting: The Lieutenant made so much noise climbing up, they'll never notice me slipping in.
Janine.trainerWins: They never noticed me slipping in. Thank you for the noise, Lieutenant.
Janine.trainerLoses: You noticed me after all. The Lieutenant was too loud.

Janine.greeting: Surge's noise is the best distraction I've ever had. Keep shouting, Lieutenant!
Janine.trainerWins: All that shouting worked! Thanks, Lieutenant!
Janine.trainerLoses: Too much shouting. You heard us coming.

Janine.greeting: Father says the Lieutenant was a fearsome soldier. Let's see if he can keep up with a ninja!
Janine.trainerWins: He kept up! Barely. Nice battle, Lieutenant!
Janine.trainerLoses: Neither of us kept up with you. Impressive.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Saffron's right next door to Vermilion. Sabrina predicts, I electrocute. Easy mission, soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Easy mission, just like I said! Predict and electrocute!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Mission failed, soldier. Even with Sabrina's predictions!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Sabrina sees the future, I make the future loud! Saffron and Vermilion, move out!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: The future was loud and victorious! Ha!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: The future was quiet... and not ours.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Neighbors since the Magnet Train days! Sabrina, give the orders, I'll fire the shots!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Orders given, shots fired, enemy down!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Shots fired, missed the target! Good dodge, kid!

Sabrina.greeting: Surge's lightning is predictable. That is why it works so well with my power. Kanto will win.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Predictable lightning, unpredictable defeat for you. As planned.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: His lightning was predictable. So, it seems, was my plan.

Sabrina.greeting: Surge asked me what happens next. I told him: he wins, if he listens. He never listens.
Sabrina.trainerWins: He listened, for once. A rare victory.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: He did not listen. I warned him.

Sabrina.greeting: Surge's thunder is crude. My mind is precise. You will find no gap between them.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Blaine, old man! You burn 'em, I zap 'em! What's left is a pile of ashes and sparks!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Ashes and sparks, just like I promised! Great fight, old man!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! No ashes, no sparks. Just us, beaten. Good one, kid!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Blaine's been in more battles than my whole unit! Let's show 'em how veterans do it!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Veterans win again! Ha!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Veterans got schooled! Good job, kid!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Fire and lightning! The two most dangerous forces in nature, on one side!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Most dangerous team in Kanto!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Most dangerous team got disarmed! Respect!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Surge's sparks and my blaze! Quiz time: what's left of your team after this? Nothing!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz answer: nothing's left of your team! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The answer was "our team." Wrong answer for us!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Quiz for Surge: what's louder than thunder? My laugh after this win!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Correct! Listen to that laugh!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Wrong! The loudest thing is your cheering!

Blaine.greeting: Surge, my boy, if you catch my volcano on fire again, I'm docking your quiz points!
Blaine.trainerWins: No fires, full points, victory! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Full points, but no victory! Hah!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Giovanni and I go way back. Two Kanto Leaders who don't mess around. Prepare yourself, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Two Leaders who don't mess around! Told ya, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! You messed us up good, kid! Respect!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Giovanni says jump, I say how high? Just kidding! I only take orders from myself!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Mission complete! Not bad, boss!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: We got outgunned! Fair fight, kid!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Kanto's toughest Gyms: Viridian and Vermilion! You picked the wrong fight, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Wrong fight, all right! We win!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Guess it was the right fight for you!

Giovanni.greeting: Lt. Surge follows orders well. Today, my orders are simple: crush this challenger.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Orders carried out. The challenger has been crushed.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: My orders failed. Unacceptable... and impressive.

Giovanni.greeting: Surge is blunt, loud, and effective. I value effective. Let's begin.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Even effective tools fail sometimes.

Giovanni.greeting: Lt. Surge once fought in a war. Today, it's merely a battle. He'll find it easy.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Not so easy. You have skill.

Erika.greeting: Janine wanted to borrow some of my Grass Pokémon's sleep powder. I believe she has a plan.
Erika.trainerWins: Janine's plan worked beautifully. And so did my sleep powder.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh dear. The plan put us to sleep instead.

Erika.greeting: Janine asked me to teach her flower arranging. I asked her to teach me sneaking. We both failed.
Erika.trainerWins: At least we succeeded at battling. Splendid, Janine.
Erika.trainerLoses: We failed at that too, it seems. Congratulations.

Erika.greeting: Celadon and Fuchsia, two quiet cities. Our battles, however, are anything but.
Erika.trainerWins: Anything but quiet, and victorious. How lovely.
Erika.trainerLoses: Anything but quiet, and defeated. Still lovely.

Janine.greeting: Erika's flowers smell lovely. Mine smell lovely too... right before the poison sets in.
Janine.trainerWins: Lovely flowers, lovely poison, lovely victory!
Janine.trainerLoses: The poison didn't set in fast enough. I'll train harder.

Janine.greeting: Erika's sleep powder plus my poison? You'll be dreaming of losing!
Janine.trainerWins: Sweet dreams, challenger! Nice one, Erika!
Janine.trainerLoses: We're the ones who'll be dreaming of losing. Ugh.

Janine.greeting: Erika smells like flowers. I smell like smoke bombs. Opposites, but a great team!
Janine.trainerWins: Flowers and smoke! Victory!
Janine.trainerLoses: Flowers wilted, smoke cleared. You win.

Erika.greeting: Sabrina says she foresaw me falling asleep. How rude. I was merely resting my eyes. Shall we?
Erika.trainerWins: I was merely resting my eyes, and still we won. How nice.
Erika.trainerLoses: Perhaps I truly was asleep. That would explain this loss.

Erika.greeting: Sabrina told me my future holds a beautiful garden. I hope it holds a win, too.
Erika.trainerWins: The future held both! Thank you, Sabrina.
Erika.trainerLoses: The garden came true. The win, not today.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's calm and Saffron's mind. We won't even need to raise our voices.
Erika.trainerWins: Not a single raised voice, and we won.
Erika.trainerLoses: We should have raised our voices. Well done.

Sabrina.greeting: Erika's garden is calm. My mind is calm. Your defeat will be quite peaceful.
Sabrina.trainerWins: A peaceful defeat, as foreseen. For you.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: My vision of peace was... inaccurate. Hmm.

Sabrina.greeting: Erika is the only Leader who can sit with me in silence. Let's battle in peace.
Erika's flowers sway with my thoughts. They know what to do before she asks.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: They knew we would lose. I chose not to listen.

Erika.greeting: Blaine, please mind my flowers with your fire. Kanto's Leaders must work together, after all.
Erika.trainerWins: Kanto's Leaders worked together, and my flowers are unharmed. Lovely.
Erika.trainerLoses: My flowers are fine. Our pride, less so.

Erika.greeting: Blaine brought me a quiz about flowers. I answered every question. He was very surprised.
Erika.trainerWins: Every answer correct, and the battle too.
Erika.trainerLoses: One wrong answer: this battle. Well played.

Erika.greeting: Fire and flowers don't usually mix. But Blaine promised to be careful. Mostly.
Erika.trainerWins: He was careful, and we won. Thank you, Blaine.
Erika.trainerLoses: He was careful, and we still lost. Oh my.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Erika's worried about her flowers. Don't fret! I only burn challengers. Quiz time!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Only challengers burned! Quiz complete!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! A flower-friendly fire, and still we lost!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Erika's the only one who's ever aced my quiz! Let's see her ace this battle!
Blaine.trainerWins: Aced it! Hah! Brilliant!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Failed it! Hah! Even quiz champions lose!

Blaine.greeting: Erika, my dear, keep your garden clear of my flames and we'll get along just fine!
Blaine.trainerWins: Garden's safe, battle's won! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Garden's safe, battle's lost! Hah!

Erika.greeting: Giovanni... I remember Team Rocket's Game Corner in Celadon. Very well. Just for today.
Erika.trainerWins: A win for Celadon. And for Giovanni, just this once.
Erika.trainerLoses: I knew this alliance was ill-fated. Perhaps it was the Game Corner luck.

Erika.greeting: Giovanni once hid his base under Celadon. I've kept watch on him ever since.
Erika.trainerWins: Watched, and won. You behaved, Giovanni.
Erika.trainerLoses: Watched, and lost. At least he behaved.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's flowers have deep roots. Even Team Rocket couldn't pull them up.
Erika.trainerWins: Deep roots, firm victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: Deep roots, but you pulled them up anyway.

Giovanni.greeting: Celadon's Gym Leader. Elegant, and far tougher than she looks. Let's see what she can do.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Tougher than she looks, indeed. A fine result.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Even elegance can't save a poor gamble.

Giovanni.greeting: The Celadon Leader still remembers my Game Corner. Good. She knows what I can do.
Giovanni.trainerWins: She knows, and now so do you.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: You know more than I expected.

Giovanni.greeting: Erika is graceful and patient. Patience wins wars. Let's be patient with you.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Patience exhausted. Impressive.

Janine.greeting: Sabrina read my mind before I could sneak up on her. Fine. Then you'll be the one surprised!
Janine.trainerWins: Surprised? I told you you'd be the one surprised!
Janine.trainerLoses: Sabrina read your mind too, didn't she? We still lost...

Janine.greeting: Sabrina always knows where I'm hiding. Today, that's a good thing! Teamwork!
Janine.trainerWins: Teamwork works! Nice, Sabrina!

Janine.greeting: Fuchsia's poison and Saffron's psychic! You'll never see either one coming!
Janine.trainerWins: Never saw it coming!

Sabrina.greeting: Janine moves without a sound. I move without moving. Kanto's quiet Leaders are its deadliest.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Kanto's quiet Leaders are its deadliest. As I said.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: You made no sound and beat us anyway. Impressive.

Sabrina.greeting: Janine's footsteps make no sound. Her thoughts, however, are quite loud.
Janine moves in shadow, I move in thought. Neither leaves a trace.

Janine.greeting: Blaine's quizzes are so loud! Okay, Blaine, here's mine: where am I hiding? Exactly. Let's go!
Janine.trainerWins: Where am I hiding? Behind a victory! Great quiz, Blaine!
Janine.trainerLoses: I hid so well, I hid our chance to win. Oops.
