Janine.greeting: Blaine asked me to hide his quiz answers. I hid them so well, even I can't find them!
Janine.trainerWins: Found a win instead! Nice, Blaine!
Janine.trainerLoses: Lost the answers and the battle. Oops.

Janine.greeting: Fire smoke and poison smoke! You won't be able to see a thing!
Janine.trainerWins: Couldn't see a thing! Victory!
Janine.trainerLoses: You saw through the smoke! Wow!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Janine's poison and my fire. Here's a quiz: how fast can a challenger fall? Very!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz answer: very fast! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The challenger fell slower than planned. Not at all, actually!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Janine's sneakier than my trickiest question! Let's see if you can solve her!
Blaine.trainerWins: Unsolvable! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Solved! Hah! You're clever!

Blaine.greeting: Janine's poison and my fire! Quiz: what burns and stings at the same time? Us!
Blaine.trainerWins: Correct! Us! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Wrong! You! Hah! Well done!

Janine.greeting: Father worked for Giovanni once. I'll show him what Koga's daughter can do on her own!
Janine.trainerWins: Koga's daughter, winning on her own terms! Even beside Giovanni.
Janine.trainerLoses: I couldn't prove myself today. Father would say train harder.

Janine.greeting: Giovanni says Father was his best agent. I'm better. Watch and learn!
Janine.trainerWins: See? Better! Nice work, Giovanni.
Janine.trainerLoses: Not better yet. I'll keep training.

Janine.greeting: Viridian's boss and Fuchsia's ninja. Shadows and power!
Janine.trainerWins: Shadows and power win!

Giovanni.greeting: Koga's daughter. Her father served me well. Let's see if she has his talent.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Her father's talent runs deep. Well done, ninja.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: The ninja's talent wasn't enough. Nor mine, it seems.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga's daughter has his stealth and her own fire. Show me both.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Neither was enough. Interesting.

Giovanni.greeting: Janine strikes unseen. I strike with force. You'll face both at once.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Both at once, and you held. Remarkable.

Sabrina.greeting: Blaine's next quiz question: how will this battle end? I already know the answer.
Sabrina.trainerWins: The answer to the quiz: we win. I knew it all along.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: The answer was... we lose. I should have looked closer.

Sabrina.greeting: Blaine keeps trying to stump me with quizzes. I keep answering before he asks.
Sabrina.trainerWins: He asked one question too many. We won.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: He finally stumped me: how did we lose?

Sabrina.greeting: Fire's chaos and a calm mind. I will direct his flames where they belong.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Sabrina knows all my quiz answers. No fair! Still, a psychic partner's a fine thing to have!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! A psychic partner AND a win! Splendid!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Even a psychic can't answer every quiz!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Sabrina reads my mind, so I'll think about winning really hard!
Blaine.trainerWins: Thought hard, won hard! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Thought hard, lost hard! Hah!

Blaine.greeting: Sabrina, my dear, tell me the answer to this battle before it starts! No? Spoilsport!
Blaine.trainerWins: The answer was victory! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: The answer was defeat! Hah!

Sabrina.greeting: Team Rocket once took over Saffron's Silph Co. I foresaw today's alliance. I didn't like it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: I foresaw the win. I still don't like the company.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: I foresaw this alliance. I should have foreseen this loss.

Sabrina.greeting: Giovanni and I share a history neither of us enjoys. Today, we share a goal.
Silph Co. still remembers Team Rocket. I remember too. Battle well, Giovanni.

Giovanni.greeting: The Saffron Gym Leader. Her power is genuine. Together, Kanto's might is beyond your reach.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Kanto's might, beyond your reach. As I promised.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Beyond your reach, I said. Apparently not.

Giovanni.greeting: The Saffron psychic reads minds. Mine is an open book: I intend to win.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Not as I intended.

Giovanni.greeting: Psychic foresight and Viridian's force. There is no future in which you win.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: It seems there was one.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Giovanni! I quit working for Team Rocket's lab years ago! Today, we're just Kanto Leaders!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Just two Kanto Leaders, and one big win!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Rocket lab or Gym, losing still burns!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Giovanni, I still have my lab notes from those old days! Want a quiz?
Blaine.trainerWins: Quiz passed, battle won! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Quiz failed, battle lost! Hah!

Blaine.greeting: Cinnabar's volcano and Viridian's earth! The ground itself is on our side!
Blaine.trainerWins: The earth agrees! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: The earth shook... for you! Hah!

Giovanni.greeting: Blaine. Hot-tempered, but brilliant. Viridian and Cinnabar will scorch this challenger to the ground.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Scorched to the ground, as promised. Excellent.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Cinnabar and Viridian, extinguished. How disappointing.

Giovanni.greeting: Blaine's research changed history. His fire burns as brightly as ever. Let's use it.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Burned out. Unexpected.

Giovanni.greeting: Two old Kanto Leaders with long memories. You will not be forgotten, challenger.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Nor will this defeat.

Falkner.greeting: Bugsy loves Bug types. I love Flying types. Johto's first two Gyms will show you the way up!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's first two Gyms showed you the way up! Great job, Bugsy!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We showed you the way up, and you climbed right past us.

Falkner.greeting: Bugsy and I trained together as kids. He chased bugs, I chased birds. We still do!
Falkner.trainerWins: Still chasing, still winning! Nice, Bugsy!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Still chasing... you got away.

Falkner.greeting: Violet City and Azalea Town, the first steps of every Johto journey. Consider this a lesson.
Falkner.trainerWins: Lesson learned! For you, that is.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Lesson learned... for us.

Bugsy.greeting: Falkner's Flying types eat Bug types in the wild... but in battle, we're the best of friends!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Best friends in battle, and best winners too!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Even best friends lose sometimes. My research continues!

Bugsy.greeting: Falkner's birds carry my bugs over Ilex Forest. It's a great research trip!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Research complete: we win!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Research note: you're really strong.

Bugsy.greeting: Falkner's dad was a Gym Leader too. Mine wasn't, but I've got science on my side!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Science wins! Thanks, Falkner!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Science says try again. Good battle!

Falkner.greeting: Whitney's team is fearsome when she's not crying. My father taught me to soar above any trouble. Johto takes flight!
Falkner.trainerWins: No tears today, Whitney! Johto took flight!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We didn't soar today. Whitney, please don't cry... too much.

Falkner.greeting: Whitney cheered so loud on the way up, my birds took off without me. Let's battle!
Falkner.trainerWins: Cheers and wings! We won!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Even the cheering couldn't lift us. Well done.

Falkner.greeting: Goldenrod's biggest heart and Violet's highest flight. Johto soars!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto soared!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Johto landed... hard.

Whitney.greeting: Falkner's birds are so cute! Teaming up with them is gonna be super fun. No crying today!
Whitney.trainerWins: Super fun, and no crying! I told you so!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I said no crying... but I'm gonna cry a little.

Whitney.greeting: Falkner promised me a ride on his bird after this! Gotta win first!
Whitney.trainerLoses: No ride today... Can I still have a ride?

Whitney.greeting: Falkner's so serious! I'm gonna make him smile with a win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: He's not smiling... and neither am I. Waaah!

Falkner.greeting: Morty's ghosts and my birds both rule the Johto skies. We'll show you the mystic heights!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's skies are ours! Mystic heights reached!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We didn't reach the heights today. My father would want me to try again.

Falkner.greeting: Morty says the Tin Tower's legend once flew over Violet. I want my birds to fly that high.
Falkner.trainerWins: Higher than the tower! Great battle, Morty!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Not high enough today. Next time.

Falkner.greeting: Violet's Sprout Tower and Ecruteak's towers. Johto's skies are ours.
Falkner.trainerWins: Ours indeed!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Yours today.

Morty.greeting: Falkner's wings over Violet City, my visions over Ecruteak. Johto's skies favor us today.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto's skies favored us, as I saw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The skies changed. My visions didn't.

Morty.greeting: Falkner's birds trace the wind. My spirits trace your fate. Both point to us winning.
Morty.trainerWins: Both were right.
Morty.trainerLoses: Both were wrong. Rare.

Morty.greeting: Falkner trains in the sky, I train in the mist. You'll find no clear path.
Morty.trainerWins: No clear path for you.
Morty.trainerLoses: You found one. Impressive.

Falkner.greeting: Chuck's been doing pushups since we got here. I'll keep the skies clear while he punches!
Falkner.trainerWins: Skies clear, punches landed! What a team!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Even clear skies couldn't stop that challenger. Train harder, Chuck!

Falkner.greeting: Chuck tried to punch a gust of wind once. It didn't go well. Let's hope he punches you better.
Falkner.trainerWins: He punched well! We won!
Falkner.trainerLoses: The wind won again.

Falkner.greeting: Sky and sea training combined. Violet and Cianwood are unstoppable.
Falkner.trainerWins: Unstoppable!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Stopped. Well played.

Chuck.greeting: Falkner, your birds are tough! But can they lift boulders? Wahahah! Johto's strength, together!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Johto's strength wins! Now, pushups!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll lift a boulder to get over this one!

Chuck.greeting: Falkner's birds are fast! My fists are faster! Wahahah! Let's go!
Falkner! Do pushups with me! No? Then do them after we win!

Falkner.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types can take my Flying types' hits... so it's a good thing we're partners.
Falkner.trainerWins: Steel and Flying, a perfect pair! Thanks, Jasmine!
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds couldn't carry us this time. Sorry, Jasmine.

Falkner.greeting: Jasmine asked if my birds could see the lighthouse from up here. They can. So can our victory.
Falkner.trainerWins: We saw it! Victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We saw it, and then lost sight.

Falkner.greeting: Steel wings and real wings. Johto's skies and Johto's steel.
Falkner.trainerWins: Steel and wings win!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Steel bent, wings clipped.

Jasmine.greeting: Falkner's birds flew me from Olivine. The view from the lighthouse is nothing like this tree.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... The view from up here is lovely after a win.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... Falkner, let's fly home to Olivine.

Jasmine.greeting: Falkner flies so high. I'll stay grounded and protect him. Is that... all right?
Jasmine.trainerWins: It was all right. We won. Thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: It wasn't enough. I'm sorry, Falkner.

Jasmine.greeting: Falkner says my Steel types are like his birds' armor. That's very kind. Let's battle.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Kind words, strong battle. Thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Kind words, but not enough. Well done.

Falkner.greeting: Pryce has trained longer than I've been alive. Johto's youngest and oldest Leaders, side by side.
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's youngest and oldest, victorious!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Even with Pryce's experience, we fell. I'll keep training.

Falkner.greeting: Pryce says my birds fly too fast for the cold. I say we're fast enough to beat you.
Falkner.trainerWins: Fast enough! Thank you, Pryce.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Not fast enough. Pryce warned me.

Falkner.greeting: Winter skies and icy winds. Johto's coldest battle begins!
Falkner.trainerWins: Cold and victorious!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Frozen out. Well done.

Pryce.greeting: Young Falkner flies so freely. I remember those days. Let's show this challenger winter's chill.
Pryce.trainerWins: Winter's chill, delivered. Well flown, young Falkner.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Ah, the chill turned on us. Even old men lose.

Pryce.greeting: Falkner's father and I were friends. I'll battle beside his son with pride.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Your father lost battles too. Remember that.

Pryce.greeting: Young wings and old ice. Experience guides youth. Let's teach this challenger.

Falkner.greeting: Clair's dragons fly higher than my birds. Don't tell her I said that. Johto, take wing!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto took wing! Clair, your dragons were great... don't let that go to your head.
Falkner.trainerLoses: We were grounded. Clair will never let me hear the end of this.

Falkner.greeting: Clair says only dragons belong in the sky. I'll prove birds belong there too.
Falkner.trainerWins: Proven! Nice flying, Clair.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Not proven today. Next time.

Falkner.greeting: Blackthorn's dragons and Violet's birds. Johto's skies belong to us!
Falkner.trainerWins: Our skies!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Your skies today.

Clair.greeting: Falkner's birds are adequate. My dragons rule the skies. Johto's skies, that is. Let's go.
Clair.trainerWins: My dragons did their job. Your birds were... adequate.
Clair.trainerLoses: You beat my dragons? Unacceptable. Falkner, we train tomorrow.

Clair.greeting: Falkner's birds are tolerable. Keep them out of my dragons' flight path.
Falkner, try to keep up. My dragons don't wait for birds.
Clair.trainerWins: You kept up with my dragons. Barely, Falkner.
Clair.trainerLoses: Neither of us kept up. Ugh.

Bugsy.greeting: Whitney cried when I showed her my bug collection. But today, she's going to make you cry instead!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Whitney made you cry instead! Just like I said!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Whitney's crying, and I'm writing this loss in my research notes.

Bugsy.greeting: Whitney promised not to cry if a bug lands on her. A Bug Catcher's dream partner!
Bugsy.trainerWins: No tears, only victory! Nice, Whitney!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Some tears. Mostly mine.

Bugsy.greeting: Azalea's bugs and Goldenrod's charm! My research says we're unbeatable!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Research confirmed!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Research needs revision.

Whitney.greeting: Bugsy's bugs gave me a fright, but they're tough! Our Johto team-up is gonna be the best!
Whitney.trainerWins: The best Johto team-up ever! Yay!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Bugsy's bugs were tough, but you were tougher. Waah!

Whitney.greeting: Bugsy's bugs are kinda cute when they're winning! Let's make 'em win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: They lost... still kinda cute. Waaah!

Whitney.greeting: Bugsy knows everything about bugs. I know everything about having fun! Let's go!

Bugsy.greeting: Morty says there are ghost bugs in Ecruteak's Burned Tower. I need to research that! After this!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Johto knew your every move! Now, to the Burned Tower for research!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research was incomplete. And you knew it.

Bugsy.greeting: Morty says I'm too curious. Ghosts like curious kids! That's... comforting?
Bugsy.trainerWins: Curiosity pays off! We win!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Curiosity cost us. Hmm.

Bugsy.greeting: Azalea's forest and Ecruteak's towers. Johto's mysteries on one side!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Mystery solved: we win!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Mystery: how did we lose?

Morty.greeting: Bugsy researches everything. I research the unseen. Between us, Johto knows your every move.
Morty.trainerWins: As I saw it: Johto knew your every move.
Morty.trainerLoses: The unseen surprised even me today.

Morty.greeting: Bugsy studies the seen world. I study the unseen. Nothing escapes us.
Morty.trainerWins: Nothing escaped.
Morty.trainerLoses: You escaped. Impressive.

Morty.greeting: Bugsy's bugs gather in the dark. My ghosts live there. You'll feel right at home in defeat.
Morty.trainerWins: Exactly as my visions showed.
Morty.trainerLoses: Not as foreseen.

Bugsy.greeting: Chuck says bugs are too small to be strong. Just watch my team, Chuck! Johto power!
Bugsy.trainerWins: See, Chuck? Bugs are strong! Johto power!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Chuck, maybe bugs are too small... No! I refuse!

Bugsy.greeting: Chuck wants to wrestle a bug. I keep telling him that's not how research works!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Research and muscles! Victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Research and muscles... defeat.

Bugsy.greeting: Azalea's brains and Cianwood's brawn. Science says we're a perfect match!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Perfect match!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Imperfect match today.

Chuck.greeting: Bugsy's bugs are tougher than they look! Like a waterfall's spray. Wahahah! Let's go!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! The waterfall's spray wins! Great job, Bugsy!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! That spray dried up fast! Good fight!

Chuck.greeting: Bugsy's bugs climbed my waterfall! Tough little guys! Wahahah! Let's battle!
Bugsy! Lift weights with me after this! Your bugs can spot us!

Bugsy.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types are hard to research. They're so shiny! Let's study this battle together!
Bugsy.trainerWins: This battle's data is shiny and wonderful! We won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: The data says we lost. I'll study it anyway.

Bugsy.greeting: Jasmine said my bugs are adorable. Nobody ever says that! Let's win for them!
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won for them! Thanks, Jasmine!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost for them... sorry, bugs.

Bugsy.greeting: Steel shells and bug shells! The toughest armor in Johto!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Armor holds! Victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Armor cracked. Wow.

Jasmine.greeting: Bugsy told me all about Bug types on the way up. I... learned a lot. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I learned a lot about Bug types... and about winning. Thank you, Bugsy.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I learned something new... about losing. Let's do better next time.

Jasmine.greeting: Bugsy is very kind to his Pokémon. I like that. Let's battle gently... but firmly.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Gently and firmly, we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Gently and firmly, we lost. Well done.

Jasmine.greeting: Bugsy told me about bug armor. Steel types have armor too. We're... alike.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Alike, and victorious.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Alike, and defeated.

Bugsy.greeting: Pryce says bugs don't survive Mahogany's winters. Mine do! I bred them myself!
Bugsy.trainerWins: My bugs survived Mahogany's winter AND this battle!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Even my bred bugs couldn't survive that. I'll keep researching!

Bugsy.greeting: Pryce says I'm too young to understand winter. I've read every book on it!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Book smarts win! Thanks, Pryce!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Books didn't cover this. Hmm.

Bugsy.greeting: Ice and bugs! Okay, my bugs don't love the cold, but they love winning!
Bugsy.trainerWins: They loved it!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: They didn't love that.

Pryce.greeting: Bugsy's enthusiasm reminds me of my youth. Johto's oldest and youngest. Let's show you what we know.
Pryce.trainerWins: Johto's oldest and youngest know a thing or two. As do you, now.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We showed you what we know. You showed us more.

Pryce.greeting: Bugsy is young and eager. I was once too. Let's see what eagerness can do.
Experience and enthusiasm, together. Johto's past and future.

Bugsy.greeting: Clair says dragons outclass bugs. My research says otherwise! Johto's Gyms, together!
Bugsy.trainerWins: My research was right! Johto's Gyms, victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research needs revising... and so does Clair's opinion of me, probably.

Bugsy.greeting: Clair let me study her dragon's scales once! Best research day ever. Let's win for science!
Bugsy.trainerWins: For science! Victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: For science... defeat.

Bugsy.greeting: Dragons and bugs! My research says the combo is underrated!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Underrated and victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Underrated... still.

Clair.greeting: A bug researcher as my partner? Fine. Just stay out of my dragons' way, Bugsy.
Clair.trainerWins: My dragons won. Your bugs stayed out of the way. Good.
Clair.trainerLoses: You stayed out of my way, and still we lost. Hmph.

Clair.greeting: Bugsy keeps asking about my dragons. If we win, I'll answer one question. Just one.
Bugsy, stay behind my dragons and keep your bugs out of trouble.

Whitney.greeting: Morty's ghosts are spooky! But with them on my side, nothing can scare me. Johto's cutest Leader is here!
Whitney.trainerWins: Nothing scared me, and we won! Johto's cutest Leader wins!
Whitney.trainerLoses: The ghosts didn't scare me... but losing did! Waah!

Whitney.greeting: Morty's so mysterious! I'm gonna make him laugh today with a big win!
Goldenrod's lights and Ecruteak's spirits! Spooky and sparkly!

Morty.greeting: Whitney cried at the Burned Tower. Today, I foresee her laughing. Ecruteak and Goldenrod, together.
Morty.trainerWins: I foresaw her laughing. And so she is.
Morty.trainerLoses: I foresaw laughter. I see tears. My visions need work.

Morty.greeting: Whitney's laughter echoes through Goldenrod. Today, it echoes through victory.
Morty.trainerWins: It echoed.
Morty.trainerLoses: It faded.

Morty.greeting: Whitney's joy is a light. My ghosts are drawn to it. They'll protect her today.
Morty.trainerWins: They protected her.
Morty.trainerLoses: They tried.

Whitney.greeting: Chuck's all muscles and I'm all heart! Goldenrod and Cianwood, let's roll right over 'em!
Whitney.trainerWins: We rolled right over 'em! Goldenrod and Cianwood rule!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We got rolled over instead! Not cute!

Whitney.greeting: Chuck promised to share his snacks after the battle! I'm battling for snacks!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Can I still have snacks? Please?

Whitney.greeting: Chuck yells, I yell! Nobody's gonna hear themselves think!

Chuck.greeting: Whitney's team rolls in like a boulder down a waterfall! Wahahah! We're unbeatable!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Beaten! I'll do a thousand pushups!

Chuck.greeting: Whitney's team is tough as a boulder! Wahahah! Let's show some Johto muscle!
Whitney! Train under my waterfall! Then we'll be unbeatable!

Whitney.greeting: Jasmine and I go shopping in Goldenrod sometimes! Today, we're shopping for a win!
Whitney.trainerWins: Shopping trip complete! We bought ourselves a win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We couldn't afford a win today. Jasmine, let's go shopping to cheer up!

Whitney.greeting: Jasmine and I picked matching hair clips for today! Cute and strong!
Goldenrod and Olivine! Shopping buddies and battle buddies!

Jasmine.greeting: Whitney is my friend. She's very... energetic. I'll do my best to keep up. Let's battle.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I kept up with Whitney... and we won. Good.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I couldn't keep up. I'm sorry, Whitney.

Jasmine.greeting: Whitney says friends win together. I want that to be true. Let's... try.
Jasmine.trainerWins: It was true. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: It wasn't true today.

Jasmine.greeting: Whitney is so bright. I'll be her shield. That's what friends do.
Jasmine.trainerWins: The shield held.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The shield broke. Sorry, Whitney.

Whitney.greeting: Pryce is like a grumpy grandpa. But he's super strong! Johto's not losing today!
Whitney.trainerWins: The grumpy grandpa and me, unbeatable! Johto wins!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Johto lost?! Pryce, say something comforting! ...He won't.

Whitney.greeting: Pryce told me I'm too loud. I told him he's too quiet! We're balanced!
Goldenrod and Mahogany! Warm hugs and cold ice!

Pryce.greeting: Whitney's tears could freeze in Mahogany's cold. Let's make sure she has nothing to cry about.
Pryce.trainerWins: Nothing to cry about. Well done, Whitney.
Pryce.trainerLoses: There's crying now. I failed to prevent it.

Pryce.greeting: Whitney's energy could melt Mahogany's snow. Let's put it to use.
Young fire and old ice. You won't know whether to sweat or shiver.

Whitney.greeting: Clair's so cool and scary! I bet her dragons and my cuties make the strongest Johto team ever!
Whitney.trainerWins: The strongest Johto team ever! Told you, Clair!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Clair's mad at me now. This is the worst!

Whitney.greeting: Clair's dragons are so cool! I'm gonna be just as cool today!
Goldenrod and Blackthorn! Sweetest and fiercest!

Clair.greeting: Whitney's team is the one thing in Goldenrod I respect. Don't slow me down.
Clair.trainerWins: You didn't slow me down. ...Fine. Good job, Whitney.
Clair.trainerLoses: You slowed me down. Or the challenger was simply better.

Clair.greeting: Whitney, if you start crying mid-battle, I'm leaving you behind.
Clair.trainerLoses: Crying, and defeat. As I feared.

Clair.greeting: Whitney's tough when it counts. I'll give her that. Don't make me take it back.

Morty.greeting: Chuck punches what he can see. My ghosts strike what you can't. Johto has you surrounded.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto surrounded you, seen and unseen.
Morty.trainerLoses: We had you surrounded, and you still slipped through.

Morty.greeting: Chuck can't touch my ghosts, so he guards them instead. A thoughtful arrangement.
Morty.trainerWins: A thoughtful plan, and a win for Ecruteak and Cianwood.
Morty.trainerLoses: A thoughtful plan, undone by a thoughtful challenger.

Morty.greeting: Ecruteak's spirits and Cianwood's fists. You can't dodge both.
Morty.trainerWins: You couldn't.
Morty.trainerLoses: You did.

Chuck.greeting: Morty's ghosts give me goosebumps! But Fighting moves don't touch them... so they're perfect partners!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Perfect partners! Ghosts and fists!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Goosebumps AND a loss! Rough day!

Chuck.greeting: Morty's ghosts scare me! But they scare you more! Wahahah!
Morty! Do pushups! No? Ghosts don't do pushups? Fine! Battle time!

Morty.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types stand firm against my ghosts. Today, they stand beside them. Shall we?
Morty.trainerWins: Steel and spirit, standing firm together. A fine battle.
Morty.trainerLoses: Even standing together, we fell. Hmm.

Morty.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types are steady. My ghosts drift. Together, we hold the line.
Morty.trainerWins: The line held.
Morty.trainerLoses: The line broke.

Morty.greeting: Ecruteak's mist and Olivine's light. You'll be lost between them.
Morty.trainerWins: Lost, as planned.
Morty.trainerLoses: Found your way. Impressive.

Jasmine.greeting: Morty told me Ecruteak's legends about a rainbow-winged guardian. I hope I see it over the Olivine lighthouse someday.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... Maybe the rainbow guardian was watching over us.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... I hope the guardian didn't see that.

Jasmine.greeting: Morty told me ghost stories on the way up. I wasn't scared. Much.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Not scared, and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: A little scared now.

Jasmine.greeting: Morty sees things others can't. I hope he sees us winning.
Jasmine.trainerWins: He saw it.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: He didn't see this.

Morty.greeting: Pryce has seen many winters, and I have seen many spirits. Johto's wisdom is on our side.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto's wisdom prevailed, as I saw it would.
Morty.trainerLoses: Even Johto's wisdom couldn't see this coming.

Morty.greeting: Pryce once told me winter is a ghost of autumn. I've thought about that for years.
Morty.trainerWins: Deep thoughts, deep victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: Deep thoughts, shallow defense.

Morty.greeting: Ecruteak and Mahogany, neighbors in the mountains. Johto's old guard.
Morty.trainerWins: The old guard holds.
Morty.trainerLoses: The old guard falls.

Pryce.greeting: Morty, the Ecruteak mystic. Young, but he sees deeply. Together, we'll see this through.
Pryce.trainerWins: We saw it through, young Morty. Well done.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We didn't see it through. Perhaps I'm getting old.

Pryce.greeting: Morty's spirits are restless. Mine have been quiet for decades. Let's wake them.
Morty, the young mystic. I've seen many like you. None as gifted.

Morty.greeting: Clair's dragons are legendary in Blackthorn. In Ecruteak, we have our own legends. Let's battle.
Morty.trainerWins: Ecruteak's legends and Blackthorn's, victorious together.
Morty.trainerLoses: Our legends were outshone today.

Morty.greeting: Clair says ghosts can't stop dragons. I say they can haunt them. Let's find out.
Morty.trainerWins: Haunted and victorious.
Morty.trainerLoses: Haunted by defeat.

Morty.greeting: Ecruteak's legends and Blackthorn's dragons. Johto's oldest powers.
Morty.trainerWins: Old power wins.
Morty.trainerLoses: Old power fades.

Clair.greeting: Morty's still waiting for his rainbow legend, isn't he? Fine. I'll show you a real legend: my dragons.
Clair.trainerWins: You saw a real legend today. My dragons.
Clair.trainerLoses: A real legend lost. That's not supposed to happen.

Clair.greeting: Morty's ghosts are useful decoys. My dragons do the real work.
Morty, stop staring at the sky for your legend. Focus on this battle.

Chuck.greeting: Jasmine's from Olivine, just across the sea from Cianwood! I'll swim over to help any time!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Cianwood and Olivine, sturdy and strong!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll swim back to Cianwood and train!

Chuck.greeting: Jasmine's lighthouse guided my boat to Olivine once! I owe her one! Wahahah!
Cianwood and Olivine, across the sea! Johto's coastal power!

Jasmine.greeting: Chuck is very loud. But strong. Cianwood and Olivine's Gym Leaders will make a sturdy team.
Jasmine.trainerWins: A sturdy team, as I hoped. Thank you, Chuck.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We weren't sturdy enough today. I'm sorry, Chuck.

Jasmine.greeting: Chuck is so strong. I'll protect his back. He protects my front. That's fair.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Fair, and victorious.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Fair, and defeated.

Jasmine.greeting: Chuck brought me medicine for my lighthouse partner once. I'll repay him today.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Repaid. Thank you, Chuck.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Not repaid yet.

Chuck.greeting: Pryce trains under ice! I train under waterfalls! Johto's toughest training, combined!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Waterfalls AND ice, and still we lost!

Chuck.greeting: Pryce trains in ice! I'll train in ice too! After we win! Wahahah!
Waterfall and glacier! The toughest training in all of Johto!

Pryce.greeting: Chuck's waterfall training is impressive. Try it in Mahogany's winter, young man.
Pryce.trainerWins: Your training held up, young man. Impressive.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even ice cracks. I'll train harder, at my age.

Pryce.greeting: Chuck's discipline rivals my own. I respect a man who trains every day.
Chuck, your fists are warm. My ice is cold. Together, we'll shatter your challenger.

Chuck.greeting: Clair, your dragons are strong! But can they do a hundred pushups? Mine can! Johto power!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Pushups pay off! Johto power!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll do a thousand pushups to make up for this!

Chuck.greeting: Clair's dragons are strong! But can they lift a boulder? Wahahah!
Cianwood and Blackthorn! Fists and dragons!

Clair.greeting: Chuck's fists won't scratch my dragons. Good thing they're aimed at you today.
Clair.trainerWins: Your fists did fine. Aimed at the right target.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your fists missed, Chuck. So did my dragons.

Clair.greeting: Chuck, stop flexing and battle. My dragons are waiting.
Chuck is loud, but his fists are honest. I can respect that.
Clair.trainerWins: Chuck's fists earned my respect today.
Clair.trainerLoses: Chuck's fists earned my respect. Not a win, though.

Jasmine.greeting: Pryce is very wise. He told me Steel types can stand any winter. I'll trust him.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Pryce was right. Steel stands any winter.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Even Steel types fall in a hard winter...

Jasmine.greeting: Pryce told me cold winds can't bend steel. I'll trust his wisdom.
Jasmine.trainerWins: His wisdom was right.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: His wisdom... wasn't enough.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine's harbor and Mahogany's snow. Steady and calm.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Steady and calm wins.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Steady and calm loses.

Pryce.greeting: Jasmine is gentle, but her Steel types never bend. Johto's strongest, together.
Pryce.trainerWins: Gentle, but unbending. Johto's strongest, as I said.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even steel bends sometimes. Well fought.

Pryce.greeting: Jasmine's heart is gentle, but her resolve is steel. Let's begin.
Jasmine, stand firm. I'll handle the cold. You handle the rest.

Jasmine.greeting: Clair... looks scary. But her dragons protected me on the way up. Let's battle together.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Clair's dragons protected me again. Thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Clair... I couldn't help enough.

Jasmine.greeting: Clair is so strong. I hope I don't slow her down. I'll try my best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I didn't slow her down. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I slowed her down. I'm sorry.

Jasmine.greeting: Steel and dragons. Johto's toughest scales.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Toughest wins.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Toughest falls.

Clair.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types can take a dragon's hit. Useful. Stay behind me, Olivine.
Clair.trainerWins: You stayed behind me and we won. Good, Olivine.
Clair.trainerLoses: Even with you behind me, we fell. Annoying.

Clair.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types are sturdy. Good. My dragons need a sturdy partner.
Jasmine, you're stronger than you think. Prove it.

Pryce.greeting: Clair. Your dragons once fell to my ice. Today, they'll rise beside it. Johto stands strong.
Pryce.trainerWins: Ice and dragon, rising together. Johto stands strong.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even ice and dragons can melt away.

Pryce.greeting: Clair has grown since our last battle. Her dragons respect my ice now.
Mahogany and Blackthorn, Johto's mountain Leaders. Cold and fierce.

Clair.greeting: Pryce's ice is the only thing I've ever feared. Today, it's your problem. Let's go.
Clair.trainerWins: Pryce's ice and my dragons. Your problem, solved.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your problem became ours. How irritating.

Clair.greeting: Pryce taught me humility once. Today, I'll teach it to you.
Pryce, your ice and my dragons. A strange alliance. A strong one.

Roxanne.greeting: Brawly surfs, I study. Rustboro and Dewford are neighbors by boat, and our strategies fit together.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Studying and surfing, a winning strategy! I'll write it down.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Our strategies didn't fit after all. Back to my notes.

Roxanne.greeting: Brawly asked me to grade his battle plan. I gave it a B-plus. Let's earn the A.
Roxanne.trainerWins: We earned the A! Well done, Brawly.

Roxanne.greeting: Rustboro and Dewford. Studied strategy and raw momentum. A textbook combination.

Brawly.greeting: Roxanne's got the notes, I've got the waves! Hoenn's first two Gyms are gonna wipe you out!
Brawly.trainerWins: We wiped you out! Hoenn's first two Gyms rule!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Wiped out by the wave instead. Tough break!

Brawly.greeting: Roxanne made flashcards for this battle! I made a surfboard. Both'll come in handy!
Roxanne's a genius! Me? I just ride the biggest wave I can find! Here it comes!

Roxanne.greeting: Wattson laughs through every battle. I took notes on why it works. Hoenn's lesson starts now.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Hoenn's lesson is over. You learned it well... by losing.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The lesson turned on us. I'll take better notes.

Roxanne.greeting: Wattson told me his secret: laugh at everything. I'm still studying why it works.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Research conclusion: it works. We won.

Roxanne.greeting: Rock insulates, electricity conducts. Wattson and I complement each other scientifically.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Roxanne's the smartest Leader in Hoenn, and I'm the most electrifying! Ready?
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Even I can't laugh this one off! ...Okay, a little.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Roxanne's notes and my sparks! The perfect Hoenn experiment!
Roxanne, my dear, your rocks and my lightning will shake Mauville to its core!

Roxanne.greeting: Flannery's fire meets my Rock types' defense. According to my notes, that's an excellent pairing.
Roxanne.trainerWins: According to my notes, an excellent pairing. Confirmed!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My notes were wrong. How embarrassing.

Roxanne.greeting: Flannery asked me to help her prepare. I made her a study guide. She lost it.
Roxanne.trainerWins: She didn't need it. We won!

Roxanne.greeting: Lavaridge's fire forged Rustboro's stones. Geology says we belong together.

Flannery.greeting: Roxanne's so put together! I'm trying to be, too. Lavaridge and Rustboro, let's heat things up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Heated things up and won! Put together, just like Roxanne!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I tried to be put together... and we fell apart. Ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Roxanne's calm and I'm... not! But we're gonna rock this! Get it? Rock?
Roxanne, I promise I won't panic this time! Let's heat things up!

Roxanne.greeting: Norman is the most respected Leader in Hoenn. I studied his battles at the Trainers' School.
Roxanne.trainerWins: I learned so much from battling with Norman. And we won!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Even studying Norman's battles couldn't prepare me for that.

Roxanne.greeting: Norman's battles were required reading at the Trainers' School. Now I'm battling beside him.
Rustboro and Petalburg. Knowledge and experience. A complete curriculum.

Norman.greeting: Roxanne taught at the Trainers' School. Her students learn well. Let's give you a lesson, too.
Norman.trainerWins: A lesson well taught. Thank you, Roxanne.
Norman.trainerLoses: The lesson was ours to learn today. Well done, challenger.

Norman.greeting: Roxanne's students admire her. Let's give them something to admire today.
Norman.trainerLoses: Something to learn from. Well fought.

Norman.greeting: Roxanne, battle as you teach: with patience. I'll provide the strength.
Norman.trainerLoses: Patience and strength fell short.

Roxanne.greeting: Winona's Flying types cover the sky; my Rock types hold the ground. Hoenn has you surrounded.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Sky and ground, you had nowhere to go!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Surrounded, and you still escaped. Fascinating.

Roxanne.greeting: Winona flew me over Route 119 so I could study the weather patterns. Let's apply what I learned.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Field research, applied and confirmed. Thank you, Winona.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My weather notes didn't predict you. A new chapter, then.

Roxanne.greeting: From Rustboro's quarry to Fortree's canopy. Earth and air, studied and ready.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Earth and air, top marks for both of us.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Earth and air, and still a failing grade. Well done.

Winona.greeting: Roxanne's Rock types are sturdy, like Fortree's treetops. Let's soar to victory.
Winona.trainerWins: We soared to victory, Roxanne. Well done.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our treetops shook today. Well fought.

Winona.greeting: Roxanne explained how wind erodes stone. She makes even geology sound like poetry.
Winona.trainerWins: Wind and stone, perfectly balanced. Lovely work, Roxanne.
Winona.trainerLoses: The wind carried this one away from us. Beautifully battled.

Winona.greeting: Roxanne holds the ground so my birds never have to worry about landing.
Winona.trainerWins: A safe landing and a victory. Thank you, Roxanne.
Winona.trainerLoses: Even with steady ground below, we fell. Congratulations.

Roxanne.greeting: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace became Champion. I'd like to take notes on his battling today.
Roxanne.trainerWins: My notes on Juan's battling are complete. And so is our win!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: I took notes on how we lost. Very thorough notes.

Roxanne.greeting: Juan corrected my posture before the battle. Apparently stance matters in art and in battle.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Proper posture, proper victory. I'll note that, Juan.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Perfect posture, imperfect result. I'll study this.

Roxanne.greeting: Sootopolis is built inside a crater. I've always wanted to discuss its geology with Juan.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Geology and victory. A productive day, Juan.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: A productive discussion, an unproductive battle.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Roxanne! A scholar of stone. Let our Hoenn art, rock and water, sculpt your defeat.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a sculpture of defeat, for you! Magnificent!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our sculpture crumbled. Still, a fine piece of art.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Roxanne's precision! She calculates, I improvise. Together we are science and song!
Juan.trainerWins: Science and song in harmony! Bravo, Roxanne!
Juan.trainerLoses: Our duet missed a note. Ahh, you played yours flawlessly.

Juan.greeting: Stone shaped by water over ages. Ahh, Roxanne and I are Hoenn's slow, patient sculpture!
Juan.trainerWins: The sculpture is finished, and it is magnificent!
Juan.trainerLoses: The sculpture cracked. Ahh, you are a fine chisel.

Roxanne.greeting: Wally earned my badge, didn't he? He's grown so much. I'm happy to battle alongside him.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Wally's grown so much! We won together!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Wally, don't worry. Losing is part of learning.

Roxanne.greeting: Wally asked me for study tips. I told him: practice, review, and never give up.
Roxanne.trainerWins: You never gave up, Wally. Full marks today.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: We'll review this battle together, Wally. Chin up.

Roxanne.greeting: The first Gym of Hoenn and the boy who reached Victory Road. Proof that study pays off.
Roxanne.trainerWins: It paid off beautifully. Well done, Wally.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Study pays off eventually. Not today.

Wally.greeting: Roxanne was my very first Gym battle! Now we're partners. I want to make Hoenn proud!
Wally.trainerWins: I made Hoenn proud with Roxanne! I did it!
Wally.trainerLoses: I didn't make Hoenn proud today... I'll keep trying!

Wally.greeting: Roxanne helped me prepare with flashcards! I know every matchup by heart now!
Wally.trainerWins: The flashcards worked! Thank you, Roxanne!
Wally.trainerLoses: I need more flashcards... you were amazing!

Wally.greeting: Roxanne believed in me when I was just starting out. I won't let her down!
Wally.trainerWins: I didn't let her down! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Roxanne. I'll train even harder.

Roxanne.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain in Hoenn. I studied the Battle Frontier's records for months.
Roxanne.trainerWins: My months of study paid off! Thank you, Anabel.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Even months of study couldn't prepare me for you.

Roxanne.greeting: Anabel answered all my questions about the Battle Frontier. Now I have more questions.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Questions answered, battle won. Thank you, Anabel.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: One question remains: how did we lose?

Roxanne.greeting: A Frontier Brain and a Trainers' School teacher. This battle should be very educational.

Anabel.greeting: Roxanne's bond with her Pokémon is very steady. Like stone. Hoenn's Trainers won't fall easily.
Anabel.trainerWins: Steady as stone, and victorious. Hoenn holds.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Even stone cracks. Your bond was stronger.

Anabel.greeting: Roxanne's mind is sharp. Her Pokémon trust her plans completely. That trust is strength.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Trust tested. You were stronger today.

Anabel.greeting: I sense Roxanne studied this battle all night. Let's make that effort count.
Anabel.trainerWins: It counted. Rest well tonight, Roxanne.
Anabel.trainerLoses: It will count next time. I'm sure of it.

Brawly.greeting: Wattson's got energy like a big wave! Dewford and Mauville, let's ride this one together!
Brawly.trainerWins: We rode that wave all the way in! Great job, Wattson!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The wave crashed on us. Still a great ride!

Brawly.greeting: Wattson told me surfing in a thunderstorm is a bad idea. Battling in one? Totally fine!
Brawly.trainerWins: Rode the storm and won! Wattson rules!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The storm wiped us out! Wahah... wait, that's his laugh.

Brawly.greeting: Dewford's cave and Mauville's power. Hoenn's got muscle and voltage!
Brawly.trainerWins: Muscle and voltage for the win!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Brawly's sea breeze and my lightning! Hoenn's having a thunderstorm today!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The storm passed you right by!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Brawly's young and I'm old, but we both love a good jolt of excitement!
Wahahahah! Brawly, if you surf near my power lines, you'll get a shock of a lifetime!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! No shocks, just a win!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! We got the shock of a lifetime!

Brawly.greeting: Flannery's hot, I'm cool, like the ocean breeze. Hoenn's big wave is coming for you!
Brawly.trainerWins: The big wave came for you, just like I said!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The big wave missed. Totally wiped out!

Brawly.greeting: Flannery and I raced from Dewford to Lavaridge. She took the cable car. I'm still mad.
Brawly.trainerWins: Still mad, but we won! Nice heat, Flannery!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Still mad, and we lost. Double bummer.

Brawly.greeting: Ocean spray and volcano steam! Hoenn's hottest wave is about to break!
Brawly.trainerWins: The wave broke right on you!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The wave broke on us! Wiped out!

Flannery.greeting: Brawly surfed all the way here? I'll bring the heat, Brawly. You bring the waves!
Flannery.trainerWins: Heat and waves, a perfect combo! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: My heat fizzled out... Sorry, Brawly!

Flannery.greeting: Brawly says I should learn to surf. I say he should learn to handle the heat!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Neither of us handled you. Wow.

Flannery.greeting: Brawly's so relaxed! I'm trying to stay calm too. Deep breath... and let's GO!
Flannery.trainerWins: Calm and fired up! We did it!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I lost my calm... and the battle.

Brawly.greeting: Norman's the strongest guy in Hoenn. Teaming up with him? That's the biggest wave I've caught!
Brawly.trainerWins: Biggest wave of my life, and we rode it!
Brawly.trainerLoses: That wave was too big even for Norman and me.

Brawly.greeting: Norman's sparring with me before the battle wore me out. In a good way! Let's go!
Brawly.trainerWins: Worn out and victorious! Thanks, Norman!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Worn out and beaten! Gotta train more!

Brawly.greeting: Petalburg's strongest dad and Dewford's surfer dude! Strength from every angle!

Norman.greeting: Brawly's Fighting types and my Normal types share one thing: strength. Let's show it.
Norman.trainerLoses: Our strength fell short. Train harder.

Norman.greeting: Brawly's raw power reminds me of myself at his age. Let's channel it properly.
Norman.trainerLoses: Raw power needs more polish. Good fight.

Norman.greeting: Brawly, hold nothing back. I'll cover any opening you leave.
Norman.trainerLoses: Openings everywhere. We'll work on that.

Brawly.greeting: Winona's birds ride the wind, I ride the waves. Hoenn's sky and sea, coming at you!
Brawly.trainerWins: Sky and sea got you! Hoenn wins!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Sky and sea got us instead. Wiped out!

Brawly.greeting: Winona showed me how to read the wind. Turns out it's a lot like reading waves!
Brawly.trainerWins: Wind and waves read perfectly! We won!

Brawly.greeting: Fortree's treetops and Dewford's shoreline! Hoenn from top to bottom!

Winona.greeting: Brawly's Fighting types hit hard. My Flying types hit from above. Shall we?
Winona.trainerWins: From above and from below. A graceful win, Brawly.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our wings were clipped. Well fought.

Winona.greeting: Brawly's enthusiasm is like a fresh sea breeze. My birds love it. Shall we begin?
Winona.trainerWins: A fresh breeze and a fine victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: The breeze turned against us. Well done.

Winona.greeting: Brawly strikes from the ground, my birds from the clouds. You'll have to look everywhere.

Brawly.greeting: Juan's the Water master of Sootopolis! Me, I just love the ocean. Let's make a splash!
Brawly.trainerWins: We made a splash! Thanks, Juan!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The splash missed. Totally wiped out!

Brawly.greeting: Juan told me surfing is just dancing on water. Now I can't unsee it! Let's dance!
Brawly.trainerWins: Danced all the way to victory!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Tripped on the dance floor! Ugh!

Brawly.greeting: Sootopolis and Dewford, both surrounded by sea. Hoenn's ocean boys!

Juan.greeting: Brawly surfs with such passion! Ahh, Hoenn's seas inspire us both. Let's make art of this battle.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a masterpiece of a battle! Hoenn's seas sing!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our art was misunderstood today.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Brawly rides the waves as I ride the music! A seaside symphony!
Juan.trainerWins: Bravo! The symphony ends in triumph!
Juan.trainerLoses: The symphony ends in a minor key. Ahh.

Juan.greeting: Brawly, your strength and my grace. Ahh, the tide is with us today!
Juan.trainerWins: The tide carried us to victory!
Juan.trainerLoses: The tide turned. Ahh, well played.

Brawly.greeting: Wally's not that frail kid anymore! He hits like a wave now. Let's show 'em, partner!
Brawly.trainerWins: Wally hits like a wave! Told ya, partner!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Even our waves crashed. Keep at it, Wally!

Brawly.greeting: Wally spent a week surfing with me in Dewford. He fell off a lot. Now he never falls!
Brawly.trainerWins: He didn't fall once! Great job, Wally!
Brawly.trainerLoses: We both fell this time. Next wave's ours!

Brawly.greeting: Wally's grown so much! Let's catch this big wave together, partner!

Wally.greeting: Brawly's Gym was my second badge. Now we're teammates! I'll fight with all I've got!
Wally.trainerWins: I fought with all I had, and we won! Thanks, Brawly!
Wally.trainerLoses: I gave it everything... and still lost. I'll keep training!

Wally.greeting: Brawly's taught me how to keep my balance, on a surfboard and in battle!
Wally.trainerWins: I kept my balance! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I lost my balance... sorry, Brawly!

Wally.greeting: Brawly says fighting is about heart. I've got plenty of that now!
Wally.trainerWins: My heart pulled through!
Wally.trainerLoses: My heart wasn't enough... yet!

Brawly.greeting: Anabel can sense my team's spirit? Then she knows it's huge! Hoenn's coming for you!
Brawly.trainerWins: Huge spirit, huge win! Hoenn rules!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Our spirit was huge, but you were bigger!

Brawly.greeting: Anabel says she can feel my team's energy. Hope she's ready for a tidal wave!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The tide went out on us!

Brawly.greeting: A Frontier Brain and a surfer dude! The Battle Frontier is gonna hear about this!

Anabel.greeting: Brawly's bond with his Pokémon is strong and wild, like the sea. I like it. Let's battle.
Anabel.trainerWins: A wild bond, a fine victory. Thank you, Brawly.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The sea was rough today. Well battled.

Anabel.greeting: Brawly's spirit is free, like the sea. I don't need to sense it. I can see it.
I sense Brawly's Pokémon want to battle hard. Let's give them the chance.
Anabel.trainerWins: They got their chance and won.
Anabel.trainerLoses: They got their chance. You were better.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Flannery's fire and my thunder! Hoenn's volcano and storm, all in one battle!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! Volcano and storm! What a show!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The volcano fizzled and the storm passed!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Flannery asked me how to stay so cheerful! Answer: lots of electricity!
Wahahahah! Lavaridge's hot springs and Mauville's power plant! Hoenn's energy district!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! The energy district is running at full power!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! A blackout in the energy district! Who forgot to pay the bill?

Flannery.greeting: Wattson laughs so much, it's contagious! Mauville and Lavaridge, let's light this place up!
Flannery.trainerWins: We lit this place up! Wattson, you're the best!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The lights went out on us... Ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Wattson's laugh is so loud it shakes Mt. Chimney! Let's shake this place too!
Wattson's so old and still so fired up! I want to be like that when I'm his age!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Norman's so serious! Lighten up, partner. Hoenn's going to win anyway!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! See, Norman? Hoenn wins anyway!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Even I didn't see that coming!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Norman and I have known each other for years! He finally laughs at my jokes!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! He didn't laugh at that one!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Mauville's sparks and Petalburg's strength! Hoenn's dads are unstoppable!

Norman.greeting: Wattson's laughter fills the room. His Electric types fill the battle. Let's go, old friend.
Norman.trainerWins: Laughter and victory. Well done, old friend.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hmph. Laughter won't fix this one, Wattson.

Norman.greeting: Wattson keeps the mood light. I keep the battle steady. A good partnership.
Norman.trainerLoses: Even good partnerships lose. Well done.

Norman.greeting: Wattson, your energy is contagious. Let's make sure it reaches our opponent too.
Norman.trainerLoses: It reached us instead.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Winona's birds are in for a shock... no, wait, we're on the same side! Go!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! No birds shocked! And we won!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! I shocked nobody at all today!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Winona, keep your birds above my lightning, and we'll be fine!
Wahahahah! Fortree's sky and Mauville's storms! Hoenn's weather report: you lose!

Winona.greeting: Wattson, please aim away from my Flying types. Hoenn's sky will be ours together.
Winona.trainerWins: The sky was ours, and my birds are unharmed. Thank you, Wattson.
Winona.trainerLoses: The sky slipped away from us. Well fought.

Winona.greeting: Wattson's lightning lights up the sky. My birds will dance between the bolts.
Winona.trainerWins: A dance among lightning, and a victory.

Winona.greeting: Wattson laughs, and the clouds part. Let's battle under clear skies.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Juan's water conducts my electricity beautifully! Hoenn's shocking art show begins!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! The shocking art show is a hit!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Juan says my laugh has rhythm! Let's make this battle a dance!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Stepped on our own feet!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Sootopolis and Mauville! The fanciest and the loudest Gyms in Hoenn!

Juan.greeting: Wattson, your thunder makes my waters sparkle. Ahh, together we are a masterpiece.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a sparkling masterpiece! Bravo, Wattson!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the sparkle faded. A tragic piece.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Wattson's thunder is the percussion, and my waters are the melody! Music!
Juan.trainerLoses: The music ended early. Ahh.

Juan.greeting: Wattson, your energy and my elegance. Ahh, an unlikely and beautiful pairing!
Juan.trainerLoses: Unlikely, beautiful, defeated. Ahh.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Wally once battled right outside my Mauville Gym! Gutsy kid! Let's go!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Gutsy, but not enough today!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Wally used to be so shy! Now look at him, ready for anything!
Wahahahah! Mauville's thunder and Wally's courage! Hoenn's brightest sparks!

Wally.greeting: Wattson is so cheerful! It makes me feel brave. Hoenn's going to win this!
Wally.trainerWins: I felt brave, and we won! Thanks, Wattson!
Wally.trainerLoses: I was brave, but we still lost... I'll try harder!

Wally.greeting: Wattson told me laughing makes you braver. I'm going to laugh a lot today!
Wally.trainerWins: I laughed and we won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'm still laughing... sort of.

Wally.greeting: Wattson's so strong and so happy! I want to battle like him!
Wally.trainerWins: I battled like him! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll keep practicing!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Anabel, the Frontier Brain! Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Mauville, together!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The Frontier and Mauville, both shocked!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Anabel says my Pokémon love me! Of course they do! I laugh with them every day!
Wahahahah! A Frontier Brain and a Mauville legend! The Battle Frontier is electrified!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! The whole Frontier felt that jolt!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Our circuits fried before the Frontier's did!

Anabel.greeting: Wattson's energy is shocking. I sense his Pokémon love him dearly. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Shocking energy, shocking win. Thank you, Wattson.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Even that energy wasn't enough. Well battled.

Anabel.greeting: Wattson's bond with his Pokémon crackles with joy. I can feel it from here.
Wattson's laughter puts me at ease. Let's battle with light hearts.

Flannery.greeting: Norman's so cool and calm. I'm trying to be like that! Hoenn's fiercest, let's go!
Flannery.trainerWins: Calm AND fierce! We did it, Norman!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I wasn't calm enough... Sorry, Norman!

Flannery.greeting: Norman told me to stay calm under pressure. I'm trying! Let's do this!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I lost my calm... sorry, Norman!

Flannery.greeting: Lavaridge's hot springs and Petalburg's dojo! Heat and strength!

Norman.greeting: Flannery has her grandfather's fire. Use it well, Lavaridge. Hoenn will win this battle.
Norman.trainerWins: You used your fire well, Lavaridge. Hoenn wins.
Norman.trainerLoses: A fine effort, Flannery. We'll be ready next time.

Norman.greeting: Flannery is passionate, like all of Lavaridge's Leaders. Let's direct that passion.
Norman.trainerLoses: Passion unfocused. We'll work on it.

Norman.greeting: Flannery, trust your grandfather's lessons. I'll trust you.
Norman.trainerLoses: Trust tested. Good fight.

Flannery.greeting: Winona's so graceful. Me? I'm all fire! Lavaridge and Fortree, let's heat up the sky!
Flannery.trainerWins: We heated up the sky! Lavaridge and Fortree win!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The sky cooled us right down. Ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Winona taught me how to calm down by watching the clouds. I'm trying it now. Okay! Ready!
Flannery.trainerWins: Calm and fiery! We did it!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Too much fire, not enough calm!

Flannery.greeting: Fortree's sky and Lavaridge's volcano! Hoenn's hottest view!
Flannery.trainerLoses: View's great, battle not so much!

Winona.greeting: Flannery's flames light up Hoenn's sky. Let's soar above this challenger together.
Winona.trainerWins: Flannery's flames lit the way to victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: The flames flickered out. Well fought.

Winona.greeting: Flannery's flames and my birds. A sunset in the middle of a battle.
Winona.trainerLoses: The sun set on us. Well done.

Winona.greeting: Flannery, let your fire rise. My birds will carry it higher.

Flannery.greeting: Juan's water could put my fire out... but today we're teammates! Hoenn, here we come!
Flannery.trainerWins: Fire and water, best teammates ever!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Juan's water didn't put out my fire... the challenger did!

Flannery.greeting: Juan said my fire has style! Juan never says that! Let's show off!
Sootopolis's lake and Lavaridge's springs! Hoenn's best bath time!

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Flannery! Fire and water dance together. A Hoenn masterpiece of steam and splendor!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a masterpiece of steam! Splendid, Flannery!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the steam has cleared. A tragic finale.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Flannery, fire and water in one performance! A spectacle of steam!
Juan.trainerWins: Bravo! The steam rises in triumph!
Juan.trainerLoses: The steam faded. Ahh, well played.

Juan.greeting: Flannery's passion and my poise. Ahh, the perfect contrast!
Juan.trainerLoses: Contrast creates beauty and defeat. Ahh.

Flannery.greeting: Wally came to Lavaridge's hot springs to build up his health, and look at him now! Let's heat things up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Wally got stronger, and so did our teamwork!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The hot springs couldn't heal this loss!

Flannery.greeting: Wally used to come to my hot springs for his health. Now he's healthier than me!
Flannery.trainerLoses: We need a long soak after that!

Flannery.greeting: Lavaridge's heat and Wally's courage! Hoenn's warmest team!

Wally.greeting: Flannery's hot springs helped me get stronger. Now I'll repay her with a win!
Wally.trainerWins: I repaid her with a win! Thank you, Flannery!
Wally.trainerLoses: I couldn't repay her today... Next time!

Wally.greeting: Flannery's hot springs made me strong. Now I'll make her proud!
Wally.trainerWins: I made her proud! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Flannery!

Wally.greeting: Flannery's so energetic! I'll keep up with her today!
Wally.trainerWins: I kept up!
Wally.trainerLoses: She was too fast for me... and you were faster.

Flannery.greeting: Anabel's so calm and collected! I'm all fired up! Hoenn's ready to win this one!
Flannery.trainerWins: Hoenn won! Fired up AND collected!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I got so fired up I fizzled out. Ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Anabel said my Pokémon trust me a lot. That made me so happy I almost cried!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Sad tears... just kidding! Good battle!

Flannery.greeting: A Frontier Brain and Lavaridge's Leader! Hoenn's toughest and hottest!

Anabel.greeting: Flannery's bond with her Pokémon burns brightly. I can feel it from here. Let's battle.
Anabel.trainerWins: Her bond burned brightly, and so did our win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The flame dimmed today. Well battled.

Anabel.greeting: Flannery's fire is honest. Her Pokémon burn for her. I can feel it.
Flannery, let your Pokémon feel your trust. They'll do the rest.

Norman.greeting: Winona's birds are a sight to behold. Petalburg and Fortree, let's show Hoenn's strength.
Norman.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, on the ground and in the sky. Well done.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's strength faltered. Train harder.

Norman.greeting: Winona's birds patrol the skies above Petalburg when I'm away. Hoenn's guardians, together.
Norman.trainerLoses: Even guardians rest. Well done.

Norman.greeting: Petalburg's dojo and Fortree's treetops. Ground and sky.
Norman.trainerLoses: Ground and sky fall.

Winona.greeting: Norman's strength is legendary in Hoenn. With him on the ground, my birds rule the sky.
Winona.trainerWins: My birds ruled the sky, with Norman on the ground.
Winona.trainerLoses: Even the sky couldn't save us today.

Winona.greeting: Norman's steady presence calms my birds. They fly better with him nearby.
Winona.trainerLoses: They flew well. You flew better.

Winona.greeting: Norman, stand firm. My birds will strike from where you can't reach.
Winona.trainerLoses: Firm ground, but you reached us. Congratulations.

Norman.greeting: Juan taught the Champion. I taught my child. Hoenn's teachers don't lose easily.
Norman.trainerWins: Hoenn's teachers don't lose easily. They didn't today.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's teachers learned a lesson today.

Norman.greeting: Juan and I disagree on teaching. He says art, I say discipline. Today, we'll see both.
Norman.trainerLoses: Neither won today.

Norman.greeting: Petalburg and Sootopolis. Hoenn's mentors, side by side.
Norman.trainerLoses: Mentors learn too.

Juan.greeting: Norman, ahh, such quiet strength. Let us show this challenger Hoenn's grace and might.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, grace and might, together! A masterpiece!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our grace stumbled. How tragic.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Norman, discipline and art! Together, a masterpiece of strategy!
Juan.trainerLoses: The masterpiece crumbled. Ahh.

Juan.greeting: Norman's strength anchors my grace. Ahh, the perfect duet!
Juan.trainerLoses: Perfect duet, imperfect ending. Ahh.

Norman.greeting: Wally caught his first Pokémon with my help in Petalburg. Look at him now. Let's battle, Wally.
Norman.trainerWins: Well battled, Wally. You've come so far.
Norman.trainerLoses: We'll get them next time, Wally. Keep your head up.

Norman.greeting: Wally's come a long way from that first catch in Petalburg. I'm proud to battle beside him.
Norman.trainerWins: Proud of you, Wally. Well done.
Norman.trainerLoses: Proud of you anyway, Wally.

Norman.greeting: Petalburg's Leader and the boy I helped start his journey. Let's see how far he's come.
Norman.trainerLoses: Far, but not far enough today.

Wally.greeting: Norman helped me catch my very first Pokémon when I was just starting out. I'll make him proud today!
Wally.trainerWins: I made Norman proud! I can't believe it!
Wally.trainerLoses: I wanted to make Norman proud... I'll do better!

Wally.greeting: Norman always believed in me. I'll show him it was worth it!
Wally.trainerWins: I showed him! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll keep trying, Norman!

Wally.greeting: Norman taught me that strength comes from never giving up!
Wally.trainerWins: I didn't give up! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I didn't give up, but we lost.

Norman.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain. Hoenn's toughest facility. I'm glad she's on our side.
Norman.trainerWins: Glad you were on our side, Anabel. A fine win.
Norman.trainerLoses: Even the Frontier's toughest couldn't hold today.

Norman.greeting: Anabel's insight and my experience. A formidable combination.
Norman.trainerLoses: Formidable, but beaten.

Norman.greeting: A Frontier Brain and Petalburg's Leader. Hoenn's best is here.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's best fell short.

Anabel.greeting: Norman's bond with his Pokémon is steady, like a father's. Hoenn's Trainers are strong.
Anabel.trainerWins: Steady and strong, like a father's bond. A fine win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The bond held, but the battle didn't.

Anabel.greeting: Norman's bond with his Pokémon is deep and quiet, like a father's love. I respect that.
Norman, your Pokémon trust you completely. Let's honor that trust.

Winona.greeting: Juan's art and my birds' grace. Hoenn's sky and sea will move together.
Winona.trainerWins: Sky and sea moved together, and won.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our sky and sea were out of step today.

Winona.greeting: Juan says my birds fly like dancers. I've never thought of it that way. Shall we dance?
Winona.trainerWins: A beautiful dance, and a victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: The dance ended too soon. Well done.

Winona.greeting: Fortree's trees and Sootopolis's crater. Hoenn's quiet beauty.

Juan.greeting: Winona's wings and my waters. Ahh, a duet of sky and sea! Hoenn's finest art!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a duet of victory! Hoenn's finest art!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our duet ended on a sour note.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Winona's grace in the sky and mine on the water! A duet of elegance!
Juan.trainerLoses: Elegance falters. Ahh.

Juan.greeting: Winona, your birds and my waters. Ahh, sky and sea in harmony!
Juan.trainerLoses: Harmony broken. Ahh, well played.

Winona.greeting: Wally used to be too weak to climb Fortree's treetops. Now he's climbed the Battle Tree.
Winona.trainerWins: From too weak to climb Fortree to winning here. Well flown, Wally.
Winona.trainerLoses: We'll climb higher next time, Wally.

Winona.greeting: Wally visited Fortree to watch my birds when he was recovering. Now he battles beside them.
Winona.trainerLoses: He battled bravely. Congratulations to you.

Winona.greeting: Wally's spirit soars now. Let's see how high.
Winona.trainerLoses: High, but not high enough. Chin up.

Wally.greeting: Winona's birds are so beautiful! I'll fight hard so they can soar!
Wally.trainerWins: The birds soared, and we won! Thank you, Winona!
Wally.trainerLoses: The birds couldn't soar today... I'm sorry!

Wally.greeting: Winona's birds made me want to fly when I was sick. Now I'm flying high!
Wally.trainerWins: I'm flying high! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll fly higher next time!

Wally.greeting: Winona believes in quiet strength. I've learned that too!
Wally.trainerWins: Quiet strength wins!
Wally.trainerLoses: Quiet strength... wasn't enough.

Winona.greeting: Anabel senses bonds, and my birds feel the wind. Hoenn's quiet Trainers are its strongest.
Winona.trainerWins: Hoenn's quiet Trainers, victorious. As I said.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our quiet strength wasn't enough today.

Winona.greeting: Anabel and I both prefer quiet. This battle will be peaceful, but decisive.
Winona.trainerLoses: Peaceful, but not decisive for us.

Winona.greeting: A Frontier Brain and Fortree's Leader. Grace and insight.

Anabel.greeting: Winona's bond with her birds is light, like feathers. But strong. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Light as feathers, strong as steel. A fine victory.

Anabel.greeting: Winona's birds feel the wind. I feel bonds. Together, nothing escapes us.
Anabel.trainerWins: Not a gust nor a bond escaped us. Well flown, Winona.
Anabel.trainerLoses: You slipped between the wind and the bonds. Impressive.

Anabel.greeting: Winona, your birds trust you like the wind trusts the sky. Let's begin.
Anabel.trainerLoses: They flew well. You were better.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Wally! You battled through Victory Road itself. A Hoenn star is born! Let us shine together!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a Hoenn star shines! Bravo, Wally!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, even stars dim sometimes. Shine again, Wally.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Wally! Your journey is an epic poem! Let us write its next verse together!
Juan.trainerLoses: A tragic verse... ahh, but poetic!

Juan.greeting: Sootopolis's Gym and Victory Road's champion! Ahh, Hoenn's finest stage!
Juan.trainerLoses: The curtain falls early. Ahh.

Wally.greeting: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace inspired me! I want to show Juan how far I've come!
Wally.trainerWins: I showed Juan how far I've come! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I wanted to show Juan... I'll try again!

Wally.greeting: Juan's battles are like art. I want my battles to be beautiful too!
Wally.trainerWins: Beautiful and victorious!
Wally.trainerLoses: Beautiful, but we lost.

Wally.greeting: Juan taught me to battle with grace. I'll show him what I've learned!
Wally.trainerWins: I showed him!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll keep learning!

Juan.greeting: Anabel, the Salon Maiden! Ahh, Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Sootopolis, an elegant duet!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our duet was drowned out.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Anabel, the Salon Maiden! Your grace rivals my own! A duet of elegance!
Juan.trainerLoses: Elegance stumbles. Ahh.

Juan.greeting: Sootopolis's artistry and the Battle Frontier's wisdom. Ahh, a masterpiece in the making!
Juan.trainerLoses: The masterpiece is unfinished. Ahh.

Anabel.greeting: Juan's bond with his Pokémon is like a dance. I sense harmony. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Harmony, and victory. Thank you, Juan.

Anabel.greeting: Juan's bond with his Pokémon flows like water. Beautiful and strong.
Juan, let your Pokémon dance. I'll watch the bonds and guide us.

Wally.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain when I was still training! Hoenn's not losing today!
Wally.trainerWins: Hoenn won! I battled with a Frontier Brain!
Wally.trainerLoses: I lost with a Frontier Brain beside me... I'll keep training!

Wally.greeting: Anabel said my Pokémon's bond with me is as strong as any Frontier Brain's! I'm so happy!
Wally.trainerWins: We proved it! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: We'll prove it next time!

Wally.greeting: A Frontier Brain on my side! Hoenn's not losing today!
Wally.trainerWins: Hoenn won!
Wally.trainerLoses: Hoenn lost... but we tried our best!

Anabel.greeting: Wally's bond with his Pokémon grew as he did. I can sense how strong it is now. Let's go.
Anabel.trainerWins: Strong bond, strong win. Well done, Wally.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Your bond is strong, Wally. Today, theirs was stronger.

Anabel.greeting: Wally's bond grew from fragile to unbreakable. I've rarely seen anything like it.
Wally, your Pokémon believe in you. So do I. Let's battle.

Roark.greeting: Gardenia's Grass types grow right out of my rocks. Oreburgh and Eterna, Sinnoh's first two badges!
Roark.trainerWins: Sinnoh's first two badges, victorious! Great job, Gardenia!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even Oreburgh and Eterna fell. Back to the mines.

Roark.greeting: Gardenia promised to come to the mine with me if we win. I'm holding her to it!
Roark.trainerWins: Mine tour scheduled! Nice, Gardenia!
Roark.trainerLoses: No mine tour... she's relieved, I think.

Roark.greeting: Oreburgh's coal and Eterna's forest! Sinnoh's first steps, together again!
Roark.trainerWins: First steps, big victory!

Gardenia.greeting: Roark spends all day underground? No thanks. Just keep any Old Chateau ghosts away from me, okay?
Gardenia.trainerWins: No ghosts AND a win! Best day! Thanks, Roark!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost... and I think I heard a ghost. I'm leaving!

Gardenia.greeting: Roark brought fossils to show my Grass types. They were not impressed. I was, a little!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We impressed you, right? We won!

Gardenia.greeting: Roark's so serious about rocks! I'm serious about plants! Let's grow a win!

Roark.greeting: Fantina's ghosts give me the creeps. Still, Oreburgh's rocks can anchor any Hearthome show.
Roark.trainerWins: My rocks anchored the show! Creepy, but great!
Roark.trainerLoses: The show went on without us. And her ghosts still give me the creeps.

Roark.greeting: Fantina invited me to a contest in Hearthome. I said yes. I regret nothing.
Roark.trainerWins: Contest-level victory! Merci, Fantina!

Roark.greeting: Hearthome's stage and Oreburgh's mine. Spotlight and helmet lamp!
Roark.trainerWins: Both lights shine on victory!

Fantina.greeting: Roark, mon ami! Your team is so... how you say... rugged! Let us put on a Sinnoh spectacle!
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! A Sinnoh spectacle! Bravo, Roark!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non, non! The spectacle has ended in sadness!

Fantina.greeting: Roark, mon ami, you dance like a boulder! But in battle, you are magnifique!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Hélas! Not today!

Fantina.greeting: Roark's rocks will be my stage, and my ghosts will dance upon them! Allons-y!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The dance ended in sorrow!

Roark.greeting: Maylene's Fighting types smash boulders for training. Glad my Rock types are on her side today!
Roark.trainerWins: Glad my rocks weren't on the wrong side of those fists! We won!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even my rocks crumbled. Good fight, Maylene.

Roark.greeting: Maylene smashed a boulder I was studying. She apologized by helping me dig for more.
Roark.trainerWins: A smashing victory! Nice, Maylene!

Roark.greeting: Veilstone's fists and Oreburgh's rocks. Hard-hitting Sinnoh!
Roark.trainerWins: Hard-hitting win!

Maylene.greeting: Roark's rocks are tough. My fists are tougher. I... I think. Let's do this for Sinnoh!
Maylene.trainerWins: My fists ARE tougher! I think! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: My fists weren't enough. I'll train harder!

Maylene.greeting: Roark's helmet light helps me train at night. I owe him a win!
Roark, I'll punch, you defend! Let's go!

Roark.greeting: Crasher Wake shook the whole mine just by shouting hello. My Rock types are ready, Wake!
Roark.trainerWins: Wake shook the mine, and we shook you!
Roark.trainerLoses: Wake, your shouting couldn't save us this time.

Roark.greeting: Crasher Wake asked to borrow my mine for a wrestling match. I said no. Then I said yes.
Roark.trainerWins: Match won! Great job, Wake!
Roark.trainerLoses: Match lost! Sorry about the mine!

Roark.greeting: Pastoria's marsh and Oreburgh's quarry! Sinnoh's muddiest team!
Roark.trainerWins: Muddiest team wins!

Crasher Wake.greeting: The miner of Oreburgh! Rock and Water, the Crasher Wake tag team is on! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The Crasher Wake tag team triumphs!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The tag team takes a tumble!

Crasher Wake.greeting: The Crasher Wake respects Roark's dedication! Rock and Water, crashing together! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The crash heard round Sinnoh!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got crashed!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Roark! Hold the line, and the Crasher Wake will smash through! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Smashed through!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got smashed!

Roark.greeting: Dad's my partner?! Fine, Byron. Let's see whose Rock and Steel team is really number one!
Roark.trainerWins: Fine, Dad. We're number one together. Just this once.
Roark.trainerLoses: We lost, Dad. Don't you dare say it was my fault.

Roark.greeting: Dad keeps bragging that his steel is stronger than my rocks. Today, we'll prove both!
Roark.trainerWins: Both proven! Good job, Dad!

Roark.greeting: Oreburgh and Canalave! The father-son mining crew!
Roark.trainerWins: Mining crew strikes gold!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! My boy Roark! Oreburgh's rocks and Canalave's steel, father and son! Nothing breaks us!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Father and son! Nothing breaks us!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! We broke, my boy! Back to training!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Roark's grown into a fine Leader! But his old man's still got it!
Gahahah! Roark, show your old man what you've learned!

Roark.greeting: Candice keeps yelling 'focus!' at me. I'm focused! Snowpoint ice on Oreburgh rock, let's go!
Roark.trainerWins: I was focused, Candice! And we won!
Roark.trainerLoses: I lost focus. Candice is never letting me forget it.

Roark.greeting: Candice gave me hand warmers for the mine. Turns out they work great in battle too!
Roark.trainerWins: Warm hands, warm victory!

Roark.greeting: Snowpoint's blizzard and Oreburgh's bedrock! Cold and solid!
Roark.trainerWins: Cold and solid wins!

Candice.greeting: Roark, FOCUS! Rock types don't mind the cold, right? Then Snowpoint and Oreburgh can't lose!
Candice.trainerWins: FOCUS! And victory! Snowpoint and Oreburgh rule!
Candice.trainerLoses: We lost focus! Both of us! Kiai... next time!

Candice.greeting: Roark, FOCUS! Rocks don't freeze, and neither does our teamwork!
Roark's so steady! I'm so excited! Let's balance each other out!

Roark.greeting: Volkner's Sinnoh's last Gym and I'm its first. Together, we cover every badge you could earn.
Roark.trainerWins: Every badge in Sinnoh, covered and won. Thanks, Volkner.
Roark.trainerLoses: First and last badge, both fell. Ouch.

Roark.greeting: Volkner says Oreburgh's challenge is boring. Let's show him it's not!
Roark.trainerWins: Not boring at all! Nice, Volkner!

Roark.greeting: Sinnoh's first and last Gyms! You'll get the whole experience!
Roark.trainerWins: The whole experience, ending in your defeat!
Roark.trainerLoses: The whole experience, ending in ours!

Volkner.greeting: The first badge of Sinnoh. Let's see if Oreburgh can make this more interesting than Sunyshore.
Volkner.trainerWins: Fine. Oreburgh made it interesting. Good.
Volkner.trainerLoses: That was interesting. I'll admit it. For you.

Volkner.greeting: Roark's enthusiasm is almost refreshing. Almost. Let's battle.
Volkner.trainerWins: Refreshing.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Disappointing.

Volkner.greeting: Roark, try not to be predictable. That's my only request.
Volkner.trainerWins: You weren't. Good.
Volkner.trainerLoses: You were. Unfortunately.

Roark.greeting: Teaming up with Champion Cynthia? Oreburgh's fossil fanatic won't let Sinnoh down!
Roark.trainerWins: Oreburgh's fossil fanatic didn't let Sinnoh down!
Roark.trainerLoses: I let the Champion down. I'm going back underground.
