Roark.greeting: Cynthia asked me about Sinnoh's oldest fossils. I talked for an hour. She listened the whole time!
Roark.trainerWins: A Champion-level victory!

Roark.greeting: Sinnoh's Champion and Oreburgh's fossil hunter! Let's dig up a win!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug it up!

Cynthia.greeting: Roark digs up fossils, and I dig up legends. Sinnoh's history is on our side. Shall we?
Cynthia.trainerWins: Sinnoh's history was on our side. Well done, Roark.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: History favored the challenger today. Fascinating.

Cynthia.greeting: Roark's passion for history matches mine. Let's write a new chapter together.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A new chapter, beautifully written.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A chapter that ends in defeat. Still worth reading.

Cynthia.greeting: Roark, let's show this challenger what Sinnoh's history can do.
Cynthia.trainerWins: History triumphs.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: History humbles us.

Gardenia.greeting: F-F-Fantina's my partner?! Your ghosts aren't from the Old Chateau, are they?! Are they?!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won, and no Old Chateau ghosts showed up! Phew!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost AND your ghosts were staring at me! Worst day!

Gardenia.greeting: Fantina promised her ghosts would stay away from me. She's lying. I can feel it.
Eterna's forest and Hearthome's stage! Flowers and phantoms!

Fantina.greeting: Gardenia, ma chérie, you tremble! My ghosts are friends. Eterna and Hearthome, together, oui?
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! Gardenia, my ghosts were friends after all, oui?
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non! Even friendly ghosts could not save us. Quelle tristesse.

Fantina.greeting: Gardenia, ma chérie, my ghosts adore you! They only want a hug!
Fantina.trainerLoses: They hugged defeat. Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Gardenia, do not tremble! We are a beautiful spectacle!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Hélas!

Gardenia.greeting: Maylene walks barefoot through Eterna Forest with me. We're both nature girls at heart!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Nature girls win! Back to Eterna Forest to celebrate!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Even nature girls lose sometimes. Let's walk it off barefoot!

Gardenia.greeting: Maylene and I hiked Mt. Coronet barefoot. Okay, she was barefoot. I wore boots.
Gardenia.trainerWins: We conquered it! And this battle!

Gardenia.greeting: Veilstone's dojo and Eterna's garden! Nature girls, unite!

Maylene.greeting: Gardenia's flowers look delicate, but they're tough, like Veilstone's fighters. Let's battle!
Maylene.trainerWins: Tough flowers, tough fists! We did it, Gardenia!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Gardenia's flowers held up better than my fists did...

Maylene.greeting: Gardenia's flowers are as tough as my fists! I'm sure of it!
Gardenia, I'll punch, you plant! Let's go!

Gardenia.greeting: Crasher Wake's rain makes my Grass types grow big and strong! Pastoria's marsh would be jealous!
Gardenia.trainerWins: The rain made my team grow strong, and we won!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Too much rain, maybe? My team got soggy.

Gardenia.greeting: Crasher Wake gave my Grass types a rain shower. They're bigger than ever!
Pastoria's marsh and Eterna's forest! Sinnoh's wettest, greenest team!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Gardenia's Grass types love the Great Marsh! Water and Grass, the Crasher Wake jungle match!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The jungle match goes to the Crasher Wake!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Lost in the jungle! What a match!

Crasher Wake.greeting: The Crasher Wake waters Gardenia's garden! Grass and Water, the jungle crash! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Jungle victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Jungle defeat!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Gardenia! Your plants and my waves! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Defeat!

Gardenia.greeting: Byron says the Old Chateau is just an old house. Easy for a guy made of steel to say!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won! Maybe I'm a little bit made of steel too!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost, and Byron still says the Old Chateau is fine. Ugh!

Gardenia.greeting: Byron promised to protect me from ghosts. With steel! That's very reassuring!
Canalave's steel and Eterna's flowers! Sturdy and sweet!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Gardenia's scared of ghosts? My Steel types fear nothing! Canalave's got your back!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Canalave had your back, and we won!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Even steel couldn't hold that one!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Gardenia's flowers growing on my steel! Canalave's garden!
Gahahah! Gardenia, my steel's a fortress! Plant your flowers behind it!

Gardenia.greeting: Candice's ice is gonna be gentle with my Grass types, right? Right?! Okay, let's go, Sinnoh!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Candice was gentle! We won! Sinnoh rocks!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Candice's ice froze my flowers... and our chances!

Gardenia.greeting: Candice says my flowers can survive Snowpoint. I'm skeptical, but let's try!
Snowpoint's snow and Eterna's flowers! Winter garden!

Candice.greeting: Gardenia, focus! Grass under snow grows back stronger! Snowpoint and Eterna, team spirit!
Candice.trainerWins: Grass under snow grows back stronger, and so do we!
Candice.trainerLoses: We didn't grow back fast enough! Focus next time!

Candice.greeting: Gardenia, FOCUS! Flowers in the snow are the prettiest ones!
Gardenia's so lively! I love it! Let's focus and win!

Gardenia.greeting: Volkner looks so bored. Don't worry, my Grass types will make this battle fun for both of us!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Told you it'd be fun, Volkner! We won!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Volkner's still bored... and we lost! Not fun!

Gardenia.greeting: Volkner smiled at one of my jokes once. Once! A win might get me a second smile.
Gardenia.trainerWins: Was that a smile, Volkner? I'm counting it!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: No smile today. I'll save my best joke for the rematch.

Gardenia.greeting: Sunyshore's lighthouse and Eterna's forest. We'll light up the trees, won't we, Volkner?
Gardenia.trainerWins: We lit up the whole forest! Told you, Volkner!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: The trees went dark on us. Bummer.

Volkner.greeting: Gardenia's energy is... a lot. Maybe that's what this battle needs. Let's see.
Volkner.trainerWins: That was... actually fun. Thanks, Gardenia.
Volkner.trainerLoses: That was a lot. And not enough.

Volkner.greeting: Gardenia talked the whole way up the tree. Somehow, I didn't mind. Let's see if she battles as well as she talks.
Volkner.trainerWins: She battles even better than she talks. That's saying something.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Plenty of talk, not enough battle. From both of us.

Volkner.greeting: Gardenia's Grass types soak up the sunshine, mine soak up the current. Fine. Let's go.
Volkner.trainerWins: That actually worked. Don't tell anyone I enjoyed it.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Sunshine and current, both cut off. You earned it.

Gardenia.greeting: Cynthia studies the old statue in Eterna City, right by my Gym! The Champion and Eterna's Leader, let's grow a win!
Gardenia.trainerWins: The Champion and Eterna's Leader grew a win!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We didn't grow a win today... Sorry, Cynthia!

Gardenia.greeting: Cynthia's my hero! I've watched her battles a hundred times! Now I'm IN one!
Gardenia.trainerWins: My hero and I won together! Best day ever!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: My hero and I lost together... still kind of the best day ever.

Gardenia.greeting: The Champion and Eterna's Leader, side by side! Sinnoh's strongest flowers in full bloom!

Cynthia.greeting: Gardenia keeps Eterna Forest safe while I study the statue in her city. Eterna's pride, together.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Eterna's pride shines bright. Thank you, Gardenia.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Eterna's statue has seen worse. We'll recover.

Cynthia.greeting: Gardenia keeps a garden of every flower in Eterna's legends. Let's add a victory to it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A victory blooms in Eterna's garden. Well done, Gardenia.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: That flower will have to wait for another season.

Cynthia.greeting: Gardenia's spirit is as bright as her flowers. I'll make sure it shines today.
Cynthia.trainerWins: It shone brilliantly. Thank you, Gardenia.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: It shone, even in defeat. Congratulations.

Fantina.greeting: Maylene, such strength in such a small Trainer! Ghost and Fighting, a duet magnifique!
Fantina.trainerWins: A duet magnifique! Such strength, my little Maylene!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Our duet has ended too soon. Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Maylene, ma petite! Your fists and my phantoms! Ensemble, a ballet of punches and spirits!
Fantina.trainerWins: The ballet ends in triumph! Brava, Maylene!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Hélas, our ballet tripped on the final step!

Fantina.greeting: Hearthome's stage and Veilstone's dojo! Strength and grace, une combinaison magnifique!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Strength and grace, but the curtain fell on us!

Maylene.greeting: Fantina's dance moves are amazing. My moves are... punches. But together, I think we can win!
Maylene.trainerWins: Dance moves and punches, together! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: My punches couldn't keep up with the dance...

Maylene.greeting: Fantina showed me how to bow after a battle. I want to bow after a win today!
Maylene.trainerWins: We won! Bowing now! Was that right, Fantina?
Maylene.trainerLoses: I'll bow anyway. You were amazing.

Maylene.greeting: Fantina dances, I punch. We're basically the same, right? Let's go!
Maylene.trainerWins: Dancing and punching, both winning moves!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Our moves weren't enough. Back to practice!

Fantina.greeting: Crasher Wake, you are so loud! But on stage, loud is good! Hearthome and Pastoria, allons-y!
Fantina.trainerWins: Bravo! Loud is good on stage! Allons-y to victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The curtain falls on us. Too loud? Non, not loud enough!

Fantina.greeting: Crasher Wake, your entrance music is wonderful! My ghosts want to dance to it! Allons-y!
Fantina.trainerWins: The ghosts danced, the crowd roared! Victoire!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The music stopped too soon. Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Pastoria's ring and Hearthome's stage! Every battle deserves a dramatic finale!
Fantina.trainerWins: A dramatic finale, ending in our victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: A dramatic finale... for you. Bravo.

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Even legends take a fall! What a match!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Fantina's flair and the Crasher Wake's splash! Prepare for a soaking spectacle! WAHAHAH!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Fantina's ghosts and my steel! I don't understand half of what she says, but let's win!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! I didn't understand that loss either!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Nodding didn't help that time!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Fantina, dance behind my wall of steel! Nobody's touching you!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! The wall held, and she danced!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Something got through my wall! Impressive!

Fantina.greeting: Candice, your Ice types dance on snow like my ghosts dance in the dark! A chilling ballet!

Fantina.trainerLoses: The ballet was frozen out. Non, non!

Fantina.greeting: Candice, your ice is a frozen ballroom! My ghosts will glide across it!

Fantina.trainerLoses: We slipped on the ice! Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Snowpoint's snowfall and Hearthome's spotlight! A winter performance!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The winter performance closes early.

Candice.greeting: Fantina, FOCUS! Ghost and Ice, a snowy haunted stage! We'll share the spotlight! Let's go!

Candice.trainerLoses: We lost focus AND the spotlight! Next time!

Candice.greeting: Fantina, FOCUS! Ghosts on ice, the spookiest show in Sinnoh!
Candice.trainerLoses: The show's over, and we lost. Focus harder next time!

Candice.greeting: Fantina says I have stage presence! I'm gonna FOCUS that presence on winning!
Candice.trainerWins: Stage presence plus focus equals victory!

Fantina.greeting: Volkner, you are bored? Non, non! With me, every battle is a spectacle! Sunyshore will shine!
Fantina.trainerWins: Every battle a spectacle! Sunyshore shines!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The spectacle was yours today. C'est la vie.

Fantina.greeting: Volkner, mon cher, a battle is a performance! Smile for the audience!
Fantina.trainerLoses: He didn't smile, and we lost. Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Sunyshore's lighthouse and Hearthome's stage! The brightest spotlights in Sinnoh!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The spotlights dimmed. Hélas!

Volkner.greeting: Fantina makes everything a performance. Fine. Let's give this challenger a show worth watching.
Volkner.trainerWins: A show worth watching. I'll admit it.
Volkner.trainerLoses: The show went on without us. Hm.

Volkner.greeting: Fantina wants a show. Fine. Let's at least make it a good one.
Volkner.trainerWins: It was a good show. I'll admit that.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Not a good show. For us, anyway.

Volkner.greeting: Fantina's energy might be enough to keep me awake. Let's find out.
Volkner.trainerWins: I stayed awake. And we won. Not bad.
Volkner.trainerLoses: I stayed awake for that? Ouch.

Fantina.greeting: Cynthia, the Champion! Ahh, Sinnoh's grace and my ghosts' charm. Une bataille magnifique!
Fantina.trainerWins: Une bataille magnifique, and a victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Magnifique, but lost. Such is the stage.

Fantina.greeting: Cynthia, the Champion! Your grace and my ghosts! This will be une bataille de légende!
Fantina.trainerWins: A legendary battle, and a legendary win!
Fantina.trainerLoses: A legendary battle, and a legendary loss!

Fantina.greeting: Hearthome's stage and Celestic's history! Sinnoh's most elegant duet!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The duet ends in a sigh. Bravo.

Cynthia.greeting: Fantina's Ghost types know the old Sinnoh tales as well as I do. Let's add a new one.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A new Sinnoh tale, and a happy ending for us.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The new tale has a twist. For you.

Cynthia.greeting: Fantina's ghosts remember Sinnoh's oldest stories. Let's give them a new one.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A new story, and a happy ending.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A new story, with a twist I didn't expect.

Cynthia.greeting: Fantina, let your Pokémon perform. I'll make sure the final act is ours.
Cynthia.trainerWins: The final act was ours. Beautiful work, Fantina.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The final act belonged to you. Well done.

Maylene.greeting: Crasher Wake's a wrestler, I'm a fighter! He says my punches could go pro. Let's prove it!
Maylene.trainerWins: My punches went pro! We won, Wake!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I wasn't ready to go pro yet...

Maylene.greeting: Crasher Wake taught me a wrestling hold! I've been practicing it all week!
Maylene.trainerLoses: The hold slipped... I'll keep practicing!

Maylene.greeting: Veilstone's dojo and Pastoria's ring! Fighting and wrestling, together at last!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Fighting and wrestling... down for the count.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Maylene's fists and my wrestling moves! The Crasher Wake tag team title match! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Tag team title, defended!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The title belt slips away!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Maylene's fists and the Crasher Wake's slam! The ultimate Sinnoh tag team! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Tag team champions of the Battle Tree!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The ultimate tag team got pinned!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Maylene! Your punches and my waves! A knockout splash! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The knockout splash lands!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got knocked out instead!

Maylene.greeting: Byron told me to wear shoes up the tree. I didn't. Veilstone and Canalave, let's go!
Byron laughed so hard when I climbed the tree barefoot! Let's make him laugh again with a win!
Maylene.trainerLoses: He's not laughing now... sorry, Byron.

Maylene.greeting: Canalave's iron and Veilstone's fists! The toughest training in Sinnoh!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Barefoot on this tree?! That's guts! Maylene's fists and my steel, unstoppable!
Gahahah! Maylene's fists and my steel! Sinnoh's sturdiest team, coming through!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Even the sturdiest team can fall!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Maylene! Punch from behind my steel wall, and nothing will touch you!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! You got past my wall! Impressive!

Maylene.greeting: Candice says toughness is all in your head. I go barefoot, she wears a skirt in blizzards. Let's win!
Maylene.trainerWins: Sinnoh girls don't feel the cold, and they don't lose!
Maylene.trainerLoses: We felt the cold today... and the loss.

Maylene.greeting: Candice and I trained in the snow together! She taught me to focus!
Maylene.trainerWins: We focused together, and won together!

Maylene.greeting: Snowpoint's blizzard and Veilstone's dojo! Cold and tough!
Maylene.trainerWins: Cold and tough wins the day!

Candice.greeting: Maylene, FOCUS! Barefoot on a tree, a skirt in a blizzard: Sinnoh girls don't feel the cold! Let's go!
Candice.trainerLoses: We didn't feel the cold, just the loss. Kiai, next time!

Candice.greeting: Maylene, FOCUS! Fighting and Ice, the toughest girls in Sinnoh!
Candice.trainerLoses: Toughest girls in Sinnoh, but you're tougher!

Candice.greeting: Maylene goes barefoot in the snow! That's real focus! Let's go!
Candice.trainerWins: Barefoot and focused, a winning combo!

Maylene.greeting: Volkner's the strongest Leader in Sinnoh. I'll do my best to make him take us seriously!
Maylene.trainerWins: Volkner took us seriously! And we won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Volkner was right to be bored. I let him down.

Maylene.greeting: Volkner said my battles are interesting! I'll make this one even more interesting!
Maylene.trainerWins: Was it interesting enough, Volkner? We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I'll find a way to make it more interesting next time!

Maylene.greeting: Sunyshore's lighthouse and Veilstone's dojo! Sinnoh's strongest and fiercest!

Volkner.greeting: Maylene's gotten stronger since Veilstone. Let's see if she can keep this battle from being dull.
Volkner.trainerWins: Not dull at all. Nice work, Maylene.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Dull ending. For us.

Volkner.greeting: Maylene, show me something I haven't seen before.
Volkner.trainerWins: That was something new. I'm impressed.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Nothing new today. Maybe next time.

Volkner.greeting: Maylene's spirit is strong. Let's see if it's enough to make this worthwhile.
Volkner.trainerWins: It was worthwhile. Good work, Maylene.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Not quite worthwhile. Sorry, Maylene.

Maylene.greeting: Fighting alongside Champion Cynthia! I can feel her team's aura from here! Sinnoh's shining today!
Maylene.trainerWins: Sinnoh shines! I fought beside the Champion and won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I let the Champion down... I'll train harder!

Maylene.greeting: Cynthia said my aura is strong! I'll show her just how strong!
The Champion and Veilstone's Leader! Sinnoh's best, together!

Cynthia.greeting: Maylene's team has a fine aura, as fierce as her fists. Let's see if you can feel it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A fierce aura, and a fierce win. Well done.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The aura wasn't enough today. We'll grow.

Cynthia.greeting: Maylene's fists carry her heart. Let's see how far it takes us.
Cynthia.trainerWins: All the way to victory. Well done, Maylene.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Not quite far enough today.

Cynthia.greeting: Maylene, fight with everything you have. I'll handle the rest.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Everything she had, and a victory.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Everything we had wasn't enough. Congratulations.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Byron! The steel giant of Canalave! Water and Steel, Sinnoh's heavyweight tag team! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Sinnoh's heavyweights, undefeated!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The heavyweights hit the mat!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Byron! The Crasher Wake challenges you to a shouting contest after we win! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Win first, shouting contest second!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Lost the battle, but I'll still win the shouting!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Canalave's harbor and Pastoria's marsh! Sinnoh's coastal crushers! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The coastal crushers crushed it!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The coastal crushers got crushed!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Crasher Wake's loud! But I'm louder! Canalave and Pastoria, let's crush this kid!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Crushed instead! Back to the mines!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Crasher Wake! Water and Steel, Sinnoh's loudest team!
Gahahah! Wake! Let's flatten this challenger like a steel plate!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Candice! The Crasher Wake hails from Pastoria's marsh, she hails from the snow! Water and Ice!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The marsh and the snow, triumphant!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The marsh froze over!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Candice! Your snow and my waves! A frozen tidal wave! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The frozen tidal wave crashes down!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Even legends take a fall!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The Champion's wrestling debut is a loss! Rematch!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Pastoria's marsh and the Champion of Sinnoh! The tag team title is ours! WAHAHAH!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The belt goes to you! Wear it with pride!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Candice's ice and my steel! Snowpoint and Canalave, Sinnoh's coldest, hardest team!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Candice tried to get my mustache to freeze! It held strong, like my steel!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Mustache and steel, both unbeaten!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! The mustache survived, the team didn't!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Cold steel cracked in the frost! Ha!

Candice.trainerLoses: Perfect for Snowpoint, not perfect enough here!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! My wall fell! Volkner, stay awake!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Steel, a laugh and a loss!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Canalave and Sunyshore, two harbor towns with two tough Gyms!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! The harbor towns held the line! Ships ahoy!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Both harbors flooded! Back to the docks!

Volkner.trainerWins: Byron held, I finished. Simple.
Volkner.trainerLoses: The line broke. Even I didn't expect that.

Volkner.greeting: Byron insisted on a team cheer. I mumbled along. Let's never speak of it.
Volkner.trainerWins: We won. I still won't speak of the cheer.
Volkner.trainerLoses: We lost. The cheer didn't help.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Cynthia, the Champion! Sinnoh's steel and Sinnoh's legends, together!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Even steel and legends crack!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! You broke us! I'll forge us back stronger!

Cynthia.trainerLoses: History was unkind to us today.

Cynthia.trainerLoses: Reliable, but not enough today.

Cynthia.greeting: Byron, hold the line. I'll find the opening.

Candice.greeting: Volkner, FOCUS! Ice and Electric, Snowpoint and Sunyshore! We're gonna win, I know it!

Candice.trainerLoses: Outshone and out-frozen! Focus harder next time!

Volkner.trainerLoses: Twenty minutes of focus, and still a loss.

Candice.greeting: Cynthia, the Champion! FOCUS, Candice! Snowpoint's best won't let Sinnoh's Champion down!

Candice.trainerLoses: I let Cynthia down... I'm so sorry!

Candice.trainerLoses: Even with the Champion's coat... we lost!

Candice.greeting: The Champion and Snowpoint's Leader! Sinnoh's coolest team!

Cynthia.greeting: Candice's focus is admirable. Snowpoint's ice and the Champion's resolve. Let's show you Sinnoh's strength.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Snowpoint's ice and the Champion's resolve, victorious.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Our resolve was strong. Theirs, stronger.

Cynthia.greeting: Candice's focus never wavers. Snowpoint is lucky to have her. Let's show you why.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Snowpoint's pride on full display.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Her focus was perfect. Ours wasn't enough.

Cynthia.greeting: Candice, focus on the battle. I'll focus on you.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Focus, matched by focus. That's how we won.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Our focus slipped for a moment. That was all you needed.

Volkner.greeting: Cynthia. The only Trainer in Sinnoh who never bores me. This might be fun after all.
Volkner.trainerWins: Not boring at all. Thanks, Cynthia.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Even the Champion couldn't keep that from being a loss.

Cynthia.greeting: Volkner, give it everything. I know you can.

Cheren.trainerLoses: The lesson failed. I'll revise the plan, Roxie.

Cheren.greeting: Roxie skipped my class to practice with her band. Today's lesson: teamwork. Attendance mandatory.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson passed with flying colors. Well done, Roxie.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Lesson failed. We'll review this one together.

Cheren.greeting: Aspertia's first lesson, Virbank's second. Unova's newest Trainers start right here.
Cheren.trainerWins: Unova's newest Trainers learned well today.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Unova's newest Trainers learned something new: defeat.

Roxie.greeting: Cheren's a teacher? Ugh, school. Fine, Teach. Let's make this loud and poisonous! Virbank rocks!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loud, poisonous, and victorious! Virbank rocks!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Ugh, I flunked the lesson. Detention, Teach?

Roxie.greeting: Teach brought a lesson plan to a battle! Nerd! Okay, it's a good plan. Let's rock it!
Roxie.trainerWins: Lesson plan plus rock music equals a win!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The plan didn't rock hard enough!

Roxie.greeting: Cheren says I'm his loudest student ever. I'm not even his student! Let's go, Teach!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loudest win ever! Thanks, Teach!

Cheren.greeting: Burgh sees art in every battle. I see logic. Either way, Unova's Leaders will see your defeat.
Cheren.trainerWins: Logic and art reached the same conclusion: victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Neither logic nor art saw that coming.

Cheren.greeting: Burgh asked to sketch me during the battle. I said only if we win.
Cheren.trainerWins: We won. Sketch away, Burgh.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We lost. No sketch today.

Cheren.greeting: Castelia's art and Aspertia's lessons. Unova's creativity and discipline.
Cheren.trainerWins: Creativity, disciplined. That's the lesson for today.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Creativity and discipline weren't enough. I'll revise.

Burgh.greeting: Cheren's battles are so precise, like a sketch with no wasted lines! A Unova masterpiece awaits!
Burgh.trainerWins: A Unova masterpiece, with no wasted lines!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Our sketch got smudged. Back to the canvas!

Burgh.greeting: Cheren's logic is like a perfectly measured composition! Inspiration strikes! Let's battle!
Burgh.trainerWins: A perfect composition, a perfect victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The composition crumbled! Ah, art!

Burgh.greeting: Cheren, every battle is a canvas! Let's paint a victory together!
Burgh.trainerWins: The victory is painted! Cheren, you've got an artist's eye!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The canvas is blank! Back to the studio!

Cheren.greeting: Elesa's battles dazzle. Mine teach. Between Nimbasa and Aspertia, you'll learn something today.
Cheren.trainerWins: You learned something today: how to lose to us.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I learned something today. Unpleasant, but useful.

Cheren.greeting: Elesa says I need more flair. I say flair without logic is just noise. Let's test both.
Cheren.trainerWins: Flair and logic, both proven.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Flair and logic, both disproven.

Cheren.greeting: Nimbasa's spotlight and Aspertia's classroom. You'll learn and be dazzled.
Cheren.trainerWins: You've been dazzled, and educated. Class dismissed.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We were the ones dazzled. Noted.

Elesa.greeting: Cheren's a bit serious for the runway, but he's sharp! Unova's Leaders, strike a pose!
Elesa.trainerWins: Unova's Leaders struck a pose, and the win!
Elesa.trainerLoses: We posed, but didn't win. Fashion fail!

Elesa.greeting: Cheren's so serious! I'm going to get him to strike a pose after this win!
Elesa.trainerWins: He posed! Barely! We won!
Elesa.trainerLoses: No pose, no win. Next time, Cheren!

Elesa.greeting: Cheren's logic and my lightning. Smart and shocking!
Elesa.trainerWins: Smart and shocking! Cheren, that's our new slogan!

Cheren.greeting: Clay built Driftveil with hard work and stubbornness. I teach my students the first one. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Hard work and stubbornness paid off. Thank you, Clay.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We were stubborn, but not enough today.

Cheren.greeting: Clay told me teachers have it easy. Let's see if a teacher can keep up with a miner.
Cheren.trainerWins: The teacher kept up. Thanks, Clay.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The teacher fell behind. Lesson learned.

Cheren.greeting: Driftveil's hard work and Aspertia's lessons. Unova's foundation.
Cheren.trainerWins: Hard work is the foundation. It held today.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The foundation cracked. Back to the drawing board.

Clay.greeting: Cheren, the schoolteacher! Teach this kid that Unova don't hand out wins for free!
Clay.trainerWins: Taught this kid a lesson! Unova don't hand out wins!
Clay.trainerLoses: Hmph. Kid earned that one. Fair and square.

Clay.greeting: Cheren's got a good head on his shoulders. For a schoolteacher. Let's dig in!
Clay.trainerWins: Dug in and won! Not bad, Teach!
Clay.trainerLoses: Dug in and lost! Hmph!

Clay.greeting: Cheren! Teach this kid that hard work beats talent!
Clay.trainerWins: Hard work beat talent! Told ya, kid!
Clay.trainerLoses: Talent won this time! Hmph! Back to the mines!

Cheren.greeting: Skyla delivers cargo across Unova; I deliver lessons. Today, we'll deliver a defeat.
Cheren.trainerWins: Defeat delivered. Thank you, Skyla.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Our delivery was returned to sender.

Cheren.greeting: Skyla flew me over Unova to show me where my students come from. A fine view, and a fine plan.
Cheren.trainerWins: Fine view, fine victory. Thank you, Skyla.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Fine view, poor landing.

Cheren.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Aspertia's classroom. Learning at altitude.
Cheren.trainerWins: A high-altitude lesson, well taught.
Cheren.trainerLoses: A high-altitude lesson... in falling.

Skyla.greeting: Cheren's so serious! Loosen up, flyboy! Mistralton and Aspertia are taking off together!
Skyla.trainerWins: We took off together, flyboy! Ha!
Skyla.trainerLoses: We crashed... Loosen up, Cheren, it's just a battle!

Skyla.greeting: Cheren's so stiff! I'll get him to loosen up! Let's take this battle sky-high!
Cheren, trust my birds! They know the way!
Skyla.trainerWins: They knew the way to victory! See, Cheren?
Skyla.trainerLoses: They got lost! Ugh! Don't say it, Cheren!

Cheren.greeting: Drayden taught Iris everything. I hope to teach my students half as well. Let's battle, sir.
Cheren.trainerWins: I hope my students learn from this as I did. Thank you, sir.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I've much to learn still. Thank you, Drayden.

Cheren.greeting: Drayden told me teaching is like training dragons: patience above all. Let's be patient with you.
Cheren.trainerWins: Patience rewarded. Thank you, sir.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Patience tested. Well battled.

Cheren.greeting: Opelucid's wisdom and Aspertia's lessons. Unova's teachers, together.
Cheren.trainerWins: A teacher's patience and a mentor's wisdom. Victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Today, Unova's teachers become the students.

Drayden.greeting: Cheren has grown into a fine teacher. Opelucid and Aspertia, Unova's wisdom, together.
Drayden.trainerWins: Unova's wisdom, proven together. Well done, Cheren.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Wisdom gained, victory lost. Such is battle.

Drayden.greeting: Cheren reminds me of Iris when she was young. Eager, sharp, determined. Let's begin.
Drayden.trainerWins: Determined, and victorious.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Determined, but outdone.

Drayden.greeting: Cheren, let your Pokémon learn from this battle. I'll guide them.
Drayden.trainerWins: They learned well.
Drayden.trainerLoses: They learned a hard lesson.

Cheren.greeting: Marlon's Gym is the last in Unova, and mine is the first. Together, we cover a Trainer's whole journey.
Cheren.trainerWins: A whole journey, first Gym to last, ending in victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The journey ends in defeat. A lesson, still.

Cheren.greeting: Marlon said he'd teach me to surf if we win. I'm... not sure I want that. Let's battle anyway.
Cheren.trainerWins: We won. I suppose I'm surfing now.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We lost. No surfing. I'm relieved.

Cheren.greeting: Humilau's waves and Aspertia's lessons. Unova from start to finish.
Cheren.trainerWins: From Aspertia's first Badge to Humilau's last. A complete win.
Cheren.trainerLoses: From first Badge to last, outdone by you.

Marlon.greeting: Cheren, dude, you gotta relax! Aspertia's first and Humilau's last, the whole Unova wave!
Marlon.trainerWins: Whole Unova wave, dude! Totally rad!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out, man. Cheren, relax, it's cool!

Marlon.greeting: Cheren's so uptight, dude! Ride the wave with me! Let's go!
Marlon.trainerWins: Rode the wave! Nice, Cheren!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out! Sorry, dude!

Marlon.greeting: Cheren, chill out and trust the flow, man!
Marlon.trainerWins: The flow brought us a win!
Marlon.trainerLoses: The flow went the other way!

Cheren.greeting: Chili, please don't rush in before I explain the plan. Unova's Leaders work best with a strategy.
Cheren.trainerWins: The plan worked, even with Chili rushing in.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I explained the plan. Chili didn't listen. We lost.

Cheren.greeting: Chili ran ahead again. I'll explain the plan to him mid-battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: The plan worked, even mid-battle.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The plan didn't survive Chili.

Cheren.greeting: Striaton's fire and Aspertia's lessons. Heat and logic.
Cheren.trainerWins: Heat, aimed by logic. A good combination.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Heat and logic fizzled. Chili, we'll debrief.

Chili.greeting: Cheren's got a plan? Cool! I'll just set everything on fire while he explains it! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Set it all on fire while he explained! It worked!
Chili.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I should've listened to the plan...

Chili.greeting: Cheren says I'm reckless! I say I'm passionate! Let's burn it up!
Cheren, just point me at the target! I'll handle the fire!
Chili.trainerWins: Target hit! Thanks for pointing, Cheren!
Chili.trainerLoses: Target missed! I think I pointed myself!

Cheren.greeting: Cress analyzes everything, like I do. Unova's most logical Leaders. Shall we begin?
Cheren.trainerWins: Logic prevails. A refined result, Cress.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even logic fails sometimes. Interesting.

Cheren.greeting: Cress and I both drafted battle plans. They were identical. Unova's logical minds think alike.
Cheren.trainerWins: Identical plans, flawless execution.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Identical plans, identical mistakes.

Cheren.greeting: Striaton's café and Aspertia's classroom. Logic, served with tea.
Cheren.trainerWins: Logic served, battle won.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Logic served cold.

Cress.greeting: Cheren and I both value clear thinking. A refined Unova partnership. Let's battle elegantly.
Cress.trainerWins: Clear thinking, elegant victory. A fine pairing.
Cress.trainerLoses: Our thinking was clear. Our result, less so.

Cress.greeting: Cheren's analysis is impeccable. Allow me to refine it with Striaton's Water.
Cress.trainerWins: Your analysis, my refinement. A flawless pairing.
Cress.trainerLoses: Even refined plans can be bested. My compliments.

Cress.greeting: Cheren, your strategy and my precision. A refined combination.
Cress.trainerWins: Precision and planning. The tea was worth it.
Cress.trainerLoses: Our refinement fell short. A rare thing.

Cheren.greeting: Cilan says he can taste the flavor of a battle. I'll trust his palate and my plan.
Cheren.trainerWins: Cilan's palate and my plan. A winning recipe.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The recipe needs adjusting, Cilan.

Cheren.greeting: Cilan described my battle plan as having a crisp aftertaste. I'll take that as a compliment.
Cheren.trainerWins: A crisp victory. Thank you, Cilan.
Cheren.trainerLoses: A bitter defeat. Well done.

Cheren.greeting: Striaton's garden and Aspertia's lessons. Fresh growth.
Cheren.trainerWins: Fresh growth from Aspertia and Striaton. A strong victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Fresh growth, cut short. We'll grow back.

Cilan.greeting: Cheren! Your battle style has a crisp, logical flavor! Paired with my Grass types, a fine Unova course!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The flavor turned sour. Back to the kitchen!

Cilan.greeting: Cheren! Your logic and my Grass types! A refreshing Unova salad! It's evaluation time!
Cheren, let's create a battle with the perfect balance of flavors!
Cilan.trainerWins: Perfectly balanced flavors, perfectly balanced win!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Too much salt! The flavors fought each other!

Cheren.greeting: Lenora's Normal types taught me how strong 'ordinary' can be. Two Unova Normal-type Leaders, together.
Cheren.trainerWins: Ordinary, and stronger than anyone thought. We won.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even ordinary strength has its limits.

Cheren.greeting: Lenora showed me the oldest Normal-type fossil in her museum. Tradition and logic, side by side.
Cheren.trainerWins: Tradition and logic, victorious.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Tradition and logic, humbled.

Cheren.greeting: Nacrene's museum and Aspertia's classroom. Unova's education district.
Cheren.trainerWins: The education district wins.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The education district needs to study harder.

Lenora.greeting: Cheren uses Normal types too! History says the simplest tools last longest. Let's prove it, Teacher!
Lenora.trainerWins: The simplest tools lasted longest! History repeats!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History has a new chapter. Not ours.

Lenora.greeting: Cheren's a fine Normal-type Leader! History will remember this team-up!
Lenora.trainerWins: History made! Great job, Cheren!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History lesson: we lost!

Lenora.greeting: Cheren, let's show this challenger that ordinary isn't weak!
Lenora.trainerWins: Ordinary, and strong! Normal types forever!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Ordinary today, I'm afraid. Well done!

Cheren.greeting: Brycen was an action star. I'm a teacher. We both believe in discipline. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Discipline wins. Thank you, Brycen.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Our discipline was tested and found wanting.

Cheren.greeting: Brycen showed me a scene from one of his films. Discipline, every frame. Let's battle with that discipline.
Cheren.trainerWins: Disciplined and victorious.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Disciplined, but defeated.

Cheren.greeting: Icirrus's frost and Aspertia's lessons. Cold discipline.
Cheren.trainerWins: Cold discipline, warm result.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Cold discipline melted under your pressure.

Brycen.greeting: Cheren's discipline rivals any Pokéstar Studios stunt crew. Unova's resolve, together. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A well-disciplined scene. Cut, and print. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The scene didn't land. Another take. Hm!

Brycen.greeting: Cheren's dedication rivals any stunt crew. Unova's resolve. Hm!
Cheren, stand firm. Ice and steel nerves. Hm!

Cheren.greeting: Bianca and I have been friends since we were kids in Nuvema. Don't trip on the stairs, Bianca.
Cheren.trainerWins: No tripping, no drops, and we won. Well done, Bianca.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Bianca didn't trip. I did, in my planning.

Cheren.greeting: Bianca packed snacks for both of us. She forgot her own Poké Balls. I brought spares.
Cheren.trainerWins: Spare Poké Balls, real victory. Nice, Bianca.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Spare Poké Balls, real defeat. Chin up, Bianca.

Cheren.greeting: Nuvema Town's childhood friends. We've come a long way from that first battle in my room.
Cheren.trainerWins: A long way, and a fine victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: A long way, and a long road ahead.

Bianca.greeting: Cheren! You're my partner! Just like old times! I promise I won't drop my Poké Balls this time!
Bianca.trainerWins: Just like old times! We won! I didn't drop anything!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I dropped a Poké Ball AND we lost! Sorry, Cheren!

Bianca.greeting: Cheren's always so calm! I'm gonna be calm too! Okay! Calm! Let's go!
Bianca.trainerWins: I stayed calm! We won, Cheren!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I wasn't calm at all! Sorry, Cheren!

Bianca.greeting: Cheren, remember when we wrecked your room in our first battle? Let's wreck this battle instead!
Bianca.trainerWins: We wrecked this battle way better than your room! Woohoo!
Bianca.trainerLoses: We got wrecked! Like your room, Cheren! Sorry!

Cheren.greeting: Grimsley gambles. I calculate. Strange partners for Unova, but the math says we win.
Cheren.trainerWins: The math said we'd win, and it did.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The math was wrong. Or the dice were.

Cheren.greeting: Grimsley offered me odds on this battle. I declined. I don't gamble. I calculate.
Cheren.trainerWins: Calculation correct.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Calculation incorrect.

Cheren.greeting: The Elite Four's gambler and Aspertia's teacher. Strange partners, sound strategy.
Cheren.trainerWins: Strange partners, sound strategy, solid win.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Strange partners, sound strategy, and still a loss.

Grimsley.greeting: The teacher from Aspertia. I'll bet on your lesson plan, Cheren. Unova's Elite and its finest Leader.
Grimsley.trainerWins: I bet on your lesson plan and won big. Thank you, Teacher.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Lost the bet, but I'd place it again.

Grimsley.greeting: Cheren's plans are a safe bet. I prefer a gamble, but I'll make an exception.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The safe bet paid off.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even safe bets lose sometimes.

Grimsley.greeting: Cheren, your logic and my luck. Let's see which wins.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Logic and luck both came through.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Neither logic nor luck came through. Rare.

Cheren.greeting: Colress worked with Team Plasma. Today he's on my side. Unova has changed a lot, hasn't it?
Cheren.trainerWins: Unova has changed. So has Colress. We won together.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Changed, but not enough to win. Hmm.

Cheren.greeting: Colress wants to study my Pokémon after the battle. I'll consider it if we win.
Cheren.trainerWins: We won. You may study them, Colress.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We lost. No studies today.

Cheren.greeting: Former Team Plasma scientist and Aspertia's teacher. Unova has changed.
Cheren.trainerWins: Change brings victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Change brings lessons.

Colress.greeting: Cheren, the logical Leader. Your Normal types are an excellent control group for my research.
Colress.trainerWins: A successful control group! Delightful data!
Colress.trainerLoses: The control group failed! How fascinating!

Colress.greeting: Cheren's Normal types are a perfect baseline for my research. Let's gather data.
Cheren, let's see what your Pokémon are truly capable of.
Colress.trainerLoses: They're capable of more. Next time.

Roxie.greeting: Burgh paints, I sing! Unova's art scene is taking over this battle! Get ready for the encore!
Roxie.trainerWins: The encore was a smash! Unova's art scene rules!
Roxie.trainerLoses: No encore. Our show got cancelled!

Roxie.greeting: Burgh painted my band's album cover! It's sick! Let's make this battle just as sick!
Roxie.trainerWins: Sick win! Burgh, paint THIS on the next album!
Roxie.trainerLoses: That loss is NOT going on the album cover!

Roxie.greeting: Virbank's stage and Castelia's studio! Unova's art scene takes over the Battle Tree!
Roxie.trainerWins: The art scene takes the Battle Tree! Rock on!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The art scene got booed off! Harsh crowd!

Burgh.greeting: Roxie's music is so raw! Her poison and my bugs, a punk-rock painting! Unova, inspire me!
Burgh.trainerWins: A punk-rock masterpiece! Inspiring!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The painting smeared. Still, raw art!

Burgh.greeting: Roxie's music inspires my brush! Poison and bugs, a punk-rock masterpiece in the making!
Burgh.trainerWins: The punk-rock masterpiece is finished! Encore!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The punk-rock masterpiece needs another coat!

Burgh.greeting: Roxie, play loud, and I'll paint bold! The crowd won't know where to look!
Burgh.trainerWins: Loud and bold! They didn't know where to look!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Loud and bold, and you still saw right through us!

Roxie.greeting: Elesa's a supermodel, I'm a rock star! Unova's celebrities are on tour, and you're the opening act!
Roxie.trainerWins: You were the opening act, and we were the headliners!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We got upstaged by the opening act!

Roxie.greeting: Elesa asked me to play at her next fashion show! Only if we win! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: We won! Fashion show, here I come!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We lost! No fashion show... I'll play the parking lot!

Roxie.greeting: Nimbasa's runway and Virbank's stage! Unova's celebrity tour stops at the Battle Tree!
Roxie.trainerWins: Celebrity tour: sold out! Next stop, everywhere!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Celebrity tour: canceled! Refunds at the door!

Elesa.greeting: Roxie's stage presence is electrifying! Nimbasa's runway and Virbank's stage, together!
Elesa.trainerWins: The runway and the stage, both standing ovations!
Elesa.trainerLoses: The tour hit a bump. We'll be back!

Elesa.greeting: Roxie's stage presence is electrifying! Let's light up this battle together!
Elesa.trainerWins: Lit up like Nimbasa at night! Thank you, Roxie!
Elesa.trainerLoses: The stage lights went out on us. What a shame!

Elesa.greeting: Roxie, let's make this battle a show they'll never forget!
Elesa.trainerWins: An unforgettable show, and an unforgettable win!
Elesa.trainerLoses: Unforgettable, but not in the way I hoped.

Roxie.greeting: Clay's a grumpy old miner. I'm a grumpy young singer. Unova's grumpiest team, let's go!
Roxie.trainerWins: Grumpiest team in Unova, and the winners!

Roxie.greeting: Clay said my music gives him a headache. Let's give the challenger a bigger one!
Roxie.trainerWins: Headache delivered! Pass the aspirin, Clay!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We got the headache instead! Ugh, my ears!

Roxie.greeting: Driftveil's mines and Virbank's stage! Unova's grumpiest team is ready to rumble!
Roxie.trainerWins: Grumpiest team, biggest smiles! We won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Grumpiest team just got a whole lot grumpier!

Clay.greeting: Roxie's music is too loud for an old miner! But she's tough. Driftveil and Virbank, let's dig in!
Clay.trainerWins: Dug in and won! Tough kid, that Roxie!
Clay.trainerLoses: Hmph. Too loud AND we lost. Great.

Clay.greeting: Roxie's too loud for an old miner! But she's got grit! Let's dig in!
Clay.trainerWins: That girl's got grit! Loud grit, but grit!
Clay.trainerLoses: Grit wasn't enough! Back to the mines, both of us!

Clay.greeting: Roxie! Play your loudest! I'll dig the deepest! Kid won't know what hit 'em!
Clay.trainerWins: Loudest and deepest! Kid never knew what hit 'em!
Clay.trainerLoses: Kid knew exactly what hit 'em, and hit back harder!

Roxie.greeting: Skyla flies cargo, I fly on stage! Unova's coolest girls are taking off! Get hyped!
Roxie.trainerWins: Coolest girls in Unova, coolest win!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We crashed and burned! Not cool!

Roxie.greeting: Skyla flew me to my concert in Mistralton! Best entrance ever! Let's make this battle epic!
Roxie.trainerWins: Epic win! Skyla, fly us to the after-party!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Epic fail! Skyla, fly me somewhere to sulk!

Roxie.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Virbank's stage! High-flying rock and roll!
Roxie.trainerWins: High-flying rock and roll lands a win!

Skyla.greeting: Roxie's poison and my birds! We're gonna fly circles and leave a toxic trail! Unova, takeoff!
Skyla.trainerWins: Flew circles around you! Toxic trail complete!

Skyla.greeting: Roxie's poison and my birds! Let's leave a toxic contrail across the sky!
Skyla.trainerWins: That toxic contrail's gonna hang around for days!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Our contrail faded fast. Back to the hangar!

Skyla.greeting: Roxie, let's fly circles around them! Loop-the-loops and power chords!
Skyla.trainerWins: Loop-the-loops and power chords! Perfect flight!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Too many loops! We got dizzy!

Roxie.greeting: Drayden's a mayor, so he's probably gonna lecture me. Whatever. Unova's toughest, let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: No lecture needed! We rocked!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I need that lecture now...

Roxie.greeting: Drayden said he likes my music. The mayor likes my music! That's so metal!
Roxie.trainerWins: The mayor rocks AND wins! That's metal!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The mayor lost... sorry, Drayden! Still metal!

Roxie.greeting: Opelucid's dragons and Virbank's poison! The toughest tour in Unova!
Roxie.trainerWins: The toughest tour in Unova, unbeaten!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The toughest tour in Unova, cut short!

Drayden.greeting: Roxie, the young singer from Virbank. Unova's spirit comes in many forms. Let's battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: Unova's spirit triumphs in many forms. Well done.
Drayden.trainerLoses: A lesson in humility, for both of us.

Drayden.greeting: Roxie's spirit is fierce. Opelucid respects that. Let's battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: Fierce spirit, fine victory. Well done, Roxie.

Clay.trainerLoses: Battle lost! Maybe I need investors!

Clay.greeting: Driftveil's mines and the Elite Four! Big money, big battle!
Clay.trainerWins: Big money, big win! That's how Driftveil does business!
Clay.trainerLoses: Big money, big loss! Worst deal of the year!

Grimsley.greeting: Clay's business instincts are sharp. I'll wager his Ground types and my Dark types clean up.

Grimsley.trainerLoses: The wager went south.

Grimsley.greeting: Clay's an honest businessman. Rare in my circles. Let's make an honest win.
Grimsley.trainerWins: An honest win. Refreshing.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: An honest loss. Also refreshing.

Grimsley.greeting: Clay, let's invest everything in this battle.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The investment paid off handsomely.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The investment crashed.

Clay.greeting: Colress, I chased Team Plasma outta Driftveil once. Don't make me regret this, egghead.

Clay.trainerLoses: We lost. No sensors in my mine!

Clay.greeting: Driftveil's mines and Colress's lab! Old school and new school!
Clay.trainerWins: Old school and new school, both win!
Clay.trainerLoses: Old school and new school, both flunk!

Colress.greeting: Clay's Ground types dig like remarkable machines. Let's test what they can do beside my work.

Colress.trainerLoses: The test failed. Back to the lab.

Colress.greeting: Clay's distrust is understandable. Let's earn some trust through battle.
Clay, show me the power of the earth. I'll measure it.
Colress.trainerWins: Measured: the earth is mightier than my models predicted.
Colress.trainerLoses: Measured: the earth shook, but not enough.

Skyla.greeting: Drayden's dragons fly higher than my cargo planes! Mistralton and Opelucid, let's ride the jet stream!
Skyla.trainerWins: Rode the jet stream all the way to victory!
Skyla.trainerLoses: The jet stream turned on us!

Skyla.greeting: Drayden let me fly alongside his dragons once! They're faster than my planes! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerWins: Faster than planes, faster than you!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's runway and Opelucid's dragons! Unova's air force!
Skyla.trainerWins: The Unova air force wins the dogfight!
Skyla.trainerLoses: The Unova air force got shot down!

Drayden.trainerWins: Unova's heights, conquered together.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Even the heights can fall.

Drayden.greeting: Skyla's wings are swift, her heart is swifter. Let us rise.

Drayden.trainerLoses: We rose, and you rose higher.

Drayden.greeting: Skyla, take the high ground. My dragons will hold the skies.
Drayden.trainerWins: High ground taken, skies held.
Drayden.trainerLoses: High ground lost. Well flown, challenger.

Skyla.greeting: Marlon surfs the waves, I ride the winds! Unova's sky and sea, coming at you!
Skyla.trainerWins: The whole horizon's ours! We won!
Skyla.trainerLoses: The horizon got away from us!

Skyla.greeting: Marlon and I raced once: my plane versus his surfboard! I won! Let's win today too!
Skyla.trainerWins: Plane beats surfboard, and we beat you!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's runway and Humilau's beach! Seaplane mode activated!

Marlon.greeting: Skyla's birds and my waves, man! That's the whole horizon right there. Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Whole horizon, dude! Rad win!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out on the horizon, man.

Marlon.greeting: Skyla's always flying high! I'll keep it real down on the waves, man!
Marlon.trainerWins: Sky and waves, totally gnarly win!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Sky and waves, totally bummed!

Marlon.greeting: Skyla, dive bomb, I'll wave crash!
Marlon.trainerWins: Dive bomb and wave crash! Total combo, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Dive bomb and wave crash missed, man!

Skyla.greeting: Chili's fire keeps my birds warm at high altitude! Mistralton and Striaton, take off!
Skyla.trainerWins: Fireworks in the sky! What a win!

Skyla.greeting: Chili tried to fly my plane once. Never again! But battling's fine! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerWins: Battling's way better than flying with Chili!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Maybe we should've let Chili fly after all!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's runway and Striaton's café! Fireworks over Unova!
Skyla.trainerWins: Fireworks over Unova, a perfect show!

Chili.greeting: Skyla's birds and my flames! We're gonna light up the sky like fireworks!
Skyla's birds plus my fire equals a phoenix attack! Let's light up the sky!
Chili.trainerWins: Phoenix attack! Totally lit up the sky!

Chili.greeting: Skyla, fly high, I'll burn bright!
Chili.trainerLoses: High and bright, and still lost!

Skyla.greeting: Cress is calm, like smooth flying weather! Mistralton and Striaton, cleared for landing!
Cress gets airsick! Poor guy! But in battle, he's steady as can be!
Mistralton's skies and Striaton's café! Rain clouds incoming!

Cress.greeting: Skyla's spirit is uplifting. Water and wind, a graceful Unova voyage. Shall we?
Cress.trainerWins: A graceful voyage, ending in victory.

Cress.greeting: Skyla's energy is infectious. Water and Flying, a soothing rain.
Cress.trainerWins: A soothing rain, and a refreshing win.
Cress.trainerLoses: The rain cleared, and so did our chances.

Cress.greeting: Skyla, let us create a graceful storm.
Cress.trainerWins: A graceful storm, a refined victory.
Cress.trainerLoses: A graceful storm that passed us by.

Skyla.greeting: Cilan says my battles taste airy, like a soufflé! Mistralton's on the menu today!
Cilan made a soufflé that rose higher than my planes! Okay, not really! Let's battle!
Skyla.trainerWins: A soufflé of a win! Light and fluffy!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Striaton's garden! Seeds on the wind!
Skyla.trainerWins: Seeds on the wind, flowers in bloom!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Seeds on the wind, blown away!

Cilan.greeting: Skyla's battles are light and soaring! Like a perfectly risen soufflé! It's evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A perfectly risen soufflé of a victory!

Cilan.greeting: Skyla's flight path has a light, airy flavor! Let's create a culinary takeoff!
Skyla, let's toss this battle into the air like a perfect salad!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Tossed right onto the floor! Oh dear!

Skyla.greeting: Lenora's museum has an old cargo plane exhibit! Maybe mine will be in there someday!
Skyla.trainerLoses: History's gonna remember this loss, huh?

Skyla.greeting: Lenora's museum has a model of my plane! It's tiny! Let's make history huge!
Skyla.trainerWins: History made, Lenora! Big, not tiny!
Skyla.trainerLoses: History made... in the wrong direction!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Nacrene's museum! Historic flight!

Lenora.trainerWins: A historic flight, Skyla! Well done!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Not every flight lands well.

Lenora.greeting: Skyla's flights carry Unova's future! Let's battle for history!
Lenora.trainerWins: Unova's future, secured today!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Unova's future can wait a little longer.

Lenora.greeting: Skyla, let's make today a page in the history books!
Lenora.trainerWins: A page that soars! Thank you, Skyla!
Lenora.trainerLoses: A page with a crash landing!

Skyla.greeting: Brycen's Icirrus is so cold, my birds get frostbite! But today, Ice and Flying soar together!

Skyla.greeting: Brycen once played a pilot in a movie! I gave him tips! Let's battle like a pro!
Skyla.trainerWins: Real pilot plus movie pilot equals real victory!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Icirrus's mountain! Freezing altitude!

Brycen.greeting: Skyla's birds glide through Twist Mountain's winds. Unova's cold skies, together. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The cold skies turned on us. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Skyla's flying is more daring than any stunt I've ever done. Hm!
Skyla, soar through the frost. Hm!

Skyla.trainerWins: We won! Bianca, buckle up, we're going flying!
Skyla.trainerLoses: We lost... but I'll still take you up, Bianca!

Skyla.greeting: Bianca threw up on my plane last time! But she's a great battler! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerWins: Great battler, no airsickness! We won!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's skies and Nuvema's sunshine! Clear skies ahead!

Bianca.trainerLoses: No flight today... Sorry, Skyla!

Grimsley.greeting: Skyla, let's gamble on the winds.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The winds favored us, and so did fortune.

Drayden.trainerWins: Fire and dragons, victorious.

Chili.greeting: Drayden's dragons are awesome! Fire and Dragon! Let's burn it all down!

Bianca.trainerLoses: I tripped on a fossil AND lost...

Bianca.greeting: Lenora's museum is so cool! I tripped on a fossil once! Let's win!
Bianca.trainerWins: No tripping, all winning!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Tripped again... we lost!

Bianca.greeting: Lenora, let's make history together!
Bianca.trainerWins: We made history! Put it in the museum!
Bianca.trainerLoses: We made history... the bad kind!

Lenora.greeting: Grimsley, history is full of risky bets. Let's make sure this one ends up in the history books!
Lenora.trainerWins: Into the history books, just like I said!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History books have losers too, it seems!

Lenora.greeting: Grimsley asked what the oldest bet in history was. A Trainer betting on their Pokémon! Let's honor it!
Lenora.trainerWins: The oldest bet in history pays off again!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Even the oldest bet in history can lose!

Lenora.greeting: Nacrene's museum and the Elite Four's gambler! History and risk!
Lenora.trainerWins: History rewards the bold! What a win!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History punishes the bold sometimes! Ha!

Grimsley.greeting: Lenora's research is thorough. A partner who studies the odds is a partner worth betting on.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Study the odds, and they favor you. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The odds were studied. And ignored.

Grimsley.greeting: Lenora knows the story behind every relic. I wonder which story this battle becomes.
Grimsley.trainerWins: A story of a well-placed wager. Fitting.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: A cautionary tale, then. Every museum needs one.

Grimsley.greeting: Lenora, let's place our wager on Unova's past and present.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Past and present, both paying out. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Past and present, both bankrupt today.

Lenora.greeting: Colress, your research once served Team Plasma. Today, let's research a victory together.
Lenora.trainerWins: Research complete: victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Research complete: defeat. Back to the books.

Lenora.greeting: Colress donated old Plasma equipment to my museum. A fine exhibit! Let's add a victory to it!
Lenora.trainerWins: The Plasma exhibit gets a happy ending!
Lenora.trainerLoses: The exhibit gets a sad footnote, I'm afraid!

Lenora.greeting: Nacrene's museum and Colress's lab! Archaeology meets technology!
Lenora.trainerWins: Archaeology and technology, a historic result!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Archaeology and technology, both outdated today!

Colress.greeting: Lenora's museum holds Unova's past. I study Pokémon's future. Together, we cover all of time.
Colress.trainerLoses: Even all of time couldn't save us.

Colress.greeting: Lenora catalogs everything. I measure everything. Between us, nothing goes unrecorded.
Colress.trainerWins: Recorded and cataloged: a decisive victory.
Colress.trainerLoses: Recorded and cataloged: a defeat worth studying.

Colress.greeting: Lenora, let's see what Normal types reveal under precise observation.
Colress.trainerWins: Observation complete: there is nothing ordinary here.
Colress.trainerLoses: Observation complete: our hypothesis was wrong.

Brycen.greeting: Bianca's cheer is like a fan at a film premiere. Let's give her a show worth watching. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A show worth watching, for our fan. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The show disappointed our fan. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Bianca asked me to sign her father's old Brycen-Man poster. After the battle. Hm!
Icirrus's frost and Nuvema's warmth. An odd cast, a good film. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: An odd cast, and a fine ending. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: An odd cast, and an unhappy ending. Hm.

Bianca.greeting: Brycen was Brycen-Man! I watched all his movies with my dad! Let's win, partner!
Bianca.trainerWins: Brycen-Man wins again! Like the movies!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Brycen-Man lost... that's not how the movie ends!

Bianca.greeting: Brycen-Man is on my team! My dad's gonna freak out! I have to win!
Bianca.trainerWins: We won! Dad's gonna freak out twice!
Bianca.trainerLoses: We lost... don't tell my dad!

Bianca.greeting: Brycen, do the Brycen-Man pose! Then let's win!
Bianca.trainerWins: He did the pose AND we won! Best day ever!
Bianca.trainerLoses: No pose, no win... aww!

Brycen.greeting: Grimsley's gambles are like a stunt with no safety net. Thrilling, as long as it lands. Hm!
Grimsley asked if I ever bet on my own stunts. I never needed to. I always landed them. Hm!
Icirrus's peaks and the Elite Four's table. Cold nerves, high stakes. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Cold nerves won the hand. Hm!

Grimsley.greeting: Brycen faced danger on film sets for years. Cold nerves. My favorite kind of partner.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Cold nerves, a clean win. My favorite.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Cold nerves, cold loss.

Grimsley.greeting: Brycen once leapt off a cliff for a film. My kind of risk-taker.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Another daring leap, another clean landing.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even a stunt man stumbles. Well played.

Grimsley.greeting: Brycen, let's play this battle without a safety net.
Grimsley.trainerWins: No net, no fall. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: No net, and a long way down.

Brycen.greeting: Colress's machines would make fine movie props. Ice and Steel, a cold, hard scene. Hm!
Colress built special effects for a film set once. Ice and machines, a cinematic pairing. Hm!
Icirrus's frost and Colress's steel. A cold, hard scene. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: The cold, hard scene, perfectly shot. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The cold, hard scene, cut short. Hm.

Colress.greeting: Brycen's Ice types endure extreme conditions. Remarkable resilience. Let's push it further.
Colress.trainerLoses: Pushed too far, it seems. Data noted.

Colress.greeting: Brycen's Ice types endure what my machines cannot. Let's measure the difference.
Brycen, push your Pokémon to the extremes. I'll take notes.

Bianca.greeting: Grimsley's an Elite Four member! Eek! I'm so nervous! But I'll do my very best!
Bianca.trainerWins: I did my very best, and we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I was so nervous... I'm sorry, Grimsley!

Bianca.greeting: Grimsley says I'm a lucky charm! I tripped on the way here, so I'm not sure! Let's go!
Bianca.trainerWins: I really am a lucky charm! We won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Maybe I'm an unlucky charm... sorry, Grimsley!

Bianca.greeting: Nuvema's research assistant and the Elite Four! Super unlikely team!
Bianca.trainerWins: Super unlikely team, super likely win!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Super unlikely team, super unlucky loss!

Grimsley.greeting: Bianca's luck is completely unpredictable. In a gamble, that's the best kind. Let's play.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The unpredictable paid off. What luck!
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Luck ran out. Such is the game.

Grimsley.greeting: Bianca's unpredictability makes her the best card in the deck. Let's play her.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The wild card won the game.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The wild card turned against us.

Grimsley.greeting: Bianca, play every card you have. Even the ones you drop.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Every card played, even the dropped ones. Victory.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Every card played, and they scattered everywhere.

Bianca.greeting: Colress is a scientist too! Professor Juniper would love to hear about his research!
Bianca.trainerWins: Professor Juniper will love hearing about this win!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I'll tell the Professor we tried our best...

Bianca.greeting: Colress let me look at his lab notes! I didn't understand any of them! Let's battle!
Bianca.trainerWins: I still don't understand the notes, but we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I don't understand the notes OR why we lost!

Bianca.greeting: Professor Juniper's lab and Colress's lab! Science team, go!
Bianca.trainerWins: Science team wins! Professor Juniper will be proud!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Science team needs to redo the experiment!

Colress.greeting: Bianca works for Professor Juniper? Then she understands. Let's draw out our Pokémon's potential.
Bianca's enthusiasm is an untested variable. Let's test it.
Colress.trainerLoses: Test result: enthusiasm is not enough.

Colress.greeting: Bianca, let's see what our Pokémon can achieve together.

Grimsley.greeting: Colress calls every battle an experiment. I call it a gamble. In Alola, we're both far from home.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Far from home, and still winning. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Far from home, and far from winning.

Grimsley.greeting: Colress asked me to calculate the odds of us winning. I said the fun is not knowing.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Not knowing made the win sweeter.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Not knowing made the loss sting less.

Grimsley.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Unova's scientist, far from home in Alola.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Far from home, and still winning.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Far from home, and further from victory.

Colress.greeting: Grimsley thrives on uncertainty. I thrive on reducing it. Together, an interesting result.
Grimsley's intuition defies my models. I'd like to understand it.
Grimsley, let's reduce the uncertainty in your favor.

Sina.greeting: Dexio and I came from Kalos together, and we battle together too! Professor Sycamore would be proud!
Sina.trainerWins: Professor Sycamore WOULD be proud! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: The Professor will still be proud of our effort, right?

Sina.greeting: Dexio and I share snacks between battles! He always takes the last one! Let's win so I get it today!
Sina.trainerWins: I get the last snack! We won, Dexio!
Sina.trainerLoses: Dexio gets the last snack... and we lost!

Sina.greeting: Kalos's research assistants, Ice and Psychic! Professor Sycamore's dream team!
Sina.trainerWins: The dream team delivers! Professor Sycamore will be thrilled!
Sina.trainerLoses: The dream team needs more research!

Dexio.greeting: Sina is cheerful enough for both of us. I'll handle the strategy. Kalos's research team, ready.
Dexio.trainerLoses: My strategy needs revision. Sina, stay cheerful.

Dexio.greeting: Sina's energy keeps the research team going. Let's put it to work.
Dexio.trainerWins: Energy, well spent. Thank you, Sina.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Energy, spent too quickly. We'll recharge.

Dexio.greeting: Sina, freeze them. I'll predict their next move.
Dexio.trainerWins: Frozen and predicted. A textbook victory.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Frozen and predicted, and still outplayed.

Plumeria.greeting: Guzma, try not to wreck the tree before we wreck this kid. Team Skull's taking this one.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Team Skull took it. Told ya.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Guzma, you wrecked the tree. And us.

Plumeria.greeting: Guzma kicked the door in on the way up. I'm paying for it. Let's win so it's worth it.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Worth the door. Nice work, Guzma.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Not worth the door. We're square, Guzma.

Plumeria.greeting: Team Skull's boss and big sis. The only family my grunts got.
Plumeria.trainerWins: The family's eatin' good tonight.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: The family's gonna hear about this one.

Guzma.greeting: Plumeria's got my back! Team Skull's boss and big sister! Nobody squashes us!
Guzma.trainerWins: Nobody squashes Team Skull! Big bad Guzma wins!
Guzma.trainerLoses: We got squashed! Big bad Guzma... defeated!

Guzma.greeting: Plumeria says I'm too reckless! I say I'm destruction in human form! Let's go!
Guzma.trainerWins: Destruction in human form! WE WON!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Destruction in human form... got destroyed!

Guzma.greeting: Plumeria, watch my back! Big bad Guzma's goin' in!
Guzma.trainerWins: She watched my back, and I smashed the rest!
Guzma.trainerLoses: She watched my back, and I still got squashed!

Plumeria.greeting: A Trial Captain on my team? Don't tell my grunts. Just keep that fire pointed at the kid.
Plumeria.trainerWins: The kid's toast. Don't tell my grunts I said thanks, Captain.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Even a Captain couldn't save us.

Plumeria.greeting: Kiawe's fire dance actually got my grunts to shut up. That's impressive. Let's battle.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Fire dance shut 'em up, fire shut the kid down.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Not even the fire dance could save us.

Plumeria.greeting: Team Skull and Wela Volcano. Poison smoke and fire.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Smoke and fire, smothering the kid. Nice.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Smoke cleared, fire's out. Lame.

Kiawe.greeting: Plumeria, Team Skull and a Trial Captain? Fine! For Alola, I'll dance the fire dance at your side!
Kiawe.trainerWins: For Alola! The fire dance has won!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance failed even beside Team Skull!

Kiawe.greeting: Plumeria protects her people with ferocity. I respect that. Let's battle with that same ferocity!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Ferocity rewarded! Akala's flames thank you!

Kiawe.greeting: Plumeria, follow the rhythm of my flames!
Kiawe.trainerWins: The rhythm carried us to victory!

Plumeria.greeting: Mallow, huh? My grunts can't stop talking about your cooking. Make this kid eat their words.
Plumeria.trainerWins: The kid ate their words. Nice cooking, Mallow.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: We're eating our words now.

Plumeria.greeting: Mallow fed my grunts for a week when they got lost in her jungle. I owe her. Let's win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Debt repaid. Thanks for the food, Mallow.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Still owe you, Mallow. Sorry.

Plumeria.greeting: Team Skull and the Lush Jungle. Toxic and tasty.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Toxic and tasty. The kid didn't stand a chance.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Toxic and tasty... the kid spat us out.

Mallow.greeting: Plumeria's tough, but she protects her friends. I respect that! Today's special: Alolan teamwork!
Plumeria's tough as nails, but she loves her grunts! I love feeding people! Let's go!
Mallow.trainerWins: Victory feast! Plumeria, bring the grunts!
Mallow.trainerLoses: No feast tonight... I'll still cook something!

Mallow.greeting: Plumeria, let's cook up a poisonous surprise!
Mallow.trainerWins: Surprise served! Plumeria, that was delicious!
Mallow.trainerLoses: The surprise backfired! Too much poison!

Guzma.greeting: A Trial Captain?! Big bad Guzma never needed your trials! But fine, let's wreck this kid together!
Guzma.trainerWins: Wrecked the kid! Big bad Guzma never needed trials!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Wrecked by the kid! Ugh! No trials!

Guzma.greeting: Kiawe keeps tellin' me to "find my rhythm." Big bad Guzma's rhythm is SMASHIN'!
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashin' rhythm wins! See, Kiawe?!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Even smashin' rhythm got off-beat!

Guzma.greeting: Team Skull's boss and a Trial Captain! Kid's gonna regret this!
Guzma.trainerWins: The kid regrets it! Big bad Guzma wins!
Guzma.trainerLoses: WE regret it! Big bad Guzma's... frustrated!

Kiawe.greeting: Guzma once tried to take the trials too. Show me what you've got now. Akala's flames are with you!
