Guzma, follow my flames! Don't charge ahead!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: He charged ahead! Of course he did!

Guzma.greeting: The Lush Jungle captain, huh? Big bad Guzma'll smash 'em, you clean up the mess. Deal?
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashed 'em! Mallow cleaned up! Deal's a deal!
Guzma.trainerLoses: The mess got us instead!

Guzma.greeting: Mallow said she'd feed me her spiciest dish if I wreck her jungle. Big bad Guzma fears nothin'! Except that.
Guzma.trainerWins: Jungle's safe, dish avoided! Victory!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Jungle's safe, but I'm gettin' that spicy dish, ain't I?

Guzma.greeting: Team Skull's boss and the Lush Jungle captain! Destruction and dinner!
Guzma.trainerWins: Destruction AND dinner! Best day ever!
Guzma.trainerLoses: No destruction, no dinner! Worst day ever!

Mallow.greeting: Guzma, if you wreck my jungle again, I'm feeding you my spiciest dish! Now, let's battle!
Mallow.trainerWins: No spicy dish needed! We won!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Guzma, you're getting the spicy dish anyway!

Mallow.greeting: Guzma eats like three grunts! I'll make him a victory feast if he behaves!
Mallow.trainerWins: He behaved! Victory feast for Guzma!
Mallow.trainerLoses: He didn't behave... no feast, Guzma!

Mallow.greeting: Guzma, smash them, but leave the plants alone!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Plants trampled AND we lost! Guzma!

Kiawe.greeting: Mallow and I are both Akala Trial Captains! Fire and Grass, Alola's island spirit burns bright!
Mallow brought lunch to my trial site again. Fire and Grass, fueled by her cooking!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Fueled by Mallow's lunch, Akala's captains win!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Even Mallow's lunch couldn't fuel us today!

Kiawe.greeting: Akala's Wela Volcano and Lush Jungle! The island's heart!
Kiawe.trainerWins: The heart of Akala beats strong!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: The heart of Akala skipped a beat!

Mallow.greeting: Kiawe, your fire would make perfect grilled Alolan sausages! Akala's captains, let's cook!
Mallow.trainerWins: Grilled sausages AND a win! Let's cook!
Mallow.trainerLoses: The sausages burned! So did we!

Mallow.greeting: Kiawe dances while he cooks! It's so funny! Let's battle like he cooks!
Kiawe, grill 'em, and I'll garnish!
Mallow.trainerWins: Grilled and garnished! A perfect dish!

Brock.greeting: Roxanne studied my Gym's battles in her textbooks. Two Rock-type Leaders, rock-solid together!
Brock.trainerWins: Rock-solid, just like I promised! Great job, Roxanne!
Brock.trainerLoses: Even rock-solid teamwork crumbles sometimes.

Brock.greeting: Roxanne asked me to guest lecture at the Trainers' School. I said yes, if we pass this test.
Brock.trainerWins: Test passed! Lecture's on, Roxanne!
Brock.trainerLoses: Test failed! I'll need to study up first!

Brock.greeting: Pewter and Rustboro! Kanto's first Gym and Hoenn's first Gym!
Brock.trainerWins: Kanto's first and Hoenn's first, and first place too!
Brock.trainerLoses: First Gyms, but second place today!

Roxanne.greeting: Brock's battles were in my study notes! Today, Kanto and Hoenn's Rock types write a new chapter.
Roxanne.trainerWins: A new chapter, written in victory!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The chapter ends in defeat. I'll revise my notes.

Roxanne.greeting: Brock's rock-solid defense is chapter one in every textbook. Let's put theory into practice!
Brock, let's show them the first lesson is the most important!
Roxanne.trainerWins: The first lesson is the most important, and we taught it!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The first lesson... we must review it again!

Brock.greeting: Roark digs up fossils, just like Pewter's museum! Rock types from Kanto and Sinnoh, let's go!
Brock.trainerWins: Rock types from Kanto and Sinnoh, unbreakable!
Brock.trainerLoses: Our rocks got broken. Ouch.

Brock.greeting: Roark showed me his fossil lab. Pewter's museum would love to borrow a few. Let's dig in!
Brock.trainerWins: Dug in and won! Good work, Roark!
Brock.trainerLoses: Dug in, and we got buried!

Brock.greeting: Pewter's museum and Oreburgh's mine! Rock types, dug up and fired up!
Brock.trainerWins: Dug up and fired up, and we won!
Brock.trainerLoses: Dug up and fired up... and buried!

Roark.greeting: Brock's the original Rock-type Leader! I'm honored. Oreburgh and Pewter, rock-hard teamwork!
Roark.trainerWins: Honored to win with the original!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even the original couldn't save us.

Roark.greeting: Brock's the legend of Rock types! I'm digging this team-up!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug up a victory! Thanks, Brock!

Roark.greeting: Brock, let's carve this challenger like a fossil!
Roark.trainerWins: Carved clean! A perfect specimen!

Roxanne.greeting: Roark revives living fossils! I've read all about them. Rock types from Hoenn and Sinnoh, together!
Roxanne.trainerWins: Living fossils and textbook notes, victorious!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My geology notes didn't cover this. Oops.

Roxanne.greeting: Roark lent me his mining helmet for a field trip. My students loved it! Let's battle!
Roxanne.trainerWins: A victory worthy of a field trip report!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: A field trip... to defeat. Noted.

Roxanne.greeting: Rustboro's classroom and Oreburgh's mine! Theory and fieldwork, united!
Roxanne.trainerWins: Theory and fieldwork earn top marks!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Theory and fieldwork, both need more study!

Roark.greeting: Roxanne's notes on Rock types are better than my mining manuals! Let's dig in, Rustboro!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug in and won, Rustboro!

Roark.greeting: Roxanne's notes are so detailed! I'm taking notes on her notes! Let's go!
Roark.trainerWins: My notes on her notes say: we won!
Roark.trainerLoses: My notes on her notes say: we lost. Ugh!

Roark.greeting: Roxanne, you study their weak points, I'll swing the pickaxe!
Roark.trainerWins: Weak points found, pickaxe swung! Done!
Roark.trainerLoses: Weak points found... but my pickaxe missed!

Misty.greeting: Juan taught Wallace everything about Water types! I want to learn his secrets, after we win!
Misty.trainerWins: We won! Now, Juan, tell me your secrets!
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost... I guess the secrets stay secret.

Misty.greeting: Juan gave me a lesson in Water-type elegance. I'll give the challenger a lesson in getting soaked!
Misty.trainerWins: Lesson delivered! Thanks, Juan!
Misty.trainerLoses: We're the ones who got soaked! Ugh!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean and Sootopolis! Kanto's mermaid and Hoenn's maestro!
Misty.trainerWins: The mermaid and the maestro win the encore!
Misty.trainerLoses: The mermaid and the maestro, washed up!

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Misty! The Cerulean mermaid! Kanto's waters and Hoenn's, a sparkling duet!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the duet ended off-key.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Misty, your spirit sparkles like Sootopolis's waters! A duet, then!
Juan.trainerWins: A sparkling duet, a sparkling victory!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the duet ended on a sour note!

Juan.greeting: Misty, let us turn this battle into a water ballet!
Juan.trainerLoses: The water ballet, a splash in the face!

Misty.greeting: Crasher Wake's so loud! But he loves Water types as much as I do. Cerulean and Pastoria, splash!
Misty.trainerWins: Cerulean and Pastoria made a splash!
Misty.trainerLoses: Too much splash, not enough win!

Misty.greeting: Crasher Wake splashed my whole audience at the Cerulean water show! They loved it! Let's battle!
Misty.trainerWins: Another splash hit! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: We got splashed this time! Ugh!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean and Pastoria! Kanto's mermaid and Sinnoh's wrestler!
Misty.trainerWins: Mermaid and wrestler, total knockout!
Misty.trainerLoses: Mermaid and wrestler, both tapped out!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Splashed out!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Honorary partners, pinned!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Misty! Splash 'em, and the Crasher Wake will slam 'em! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Splashed and slammed!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got splashed AND slammed!

Misty.greeting: Marlon surfs better than I swim, and I swim like a mermaid! Cerulean and Humilau, Water types forever!
Misty.trainerWins: Water types forever! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Our tsunami fizzled out!

Misty.trainerWins: Won the race, won the battle!
Misty.trainerLoses: Lost the battle... at least I won the race!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean and Humilau! Kanto's mermaid and Unova's surfer!
Misty.trainerWins: Mermaid and surfer, riding the winning wave!
Misty.trainerLoses: Mermaid and surfer, washed ashore!

Sabrina.trainerLoses: Words are still unnecessary. You've earned this.

Sabrina.greeting: Saffron's Gym and the Battle Frontier. Two minds, one will.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Two minds, one will, one victory.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Two minds, one will, and still outmatched.

Anabel.greeting: Sabrina's mind is sharp as a blade. I can sense her Pokémon's trust. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Her Pokémon's trust carried us. A fine win.

Anabel.greeting: Sabrina's mind and my sense for bonds. Together, nothing is hidden.
Anabel.trainerWins: Nothing was hidden from us. A clean victory.
Anabel.trainerLoses: You hid your bond well. I'm impressed.

Anabel.greeting: Sabrina, let's read their every move together.
Anabel.trainerWins: We read every move. Not one surprised us.
Anabel.trainerLoses: We read every move, and you still surprised us.

Dexio.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain. Her Psychic types are formidable. Kalos and Hoenn, let's begin.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Even a Frontier Brain can't win every time.

Dexio.greeting: Anabel told me she sensed my Pokémon's trust in me. That means more than any data. Let's battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: Trust, confirmed by victory. Thank you, Anabel.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Trust, tested by defeat. It still holds.

Dexio.greeting: Kalos's research and the Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Psychic synergy.
Dexio.trainerWins: Psychic synergy, confirmed by the results.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Psychic synergy, disrupted. I'll revise my notes.

Anabel.greeting: Dexio's bond with his Pokémon is quiet but strong. I sense it. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Quiet but strong, as I sensed.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The bond held. The battle didn't.

Anabel.greeting: Dexio's bond is quiet but unbreakable. I sense it. Let's battle.
Dexio, let your bond guide your choices today.
Anabel.trainerWins: His bond guided him true. Victory.
Anabel.trainerLoses: His bond guided him, but yours was stronger.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Flannery took over her grandpa's Gym, and I rebuilt mine after a volcano blew it up! Fire-type Leaders never quit!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire-type Leaders never quit, and we won!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Even an eruption couldn't stop me... but you did!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Flannery's grandfather and I were rivals! Now I battle beside his granddaughter! Let's fire it up!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Her grandpa would be proud!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Her grandpa would laugh at us!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Cinnabar's volcano and Lavaridge's hot springs! Fire-type heat from the earth itself!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Volcano and hot springs, boiling over!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Volcano and hot springs, gone cold!

Flannery.greeting: Blaine kept his Gym going even after Cinnabar's volcano erupted! That's the Leader I want to be! Let's heat it up!
Flannery.trainerWins: That's the Leader I want to be! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I want to be like Blaine... starting with not losing!

Flannery.greeting: Blaine knew my grandpa! I gotta make them both proud! Let's heat it up!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Grandpa and Blaine, both disappointed... ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Blaine, quiz time! What happens when two volcanoes team up?

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Quiz time, Chili! Which burns hotter, Cinnabar's volcano or Striaton's kitchen? Let's test it on the challenger!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! The challenger got roasted! Quiz complete!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer! We got roasted!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Chili answered all my quiz questions wrong, but with such passion! Let's battle!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Wrong answers, right result!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answers, wrong result!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Cinnabar and Striaton! The quizmaster and the hothead!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quizmaster and hothead, perfect score!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Quizmaster and hothead, failing grade!

Chili.greeting: Blaine's quizzes are awesome! Answer: the challenger's about to get roasted! Fire types, let's go!
Blaine's quizzes are so hard! But I know one answer: we're gonna win!
Chili.trainerWins: Right answer! We won! Ask me another, Blaine!
Chili.trainerLoses: Wrong answer! We lost! Can I retake the quiz?

Chili.greeting: Blaine, quiz me on fire! I'll answer with flames!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Kiawe dances on Wela Volcano, and I built my Gym on Cinnabar's! Two volcano men, burning bright!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Two volcano men, burning bright!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Our volcanoes went dormant!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Kiawe danced on my volcano when he visited Cinnabar! Let's dance on this challenger!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! We danced right over 'em, Kiawe!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! They danced right over us!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Cinnabar and Wela! Two volcanoes, one eruption!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! One eruption, and the challenger's toast!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! One eruption, and only smoke came out!

Kiawe.greeting: Blaine's Gym survived an eruption, and his fire never went out! Akala's captain salutes you! Let's burn!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance fell short beside the master...

Kiawe.greeting: Blaine's spirit is like a volcano that never sleeps! Let's burn together!
Kiawe.trainerWins: A volcano that never sleeps, victorious!

Kiawe.greeting: Blaine, follow the rhythm of the flames! Feel the dance!
Kiawe.trainerWins: The rhythm carried us! Blaine, you're a natural!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: The rhythm broke! Blaine, you stepped on my foot!

Flannery.greeting: Chili's even more fired up than me! Lavaridge's hot springs and Striaton's hot sauce, let's get spicy!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Too spicy for us, I guess!

Flannery.greeting: Chili's hot sauce made me cry! It was amazing! Let's make the challenger cry too!
Flannery.trainerWins: Challenger's crying now! We won, Chili!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Now WE'RE crying! And it's not the hot sauce!

Flannery.greeting: Lavaridge and Striaton! Hot springs and hot sauce!
Flannery.trainerWins: Hot springs and hot sauce, scorching win!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Hot springs and hot sauce, cooled off!

Chili.greeting: Flannery gets it! Fire's all about passion! Lavaridge and Striaton, crank up the heat!
Chili.trainerWins: Cranked up the heat! We won!

Chili.greeting: Flannery gets it! Fire is passion! Let's burn it all down!
Chili.trainerWins: Burned it all down! Flannery, high five!
Chili.trainerLoses: Burned out too fast! Flannery, I'm sorry!

Chili.greeting: Flannery, let's crank the heat to max!
Chili.trainerWins: Max heat, max win! Flannery, you're awesome!
Chili.trainerLoses: Max heat... and we still melted!

Flannery.greeting: Kiawe's fire dance is so cool! Maybe I'll try it at the Lavaridge hot springs! Let's burn it up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Volcano Trainers win! I'm trying the fire dance!
Flannery.trainerLoses: My fire dance needs work... we lost!

Flannery.greeting: Kiawe taught me his fire dance! I tripped a lot! But I'll battle better than I dance!
Flannery.trainerWins: Battled better than I danced! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Battled worse than I danced... somehow!

Flannery.greeting: Lavaridge and Wela! Volcano Trainers unite!

Kiawe.greeting: Flannery's spirit burns like Wela Volcano itself! Lavaridge and Akala, volcano Trainers unite!
Flannery's spirit burns like Wela Volcano! Let's dance the fire dance together!
Kiawe.trainerWins: The fire dance, performed perfectly! Well done, Flannery!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: The fire dance stumbled! We'll practice!

Kiawe.greeting: Flannery, feel the rhythm of the flames, and strike!
Kiawe.trainerWins: She felt it! The rhythm brought victory!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: We lost the rhythm, and the battle!

Chili.greeting: Kiawe's a fire dancer, and I'm a fire waiter! Same energy! Let's serve up some flames!
Kiawe asked me to join his fire dance! I'll dance AND battle! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Danced, battled and won! Kiawe, teach me more!
Chili.trainerLoses: Danced, battled and lost! Too many steps!

Chili.greeting: Striaton's café and Wela Volcano! Fire waiter and fire dancer!
Chili.trainerWins: Fire waiter and fire dancer, winning combo!
Chili.trainerLoses: Fire waiter and fire dancer, dropped the tray!

Kiawe.greeting: Chili's passion rivals the flames of Wela Volcano! Fire types, our blaze will not die out!
Chili's passion rivals Wela Volcano! Let's burn bright together!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Burned bright, just as I knew we would!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Burned out too soon! We'll rekindle!

Kiawe.greeting: Chili, let's set this battle ablaze with Akala's spirit!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Ablaze with Akala's spirit, and victorious!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Ablaze, but extinguished by a stronger wind!

Giovanni.greeting: Clay built an empire from his mines. I built mine by... other means. Ground types respect only strength.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Strength failed. Unacceptable.

Giovanni.greeting: Clay refused my offer to buy his mines. A man of principle. I can respect that, briefly.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Principle and power, both insufficient.

Giovanni.greeting: Viridian's Ground types and Driftveil's. The earth obeys strength.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: The earth defied us. Unexpected.

Clay.greeting: Team Rocket's boss, huh? Hmph. Business is business, and my Ground types don't care who's watchin'. Let's dig.
Clay.trainerWins: Business is business. And business is good.
Clay.trainerLoses: Business went bust. Hmph.

Clay.greeting: Giovanni offered me a fortune for my mines. I said no. Today, I'll take his help. Nothin' more.
Clay.trainerWins: His help paid off. Still not sellin'!
Clay.trainerLoses: His help didn't help! Hmph!

Clay.greeting: Giovanni, you dig 'em a hole, I'll fill it in!
Clay.trainerWins: Hole dug, filled in! Good work, Giovanni!
Clay.trainerLoses: We're the ones in the hole! Hmph!

Falkner.greeting: Winona's birds fly like clouds. My father would have loved to see them. Violet and Fortree, take wing!
Falkner.trainerWins: Violet and Fortree took wing! My father would be proud!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We were grounded today. Even the clouds fell.

Falkner.greeting: Winona flew with my father once. She told me stories about him. Let's honor him today!
Falkner.trainerWins: Father would be proud! Thank you, Winona!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Father would understand. We'll fly again.

Falkner.greeting: Violet and Fortree! Johto and Hoenn's skies, united!
Falkner.trainerWins: The skies of two regions, both ours today!
Falkner.trainerLoses: The skies of two regions, clouded over!

Winona.greeting: Falkner defends the honor of Flying types, as I do. Johto's skies and Hoenn's, soaring as one.
Falkner's dedication to Flying types reminds me of his father. Let's soar together.
Falkner, let's ride the same wind.
Winona.trainerWins: The same wind carried us to victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: The same wind turned against us.

Falkner.greeting: Skyla flies real planes! My birds are a little jealous. Flying-type Leaders, let's soar!
Falkner.trainerWins: Flying-type Leaders soared! Great flying, Skyla!
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds are jealous of your plane... and that challenger.

Falkner.greeting: Skyla let me ride in her cargo plane! My birds were jealous! Let's battle!
Falkner.trainerWins: My birds won't be jealous anymore! Victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds are still jealous, and now grounded.

Falkner.greeting: Violet's birds and Mistralton's planes! Johto and Unova's skies!
Falkner.trainerWins: Birds and planes, ruling the skies!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Birds and planes, shot down!

Skyla.greeting: Falkner's birds are so well trained! Violet City's finest and Mistralton Cargo, cleared for takeoff!
Skyla.trainerWins: Cleared for takeoff, landed a win!

Skyla.greeting: Falkner's birds are so well trained! Let's take to the skies!
Skyla.trainerWins: Took to the skies, landed a win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Took to the skies, and crashed!

Skyla.greeting: Falkner, let's loop-the-loop around them till they're dizzy!
Skyla.trainerWins: Looped 'em till they were dizzy! Ha!
Skyla.trainerLoses: We got looped till WE were dizzy!

Winona.greeting: Skyla's cargo planes and my birds ride the same winds. Fortree and Mistralton, together in the sky.
Winona.trainerWins: Same winds, same victory. Well flown, Skyla.
Winona.trainerLoses: The winds turned against us both.

Winona.greeting: Skyla asked me to teach her graceful flight. She taught me loop-the-loops. Let's battle!
Winona.trainerWins: Grace and loop-the-loops, a winning flight!
Winona.trainerLoses: Grace and loop-the-loops, and still we fell.

Winona.greeting: Fortree and Mistralton. Hoenn and Unova's skies, side by side.
Winona.trainerWins: Side by side, the skies are ours.
Winona.trainerLoses: Side by side, and the skies were yours.

Skyla.greeting: Winona's so graceful in the air! I'm more of a loop-the-loop flyer. Fortree and Mistralton, let's take off!
Winona's so elegant! I'll try to be elegant too! Let's fly!
Skyla.trainerWins: Elegant victory! Did I do it right, Winona?

Skyla.greeting: Winona, let's ride the jet stream!
Skyla.trainerWins: Rode the jet stream to victory!
Skyla.trainerLoses: The jet stream blew us away!

Bugsy.greeting: Burgh paints Bug types, and I research them! Azalea and Castelia, the Bug-type experts' summit!
Bugsy.trainerWins: The Bug-type experts' summit, victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research needs more data!

Bugsy.greeting: Burgh painted a portrait of my favorite Bug type! I'm hanging it in my Gym! Let's battle!
Bugsy.trainerWins: A victory to hang next to the portrait!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: No victory for the wall today!

Bugsy.greeting: Azalea and Castelia! Bug research and Bug art!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Research and art, victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Research and art, back to the drawing board!

Burgh.greeting: Bugsy knows every Bug type by heart, and I know them by color! Together, a Bug-type masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerWins: A Bug-type masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The masterpiece got squashed!

Burgh.greeting: Bugsy's knowledge of Bug types is astounding! A true scholar! Let's paint a victory!
Burgh.trainerWins: A scholar's masterpiece! Bugsy, brilliant!
Burgh.trainerLoses: A scholar's smudge! Ah, well!

Burgh.greeting: Bugsy, let's create a Bug-type masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerWins: A masterpiece, scientifically accurate!
Burgh.trainerLoses: A masterpiece, scientifically flawed!

Bugsy.greeting: Guzma's Bug types are amazing! Can I take notes on them after the battle? Bug types, let's go!
Bugsy.trainerWins: I wrote it down: destruction! Of the challenger!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: I'll take notes on how we got destroyed instead...

Bugsy.greeting: Guzma let me take notes on his Bug types! He's actually really nice about it! Let's battle!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Notes taken, battle won! This is great research!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Notes taken, battle lost! Still great research!

Bugsy.greeting: Azalea's research and Team Skull's boss! Bug types, all kinds!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Bug types, all kinds, all winners!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Bug types, all kinds, all squashed!

Guzma.greeting: A Bug-type nerd, huh? Fine. Watch big bad Guzma and write this down: destruction!
Guzma.trainerWins: Big bad Guzma smashed it! Write THAT down!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Big bad Guzma got smashed! Don't write that!

Guzma.greeting: A Bug nerd, huh? Fine. Watch big bad Guzma and take notes on THIS!
Guzma.trainerWins: Take notes: big bad Guzma wins!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Take notes: big bad Guzma... lost. Don't write that!

Guzma.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe somethin's my weakness.

Burgh.greeting: Guzma's Bug types are a sculpture of pure power! How inspiring!
Burgh.trainerWins: A sculpture of pure power, and pure victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The sculpture crumbled!

Burgh.trainerWins: A sculpture of pure power, victorious!

Burgh.greeting: Castelia and Team Skull! Art and destruction!
Burgh.trainerWins: Art and destruction, a masterpiece!

Guzma.trainerWins: Big bad Guzma, smashin' it! Paint that!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Don't paint THAT, artist!

Guzma.greeting: An artist, huh? Paint big bad Guzma smashin' this kid!
Guzma.trainerWins: Paint it! Big bad Guzma smashed 'em!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Don't you dare paint this one, artist!

Guzma.greeting: Burgh, sketch fast! Big bad Guzma's movin'!
Guzma.trainerWins: Sketched fast, smashed faster!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Too fast to sketch! Too slow to win!

Whitney.greeting: Norman's team is huge! Me and my cuties are gonna roll right alongside 'em! Normal types, go!

Whitney.trainerLoses: Cute AND strong... and crying! Waaah!

Norman.trainerLoses: We were humbled today. Train harder.

Norman.greeting: Whitney's spirit is strong, even if her tears flow freely. Let's battle.
Norman.trainerWins: No tears today. Well done, Whitney.
Norman.trainerLoses: Tears today, I'm afraid. Chin up.

Norman.greeting: Whitney, Brendan and May would cheer for you. Let's give them something to cheer about.
Norman.trainerWins: Brendan and May have plenty to cheer about now.
Norman.trainerLoses: Brendan and May will tease me about this one.

Whitney.greeting: Cheren's so serious! Are you gonna grade me, Teach? Normal types are cute AND strong!
Whitney.trainerWins: Cute AND strong! What's my grade, Teach?
Whitney.trainerLoses: Do I get extra credit for trying?

Whitney.greeting: Cheren says Normal types need strategy! I say they need love! Let's do both!
Whitney.trainerWins: Strategy and love, both work! We won!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Strategy and love... and tears! Waaah!

Whitney.greeting: Goldenrod and Aspertia! Normal-type Leaders, cute and smart!
Whitney.trainerWins: Cute and smart, top of the class!

Cheren.trainerWins: Textbook. Whitney gets top marks.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The lesson didn't go to plan. Revising.

Cheren.greeting: Whitney's tears are a known variable. Let's minimize them by winning.
Cheren.trainerWins: Tears minimized. Victory maximized.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Tears maximized. I'm sorry, Whitney.

Cheren.greeting: Whitney, today's lesson: never underestimate Normal types.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson taught, and the class passed.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Lesson learned, by the teachers this time.

Whitney.greeting: Lenora runs a museum AND a Normal-type Gym? That's so cool! Goldenrod and Nacrene, let's go!
Whitney.trainerWins: Goldenrod and Nacrene win! History made!
Whitney.trainerLoses: No history books for this one... Waah!

Whitney.greeting: Lenora gave me a museum tour, and I cried at the fossils! They looked so old and lonely! Let's battle!
Whitney.trainerWins: No crying today! We won, Lenora!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Waaah! I'm crying again, and not at fossils!

Whitney.greeting: Goldenrod's Department Store and Nacrene's museum! Shopping AND history!
Whitney.trainerWins: Shopping and history, both on the winner's list!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Shopping and history... and we're broke!

Lenora.greeting: Whitney's Gym is famous for humbling new Trainers! Let's add that to the history books! Normal types, together!
Lenora.trainerWins: Another newcomer humbled! Into the history books!
Lenora.trainerLoses: The history books will say we tried!

Lenora.greeting: Whitney's emotions run as strong as her Pokémon! Let's channel that into a win!

Lenora.trainerLoses: Channeled... into tears, I'm afraid!

Lenora.greeting: Whitney, let's show them that Normal types make history!
Lenora.trainerWins: History made, by the cutest team in Unova and Johto!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History made... a tearful chapter!

Norman.trainerLoses: Patience wasn't enough today. We learn.

Norman.trainerLoses: Patience, tested. We'll learn from this.

Norman.greeting: Petalburg and Aspertia. A father and a teacher. Both raise Trainers.
Norman.trainerLoses: Even well-raised Trainers stumble.

Cheren.greeting: Norman's team is a lesson in raw power. Petalburg and Aspertia, Normal types, side by side.
Cheren.trainerWins: A lesson in raw power, delivered. Thank you, sir.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Raw power fell short. A lesson for us both.

Cheren.greeting: Norman's discipline is the kind I teach to my students. Let's demonstrate it.
Cheren.trainerWins: Demonstration complete. Class, take notes.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Demonstration failed. Class, ignore that.

Cheren.greeting: Norman, let's teach a lesson in Normal-type strength.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson taught. Thank you, Norman.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Lesson learned. By us, unfortunately.

Norman.greeting: Lenora understands that Normal types are anything but ordinary. Petalburg and Nacrene, let's prove it.
Norman.trainerLoses: Ordinary today, I'm afraid.

Norman.greeting: Lenora asked me to donate one of my old Gym Badges to her museum. Only if we win.
Norman.trainerWins: We won. The Badge is yours, Lenora.
Norman.trainerLoses: We lost. The Badge stays in Petalburg.

Norman.greeting: Petalburg and Nacrene. Two Normal-type Gyms that refuse to be called ordinary.
Norman.trainerWins: Two Gyms, zero ordinary. Well done, Lenora.
Norman.trainerLoses: Two Gyms, and today, ordinary results.

Lenora.greeting: Norman's battles are the stuff of Hoenn legend! Let's make some Unova history too! Normal types, together!
Lenora.trainerWins: Hoenn legend and Unova history, made together!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History won't remember this one fondly!

Lenora.greeting: Norman's legacy is already Hoenn history! Let's make some Unova history too!
Lenora.trainerWins: Unova history made, with a Hoenn legend!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History was not kind to us today!

Lenora.greeting: Norman, let's prove Normal types are anything but ordinary, again!
Lenora.trainerWins: Proven again! Normal types forever!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Not proven today, but we'll try again!

Morty.greeting: Fantina's Ghost types move like dancers. Ecruteak and Hearthome, a mystical pairing.
Morty.trainerWins: A mystical victory, as I foresaw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The spirits turned away from us.

Morty.greeting: Fantina dances with her ghosts. I meditate with mine. Today, we move as one.

Morty.trainerLoses: We moved as one, yet the spirits turned away.

Morty.greeting: Ecruteak's tower and Hearthome's stage. Mystics of Johto and Sinnoh.
Morty.trainerWins: The mystics foresaw this victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: The mystics did not foresee this.

Fantina.greeting: Morty, the Ecruteak mystic! Ghost types of Johto and Sinnoh, a séance magnifique!

Fantina.trainerLoses: The séance summoned... only defeat. Hélas!

Fantina.greeting: Morty, let your ghosts dance with mine! Une danse macabre!
Fantina.trainerWins: Une danse macabre, ending in triumph!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Une danse macabre, ending in tears!

Chuck.greeting: Brawly trains in the sea, I train under waterfalls! Same water, same spirit! Fighting types, HYAH!

Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got swept away like a waterfall!

Chuck.greeting: Cianwood's waterfall and Dewford's surf! Fighting types, water-trained!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Water-trained fists... washed right out! Hmph!

Chuck's intensity is like a big wave crashing down! Let's ride it!
Brawly.trainerWins: Rode Chuck's wave all the way!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Chuck's wave crashed right on us!

Brawly.greeting: Chuck, let's crash into this battle like a big wave!
Brawly.trainerWins: Crashed in and won! Big wave, big win, Chuck!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Crashed in, wiped out! Back to training, Chuck!

Chuck.greeting: Maylene trains barefoot! Excellent! Toughen those soles! Fighting types, Cianwood and Veilstone!
Maylene wants to try my waterfall training! First, she must survive this battle! HYAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! She survived! To the waterfall!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We didn't survive! The waterfall can wait!

Chuck.greeting: Cianwood and Veilstone! Fighting dojos united!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The dojos took a beating!

Maylene.greeting: Chuck's training is so intense... I want to try the waterfall too! After we win! Fighting types, let's go!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I lost... maybe I need the waterfall now!

Maylene.greeting: Chuck's training is so intense! I'll show him I'm ready!
Maylene.trainerWins: I'm ready! Waterfall training, here I come!

Maylene.greeting: Chuck, let's punch through this challenger together!

Brawly.greeting: Maylene's team has some serious aura! Dewford's waves and Veilstone's fists, let's do this!
Maylene's got serious aura! I can feel it like a swell before a big wave! Let's go!
Brawly.trainerWins: That swell turned into a monster wave! Victory!

Brawly.greeting: Dewford's cave and Veilstone's dojo! Fighting spirits!

Maylene.greeting: Brawly's so cool and confident. I'll do my best too! Fighting types from Hoenn and Sinnoh, together!
Maylene.trainerWins: I did my best, and we won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I did my best... it wasn't enough.

Maylene.greeting: Brawly is so cool and confident! I'll do my best to be confident too!
Brawly, let's knock them out together!

Jasmine.greeting: Byron's steel and mine... we'll be like a wall. Olivine and Canalave are both harbor towns, too.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Like a wall. Olivine and Canalave held firm.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The wall broke... I'm sorry, Byron.

Jasmine.greeting: Byron showed me the Canalave lighthouse. It reminded me of Olivine's. Let's... shine together.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We shone together. Thank you, Byron.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Our light dimmed. I'm sorry, Byron.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine and Canalave... two harbors, two lighthouses, two Steel-type Leaders.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Two lighthouses guiding us to victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Two lighthouses, and still we lost our way.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Jasmine! Two harbor-town Steel-type Leaders! Our defense is unbreakable!
Gahahah! Jasmine's quiet, but her steel is mighty! Let's build a fortress!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! The fortress held! Well done, Jasmine!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! The fortress crumbled! Sorry, Jasmine!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Jasmine, stand behind my steel! Nothing gets through!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Nothing got through, just as I said!

Jasmine.greeting: Colress says my Steel types have great potential. I... think so too. Let's do our best together.
Jasmine.trainerWins: My Steel types reached their potential. Thank you, Colress.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We didn't reach it today...

Jasmine.greeting: Colress tuned up my Steel types' armor... I think they like him. Let's battle.
Jasmine.trainerWins: They liked his tune-up, and we won!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Even with his tune-up... we lost. Sorry.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine's lighthouse and Colress's lab... light and science.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Light and science, shining together.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Light and science, both dimmed.

Colress.greeting: Jasmine's bond with her Steel types is quiet but powerful. Let's see how far it can go.
Jasmine's care for her Pokémon is a variable I can't quantify. Fascinating.
Jasmine, let's see how strong your bond truly is.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! A scientist who loves Steel types! Canalave's mines could use your gadgets, Colress!
Gahahah! Colress gave me a drill for my mine! Faster than a pickaxe! Let's battle!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! The drill broke! So did we!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Canalave's mine and Colress's lab! Steel and science!

Colress.greeting: Byron's Steel types were forged by years in the mines. Fascinating. Let's measure their full potential.
Byron's mine produces exceptional steel. Let's test its mettle.
Byron, let's push your Steel types to their limits.
Colress.trainerLoses: Limits reached, and exceeded by you.

Pryce.greeting: Candice is full of youthful fire, for an Ice-type Trainer. Mahogany and Snowpoint, winter's might.
Pryce.trainerWins: Youthful fire and winter's might. A fine pairing.

Pryce.greeting: Candice asked me how to stay focused through a long winter. Patience, child. Let's battle.
Mahogany and Snowpoint. Winter's elder and winter's youth.

Candice.greeting: Pryce! The Ice-type grandmaster! FOCUS, Candice! Let's give 'em a blizzard!
Pryce has seen more winters than anyone! FOCUS, Candice! Make him proud!
Candice.trainerWins: He's proud! I can tell! We won!
Candice.trainerLoses: He's not proud... I need to focus harder!

Candice.greeting: Pryce, let's make a blizzard so big it lasts all winter!
Candice.trainerWins: A blizzard to last all winter!

Pryce.greeting: Brycen, the actor who chose the mountains over the screen. I understand that choice. Ice types, together.
Pryce.trainerWins: The mountains chose well. A victory.

Pryce.greeting: Brycen gave up fame for the mountains. I gave my youth to the ice. We understand each other.
Pryce.trainerWins: Two who understand the ice, victorious together.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Two who understand the ice, and still it cracked.

Pryce.greeting: Mahogany and Icirrus. Mountains of ice in two regions.
Pryce.trainerWins: The mountains of two regions stand tall.

Brycen.greeting: Pryce has endured more winters than I have. I'll follow his lead. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Following his lead, to victory. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Even his lead couldn't save us. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Pryce's winters are longer than my career. I'll follow his lead. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Following Pryce's lead was the right choice. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Followed him faithfully, into defeat. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Pryce, let's freeze them like a winter landscape. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A frozen landscape, beautifully still. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The landscape thawed too soon. Hm.

Pryce.greeting: Young Sina's cheer melts even an old man's frost. Ice types, Johto and Kalos.
Pryce.trainerWins: Even an old man's frost can win. Well done, Sina.

Pryce.greeting: Young Sina's spirit reminds me of my own youth. Warm, even in the cold. Let's battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: Warm hearts, cold ice, and a victory.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Warm hearts, cold ice, and a lesson.

Pryce.greeting: Mahogany and Kalos. Old ice and new ice.
Pryce.trainerWins: Old ice and new ice, unbreakable.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Old ice and new ice, both melted.

Sina.greeting: Pryce is an Ice-type legend! I'm going to study how he battles! Let's freeze 'em!
Sina.trainerWins: I studied how Pryce battles, and we won!
Sina.trainerLoses: I'll study how Pryce loses, too, I guess...

Sina.greeting: Pryce is an Ice-type legend! I'm taking notes! Let's freeze them!
Sina.trainerWins: Notes taken, battle won! Thank you, Pryce!
Sina.trainerLoses: Notes taken... I need to study more!

Sina.greeting: Pryce, teach me your secret ice technique! After we win!
Sina.trainerWins: We won! Now teach me the secret!
Sina.trainerLoses: We lost... maybe the secret is practice!

Candice.greeting: Brycen-Man was my favorite movie hero! FOCUS! Snowpoint and Icirrus, ice cold!
Candice.trainerLoses: My movie hero lost! Focus, next time!

Candice.greeting: Brycen-Man signed my scarf! I'm wearing it right now! FOCUS! Let's win!
Candice.trainerWins: My lucky scarf works! We won, Brycen-Man!
Candice.trainerLoses: My lucky scarf failed me! Ugh!

Candice.greeting: Snowpoint and Icirrus! Sinnoh and Unova's snowiest towns!
Candice.trainerWins: The snowiest towns, the warmest victory!
Candice.trainerLoses: The snowiest towns got snowed under!

Brycen.greeting: Candice's energy could melt a glacier. Point it at the challenger. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A glacier, melted. The challenger's. Hm!

Brycen.greeting: Candice's energy is like a blizzard: hard to control, harder to stop. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: An unstoppable blizzard, aimed true. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The blizzard was stopped. Hm. Impressive.

Brycen.greeting: Candice, let's make this battle an avalanche. Hm!

Candice.greeting: Sina loves Ice types as much as I do! FOCUS! Snowpoint and Kalos, let's make it snow!
Candice.trainerLoses: The snow melted! Focus, next time!

Candice.greeting: Sina and I had a snowball fight in Snowpoint! I won! FOCUS! Let's win this too!
Candice.trainerLoses: Lost the battle... but I'm still snowball champ!

Candice.greeting: Snowpoint and Kalos! Ice-type girls, ice-cold focus!

Sina.greeting: Candice's energy is contagious! Ice types from Sinnoh and Kalos, let's freeze this battle!
Sina.trainerWins: Froze the battle! Great job, Candice!
Sina.trainerLoses: We got frozen out! Oops!

Sina.greeting: Candice's energy is contagious! Let's make it snow!
Sina.trainerWins: It snowed victory everywhere! Thanks, Candice!
Sina.trainerLoses: It snowed... right on top of us!

Sina.greeting: Candice, let's build a snowman of victory!
Sina.trainerWins: Our victory snowman is finished! It's so cute!
Sina.trainerLoses: Our snowman melted before we finished!

Brycen.greeting: Sina's cheer warms even an icy heart. Icirrus and Kalos, together. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: An icy heart, warmed by victory. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: An icy heart, chilled by defeat. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Sina asked for my autograph for Dexio. He's a fan, apparently. Hm!
Icirrus and Kalos. Old frost and fresh snow. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Old frost and fresh snow, unmelted. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Old frost and fresh snow, washed away. Hm.

Sina.greeting: Brycen was in movies? Dexio has to see this! Ice types, let's go!
Sina.trainerWins: Dexio's going to want to see this! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: Don't tell Dexio we lost!

Sina.greeting: Brycen was in movies?! I'll get him to sign something for Dexio! Let's win!
Sina.trainerWins: We won! Dexio's getting an autograph!
Sina.trainerLoses: We lost... Dexio still gets an autograph, right?

Sina.greeting: Brycen, do your movie pose! Then let's freeze them!
Sina.trainerWins: Movie pose AND a frozen challenger! Amazing!
Sina.trainerLoses: No pose, no win... Dexio will be sad!

Clair.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's dragon master. Finally, a partner worthy of Blackthorn's dragons.
Clair.trainerWins: A worthy partner, and a worthy win.

Clair.greeting: Drayden trained Iris. I trained myself. Let's see which method wins today.
Clair.trainerWins: Both methods won. Fine. I'll accept that.

Clair.greeting: Blackthorn and Opelucid. Dragon masters of two regions.
Clair.trainerWins: Dragon masters of two regions, unmatched today.
Clair.trainerLoses: Dragon masters of two regions, both humbled.

Drayden.greeting: Clair has the pride of a true dragon tamer. Blackthorn and Opelucid, let us show you a dragon's might.
Drayden.trainerWins: A dragon's might, shown. Well done, Clair.
Drayden.trainerLoses: A dragon's might, humbled.

Drayden.greeting: Clair's pride burns like dragonfire. Temper it, and it becomes strength.
Drayden.trainerWins: Tempered, and strong. Well done, Clair.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Untempered, and outmatched.

Drayden.greeting: Clair, let your dragons roar. Mine will answer.
Drayden.trainerWins: They roared together, and triumphed.
Drayden.trainerLoses: They roared together, and fell.

Lorelei.greeting: Agatha and I once guarded the Indigo Plateau side by side. Old colleagues, one goal: freeze you out.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Frozen out, as promised. Thank you, Agatha.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Old colleagues, old mistakes. Hmph.

Lorelei.greeting: Agatha used to scare my dolls at the Plateau. Today she can scare the challenger instead.
Lorelei.trainerWins: The challenger's scared stiff. Frozen, even.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: We're the ones left shivering.

Lorelei.greeting: Kanto's Elite Four, ice and ghosts. A chilling combination.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Thoroughly chilling. Well done, Agatha.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Chilling, but not enough.

Agatha.greeting: Lorelei always was the chilly one. Leave the real chills to me, dearie.
Agatha.trainerWins: The real chills came through, dearie.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Chilly and beaten. How embarrassing.

Agatha.greeting: Lorelei's dolls gave me the creeps! And I'm a Ghost-type Trainer! Hah! Let's go, dearie!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Creepier than her dolls, and victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Even the dolls would laugh at this!

Agatha.greeting: Lorelei, freeze them stiff, and I'll haunt what's left!
Agatha.trainerWins: Frozen stiff and haunted! Hah!
Agatha.trainerLoses: We got haunted instead! Hah!

Lorelei.greeting: Blaine, try not to melt my strategy with your volcano talk.
Lorelei.trainerWins: My strategy survived the volcano talk. Good.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Melted strategy. As I feared.

Lorelei.greeting: Blaine quizzed me on melting points all the way up. I knew every answer. Let's battle.
Lorelei.trainerWins: I knew every answer, and the battle's too.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: I knew every answer, except how to win.

Lorelei.greeting: Fire and ice from the Indigo Plateau. Opposites, but effective.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Opposites, effective as predicted.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Opposites, cancelling each other out.

Blaine.greeting: Quiz time, Lorelei! What melts ice fastest? Hah! Don't answer, just watch!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! What melts ice fastest? The challenger's chances!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Melted myself!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Lorelei's cool head and my hot temper! Steam power!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Steam power at full blast!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Steam power... just fizzled!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Lorelei, quiz time! What's hotter than fire and colder than ice?
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Correct answer: this victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer: this defeat!

Lorelei.greeting: Brock, steady as Pewter's stone. A good wall to stand behind while I freeze the field.
Lorelei.trainerWins: The wall held, and the field froze. Well done, Brock.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: The wall cracked. A pity.

Lorelei.greeting: Brock offered to carry my bag up the tree. A gentleman. Let's battle.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A gentleman and a strong partner. Thank you, Brock.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A gentleman, but we still lost.

Lorelei.greeting: Pewter's stone and the Plateau's ice. Solid and cold.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Solid and cold, and unbreakable today.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Solid and cold, and broken all the same.

Brock.greeting: Lorelei of the Elite Four! I'll hold the line so your ice can do its work.
Brock.trainerWins: The line held! Your ice did its work, Lorelei!
Brock.trainerLoses: The line broke. Sorry, Lorelei.

Brock.greeting: Lorelei, I'll be your wall! Freeze them from behind my Rock types!
Brock.trainerWins: The wall held, and the ice struck!
Brock.trainerLoses: The wall crumbled, and the ice melted!

Brock.greeting: Lorelei, let's build a fortress of rock and ice!
Brock.trainerWins: Fortress of rock and ice, standing tall!
Brock.trainerLoses: Fortress of rock and ice, fallen!

Lorelei.greeting: Bruno, warm up quietly, please. I need you focused, not shouting.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Focused, and victorious. Thank you, Bruno.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Too much shouting. Too little winning.

Lorelei.greeting: Bruno did push-ups the whole elevator ride. Please, Bruno, save some energy for the battle.
Lorelei.trainerWins: He saved enough energy after all. Victory.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: He spent too much on push-ups, I'm afraid.

Lorelei.greeting: The Indigo Plateau's ice and fists. Cold and strong.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Cold and strong, as the Plateau should be.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Cold and strong, and still not enough today.

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Lorelei! The Indigo Plateau's old guard rides again!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The old guard rides on!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The old guard fell!

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Lorelei's ice and my fists! The Plateau's toughest!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Toughest team, toughest win!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Toughest team, toughest loss!

Bruno.greeting: Lorelei, freeze them! I'll shatter them! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Frozen and shattered! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerLoses: We got shattered! Hoo hah... ugh.

Lorelei.greeting: Brycen, I hear you once starred in films. Let's give this battle a chilling final scene.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A chilling final scene. Perfect.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: The final scene thawed.

Lorelei.greeting: Brycen showed me a clip of his old film. The ice effects were unconvincing. Let's show him real ice.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Real ice, real victory. Convinced, Brycen?
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Our ice was unconvincing too, apparently.

Lorelei.greeting: Kanto's Plateau and Unova's mountain. Ice from two regions.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Ice from two regions, frozen into victory.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Ice from two regions, melted all the same.

Brycen.greeting: Lorelei of Kanto. Ice from two regions, one very cold welcome.
Brycen.trainerLoses: A cold farewell for us. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Lorelei's ice is real. Mine was once special effects. Today, both are real. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Real ice, and a real victory. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Real ice, and a real defeat. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Lorelei, freeze the frame. I'll finish the scene. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The frame thawed before the scene ended. Hm.

Lorelei.greeting: Candice, your energy could melt a glacier. Aim it at our opponent, please.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Your energy was well aimed. Good.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Your energy... scattered. As did my plan.

Lorelei.greeting: Candice asked me to sign her ice skates. I asked her to focus. She's doing both.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Focused and victorious. Well done, Candice.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Focused, but outmatched.

Lorelei.greeting: Snowpoint and the Plateau. Youthful ice and seasoned ice.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Youthful and seasoned, a perfect freeze.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Youthful and seasoned, both melted.

Candice.greeting: Lorelei! An ice legend from Kanto! I'm so focused right now, I promise!
Candice.trainerWins: I was SO focused! We won!
Candice.trainerLoses: I lost focus! I'm so sorry!

Candice.greeting: Lorelei signed my skates! FOCUS! I'll win this for her!
Candice.trainerWins: I won it for Lorelei! Skates and all!
Candice.trainerLoses: Lost it for Lorelei... my skates feel heavy!

Candice.greeting: Lorelei, let's freeze this whole tree! FOCUS!

Lorelei.greeting: Erika, try to stay awake. This will be a cold, quick battle.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Cold and quick, as I said. Well done, Erika.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Erika slept through our loss, I think.

Lorelei.greeting: Erika fell asleep during my last lecture on ice. I'll keep this battle brief so she stays awake.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Brief, and victorious. She stayed awake.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Brief, but defeated. She may have dozed off.

Lorelei.greeting: Celadon's garden and the Plateau's frost. A winter garden.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A winter garden in full bloom.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A winter garden, frostbitten.

Erika.greeting: Lorelei... how refreshing to have a cool breeze beside me in this heat.
Erika.trainerWins: A refreshing victory. How lovely.
Erika.trainerLoses: The breeze turned cold. Oh dear.

Erika.greeting: Lorelei's chill keeps me alert... mostly. Let's battle, shall we?
Erika.trainerWins: Mostly alert, entirely victorious.
Erika.trainerLoses: Mostly alert... perhaps not enough.

Erika.greeting: Lorelei, a cool breeze over my flowers... how lovely. Let's win.
Erika.trainerWins: Lovely, and victorious. Thank you, Lorelei.
Erika.trainerLoses: Lovely, but defeated. The flowers droop.

Lorelei.greeting: Giovanni. I'll battle beside you, but I'm keeping one eye on you.
Lorelei.trainerWins: We won. I'm still watching you, Giovanni.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: We lost, and I'm still watching you.

Lorelei.greeting: Giovanni asked if I'd consider joining his organization. I declined. Today, I'll battle beside him.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Victory, and I'm still declining.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Defeat, and I'm still declining.

Lorelei.greeting: The Plateau's ice and Viridian's earth. Cold calculation.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Cold calculation, flawless result.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Cold calculation, flawed result.

Giovanni.greeting: The Elite Four's ice. Freeze them in place; I'll handle the rest.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Unhandled. Unacceptable.

Giovanni.greeting: Lorelei's refusal was... expected. Her ice, however, is welcome.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Her ice failed. Unexpected.

Giovanni.greeting: Lorelei, freeze them. I'll bury them.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Frozen and buried. Efficient work, Lorelei.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Neither frozen nor buried. Disappointing.

Lorelei.greeting: Glacia, two ice masters from two Leagues. Our opponent may need a blanket.
Lorelei.trainerWins: They'll need that blanket now.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: We're the ones who need a blanket.

Lorelei.greeting: Glacia came from far away to find a worthy opponent in Hoenn. Today she has a worthy partner.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A worthy partner, a worthy win.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A worthy partner, and a worthy opponent too.

Lorelei.greeting: Kanto and Hoenn's Elite Four ice. A double blizzard.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A double blizzard, overwhelming.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A double blizzard, weathered by you.

Glacia.greeting: Lorelei, how lovely. Let's show them what true cold feels like.
Glacia.trainerWins: True cold, felt by all. Lovely.

Glacia.greeting: Lorelei, your ice is as refined as mine. How lovely. Let's freeze them.
Lorelei, let's show them the true meaning of cold.
Glacia.trainerWins: The true meaning of cold, demonstrated.
Glacia.trainerLoses: They taught us the true meaning of cold.

Lorelei.greeting: Janine, your father speaks very highly of you. Let's see why.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Now I see why your father speaks so highly of you.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Your father will understand. Losses teach.

Lorelei.greeting: Janine trained under Koga, and it shows. Let's see her ninja skills in action.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Ninja skills, on full display. Impressive.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Ninja skills, outmaneuvered.

Lorelei.greeting: Kanto's ice and Fuchsia's poison. Cold and toxic.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Cold and toxic, deadly effective.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Cold and toxic, neutralized.

Janine.greeting: Lorelei! Father says you're the coolest trainer he knows. Literally!
Janine.trainerWins: The coolest trainer, and a cool win!
Janine.trainerLoses: Even the coolest trainer can't win every time!

Janine.greeting: Lorelei's the coolest! Father says so! I'll make her proud!
Janine.trainerWins: Made Lorelei proud! And Father!

Janine.greeting: Lorelei, freeze them, and I'll strike from the shadows!
Janine.trainerWins: Frozen in place, then struck from the shadows!
Janine.trainerLoses: The shadows gave us away! Ugh!

Lorelei.greeting: Koga, ice and poison. Please, no smoke bombs near my glasses.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Ice, poison, and no smoke bombs. Excellent.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A smoke bomb went off, didn't it? We lost.

Lorelei.greeting: Koga's daughter Janine is the best student I've met. Let's see if the father matches.
Lorelei.trainerWins: The father matches the daughter. Well done, Koga.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: The daughter would've done better. Sorry, Koga.

Lorelei.greeting: The Indigo Plateau's ice and ninja. Silent and cold.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Silent and cold, and unstoppable today.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Silent and cold, and stopped all the same.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Lorelei! The Plateau's frost and a ninja's venom. A fearsome blend!
Fwahaha! Lorelei's ice and my poison! The Plateau's deadliest!
Fwahaha! Lorelei, freeze them, and my poison will finish!

Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Old friends, new defeat!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and dragons! The Plateau's mightiest!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The Plateau's mightiest, proven again!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The Plateau's mightiest, humbled!

Lance.greeting: Bruno, it's good to fight beside you again, old friend.
Lance.trainerWins: Good to win beside you, old friend.
Lance.trainerLoses: Good to fight beside you, even in defeat.

Lance.greeting: Bruno's strength has never wavered. Let's battle as we did years ago.
Lance.trainerWins: Just as we did years ago, and just as victorious.
Lance.trainerLoses: Just as we did years ago... we're just a little older.

Lance.greeting: Bruno, strike the ground. My dragons will strike from the sky.
Lance.trainerWins: Ground and sky, both ours. Well done, old friend.
Lance.trainerLoses: Ground and sky, both lost. Next time, old friend.

Bruno.greeting: Surge! A soldier's discipline matches a fighter's! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Discipline wins! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Discipline faltered! Hoo hah!

Bruno.greeting: Lt. Surge does more push-ups than me! Impossible! Let's settle it in battle! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Settled! Victory, and more push-ups!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Still unsettled! More push-ups!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Vermilion's lightning! Discipline and voltage!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Discipline and voltage, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Discipline and voltage, shorted out!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Bruno! My drill sergeant would've loved you! Fall in, soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Mission accomplished, soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Mission failed, soldier!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Bruno's the toughest recruit I've ever seen, baby! Let's go!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Toughest recruit, toughest win!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Toughest recruit, toughest loss!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Bruno, march in step with me, soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Marched in step, all the way to victory, baby!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Marched in step, right into an ambush!

Bruno.greeting: Marshal! I hear Alder trained you well. Show me!
Bruno.trainerWins: Alder trained you well! Proven!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Train harder, Marshal! As will I!

Bruno.greeting: Marshal trained under Alder. I trained under no one but myself! Let's compare! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Self-taught and Alder-taught, both winners!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Self-taught and Alder-taught, both schooled!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's Elite Four and Unova's Elite Four! Fists of two regions!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Fists of two regions, landing as one!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Fists of two regions, blocked!

Marshal.greeting: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your discipline is famous in Unova too. Let us begin.
Marshal.trainerWins: Your discipline, shared. A worthy victory.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Discipline alone could not win. A lesson.

Marshal.greeting: Bruno's discipline is legendary. Let us battle as fighters should.
Marshal.trainerWins: We battled as fighters should, and won with honor.
Marshal.trainerLoses: We battled as fighters should. You fought better.

Marshal.greeting: Bruno, strike with discipline. I'll strike with spirit.
Marshal.trainerWins: Discipline and spirit, struck as one.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Discipline and spirit, and still outmatched.

Bruno.greeting: Maylene! Barefoot and fearless! I like your style!
Bruno.trainerWins: Fearless and victorious! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Fearless, but beaten!

Bruno.greeting: Maylene trains barefoot! Excellent! Toughens the spirit! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Barefoot and victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Barefoot and defeated!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Veilstone's aura! Fighting spirits!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Fists and aura, unstoppable!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Fists and aura, stopped cold!

Maylene.greeting: Bruno! I've studied your fighting style for years! Let's do this!
Maylene.trainerWins: Years of study paid off! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I studied for years... and still lost!

Maylene.greeting: Bruno is my hero! I've studied his style forever! Let's do this!
Maylene.trainerWins: Side by side with my hero, and we won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Side by side with my hero... and we lost!

Maylene.greeting: Bruno, let's punch through together! One, two!
Maylene.trainerWins: One, two, and we punched right through!
Maylene.trainerLoses: One, two, and they blocked both!

Bruno.greeting: Misty! Cerulean's tomboyish mermaid! Strong water, strong will!
Bruno.trainerWins: Strong water, strong win!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Strong water, washed out!

Bruno.greeting: Misty swims laps faster than I can run them! Impressive! Let's battle! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Fast and strong, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Fast and strong, outpaced!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Cerulean's waves! A crashing combo!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The crashing combo lands!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The crashing combo crashed!

Misty.greeting: Bruno, don't splash around too much. That's my job!
Misty.trainerWins: No extra splashing! Good job, Bruno!
Misty.trainerLoses: Too much splashing! From Bruno!

Misty.greeting: Bruno's so strong! But I'm faster in the water! Let's win!
Misty.trainerWins: Strong and fast! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Strong and fast... and we still lost!

Misty.greeting: Bruno, punch them into the water! I'll handle the rest!
Misty.trainerWins: Punched in and splashed out! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: We got punched in and splashed out!

Bruno.greeting: Morty! You see the future? Then you know we'll win!
Bruno.trainerWins: You foresaw it! Victory!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Didn't see this one, did you?!

Bruno.greeting: Morty sees the future! Then he knows we win! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The future was right, Morty!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The future lied to us, Morty!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Ecruteak's mysticism! Muscle and mystery!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Muscle and mystery, a winning combo!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Muscle and mystery, unsolved!

Morty.greeting: Bruno... I sense great strength. And great volume.
Morty.trainerWins: Great strength, and great volume. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: Great volume. Little victory.

Morty.greeting: Bruno's aura is... overwhelming. Loud. Strong. Let's battle.
Morty.trainerWins: Strong, loud and victorious. As I sensed.
Morty.trainerLoses: Strong, loud and defeated. I sensed that too.

Morty.greeting: Bruno, I'll guide your fists with foresight.
Morty.trainerWins: Foresight guided us to victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: Foresight failed us today.

Bruno.greeting: Pryce! An elder of battle. I'll match your patience with power!
Bruno.trainerWins: Patience and power, unbeatable!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Power without patience. We fell.

Bruno.greeting: Pryce has trained longer than I've been alive! I'll learn from him! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Learned from the elder, and won!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Learned from the elder, and lost!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Mahogany's ice! Strength and patience!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Strength and patience, triumphant!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Strength and patience... ran out!

Pryce.greeting: Bruno. You remind me of my younger days. Hot-headed, and strong.
Bruno's fire reminds me of my own youth. Let's battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: Youth's fire and age's frost, victorious.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Youth's fire and age's frost, both outmatched.

Pryce.greeting: Bruno, temper your strength with patience.

Bruno.greeting: Sabrina! Mind and muscle, together at last!
Bruno.trainerWins: Mind and muscle, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Mind and muscle, beaten!

Bruno.greeting: Sabrina read my mind and said I'm thinking about protein! She's right! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Mind read, battle won!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Mind read, battle lost!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Saffron's psychic! Telekinetic punches!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Telekinetic punches, landed!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Telekinetic punches, dodged!

Sabrina.greeting: Bruno. I sense your next move: something very loud.
Bruno's mind is simple. Strength. Victory. I respect that.
Bruno, I'll guide your fists with my mind. Don't resist.
Sabrina.trainerWins: He didn't resist, and we won.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: He resisted, and we lost. Typical.

Bruno.greeting: Whitney! No tears today, win or lose! Fight hard!
Bruno.trainerWins: No tears, and a win! Well fought!
Bruno.trainerLoses: No tears now! Fight harder next time!

Bruno.greeting: Whitney cried during my training demo! Too intense? Let's battle gently! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Gentle, yet victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Gentle... and she's crying again!

Bruno.greeting: Kanto's fists and Goldenrod's cuteness! Strong and cute!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Strong and cute, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Strong and cute, defeated!

Whitney.greeting: Bruno, you're so strong! Don't let me lose, okay?
Whitney.trainerWins: Bruno didn't let me lose! Yay!

Whitney.greeting: Bruno's so strong! I'll be strong too! No tears!
Whitney.trainerWins: No tears! We won, Bruno! I'm so strong!

Whitney.greeting: Bruno, let's be the strongest, cutest team ever!
Whitney.trainerLoses: The strongest, cutest loss ever! Waaah!

Bruno.greeting: Will! The Johto Elite Four stands together!
Bruno.trainerWins: The Johto Elite Four stands! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerLoses: The Johto Elite Four stumbles!

Bruno.greeting: Will's mask hides his face, but not his strength! Hoo hah! Let's battle!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Masked and mighty, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Masked and mighty, unmasked!

Bruno.greeting: Johto's Elite Four, fists and psychics!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Fists and psychics, triumphant!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Fists and psychics, outmatched!

Will.greeting: Bruno, try to be subtle. Just this once.
Bruno's training is crude. Effective, but crude. I'll provide the polish.
Will.trainerWins: Polished and effective. A fine result.

Will.greeting: Bruno, let's give them a show. Elegance and brute force.
Will.trainerWins: An elegant show, and a brute victory.
Will.trainerLoses: An elegant show, a brutal defeat.

Agatha.greeting: Acerola! A young lady who loves spooky things. You remind me of myself, long ago.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Losing reminds me of my youth, too. Hah!

Agatha.greeting: Acerola asked me for ghost stories. I told her the scariest one: my rivalry with Oak! Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Scarier than Oak, and victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Even Oak would laugh at this loss!

Agatha.greeting: Kanto's elder and Alola's captain. Ghosts across generations.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Ghosts across generations, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Ghosts across generations, exorcised!

Acerola.greeting: Agatha! A grandma who loves ghosts! Can I call you Granny? Hee hee!
Acerola.trainerWins: Granny Agatha and me, the spookiest win!
Acerola.trainerLoses: Granny Agatha, we lost! Hee hee... ugh.

Acerola.greeting: Agatha's ghost stories are the best! Hee hee! Let's make a spooky victory!
Acerola.trainerWins: A spooky victory! Hee hee! Granny, we did it!
Acerola.trainerLoses: A spooky defeat... boo hoo, Granny!

Acerola.greeting: Agatha, let's haunt them together! Ready? Boo!
Acerola.trainerWins: Boo! They ran away! Hee hee!

Agatha.greeting: Blaine, you old coot! Still asking riddles at your age?

Agatha.trainerLoses: The riddle's on us today, old coot.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The old-timers got outlasted!

Agatha.greeting: Kanto's oldest Gym Leader and oldest Elite Four member. Experience, dearie.
Agatha.trainerWins: Experience wins, as always. Hah!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Experience isn't everything, apparently. Hah!

Blaine.greeting: Agatha! Riddle me this: which of us is older? Hah! Better not answer!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Riddle answered: we won!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Riddle unsolved! We lost!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Agatha, quiz time! What's scarier, your ghosts or your temper? Don't answer!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Both scared the challenger off!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Neither scared them! Rematch!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Agatha, your ghosts and my fire! A haunted volcano!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! The haunted volcano erupts in victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The haunted volcano went cold!

Agatha.greeting: Brock, dear boy. Stand still and let my ghosts do the work.
Agatha.trainerWins: You stood still, and my ghosts did the work.
Agatha.trainerLoses: You stood still... too still, dear boy.

Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! A polite boy deserves a win!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Politeness doesn't win battles, it seems!

Agatha.greeting: Pewter's rock and the Plateau's ghosts. Solid and spectral.
Agatha.trainerWins: Solid and spectral, victorious. Hah!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Solid and spectral, both crumbled. Hah!

Brock.trainerLoses: I couldn't keep you safe, ma'am... we lost.

Brock.greeting: Agatha, I'll protect you! Your ghosts can do the rest!

Agatha.trainerLoses: Even my ghosts couldn't wake you, dear.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! She slept through the defeat!

Agatha.greeting: Celadon's flowers and Kanto's ghosts. A haunted garden.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! The haunted garden blooms!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The haunted garden withers!

Erika.greeting: Agatha, your ghosts are rather charming in their own way.

Erika.trainerWins: Lovely ghosts, lovely victory.

Erika.greeting: Agatha, let's make this battle a spooky garden party.

Erika.trainerLoses: A spooky garden party, sadly rained out.

Agatha.trainerWins: You dance, I scare. It worked!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Dancing didn't save us. Neither did scaring.

Agatha.greeting: Fantina tried to teach my ghosts to dance. They stepped on her toes! Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! They danced their way to victory!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! They stepped on our toes again!

Agatha.greeting: Kanto's eldest and Hearthome's dancer. Ghosts old and new.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Old ghosts and new, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Old ghosts and new, banished!

Fantina.greeting: Agatha, let us haunt them with style! Magnifique!

Agatha.greeting: Giovanni. I've outlived plenty of crooks. Behave yourself.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The ghosts are laughing at us!

Agatha.greeting: Viridian's boss and the Plateau's elder. Crooks and ghosts.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Crooks and ghosts, both caught!

Giovanni.greeting: Agatha. Even I respect that much experience.

Giovanni.greeting: Agatha has seen empires rise and fall. Let's add another victory to her memories.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: A defeat she'll never let me forget.

Giovanni.greeting: Agatha, haunt them. I'll handle what remains.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Neither haunted nor handled. Pathetic.

Agatha.greeting: Janine, your father was quite the rascal in his day.
Agatha.trainerWins: Sneaky and victorious, just like your father!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Your father would've gotten away with it.

Agatha.greeting: Janine snuck up on me in the Plateau halls. I almost dropped my cane! Good ninja! Hah!

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Sneaky ninja, sneaky defeat!

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The unseen got seen!

Janine.greeting: Agatha! Ghosts and ninjas, both sneaky! We'll be perfect together!

Janine.greeting: Agatha, let's vanish and reappear behind them!
Janine.trainerWins: Vanished and reappeared! Victory!

Agatha.greeting: Koga, you old sneak. Still hiding behind smoke?

Agatha.trainerLoses: Your smoke blew back in our faces, Koga.

Agatha.greeting: Koga's smoke bombs made my ghosts sneeze at the Plateau. Hah! Today, aim at the challenger!

Agatha.greeting: The Plateau's old sneaks, back together. Hah!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Agatha, mistress of shadows. We are kindred spirits!

Fwahaha! Agatha, haunt them, and I'll poison them!

Agatha.greeting: Lance, still flying around in that cape, I see.
Agatha.trainerWins: Still flying, and still winning. Good.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Even capes can't catch every fall.

Agatha.greeting: Lance was a scrawny boy when I first battled him. Look at him now, cape and all! Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! The scrawny boy's all grown up!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! He's still scrawny in my eyes!

Agatha.greeting: The Plateau's ghosts and its Champion. Old and new.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Old and new, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Old and new, both outdone!

Lance.greeting: Agatha, it's an honor to stand beside you again.

Lance.greeting: Agatha, your ghosts and my dragons. Let's soar and haunt.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Politeness won't save you, soldier!

Agatha.greeting: Vermilion's thunder and the Plateau's ghosts. Shocking frights.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Shocking frights, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Shocking frights, fizzled!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Agatha! You're tougher than any soldier I ever served with!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Agatha, haunt 'em, I'll shock 'em!

Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Shocked ourselves! Ugh!

Agatha.greeting: Misty dear, don't be frightened of my ghosts.

Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Misty screamed again! Defeat!

Agatha.greeting: Cerulean's waters and Kanto's ghosts. A haunted lake.

Misty.greeting: Agatha! Your ghosts are creepy... in a good way, I think!

Misty.trainerLoses: Creepy in a bad way! We lost!

Misty.trainerLoses: I wasn't brave enough... eek!

Misty.greeting: Agatha, your ghosts and my water! Spooky splash!

Agatha.trainerLoses: The ghosts are laughing at us, Morty.
