Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! A seer and an old witch, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! A seer and an old witch, outfoxed!

Agatha.greeting: Ecruteak's seer and the Plateau's ghost master. The spirits are watching.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! The spirits approve!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The spirits are laughing!

Morty.greeting: Agatha... the spirits around you are ancient and powerful.
Morty.trainerWins: Ancient spirits, and a fresh victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: The ancient spirits are silent tonight.

Morty.greeting: Agatha's spirits are ancient. I sense their power. Let's battle together.
Morty.trainerWins: The ancient spirits guided us.
Morty.trainerLoses: The ancient spirits turned away.

Morty.greeting: Agatha, let the spirits guide our moves.
Morty.trainerWins: The spirits guided every move. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: The spirits guided us astray today.

Agatha.greeting: Phoebe, Mt. Pyre's ghost girl. Show this old lady your bond.
Agatha.trainerWins: Show this old lady your bond, she said. You did!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Your bond's strong, girl. Ours fell short.

Agatha.greeting: Phoebe trained on Mt. Pyre with her grandma. I trained in Lavender's tower. Ghosts know their own.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Ghosts know their own, and their victories!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Ghosts know their own... defeat.

Agatha.greeting: Kanto's ghosts and Mt. Pyre's ghosts. Spirits of two regions.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Two regions' spirits, victorious!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Two regions' spirits, laid to rest!

Phoebe.greeting: Agatha! A ghost master from Kanto! The spirits are so excited!
Phoebe.trainerWins: The spirits are cheering! We won!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are sad... we lost.

Phoebe.greeting: Agatha trained in Lavender Town! The spirits there must be so old! Let's battle!
Phoebe.trainerWins: The old spirits cheered! We won, Agatha!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The old spirits are sighing... we lost!

Phoebe.greeting: Agatha, let's call every ghost on Mt. Pyre!

Agatha.greeting: Sabrina, your mind tricks against my ghosts. Who's spookier, eh?
Agatha.trainerWins: Spookier together. We won.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Spooked ourselves, I'd say.

Agatha.greeting: Sabrina's mind tricks never worked on me. Today, she's on my side. Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Her mind tricks worked this time!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Her mind tricks failed us both!

Agatha.greeting: Saffron's psychic and Kanto's ghosts. Old enemies, new allies.
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Old enemies, new victory!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Old enemies, new defeat!

Sabrina.greeting: Agatha. Our powers have always been at odds. Not today.
Sabrina.trainerWins: At odds no more. A victory.

Sabrina.greeting: Agatha's ghosts were once my weakness. Today, they're my strength.
Agatha, I foresee your ghosts haunting them. Proceed.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Not as foreseen. The ghosts misbehaved.

Agatha.greeting: Shauntal, are you writing about me? Make me sound scarier.
Agatha.trainerWins: Make me sound scary in the victory chapter!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Leave this part out of your book, dear.

Agatha.greeting: Shauntal wants to write my life story. I told her it's too scary for print. Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! Put this victory in your book!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! Leave this chapter out, dearie!

Agatha.greeting: Kanto's ghost master and Unova's ghost writer. Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Hah! The ghost writer gets a happy ending!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Hah! The ghost writer needs a rewrite!

Shauntal.greeting: Agatha! A ghost master from Kanto! My next chapter is writing itself!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The chapter wrote itself: victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The chapter ends in tragedy!

Shauntal.greeting: Agatha is the protagonist I've always dreamed of! Let's write a thrilling victory!
Shauntal.trainerWins: A thrilling victory! Agatha, you were magnificent!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: Agatha, I may have to write you a sadder ending!

Shauntal.greeting: Agatha, let's make this battle a ghost story for the ages!
Shauntal.trainerWins: A ghost story for the ages! Bestseller!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: A ghost story... with a tragic twist!

Lance.greeting: Alder, Unova's free-spirited Champion. Let's show them two Champions at once.
Lance.trainerWins: Two Champions, one victory. A fine day.

Lance.greeting: Alder offered to teach me to relax. I offered to teach him discipline. Let's see who wins.
Lance.trainerWins: Discipline and relaxation, both won.

Lance.greeting: Kanto's Champion and Unova's Champion. Two Champions, one goal.
Lance.trainerWins: Two Champions, one goal, one victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Two Champions, one goal, and we missed it.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Lance, the dragon master! Two Champions, one wild battle!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! One wild win!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! One wild loss!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Lance is so serious! A Champion should have fun! Let's have fun winning!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Fun AND victory! The best combination!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! We had fun, at least! That counts!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Lance, let your dragons run wild!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Wild dragons, wild win, Lance!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Wild dragons ran off without us!

Lance.greeting: Blaine, keep the flames high. My dragons love the heat.
Lance.trainerWins: The flames stayed high. My dragons approve.
Lance.trainerLoses: The flames died down too soon.

Lance.greeting: Blaine asked me a quiz about dragon fire. I got it wrong. Let's make up for it.
Lance.trainerWins: Made up for that quiz, and then some. Victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Still making up for that quiz, it seems.

Lance.greeting: Cinnabar's volcano and the Plateau's dragons. Fire and flight.
Lance.trainerWins: Fire and flight, triumphant over all.
Lance.trainerLoses: Fire and flight, grounded by you.

Blaine.greeting: Lance! Quiz: what do dragons and volcanoes have in common? Fire! Let's win!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire! The answer and the victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer! We lost!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Lance's dragons and my fire! A blazing sky!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! A blazing sky, a blazing victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The blazing sky burned out!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Lance, quiz time! Who wins when dragons and fire team up?
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Correct answer: we do!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer: they do!

Lance.greeting: Brock, your steadiness gives my dragons room to fly.
Lance.trainerWins: Your steadiness let my dragons fly. Thank you.
Lance.trainerLoses: The line held, but my dragons fell.

Lance.greeting: Brock offered to cook for my dragons. They loved it. Let's battle as a well-fed team.
Lance.trainerWins: Well-fed and victorious. Thank you, Brock.

Lance.greeting: Pewter's stone and the Plateau's dragons. Ground and sky.
Lance.trainerWins: Ground and sky, conquered together.
Lance.trainerLoses: Ground and sky, both lost today.

Brock.greeting: Lance, the Champion himself! I'll hold the line!
Brock.trainerWins: I held the line for the Champion!
Brock.trainerLoses: I couldn't hold it, Lance. Sorry.

Brock.greeting: Lance, the Champion! I'll be the steady rock your dragons can count on!
Brock.trainerWins: Steady rock, soaring dragons, victory!
Brock.trainerLoses: The rock cracked... sorry, Lance!

Brock.greeting: Lance, your dragons fly, my Rock types hold the ground!
Brock.trainerWins: They flew, we held, and we won!
Brock.trainerLoses: They flew, we held... and we still lost!

Lance.greeting: Bugsy, your research is impressive. Let's add some field data.
Lance.trainerWins: Field data collected: victory.

Lance.greeting: Bugsy asked to measure my dragons' wingspans. I said after the battle.
Lance.trainerWins: Wingspans measured, battle won.

Lance.greeting: Azalea's research and the Plateau's dragons. Knowledge and power.
Lance.trainerWins: Knowledge and power, victorious.

Bugsy.greeting: Lance! I've always wanted to study how you battle up close!
Bugsy.trainerWins: I studied the Champion up close, and we won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: I studied up close... how we lost.

Bugsy.greeting: Lance! I've got so many questions about your dragons! Win first, questions later!
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won! Question one: how fast do they fly?
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost... question one: what went wrong?

Bugsy.greeting: Lance, let's collect some real field data!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Field data collected: victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Field data collected: defeat!

Lance.greeting: Chuck, your strength is matched only by your enthusiasm.
Lance.trainerWins: Strength and enthusiasm, victorious.

Lance.greeting: Chuck challenged my dragons to a waterfall race. They declined. Let's battle instead.
Lance.trainerWins: A battle won. The waterfall can wait.
Lance.trainerLoses: A battle lost. Perhaps the waterfall was easier.

Lance.greeting: Cianwood's fists and the Plateau's dragons. Strength and wings.
Lance.trainerWins: Strength and wings, unstoppable.

Chuck.greeting: Lance! WAHAHAH! Let's crush them together!
WAHAHAH! Lance! The Champion and Cianwood's strongest! HYAH!
WAHAHAH! Lance, let's crush them with dragon fists!

Lance.greeting: Clair, cousin. Let's show them what Blackthorn's dragon clan can do.
Lance.trainerWins: Blackthorn's clan, unbeaten. Well done, Clair.

Lance.greeting: Clair still reminds me she beat me in our first practice match. Today, we win together.
Lance.trainerWins: Together, as Blackthorn's dragons should be.

Lance.greeting: Blackthorn's dragon clan. Cousins, rivals, partners.
Lance.trainerWins: Cousins, rivals, partners, victors.

Clair.greeting: Lance. Don't you dare outshine me. We do this as equals.
Clair.trainerWins: As equals, and victors. Don't forget it, Lance.

Clair.greeting: Lance gets all the attention. Today, I'm showing everyone who the real dragon tamer is.
Clair.trainerWins: Everyone saw. I'm the real dragon tamer.

Clair.greeting: Lance, my dragons lead. Yours follow.
Clair.trainerWins: My dragons led. His followed. Victory.
Clair.trainerLoses: My dragons led... into defeat. Annoying.

Lance.greeting: Cynthia, Sinnoh's Champion. It's a privilege to battle beside you.
Lance.trainerWins: A privilege, and a win. Thank you, Cynthia.

Lance.greeting: Cynthia and I compared notes on our Elite Fours. Hers are tougher. Let's see if we are too.
Lance.trainerWins: Tough enough, it turns out. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Kanto's Champion and Sinnoh's Champion. A rare alliance.
Lance.trainerWins: A rare alliance, a rare victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: A rare alliance, a rare defeat.

Cynthia.greeting: Lance. Two Champions together. Our opponent is in for a long day.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A long day for our opponent indeed.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A long day for us, it turns out.

Cynthia.greeting: Lance's dragons are magnificent. I'd love to study their history after this.
Cynthia.trainerWins: History made today. Thank you, Lance.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: History will remember your victory, not ours.

Cynthia.greeting: Lance, let's give them a battle worthy of two Champions.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Worthy of two Champions. Well done.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Worthy, but not victorious.

Lance.greeting: Diantha, I've seen your films. Let's give them a real show.
Lance.trainerWins: A real show, and a real win.

Lance.greeting: Diantha asked me to cameo in her next film. I said only if we win.
Lance.trainerWins: We won. I suppose I'm in a film now.
Lance.trainerLoses: We lost. No film for me.

Lance.greeting: Kalos's star and Kanto's Champion. A blockbuster cast.
Lance.trainerWins: A blockbuster cast, a blockbuster win.
Lance.trainerLoses: A blockbuster cast, a box office flop.

Diantha.greeting: Lance, the dragon master! What a co-star. Shall we?
Diantha.trainerWins: What a co-star! And what a finale!
Diantha.trainerLoses: The finale didn't play out as written.

Diantha.greeting: Lance would make a dashing hero on screen! Let's film a victory!
Lance, let's make this battle a scene to remember!

Lance.greeting: Drake, a dragon tamer from Hoenn. Let's see whose dragons roar louder.
Lance.trainerWins: My dragons roared loudest, together with yours.

Lance.greeting: Drake sailed the seas before taming dragons. A worthy partner for my own.
Lance.trainerWins: Drake's dragons roared, mine answered. Victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Drake's dragons roared, and you roared back.

Lance.greeting: Hoenn's sea dragon tamer and Kanto's sky dragon master. Sea and sky.
Lance.trainerWins: Sea and sky, both conquered by dragons.
Lance.trainerLoses: Sea and sky, and both slipped away.

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Lance! Two dragon masters in one battle! Glorious!
Gwahaha! Lance! Two dragon masters, one tide of fury!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The tide of fury swept them away!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The tide turned on us!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Lance, let's make them walk the plank!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Lance and I got tossed overboard!

Lance.greeting: Drasna, your gentle way with dragons is admirable.
Lance.trainerWins: Gentle and victorious. Admirable.
Lance.trainerLoses: Even gentleness can't win every battle.

Lance.greeting: Drasna offered my dragons homemade treats. They've never been happier. Let's battle.
Lance.trainerWins: Happy dragons, happy victory.

Lance.greeting: Kalos's gentle dragon tamer and Kanto's fierce one. Balance.
Lance.trainerWins: Gentle and fierce, perfectly balanced.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lance! The famous dragon master! What a treat!
Drasna.trainerWins: What a treat! We won!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my. That treat turned sour.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lance's dragons are so well behaved! Let's have a lovely battle!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, what a lovely victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, what a lovely... defeat.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lance, let's show them how dragons should be loved!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, loved and victorious! Splendid!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, loved, but defeated. They'll still get treats.

Lance.greeting: Drayden, the dragon master of Opelucid. An honor.
Lance.trainerWins: An honor and a victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Unova's dragon master beside me, and still we fell.

Lance.greeting: Drayden told me about Unova's dragon legends. I told him about Blackthorn's. Let's make a new one.
Lance.trainerWins: A new legend, made together.

Lance.greeting: Opelucid's dragons and the Plateau's dragons. Two regions' finest.
Lance.trainerWins: Two regions' finest, victorious.

Drayden.greeting: Lance. Your name flies far. Let us see the dragons behind it.
Drayden.trainerWins: The dragons behind the name, proven.
Drayden.trainerLoses: The dragons fell short today.

Drayden.greeting: Lance's dragons are swift. Mine are steadfast. Together, unstoppable.
Drayden.trainerWins: Swift and steadfast, unstoppable.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Swift and steadfast, stopped.

Drayden.greeting: Lance, let us show them the full might of dragons.
Drayden.trainerWins: The full might of dragons, unleashed.
Drayden.trainerLoses: The full might of dragons, contained.

Lance.greeting: Erika, your calm balances my dragons' fury.
Lance.trainerWins: Calm and fury, balanced. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Erika sent my dragons a bouquet after our last battle. They ate it. Let's battle.
Lance.trainerWins: Victory, and no bouquets were harmed.
Lance.trainerLoses: Defeat. My dragons owe Erika a new bouquet.

Lance.greeting: Celadon's garden and the Plateau's dragons. Calm and fury.
Lance.trainerWins: Calm and fury, perfectly balanced.

Erika.greeting: Lance... please keep your dragons away from the flower beds.
Erika.trainerWins: The flower beds survived, and so did we.
Erika.trainerLoses: The flower beds are fine. We are not.

Erika.greeting: Lance's dragons are... large. But surprisingly gentle. Let's win gracefully.
Erika.trainerWins: Graceful, and victorious. Thank you, Lance.
Erika.trainerLoses: Graceful, but defeated. The petals are fine.

Erika.greeting: Lance, let your dragons fly gently over my garden.
Erika.trainerWins: They flew gently, and we won.
Erika.trainerLoses: They flew gently, but too slowly.

Lance.greeting: Falkner, take to the skies. My dragons will follow.
Lance.trainerWins: Skies and dragons, ours. Well flown.

Lance.greeting: Falkner's birds follow my dragons in formation. Impressive discipline. Let's fly.
Lance.trainerWins: Formation held to the very end. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Violet's birds and the Plateau's dragons. A sky full of wings.
Lance.trainerWins: A sky full of wings, a sky full of victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: A sky full of wings, grounded.

Falkner.greeting: Lance! Flying beside dragons is a dream come true!
Falkner.trainerWins: A dream come true! We won!
Falkner.trainerLoses: A dream with a bad ending...

Falkner.greeting: Lance! Flying beside dragons! Father would be amazed!
Falkner.trainerWins: Dragons and birds, side by side, victorious! I'll tell Father!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Dragons and birds... I'll still tell Father it was amazing.

Falkner.greeting: Lance, let's own the skies together!
Falkner.trainerWins: The skies belong to us today!
Falkner.trainerLoses: The skies belonged to them today!

Lance.greeting: Giovanni. I've broken up your organization before. Don't make me regret this.
Lance.trainerWins: No regrets. Today.

Lance.greeting: Giovanni and I have a long history. Today, it's a truce. Nothing more.
Lance.trainerWins: The truce held, and so did our lead.
Lance.trainerLoses: The truce held. Our lead didn't.

Lance.greeting: Team Rocket's boss and the Plateau's Champion. An uneasy alliance.
Lance.trainerWins: An uneasy alliance, a solid victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: An uneasy alliance, a shaky defeat.

Giovanni.greeting: Lance. Let's settle our differences on the opponent instead.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Differences remain, and so does the loss.

Giovanni.greeting: Lance has foiled my plans many times. Today, he serves them.
Giovanni.trainerWins: He served my plans well today.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: He served my plans poorly. Predictable.

Giovanni.greeting: Lance, your dragons and my Ground types. Let's crush them.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: We were the ones crushed. Unacceptable.

Lance.greeting: Iris, Unova's young Champion. Your dragons have such spirit.
Lance.trainerWins: Such spirit, and such a win!
Lance.trainerLoses: Spirit isn't enough every time, Iris.

Lance.greeting: Iris challenged my dragons to a race around the tree. She won. Let's win this together.
Lance.trainerWins: Together, we're even faster. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Unova's young Champion and Kanto's veteran. Dragon spirit, past and future.
Lance.trainerWins: Dragon spirit, past and future, victorious.
Lance.trainerLoses: Dragon spirit, past and future, humbled.

Iris.greeting: Lance! You're like a dragon superhero! Let's win together!
Iris.trainerWins: Dragon superhero wins! Yay!

Iris.greeting: Lance is like a dragon superhero! I wanna be just like him! Let's go!
Iris.trainerWins: The dragon superhero and me, victorious! Woohoo!
Iris.trainerLoses: The dragon superhero and me... lost! Aww!

Iris.greeting: Lance, let's roar like dragons! RAWR!
Iris.trainerWins: RAWR! The dragons won! Lance, did you hear us?
Iris.trainerLoses: Rawr... the dragons are sad. We lost.

Lance.greeting: Janine, your father would be proud to see you here.
Lance.trainerWins: Your father would be proud. I am.
Lance.trainerLoses: Your father would still be proud.

Lance.greeting: Janine tried to sneak up on me. My dragons spotted her. Good effort, though. Let's battle.
Lance.trainerWins: Good effort, and a great victory.

Lance.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and the Plateau's Champion. Stealth and might.
Lance.trainerWins: Stealth and might, victorious.

Janine.greeting: Lance! Father says you're the toughest Champion there is!
Janine.trainerWins: The toughest Champion wins! Father was right!
Janine.trainerLoses: We lost... Father won't believe it.

Janine.greeting: Lance is the toughest Champion! Father says so! I'll prove I'm tough too!
Janine.trainerWins: Proved I'm tough! Victory!

Janine.greeting: Lance, I'll sneak around while your dragons attack!
Janine.trainerWins: Sneaked around, struck hard! Victory, Lance!
Janine.trainerLoses: They spotted me sneaking around! Ugh!

Lance.greeting: Jasmine, your steel and my dragons. A sturdy pair.
Lance.trainerWins: A sturdy pair, and a sturdy win.

Lance.greeting: Jasmine's care for her Pokémon is exemplary. My dragons trust her already.
Lance.trainerWins: Their trust was rewarded. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Olivine's steel and the Plateau's dragons. Shield and sword.
Lance.trainerWins: Shield and sword, victorious.

Jasmine.greeting: Lance... I'll do my best not to slow you down.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I didn't slow you down! We won!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I slowed us down... I'm sorry, Lance.

Jasmine.greeting: Lance... I'm nervous battling beside a Champion. But I'll try my best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I tried my best... and we won!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I tried my best... but we lost.

Jasmine.greeting: Lance, my steel will guard your dragons.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Guarded well, and victorious. Thank you, Lance.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I guarded them... but not well enough. Sorry.

Lance.greeting: Karen, the Johto Elite Four at full strength.
Lance.trainerWins: The Johto Elite Four, at full strength and victorious.

Lance.greeting: Karen says I'm too dramatic. I say she's too blunt. Let's agree on winning.
Lance.trainerWins: Agreed on winning, and we won.

Lance.greeting: Johto's Elite Four and its Champion. Darkness and dragons.
Lance.trainerWins: Darkness and dragons, triumphant.

Karen.greeting: Lance. Don't hog the spotlight, Champion.
Karen.trainerWins: You shared the spotlight. Good. We won.
Karen.trainerLoses: You hogged it, and we lost. Hmph.

Karen.greeting: Lance, strong Pokémon, weak Pokémon. Dragons are just Pokémon. Prove they're more.
Lance, stop posing and attack.

Lance.greeting: Koga, a ninja beside the Champion. Strike true.
Lance.trainerWins: You struck true. Well done.

Lance.greeting: Koga once challenged my dragons to hide-and-seek. They never found him. Let's battle.
Lance.trainerWins: Found the victory, if not Koga.
Lance.trainerLoses: We couldn't find Koga OR the victory.

Lance.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and the Plateau's dragons. Shadow and sky.
Lance.trainerWins: Shadow and sky, victorious together.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Lance! Let us show them the might of the Plateau!
Fwahaha! Lance, your dragons are loud. My poison is silent. Together, perfect!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Loud and silent, a perfect victory!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! Loud and silent, both silenced!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Lance, your dragons draw their eye, my poison strikes unseen!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! They never saw the poison coming!

Lance.greeting: Surge, let's coordinate. Dragons in the air, thunder on the ground.
Lance.trainerWins: Coordination complete. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Surge insisted on a military briefing before the battle. Fine. Let's execute.
Lance.trainerWins: Executed perfectly. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Vermilion's thunder and the Plateau's dragons. Storm and flight.
Lance.trainerWins: Storm and flight, victorious.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Roger that, Lance! Air support and thunder, coming right up!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Air support and thunder, mission accomplished!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Air support grounded! Mission failed!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Lance, the Champion! Air support and ground forces, baby!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Air support and ground forces, mission accomplished!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Air support and ground forces, pinned down!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Lance, let's coordinate a lightning strike!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Lightning strike, right on target, baby!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Lightning strike, missed the target!

Lance.greeting: Misty, keep the waters rough. My dragons thrive in a storm.
Lance.trainerWins: The storm favored my dragons. Thank you, Misty.

Lance.greeting: Misty asked my dragons for a ride over Cerulean. Win this, and they'll take you.
Lance.trainerWins: We won. Enjoy the ride, Misty.

Lance.greeting: Cerulean's waters and the Plateau's dragons. Storm and sea.
Lance.trainerWins: Storm and sea, victorious.

Misty.greeting: Lance! I'll make the waves, you make them roar!
Misty.trainerWins: Waves and roars, victory!
Misty.trainerLoses: The waves went flat!

Misty.greeting: Lance's dragons are so cool! I want a ride! Let's win!
Misty.trainerWins: We won! Dragon ride time!
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost... no dragon ride!

Misty.greeting: Lance, let's make a storm so big they can't see straight!
Misty.trainerWins: A storm so big they couldn't see straight! Victory!
Misty.trainerLoses: The storm fizzled out before it hit!

Lance.greeting: Morty, what do your visions say about this battle?
Lance.trainerWins: Your visions were right.

Lance.greeting: Morty described a vision of my dragons soaring. I hope it comes true today.
Lance.trainerWins: Morty's vision came true. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Ecruteak's seer and the Plateau's dragons. Vision and power.
Lance.trainerWins: Vision and power, victorious.

Morty.greeting: Lance... I see dragons soaring to victory.
Morty.trainerWins: Dragons soared to victory, as I saw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The vision changed. Dragons grounded.

Morty.greeting: Lance's aura is fierce. I sense the dragons' spirit in him.
Morty.trainerWins: The dragons' spirit triumphs.
Morty.trainerLoses: The dragons' spirit falters.

Morty.greeting: Lance, I see your dragons in the sky. Strike now.
Morty.trainerWins: Struck at exactly the right moment.
Morty.trainerLoses: Struck a moment too soon. I misread it.

Lance.greeting: Pryce, ice and dragons rarely mix. Let's prove that wrong.
Lance.trainerWins: Ice and dragons mixed well after all.

Lance.greeting: Pryce told me dragons fear the cold. I told him mine fear nothing. Let's prove it.
Lance.trainerWins: Proven. My dragons fear nothing, Pryce.
Lance.trainerLoses: Not proven. Perhaps they fear defeat.

Lance.greeting: Mahogany's ice and the Plateau's dragons. Frost and fire.
Lance.trainerWins: Frost and fire, victorious.

Pryce.greeting: Lance. Mind the cold, young dragon master.
Pryce.trainerWins: You minded the cold. Good. A win.
Pryce.trainerLoses: The cold got to us both.

Pryce.greeting: Lance's dragons are bold. Bold enough to stand beside the cold? Let's see.
Pryce.trainerWins: They stood beside the cold. Victory.

Pryce.greeting: Lance, let my ice slow them. Your dragons will finish.
Pryce.trainerWins: Slowed by ice, finished by dragons. Good.

Lance.greeting: Sabrina, your foresight and my dragons. A formidable combination.
Lance.trainerWins: A formidable combination, proven.

Lance.greeting: Sabrina told me the outcome before the battle started. She wouldn't say which.
Lance.trainerWins: She knew we'd win all along.
Lance.trainerLoses: She knew we'd lose, didn't she?

Lance.greeting: Saffron's mind and the Plateau's dragons. Foresight and force.
Lance.trainerWins: Foresight and force, victorious.

Sabrina.greeting: Lance. I already know how this ends. You'll like it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: You liked it, didn't you? Victory.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: I didn't see this coming. Truly.

Sabrina.greeting: Lance's dragons are predictable. In a good way. Let's begin.
Lance, I'll tell you when to strike.
Sabrina.trainerWins: He struck when I said. Victory.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: He struck when I said. I said wrong.

Lance.greeting: Steven, Hoenn's stone-loving Champion. Let's make this battle shine.
Lance.trainerWins: This battle shone. Well done, Steven.

Lance.greeting: Steven gave me a rare stone as thanks for partnering with him. Let's earn it.
Lance.trainerWins: Earned the stone, and the victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Didn't earn the stone. I'll give it back.

Lance.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Kanto's Champion. Stone and sky.
Lance.trainerWins: Stone and sky, victorious.

Steven.greeting: Lance, it's an honor. Your dragons are rarer than any stone I've found.
Steven.trainerWins: Rarer than any stone: a win beside Lance.
Steven.trainerLoses: Even rare stones crack.

Steven.greeting: Lance's dragons are rarer than any gem. Let's polish this victory.
Steven.trainerWins: A victory polished to a mirror shine.
Steven.trainerLoses: Tarnished, unfortunately. A rare flaw.

Steven.greeting: Lance, let's make this battle shine like a diamond.
Steven.trainerWins: Shining like a flawless diamond.
Steven.trainerLoses: Dull as an unpolished rock today.

Lance.greeting: Wallace, your elegance meets my power. Interesting.
Lance.trainerWins: Elegance and power. Interesting, and victorious.

Lance.greeting: Wallace asked if my cape was designer. I said it was practical. He was disappointed.
Lance.trainerWins: Practical cape, practical victory.

Lance.greeting: Sootopolis's elegance and the Plateau's might. Grace and power.
Lance.trainerWins: Grace and power, victorious.

Wallace.greeting: Lance! A dragon master's might paired with my grace. Exquisite!
Wallace.trainerWins: Exquisite! A triumph of grace and might!

Wallace.greeting: Lance's cape is so dramatic! Let's make this battle just as dramatic!
Wallace.trainerWins: Dramatic from start to finish! Exquisite!
Wallace.trainerLoses: Dramatic, and tragic! Such is art!

Wallace.greeting: Lance, let's give them a performance they'll never forget!

Lance.greeting: Whitney, keep your spirits up. We'll win this together.
Lance.trainerWins: Spirits up, and a win. Well done, Whitney.
Lance.trainerLoses: Chin up, Whitney. We'll win next time.

Lance.greeting: Whitney asked if she could ride my dragon. If she doesn't cry, she can.
Lance.trainerWins: She didn't cry. Ride's yours, Whitney.

Lance.greeting: Goldenrod's spirit and the Plateau's dragons. Heart and might.
Lance.trainerWins: Heart and might, victorious.

Whitney.greeting: Lance! You're so cool! I won't cry, I promise!
Whitney.trainerWins: Lance won with me! And I didn't cry!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I promised not to cry... Waah!

Whitney.greeting: Lance is so cool! I promise I won't cry! Let's win!
Whitney.trainerWins: No crying! We won! Dragon ride!

Whitney.greeting: Lance, let's be the coolest team ever!
Whitney.trainerWins: The coolest team ever wins! Lance, high five!
Whitney.trainerLoses: The coolest team ever... is now the crying team!

Lance.greeting: Will, focus your mind. My dragons will clear the way.
Lance.trainerWins: The way was cleared. Thank you, Will.
Lance.trainerLoses: My dragons couldn't clear it today.

Lance.greeting: Will practiced his entrance three times before this battle. I'll let it slide.
Lance.trainerWins: His entrance was perfect. So was the win.
Lance.trainerLoses: His entrance was perfect. The battle wasn't.

Lance.greeting: Johto's Elite Four and its Champion. Mind and dragons.
Lance.trainerWins: Mind and dragons, victorious.

Will.greeting: Lance, our Champion. I'll follow your lead... gracefully.
Lance, our Champion. I'll make sure my elegance complements your power.
Will.trainerWins: My elegance complemented his power perfectly.
Will.trainerLoses: My elegance, his power... both insufficient.

Will.greeting: Lance, I'll read their minds. Your dragons strike.
Anabel, the Salon Maiden. Our minds should be in perfect sync.
Anabel and I tested our psychic sync before the battle. Perfect. Let's prove it.
Will.trainerLoses: Disproven. We fell out of sync.

Will.greeting: Johto's Elite Four and the Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Psychic harmony.

Anabel.greeting: Will. I can feel your focus. Let's read our opponent together.
Anabel.trainerWins: We read them right. A fine win, Will.
Anabel.trainerLoses: We read them wrong. Forgive me.

Anabel.greeting: Will's focus is sharp. I sense his Pokémon trust him deeply.
Anabel.trainerWins: Their trust led us to victory.

Anabel.greeting: Will, let's read our opponent together.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Read together, and still they surprised us.

Will.greeting: Bugsy, your analytical mind would make a fine psychic.
Will.trainerWins: A fine psychic mind, and a fine win.
Will.trainerLoses: Your analysis failed us, Bugsy. As did my focus.

Will.greeting: Bugsy asked to study my mask's effect on focus. I'll allow it, if we win.
Will.trainerWins: We won. Study the mask all you like, Bugsy.
Will.trainerLoses: We lost. The mask stays unstudied.

Will.greeting: Azalea's research and Johto's Elite Four. Mind and science.

Bugsy.greeting: Will! I'd love to study how that mask affects your focus!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Data on the mask: it works! We won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Data on the mask: it didn't help!

Bugsy.greeting: Will's psychic powers are fascinating! I'll observe closely while we battle!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Observation complete: masked focus works! Victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Observation complete: masked focus failed! Hmm!

Bugsy.greeting: Will, let's combine psychic power and bug science!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Psychic power plus bug science! Perfect formula!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Psychic power plus bug science... formula failed!

Will.greeting: Caitlin, a lady of elegance and mind. Shall we perform?
Caitlin asked if I'd perform in her castle's theater. I said yes, if we win.
Will.trainerLoses: We lost. The theater stays dark.

Will.greeting: Johto's Elite Four and Unova's Elite Four. Elegance of two regions.

Caitlin.greeting: Will. Your mask is rather theatrical. I approve.
Will's theatrical flair is quite entertaining. Let's give a performance.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A splendid performance. I'm quite pleased.

Caitlin.greeting: Will, let us show them true refinement.

Will.greeting: Chuck, please try to think before you punch.
Chuck asked me to teach him meditation. He fell asleep in two minutes. Let's battle.
Cianwood's fists and Johto's psychic. Brawn and brain.

Chuck.greeting: Will! Thinking is overrated! WAHAHAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Thinking IS overrated! We won!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Will's so calm! I'll be calm too! For one battle! HYAH!
WAHAHAH! Will, think fast, I'll punch faster!

Will.greeting: Clair, your pride is formidable. Let's aim it at our foes.
Clair said my poses slow me down. I'll prove they don't.
Blackthorn's dragons and Johto's psychic. Pride and grace.

Clair.greeting: Will. Don't slow me down with your poses.
Clair.trainerWins: No poses slowed me down. Good.

Clair.greeting: Will's elegant, I'll give him that. Now let's see if he can keep up with my dragons.
Clair.trainerWins: He kept up with my dragons. Impressive.
Clair.trainerLoses: He didn't keep up. Unimpressive, Will.

Clair.greeting: Will, read their minds, then get out of my dragons' way.
Clair.trainerWins: He got out of the way. Victory.
Clair.trainerLoses: He got in the way. Defeat.

Will.greeting: Dexio, a student of the mind. Let's show them true focus.
Will.trainerWins: True focus, shown. Well done, Dexio.

Will.greeting: Dexio has studied my techniques for years. Let's see what he's learned.
Will.trainerWins: He's learned well. I'm impressed, Dexio.
Will.trainerLoses: He has more to learn. As do I.

Will.greeting: Kalos's research and Johto's Elite Four. Student and master.

Dexio.greeting: Will of the Elite Four! I've studied your psychic techniques for years!
Dexio.trainerWins: Years of study paid off beside Will himself!
Dexio.trainerLoses: I studied for years... and still lost.

Dexio.greeting: Will of the Elite Four! I'll apply everything I've studied!
Dexio.trainerWins: Everything I studied, applied! We won!
Dexio.trainerLoses: Everything I studied... and still we lost!

Dexio.greeting: Will, let's analyze their every move together.

Will.greeting: Falkner, soar high. My mind will guide your path.
Will.trainerWins: My mind guided your path to victory.

Will.greeting: Falkner's birds dislike my mask. They'll get over it. Let's battle.
Will.trainerWins: The birds got over the mask. Victory.
Will.trainerLoses: The birds never got over the mask. Defeat.

Will.greeting: Violet's birds and Johto's psychic. Wings guided by mind.

Falkner.greeting: Will, your psychic power and my birds. Let's take to the sky!
Falkner.trainerWins: Psychic power and birds, soaring!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Grounded, even with psychic help!

Falkner.greeting: Will's psychic power and my birds! Let's soar!
Falkner.trainerWins: Psychic power and wings! We soared to victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Psychic power and wings... we soared, then fell!

Falkner.greeting: Will, guide my birds through the sky!
Falkner.trainerWins: Guided perfectly through the sky! Victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Guided... into a headwind! Defeat!

Will.greeting: Jasmine, your quiet strength steadies the mind.
Jasmine says my mask is scary. I'll take it off after the battle. Maybe.
Will.trainerWins: We won. Perhaps I'll take the mask off. Perhaps.
Will.trainerLoses: We lost. The mask stays on, to hide my shame.

Will.greeting: Olivine's steel and Johto's psychic. Calm and focus.

Jasmine.greeting: Will... your mask is a little scary. But I trust you.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I trusted you, Will... and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Will. I couldn't help enough.

Jasmine.greeting: Will is a little scary... but he's kind to his Pokémon. I trust him.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I trusted him. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I trusted him. We lost... but that's okay.

Jasmine.greeting: Will, I'll keep watch like Olivine's lighthouse. You focus.
Jasmine.trainerWins: The lighthouse kept watch. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The lighthouse dimmed... I'm sorry, Will.

Will.greeting: Karen, the Johto Elite Four united. Let's be elegant about it.
Karen rolled her eyes at my entrance. Again. Let's battle.
Will.trainerWins: Victory. She'll roll her eyes at that too.
Will.trainerLoses: Defeat. She's definitely rolling her eyes.

Will.greeting: Johto's Elite Four, mind and darkness.

Karen.greeting: Will. Less posing, more battling.
Karen.trainerLoses: More posing, more losing. Told you.

Karen.greeting: Will's elegant. I'm efficient. Let's see whose style wins.
Will, let's finish this quickly.
Karen.trainerWins: Finished quickly. That's how I like it.
Karen.trainerLoses: Finished badly. That's how I hate it.

Will.greeting: Koga, a ninja's patience and my focus. Perfect harmony.
Koga's smoke bombs ruined my last entrance. Today, he's on my side.
Will.trainerWins: The smoke cleared on our victory.
Will.trainerLoses: The smoke lingered over our defeat.

Will.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and Johto's psychic. Shadows and mind.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Will! Strike from the mind, strike from the shadows!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Mind and shadow struck true!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Will's mind and my poison! Unseen and unstoppable!
Fwahaha! Will, confuse them, and I'll strike!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! We were the confused ones!

Will.greeting: Lucian, a fellow scholar of the mind. Shall we study our opponent?
Lucian read an entire novel during the elevator ride. I meditated. Let's battle.
Will.trainerWins: Victory, and he finished his novel.
Will.trainerLoses: Defeat, and he lost his page.

Will.greeting: Sinnoh's Elite Four and Johto's Elite Four. Minds of two regions.

Lucian.greeting: Will. I'll mark my page and give you my full attention.
Lucian.trainerLoses: I'll mark this page too. A sad chapter.

Lucian.greeting: Will, a fellow scholar. Let's study our opponent with care.
Lucian.trainerLoses: Studied carefully, yet outmatched. A lesson.

Lucian.greeting: Will, let's turn this battle into an elegant chapter.

Will.greeting: Morty, a seer and a psychic. Our opponent can hide nothing.
Will.trainerWins: Nothing hidden, nothing lost. A win.

Will.greeting: Morty saw my mask in a vision before we met. Unsettling. Let's battle.
Ecruteak's seer and Johto's psychic. Visions and minds.

Morty.greeting: Will. I see your mask... and the focus behind it.
Morty.trainerWins: The focus behind the mask won us this.
Morty.trainerLoses: The mask couldn't hide that defeat.

Morty.greeting: Will's focus is like a spirit's gaze. Steady. Piercing. Let's battle.
Morty.trainerWins: Steady and piercing, victorious.
Morty.trainerLoses: Steady and piercing, deflected.

Morty.greeting: Will, I'll see their path. You read their minds.
Morty.trainerWins: Seen and read. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: Seen and read, yet still surprised.

Will.greeting: Pryce, your patience is the mark of a true master.
Will.trainerLoses: Even masters fall, now and then.

Will.greeting: Pryce told me to keep my mind cool. I'll try to keep it icy.
Will.trainerWins: An icy mind brings a clear victory.
Will.trainerLoses: An icy mind, frozen solid. Defeat.

Will.greeting: Mahogany's ice and Johto's psychic. Cold focus.

Pryce.greeting: Will. Your mind is sharp. Keep it cool.
Pryce.trainerWins: Sharp and cool. A fine win.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Sharp, but not cool enough today.

Pryce.greeting: Will's mind is sharp. Sharp minds need patience. Let's battle.
Will, let the cold settle your mind.
Pryce.trainerLoses: A settled mind, but an unsettled result.

Will.greeting: Sabrina, the strongest mind in Kanto. Let's combine our power.
Sabrina finished my sentence before I started it. Twice. Let's battle.
Will.trainerLoses: She foresaw the defeat, I suspect.

Will.greeting: Saffron's psychic and Johto's psychic. Kanto and Johto's strongest minds.

Sabrina.greeting: Will. I foresaw you'd say that. Let's begin.
Will's mind is elegant. I've seen our victory. Let's begin.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Not as I saw it. Curious.

Sabrina.greeting: Will, follow my vision precisely.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: He followed it precisely. My vision erred.

Will.greeting: Whitney, stay calm. A calm mind wins battles.
Will.trainerWins: A calm mind won. Well done, Whitney.
Will.trainerLoses: A calm mind lost. Rare, but it happens.

Will.greeting: Whitney asked if my mask was a costume. It is not. Let's battle.
Will.trainerWins: Not a costume, and a fine victory.
Will.trainerLoses: Not a costume, and a sad defeat.

Will.greeting: Goldenrod's spirit and Johto's psychic. Heart and mind.

Whitney.greeting: Will, you're kinda creepy... but cool! Let's win!
Whitney.trainerWins: Creepy and cool AND we won!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Creepy, cool, and we lost! Waah!

Whitney.greeting: Will's kinda creepy... but he's nice! I'll stay calm like him!
Will, teach me to be calm! After we win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We lost! Waaah! Teach me anyway!

Koga.greeting: Blaine! Two old Kanto Gym Leaders! Let us burn and poison!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha... we went up in smoke.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Blaine and I guarded Kanto's Gyms for decades! Old warriors, still sharp!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! The old warriors are still sharp!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! The old warriors grew dull!

Koga.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and Cinnabar's volcano. Poison and flame.

Blaine.greeting: Koga! Ninja quiz: what vanishes in a puff of smoke? Our opponents! Hah!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Vanished in a puff of smoke! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! WE vanished in smoke!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Koga's smoke and my fire! A smoky inferno!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! The smoky inferno engulfs them!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The smoky inferno fizzles!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Koga, quiz time! What's deadlier than poison? Poison AND fire!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Correct! Poison and fire win!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Incorrect! Poison and fire... lose!

Koga.greeting: Brock, the rock of Pewter. Hold firm while I strike!
Koga.trainerWins: The rock held, my strike landed.
Koga.trainerLoses: The rock held, but my strike missed.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Brock's stone walls are perfect cover for my ninja tactics!
Pewter's stone and Fuchsia's poison. Earth and venom.

Brock.greeting: Koga! I'll be your shield. You handle the sneaky stuff!
Brock.trainerWins: I shielded, you snuck! We won!
Brock.trainerLoses: I shielded, but it wasn't enough.

Brock.greeting: Koga taught me how to hide a rock in plain sight! Let's use it!
Brock.trainerWins: Hidden in plain sight, and we won!
Brock.trainerLoses: Hidden in plain sight... and found!

Brock.greeting: Koga, let's set a trap they can't escape!
Brock.trainerWins: Trap sprung! They never saw it coming!
Brock.trainerLoses: Trap sprung... right on us!

Koga.greeting: Bugsy, your insects and my poison. A deadly pairing.
Fwahaha! Bugsy wants to study my poison! Study it in action!
Fuchsia's poison and Azalea's bugs. Small and deadly.

Bugsy.greeting: Koga! Did you know some insects are natural ninjas? Fascinating!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Natural ninjas, victorious! Fascinating!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Natural ninjas, defeated! Still fascinating!

Bugsy.greeting: Koga's poison and my bugs! I'll take notes mid-battle!
Bugsy.trainerWins: My notes say: total victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My notes say: total defeat!

Bugsy.greeting: Koga, let's sting them like a ninja hornet!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Ninja hornet sting! Victory!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Ninja hornet swatted! Defeat!

Koga.greeting: Chuck, your fists are loud. My strikes are silent. Together, unstoppable.
Fwahaha! Chuck tried to sneak up on me. I heard him from three rooms away!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Loud Chuck and silent Koga, victorious!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! Too loud, Chuck! They heard us coming!

Koga.greeting: Fuchsia's shadows and Cianwood's waterfalls. Stealth and strength.

Chuck.greeting: Koga! A real ninja! I've always wanted to train with one!
Chuck.trainerWins: I trained with a real ninja, and we won!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Even a ninja couldn't save us! WAHAHAH!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Koga's teaching me ninja moves! I'll use them right now! HYAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Ninja moves, mastered in one battle!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Ninja moves need way more practice!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Koga, you poison 'em, I punch 'em!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got poisoned and punched!

Koga.greeting: Clair, let my poison wear them down for your dragons.
Koga.trainerWins: Worn down, then finished. As planned.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Clair said my tricks are beneath a dragon tamer. Watch them work, Clair!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! The tricks worked! Admit it, Clair!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! The tricks failed! Don't say it, Clair!

Koga.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and Blackthorn's dragons. Venom and fury.

Clair.greeting: Koga. Do your ninja tricks. I'll finish them off.
Clair.trainerWins: Your tricks worked. Fine. I finished them.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your tricks failed. So did my dragons.

Clair.greeting: Koga's poison softens them up. My dragons finish. Simple.
Clair.trainerWins: Simple, and effective. Good work, Koga.

Clair.greeting: Koga, stay in the shadows. My dragons take the spotlight.
Clair.trainerWins: He stayed in the shadows. My dragons shone.
Clair.trainerLoses: He stayed in the shadows. My dragons didn't shine.

Koga.greeting: Erika, poison and flowers. Nature's most dangerous combination.
Fwahaha! Erika's flowers hide poison as well as any ninja!
Fuchsia's poison and Celadon's flowers. Toxic beauty.

Erika.greeting: Koga... I do hope your poison won't wilt my flowers.
Erika.trainerWins: My flowers survived, and we won. How nice.
Erika.trainerLoses: My flowers wilted... and so did we.

Erika.greeting: Koga, poison and petals... a dangerous bouquet. Let's battle.
Erika.trainerWins: A dangerous bouquet, delivered with care.
Erika.trainerLoses: A dangerous bouquet, returned to sender.

Erika.greeting: Koga, let's make a garden they'll never forget.
Erika.trainerWins: An unforgettable garden, blooming in victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: An unforgettable garden, sadly overgrown.

Koga.greeting: Falkner, strike from above. I strike from the shadows.
Koga.trainerWins: From above and from the shadows! Victory!
Koga.trainerLoses: Neither shadow nor sky could save us.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Falkner's birds spotted me hiding on the roof! Sharp eyes!
Fuchsia's ninja and Violet's birds. Shadow and wing.

Falkner.greeting: Koga! Your stealth and my speed. They won't see us coming!
Falkner.trainerWins: They never saw us coming!
Falkner.trainerLoses: They saw us coming...

Falkner.greeting: Koga showed my birds how to fly silently! Let's surprise them!
Falkner.trainerWins: Silent wings, sudden victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Silent wings... but they heard us!

Falkner.greeting: Koga, let's make them look up and down at the same time!
Falkner.trainerWins: They looked up, they looked down, they lost!
Falkner.trainerLoses: They looked up, they looked down, they won!

Koga.greeting: Giovanni. Two Kanto Gym Leaders with... complicated pasts.
Fwahaha! Giovanni and I once shared a secret or two. Today, we share a battle.
Viridian's earth and Fuchsia's poison. Old Kanto power.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga. Your ninja skills would have served me well, once.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Your skills served well. Once more.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Your skills failed me. Once more.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga's skills were wasted on a Gym. Today, they serve a better purpose.
Giovanni.trainerWins: His skills served well today. As they should.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: His skills served poorly. Wasted again.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga, poison them. I'll bury them.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Poisoned, then buried. Clean work, Koga.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Not poisoned, not buried. Sloppy work.

Koga.greeting: Janine, my daughter! Show your father how much you've grown!
Koga.trainerWins: You've grown so much, Janine! A fine win!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha... even I couldn't carry us today. We train together tomorrow.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Janine has trained in secret for months! Show me, my daughter!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! My daughter has surpassed me!

Koga.greeting: Father and daughter, Fuchsia's ninja clan. Our shadows move as one.
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Our shadows moved as one!

Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The storm broke against us!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and the Battle Frontier's mind. Power and focus.

Anabel.greeting: Drake. Your dragons' strength is almost overwhelming.

Anabel.trainerLoses: Their loyalty was strong. Not strong enough.

Anabel.greeting: Drake, I'll read their moves. Your dragons will strike.

Anabel.trainerLoses: Read and struck, yet they endured.

Drake.greeting: Brawly! A fellow lover of the sea! Let's make waves!

Brawly.greeting: Drake! The old sea dog himself! Let's surf to victory!
Brawly.trainerWins: Surfed to victory with the old sea dog!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The old sea dog and I wiped out!

Brawly.greeting: Drake's got stories from every sea! Let's make a new one!
Drake, let's ride a dragon-sized wave!

Gwahaha! Clair called me "old man." I've been called worse at sea! Let's go!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The old man still has it!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The old man's getting slow!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's sea dragons and Blackthorn's mountain dragons. Sea and peak!

Clair.greeting: Drake. Just keep up with my dragons, old man.

Clair.trainerLoses: You couldn't keep up. Neither could I.

Clair.greeting: Drake's dragons are seasoned. Mine are fierce. A good combination, I'll admit.
Clair.trainerLoses: Seasoned and fierce, and still beaten.

Clair.greeting: Drake, follow my dragons. Try to keep up.
Clair.trainerWins: He kept up. Not bad, old man.

Drake.greeting: Drasna! A gentle dragon tamer. Your dragons must love you.

Hoenn's sea dragons and Kalos's gentle dragons. Fierce and kind!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Drake! Your dragons are so lovely and fierce!
Drasna.trainerWins: Lovely and fierce, and victorious! Oh my!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, fierce wasn't enough!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Drake's dragons are so rugged! They need a little pampering!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, pampered and victorious!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, pampered and defeated!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Drake, let's show them how dragons can be both strong and sweet!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, strong and sweet, and victorious!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, sweet, but not strong enough!

Drake.greeting: Drayden! Two old dragon tamers! Let's show the youngsters!
Gwahaha! Drayden and I have trained dragons longer than most Trainers have been alive!
Hoenn's dragons and Opelucid's dragons! Old masters, old fire!

Drayden.greeting: Drake. Your experience shows. Let us battle as one.
Drayden.trainerWins: As one, victorious. Well done.
Drayden.trainerLoses: As one, defeated.

Drayden.greeting: Drake's dragons ride the sea winds. Mine guard the mountains. Together, all terrain.
Drayden.trainerWins: Sea and mountain, conquered together.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Sea and mountain, both lost today.

Drayden.greeting: Drake, let us show the youth what decades of dragon training mean.
Drayden.trainerWins: Decades, well spent. Victory.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Decades, and still more to learn.

Drake.greeting: Flannery! Fire and dragons, a hot combination!
Gwahaha! Flannery's fire is as hot as my dragons' breath!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Dragon breath and fire, victorious!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Dragon breath and fire, extinguished!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and Lavaridge's flames! A volcanic sea!

Flannery.greeting: Drake! Dragons love the heat, right? Let's burn them up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Burned them up! Dragons DO love heat!

Flannery.greeting: Drake's dragons love the heat! I'll keep it extra hot!
Drake, let's set the sea on fire!
Flannery.trainerWins: The sea's on fire! We won, Drake!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The sea put out our fire! Ugh!

Drake.greeting: Iris! A young dragon tamer with fire in her heart!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Fire in her heart, and a win in her hand!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Even fire dims! Next time, lass!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Iris called me a pirate! I'll take it! Let's sail!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Pirate and dragon girl, victorious!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Pirate and dragon girl, shipwrecked!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's veteran and Unova's young Champion. Old salt and new fire!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Old salt and new fire, unstoppable!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Old salt and new fire, stopped!

Iris.greeting: Drake! You're like a pirate dragon master! So cool!
Iris.trainerWins: The pirate dragon master and me won! So cool!
Iris.trainerLoses: The pirate dragon master and me lost... Not cool!

Iris.greeting: Drake's dragons are so cool! I wanna sail with them!
Iris.trainerWins: Sailed with dragons, and won!

Iris.greeting: Drake, let's be dragon pirates! Arr!
Iris.trainerWins: Arr! Dragon pirates win!

Drake.greeting: Juan! The sea and dragons, eh? A fine combination!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The sea and dragons, triumphant!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Sunk, the both of us!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Juan's water is elegant. My sea is wild. Let's mix them!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Elegant and wild, washed out!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and Sootopolis's water. The deep sea!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The deep sea claims victory!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The deep sea claims us!

Juan.greeting: Drake. Your seafaring spirit is delightful.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a delightful voyage to victory.
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the voyage ran aground.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Drake! A seafaring spirit! Let us make waves into art!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the waves became chaos!

Juan.greeting: Drake, let us paint a seascape with dragons!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, a dragon seascape, stormy!

Drake.greeting: Norman! A strong father! Let's fight like family!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Fought like family, and won!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Family squabble, and a loss!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Norman raised two Trainers who became legends! A fine captain!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The captain leads us to victory!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The captain went down with the ship!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and Petalburg's strength. Hoenn's old guard!

Norman.greeting: Drake. A seasoned veteran. Lead the way, and I'll follow.
Norman.trainerWins: I followed, and we won. Well led, Drake.
Norman.trainerLoses: I followed... into defeat.

Norman.greeting: Drake's experience is unmatched. I'll follow his lead.
Norman.trainerLoses: Following Drake led us astray.

Norman.greeting: Drake, let's show them what Hoenn's veterans can do.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's veterans were humbled.

Drake.greeting: Roxanne! Brains and dragons! A good mix!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Brains and dragons! A fine mix!

Roxanne.trainerWins: My studies on dragons, confirmed! So fun!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My studies were incomplete. Not fun.

Roxanne.greeting: Drake's dragons behave exactly as my research predicted! Mostly! Let's battle!
Drake, let's apply my research to your dragons!

Drake.greeting: Steven! Our Champion! Let's sail into battle!
Gwahaha! Steven found a stone shaped like a dragon! He gave it to me!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! The dragon stone brings luck!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! The dragon stone is cursed!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Hoenn's dragon master! Stone and storm!

Steven.greeting: Drake, your dragons are a force of nature.
Steven.trainerWins: A force of nature indeed. Thank you, Drake.
Steven.trainerLoses: Even forces of nature can be stopped.

Steven.greeting: Drake's dragons are a force of nature. Let's harness it.
Steven.trainerWins: Harnessed, and victorious.
Steven.trainerLoses: Unharnessed, and defeated.

Steven.greeting: Drake, let's show them Hoenn's might.
Steven.trainerWins: Hoenn's might, shown to the world.
Steven.trainerLoses: Hoenn's might, tested and humbled.

Drake.greeting: Wallace! The sea's most elegant trainer!
Gwahaha! Wallace wants to make my dragons sparkle! Dragons don't sparkle!
Hoenn's dragons and Sootopolis's beauty! Storm and grace!

Wallace.greeting: Drake, let me add a little elegance to your storm.
Wallace.trainerLoses: An inelegant storm. And a loss.

Wallace.greeting: Drake's dragons are magnificent, if a little rough. Let me add some polish.
Drake, let's give them a stormy, beautiful show!

Drake.greeting: Wally! You've grown into a strong trainer!
Gwahaha! Wally was a sickly boy when I met him! Look at him now!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Strong as a sailor! Victory!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and Hoenn's rising star! Old salt and young blood!

Wally.greeting: Drake! Your dragons are amazing! I'll do my best!
Wally.trainerWins: I did my best with Drake, and we won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I did my best... we still lost.

Wally.greeting: Drake's dragons are amazing! I want to be as strong as them!
Wally.trainerWins: As strong as dragons! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: Not as strong as dragons yet...

Wally.greeting: Drake, let's sail into battle together!
Wally.trainerWins: We sailed right into victory, Drake!
Wally.trainerLoses: We sailed right into a storm!

Drake.greeting: Wattson! Gwahaha! Two loud old men!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Two loud old men, two big winners!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Two loud old men, quieted!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Wattson and I have a laughing contest every time we meet!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Laughing all the way to victory!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Laughing all the way to defeat!

Drake.greeting: Hoenn's dragons and Mauville's lightning! A thunderstorm at sea!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Drake! Let's shake things up!
Wahahahah! Drake! Two loud old men! Let's make some noise!
Wahahahah! Drake, let's shock 'em silly!

Drake.greeting: Winona! Birds and dragons rule the sky!
Gwahaha! Winona's birds and my dragons rule the skies!
Hoenn's dragons and Fortree's birds! Wings of Hoenn!

Winona.greeting: Drake, your dragons fly with real power. Let's soar together.
Winona.trainerWins: We soared together. Well flown, Drake.

Winona.greeting: Drake's dragons fly with raw power. My birds fly with grace. Together, perfect.
Drake, let's soar higher than they can reach.

Steven.greeting: Alder, Unova's Champion. I hear you wander as much as I do.
Steven.trainerWins: Two wanderers, one win. Let's go rock hunting.
Steven.trainerLoses: We wandered right into a loss.

Steven.trainerWins: We both found what we came for: a victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Neither of us found a victory in that cave today.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Unova's wandering Champion. Two travelers sharing one road.
Steven.trainerWins: Two travelers, and the road led straight to victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Two travelers who took a wrong turn somewhere.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Steven! A fellow wanderer! Find any good rocks lately?
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Found a good rock: victory!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Tripped over a rock, it seems!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Steven's rocks and my wild spirit! Let's have an adventure!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! What an adventure! Steven, same cave next year?
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! The adventure bit back! Still a good time!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Steven, let's wander right into a win!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Wandered right into it, just like I said!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! We wandered right past it! Oops!

Steven.greeting: Anabel, I've heard about your talents at the Battle Frontier. Impressive.
Steven.trainerWins: A rare victory, indeed. Thank you, Anabel.
Steven.trainerLoses: Not so rare, losing. Unfortunately.

Steven.greeting: Anabel's focus is like a perfectly cut gem: every facet in place. Let's battle.
Steven.trainerWins: Every facet in place, and a flawless result.
Steven.trainerLoses: One facet chipped. You found it, challenger.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and the Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Stone and sense.
Steven.trainerWins: Stone and sense, solid from start to finish.
Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and sense, and you saw through both.

Anabel.greeting: Steven. I sense your love for rare things. Let's add a rare victory.
Steven's love for rare things is easy to sense. Let's give him a rare victory.
Anabel.trainerWins: A rare victory for a rare collector.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Rare things are hard to find. Victory was, today.

Anabel.greeting: Steven, I'll sense their intentions. Your steel will be waiting for them.
Anabel.trainerWins: They came where I sensed, and his steel was ready.
Anabel.trainerLoses: I sensed them, but they slipped past his steel.

Steven.trainerLoses: Even Granite Cave couldn't save us.

Steven.trainerWins: Debt repaid, Brawly. Thank you for that cave.
Steven.trainerLoses: Still in your debt, Brawly. I'll repay it.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Dewford's surfer. Stone and wave.
Steven.trainerWins: The wave crashed, the stone held. Victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Even stone erodes under enough waves.

Brawly.greeting: Steven! You found rocks in Granite Cave, right? Let's rock this battle!

Brawly.trainerWins: Rocked it, Steven! Granite Cave would be proud!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Rocked and rolled... right off the board!

Brawly.greeting: Steven, let's crash on 'em like surf on the rocks!
Brawly.trainerWins: Surf and rocks, the whole beach is ours!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Crashed on the rocks... ouch, man!

Steven.greeting: Byron, a man who knows his steel and stone. A pleasure.

Steven.trainerLoses: A pleasure, even in defeat.

Steven.trainerLoses: A defeat as deep as that mine.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Canalave's miner. Stone and steel, from deep underground.
Steven.trainerWins: Stone and steel, unbreakable today.
Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and steel, and still we cracked.

Byron.greeting: Steven! Gahaha! A fellow steel lover! Let's dig in!

Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Steel lovers, dented and bent!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Steven, let's build a steel fortress they can't dig through!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! They dug right through us!

Steven.greeting: Colress, your scientific mind would appreciate my stone collection.
Steven.trainerWins: Fascinating, and victorious. My collection awaits you.
Steven.trainerLoses: Fascinating, but defeated.

Steven.trainerWins: We won. The stones are yours to study, Colress.
Steven.trainerLoses: We lost. The stones stay in my pocket today.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Colress's laboratory. Stone and science.
Steven.trainerWins: Stone and science, a winning formula.
Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and science, a failed experiment.

Colress.greeting: Steven. Steel, science, and stones. A fascinating combination.
Steven's steel types are flawless specimens. Let's test them under battle stress.
Colress.trainerWins: Under stress, flawless. Exactly as I hoped.
Colress.trainerLoses: Under stress, a fracture. Fascinating, though.

Colress.greeting: Steven, let's see what your steel can do under real pressure.
Colress.trainerLoses: Under real pressure, it cracked. Noted.

Steven.trainerWins: A myth made. Well done, Cynthia.
Steven.trainerLoses: Not every myth has a happy ending.

Steven.greeting: Cynthia and I spent hours discussing ancient ruins and rare stones. Let's battle.
Steven.trainerWins: Ancient wisdom, modern victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Ancient wisdom, modern defeat.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Sinnoh's Champion. Two Champions, one shared curiosity.
Steven.trainerWins: Two Champions, curious and victorious.
Steven.trainerLoses: Two Champions, curious about how we lost.

Cynthia.trainerLoses: This one won't go in my collection.

Cynthia.greeting: Steven collects stones the way I collect myths. Let's make a new legend together.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A new legend, set in stone.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: That legend will have to wait for another day.

Cynthia.greeting: Steven, let's give them a battle worthy of the myths we love.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A battle worthy of any myth. Thank you, Steven.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Worthy of a myth, though not ours to win.

Steven.greeting: Diantha, Kalos's Champion. Your screen presence is quite something.
Steven.trainerWins: Quite a performance, and quite a win.
Steven.trainerLoses: The performance fell short.

Steven.greeting: Diantha asked if my stones could be film props. Only the replicas, I said. Let's battle.
Steven.trainerWins: A victory worthy of the big screen.
Steven.trainerLoses: A defeat for the blooper reel, I'm afraid.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Kalos's Champion. Stone and screen.
Steven.trainerWins: Stone and screen, a blockbuster win.
Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and screen, a box office miss.

Diantha.greeting: Steven, the Hoenn Champion. Let's give them a performance to remember.
Steven would be perfect as a mysterious hero in my next film! Let's film this victory!
Diantha.trainerWins: And... cut! A perfect take, Steven!
Diantha.trainerLoses: And... cut! Let's try that scene again!

Diantha.greeting: Steven, let's give them a performance to remember!
Diantha.trainerWins: A performance to remember, darling Steven!
Diantha.trainerLoses: A performance to forget, darling. We'll reshoot.

Steven.greeting: Flannery, Lavaridge's hot springs are lovely. Let's bring that heat.

Steven.trainerLoses: Too much heat, perhaps?

Steven.greeting: Flannery took me to Lavaridge's hot springs. My stones loved the minerals. Let's battle.
Steven.trainerWins: A victory as warm as Lavaridge's springs.
Steven.trainerLoses: The springs cooled off, and so did we.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Lavaridge's Leader. Stone and fire.
Steven.trainerWins: Stone and fire, forged into victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and fire, melted into defeat.

Flannery.greeting: Steven! Let's turn up the heat on these two!
Flannery.trainerWins: Turned up the heat! We won!

Flannery.greeting: Steven's so cool! Fire and steel! Let's forge a win in the heat!
Flannery.trainerWins: Forged in the heat, and we won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The forge cooled down too fast! Ugh!

Flannery.greeting: Steven, let's heat your steel until it glows!

Steven.greeting: Iris, the young Champion of Unova. Your energy is remarkable.
Steven.trainerWins: Super Champions indeed! Well done, Iris.
Steven.trainerLoses: Even super Champions lose sometimes.

Steven.trainerWins: Three dragon stones, one victory. Lucky!
Steven.trainerLoses: Three dragon stones, no luck today.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Unova's young Champion. Experience and energy.
Steven.trainerWins: Experience and energy, unbeatable together.
Steven.trainerLoses: Experience and energy, still not enough.

Iris.greeting: Steven! You're a Champion too? Let's be super Champions together!
Iris.trainerWins: Super Champions win! Yay!

Iris.greeting: Steven gave me dragon rocks! He's so nice! Let's win this for him!
Iris.trainerWins: We won it for Steven! Woohoo!
Iris.trainerLoses: Lost it for Steven... sorry! I'll keep the rocks safe!

Iris.greeting: Steven, let's be super Champions together!
Iris.trainerWins: Super Champions, super win!

Steven.greeting: Jasmine, your steel has a quiet strength. I appreciate that.
Steven.trainerWins: Quiet strength, polished victory.
Steven.trainerLoses: Quiet strength, quiet loss.

Steven.greeting: Jasmine's steel is polished with care. I can see the love in every scratch. Let's battle.
Steven.trainerWins: Polished with love, and victorious.
Steven.trainerLoses: Polished with love, and that's what matters.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Olivine's Leader. Two who love steel.
Steven.trainerWins: Two who love steel, and steel loved us back.
Steven.trainerLoses: Two who love steel, and steel let us down.

Jasmine.greeting: Steven... um, your steel is so polished. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We did our best... and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We did our best... and we lost.

Jasmine.greeting: Steven's steel is so shiny... I'll do my best to match it.

Jasmine.trainerLoses: I couldn't match it... I'm sorry, Steven.

Jasmine.greeting: Steven, let's shine together like Olivine's lighthouse.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We shone like the lighthouse!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The lighthouse dimmed... for now.

Steven.greeting: Juan, Sootopolis's master. Wallace speaks so highly of you.
Steven.trainerWins: Wallace's teacher, my partner. A fine win.
Steven.trainerLoses: Wallace will hear about this, I'm sure.

Steven.trainerLoses: Even the master has off days, it seems.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Sootopolis's former master. Stone and water.

Steven.trainerLoses: Stone and water, worn away together.

Juan.greeting: Steven. My former student has excellent taste in friends.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Steven! Wallace's dear friend! Let us create something dazzling!

Juan.greeting: Steven, let us show them Hoenn's elegance, stone and stream alike!

Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, Hoenn's elegance, dimmed for today!

Steven.greeting: Molayne, a fellow steel enthusiast from Alola. Let's see your steel shine.

Molayne.trainerWins: Charted and confirmed: a shining win!
Molayne.trainerLoses: The stars weren't aligned for us tonight.

Molayne.greeting: Steven, let's reach for the stars, and grab a win on the way.
Molayne.trainerWins: Reached the stars, and grabbed the win!

Steven.greeting: Norman, Petalburg's Gym Leader. Let's show them Hoenn's strength.
Steven.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, shown. Well done, Norman.
Steven.trainerLoses: Hoenn's strength faltered today.

Steven.greeting: Norman's children are both legends now. He must be proud. Let's make him prouder.

Steven.trainerLoses: Still proud, I hope, even after this.

Steven.greeting: Hoenn's Champion and Petalburg's Gym Leader. The strength of Hoenn, side by side.
Steven.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, proven together.
Steven.trainerLoses: Hoenn's strength, tested and found short.

Norman.greeting: Steven. A Champion beside me. I'll do my best.
