Morty.trainerWins: The story ended well. As I saw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The story ended sadly. I saw that too.

Morty.greeting: Shauntal, I'll see the ending. You write it.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw it, she wrote it. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw it, she wrote it. Defeat.

Shauntal.greeting: Roxie, a punk rocker! Your lyrics would make wonderful epigraphs!
Shauntal.trainerWins: An epigraph of victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: An epigraph of defeat!

Shauntal.greeting: Roxie wants lyrics from my novel for her next song! I'm so flattered! Let's battle!
Shauntal.trainerWins: A victory worthy of a song!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: A defeat worthy of a sad ballad!

Shauntal.greeting: Unova's ghost writer and Virbank's rock star! Gothic punk!
Shauntal.trainerWins: Gothic punk, topping the charts!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: Gothic punk, off the charts!

Roxie.greeting: Shauntal! Write me a song after this! A loud one!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loud song coming right up! We won!

Roxie.greeting: Shauntal writes the creepiest stories! Perfect for my band! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Creepy and victorious! Encore!

Roxie.greeting: Shauntal, write me a battle anthem!
Roxie.trainerWins: Battle anthem, nailed it!

Shauntal.greeting: Skyla, a pilot! The adventure novels practically write themselves!
Shauntal.trainerWins: An aerial battle scene, triumphant!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The aerial scene crashed!

Shauntal.greeting: Skyla took me on a flight for research! I screamed the whole time! Excellent material!
Shauntal.trainerWins: Excellent material, excellent victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: Excellent material, terrible landing!

Shauntal.greeting: Unova's ghost writer and Mistralton's pilot! Spirits of the sky!
Shauntal.trainerWins: Spirits of the sky, soaring to victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: Spirits of the sky, grounded!

Skyla.greeting: Shauntal! Let's give your book an aerial battle scene!
Skyla.trainerWins: Your book got its aerial victory!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Your book got an aerial crash!

Skyla.greeting: Shauntal screamed the whole flight! Let's give her a battle scene just as thrilling!
Shauntal, let's give your book an aerial dogfight!

Caitlin.greeting: Alder, our former Champion. Do try to be a little less... boisterous.
Alder woke me from a perfectly lovely nap to battle. He'd better make it worth it.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Worth waking up for, I'll admit.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Not worth waking up for. Goodnight.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and its wandering Champion. Elegance and wildness.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Caitlin! Woke up just for me, eh? Let's have some fun!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Fun AND a win!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Fun, but a loss!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Caitlin's always napping! Let's wake her up with an exciting battle!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! She's wide awake now!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Put her right back to sleep!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Caitlin, let's have some fun! Even you!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Even Caitlin had fun!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Caitlin's back to napping!

Caitlin.greeting: Anabel, a fellow lady of the Battle Frontier circuit. Shall we?
Anabel and I both grew up around Battle Frontiers. A lady of the circuit, like myself.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Two ladies of the circuit, victorious.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Two ladies of the circuit, outclassed.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and the Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Psychic grace.

Anabel.greeting: Caitlin. I sense such poise in you. Let's begin.
Caitlin's mind is calm, even when she's half asleep. I sense it.
Caitlin, let's read them gently.

Caitlin.greeting: Bianca, dear, please don't trip. It would wake me completely.
Caitlin.trainerWins: No trips. I stayed half asleep. Lovely.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: You tripped, didn't you? I'm wide awake now.

Caitlin.greeting: Bianca tripped over my gown at the gala. She apologized forty times. Charming, really.
Unova's Elite Four and Professor Juniper's assistant. Grace and gusto.

Bianca.greeting: Caitlin! I'll do my best! You look so elegant!
Bianca.trainerWins: Elegant AND victorious!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Not elegant. Not victorious.

Bianca.greeting: Caitlin's so elegant! I'll be super careful not to trip near her! Let's go!
Bianca.trainerWins: I didn't trip! We won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I tripped... on her gown again! Sorry!

Bianca.greeting: Caitlin, teach me to be elegant! After we win!
Bianca.trainerWins: We won! Elegance lessons now!
Bianca.trainerLoses: We lost... still want lessons!

Caitlin.greeting: Brycen, a former star of the screen. How refined.
Brycen's films were rather dramatic. I watched one. It woke me up.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A victory as dramatic as his films.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A defeat as dramatic as his films.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Icirrus's star. Elegance and frost.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Elegance and frost, a refined victory.

Brycen.greeting: Caitlin. Your elegance is cinematic. Let's begin.
Caitlin's elegance belongs on the silver screen. Let's give her a scene. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A scene fit for the screen. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: A scene for the cutting room floor. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Caitlin, let's give them a cinematic finale. Hm!

Caitlin.greeting: Burgh, your art is lovely, but do keep the paint off my dress.
Caitlin.trainerWins: My dress survived, and so did our win.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Paint on my dress, and a loss. How tiresome.

Caitlin.greeting: Burgh asked to paint my portrait. I agreed, provided I may sleep during the sitting.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A portrait of a victorious lady.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A portrait of a sleepy, defeated lady.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Castelia's artist. Elegance on canvas.

Burgh.greeting: Caitlin! You're a portrait waiting to happen! Let's battle beautifully!
Burgh.trainerWins: A beautiful portrait of victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The portrait smudged!

Burgh.greeting: Caitlin is a portrait waiting to happen! Let's paint a victory around her!
Burgh.trainerWins: The portrait is complete, and triumphant!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The portrait got smudged!

Burgh.greeting: Caitlin, hold still! I'm painting victory!
Burgh.trainerWins: Painted! Victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Painted... defeat!

Caitlin.greeting: Cheren, a serious young teacher. How admirable.
Cheren lectured me on the importance of punctuality. I arrived after my nap. Let's battle.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Late, but victorious. Punctuality is overrated.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Late, and defeated. Perhaps he had a point.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Aspertia's teacher. Elegance and diligence.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Elegance and diligence, a fine result.

Cheren.greeting: Caitlin. I'll follow your lead. Elegantly, if I can.
Cheren.trainerWins: Elegantly done. We won.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Not elegant enough.

Cheren.greeting: Caitlin naps between battles. I've noted it's when she's at her sharpest. Let's begin.
Cheren.trainerWins: Well rested, sharp, victorious. As noted.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Well rested, but outmatched. Revising my notes.

Cheren.greeting: Caitlin, today's lesson: stay awake until the final turn.
Cheren.trainerWins: She stayed awake. Lesson passed.
Cheren.trainerLoses: She dozed off at the end. Lesson failed.

Caitlin.greeting: Chili, your fiery temper is rather loud. I was napping.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Wide awake for a loss. Lovely.

Caitlin.greeting: Chili's shouting woke me from a lovely dream. He'll battle to make up for it.
Caitlin.trainerWins: He made up for it. I forgive him.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: He didn't make up for it. I'm going back to sleep.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Striaton's hothead. Poise and fire.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Poise and fire, a lovely blaze.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Poise and fire, both snuffed out.

Chili.greeting: Caitlin! Sorry! But you'll be wide awake after this battle!
Chili.trainerWins: Told you you'd be awake! We won!
Chili.trainerLoses: You're awake now... and we lost!

Chili.greeting: Caitlin's so calm! I'll be calm too! ...Nope! Let's burn it up!
Caitlin, I'll heat things up so you stay awake!
Chili.trainerWins: Heated up, and she stayed awake!
Chili.trainerLoses: Heated up... and she still dozed off!

Caitlin.greeting: Cilan, a connoisseur. I appreciate refined tastes.
Cilan brewed me a tea so fine I stayed awake through an entire afternoon. Remarkable.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A victory as fine as that tea.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A defeat as bitter as cold tea.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Striaton's connoisseur. Refinement served warm.

Cilan.greeting: Caitlin! Your elegance has a rich, sophisticated bouquet!
Caitlin's elegance has the delicate notes of a rare blossom tea! It's evaluation time!
Caitlin, let's serve this battle with the elegance of afternoon tea!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Afternoon tea... spilled on the tablecloth!

Caitlin.greeting: Clay, your manners could use some polish. But your strength is real.
Clay tracked mud into my castle's ballroom. I'll forgive him if we win.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Not forgiven. And now my ballroom's muddy.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Driftveil's miner. Silk and stone.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Silk and stone, torn and crumbled.

Clay.greeting: Caitlin, eh? Fancy lady, strong mind. Let's get to it.
Clay.trainerWins: Fancy and strong, and victorious.
Clay.trainerLoses: Fancy and strong, and beaten.

Clay.greeting: Caitlin's fancy, but she's tough. Respect. Let's dig in.
Clay.trainerWins: Fancy and tough! Won it!
Clay.trainerLoses: Fancy, tough, and still lost! Hmph!

Clay.greeting: Caitlin, I'll dig, you float. Sound good?
Clay.trainerWins: Dug and floated! Victory!
Clay.trainerLoses: Dug a hole, she floated over it... we lost!

Caitlin.greeting: Colress, your experiments are fascinating, if a bit unsettling.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Fascinating and victorious. Not unsettling at all.

Caitlin.greeting: Colress wants to measure my psychic waves while I sleep. I said only if we win.
Caitlin.trainerWins: We won. You may measure my nap, Colress.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: We lost. No measurements, and no nap.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and its scientist. Elegance and experiment.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Elegance and experiment, a lovely result.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Elegance and experiment, a failed trial.

Colress.greeting: Caitlin. Your psychic abilities would make an excellent study. Later.
Colress.trainerWins: An excellent study for later. A win now.
Colress.trainerLoses: The study waits. The loss doesn't.

Colress.greeting: Caitlin's psychic power peaks after rest. A fascinating pattern. Let's test it.
Colress.trainerLoses: Pattern broken. She needed a longer nap.

Colress.greeting: Caitlin, let's push your psychic power to its limit.

Caitlin.greeting: Cress, a gentleman of water. How refreshing.
Cress pours tea with perfect posture. A gentleman of the old school. Let's battle.
Unova's Elite Four and Striaton's composed one. A refined pairing.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A refined pairing, a refined victory.

Cress.greeting: Caitlin. Your poise matches my own. Let's begin.
Caitlin's poise is exemplary. I'll match it, step for step.
Cress.trainerWins: Matched step for step, and victorious.
Cress.trainerLoses: Matched step for step, into defeat.

Cress.greeting: Caitlin, shall we show them true composure?

Caitlin.greeting: Cynthia. I spent my youth at Sinnoh's Battle Frontier. It's an honor to battle beside its Champion.
Caitlin.trainerWins: An honor, Champion. And a victory.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Defeated beside a Champion. Still a privilege.

Caitlin.greeting: Cynthia visited the Battle Frontier when I was a girl. I fell asleep watching her. Out of comfort, truly.
Unova's Elite Four and Sinnoh's Champion. Undella's summer neighbors.

Cynthia.greeting: Caitlin. I summer in Undella Town, so we're nearly neighbors in Unova too. Shall we?
Cynthia.trainerWins: Nearly neighbors, and fully victorious.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Nearly neighbors, and both beaten.

Cynthia.greeting: Caitlin's grown into such a graceful Trainer. Let's battle as two ladies of Sinnoh's past.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Two ladies of Sinnoh's past, victorious today.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Two ladies of Sinnoh's past, humbled today.

Cynthia.greeting: Caitlin, stay awake for me. I'll make it worth it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: She stayed awake, and it was worth it.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: She dozed off. We'll try again.

Caitlin.greeting: Dexio, a student of psychic power. Let's see what you've learned.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: More to learn, dear. As always.

Caitlin.greeting: Dexio asked to observe my psychic training. He took twelve pages of notes during my nap.
Unova's Elite Four and Kalos's researcher. Mastery and study.

Dexio.greeting: Caitlin! I've studied your techniques! It's an honor!
Caitlin's psychic technique is effortless, even half asleep! I'll study it closely!
Caitlin, let's analyze their psychic patterns together!

Caitlin.greeting: Drayden, Opelucid's dignified mayor. A pleasure.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A pleasant battle, and a fine result.

Caitlin.greeting: Drayden is the only mayor who's never woken me with a speech. I like him. Let's battle.
Unova's Elite Four and Opelucid's mayor. Elegance and authority.

Drayden.greeting: Caitlin. Dignity and strength. Let us show them both.
Drayden.trainerWins: Dignity and strength, both shown.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Dignity remains. Strength faltered.

Drayden.greeting: Caitlin carries herself with the dignity of royalty. Let us battle with that dignity.
Drayden.trainerWins: Dignity preserved, victory earned.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Dignity preserved, despite defeat.

Drayden.greeting: Caitlin, your mind and my dragons. Let us begin.
Drayden.trainerWins: Her mind guided my dragons true. Victory.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Her mind and my dragons, both outthought today.

Caitlin.greeting: Elesa, a model. Your poise on the runway is quite something.
Elesa asked me to walk her runway. I declined. I'd fall asleep mid-stride.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A victory worthy of the runway.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A defeat worthy of a nap.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Nimbasa's star. Elegance and electricity.

Elesa.greeting: Caitlin! You're so graceful! Let's make this battle sparkle!
Elesa.trainerWins: Graceful and sparkling! We won!

Elesa.greeting: Caitlin's so graceful! She'd be a natural on the runway! Let's sparkle!
Elesa.trainerWins: Sparkled together! Victory!

Elesa.greeting: Caitlin, let's make this battle a fashion show!
Elesa.trainerWins: A fashion show victory!

Caitlin.greeting: Grimsley, my colleague. Please don't gamble with our victory.
Caitlin.trainerWins: You didn't gamble it away. Good.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: You gambled it away, didn't you?

Caitlin.greeting: Grimsley bet I'd fall asleep before the battle. I didn't. He owes me tea.
Caitlin.trainerWins: He owes me tea, and we won. Lovely.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: He owes me tea, and we lost. Less lovely.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four, psychic and dark. Elegance and risk.

Grimsley.greeting: Caitlin. The odds are always in our favor when you're awake.
Grimsley.trainerWins: I was awake, and so were the odds.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even awake, the odds turned.

Grimsley.greeting: Caitlin awake is a sure bet. Caitlin asleep is a gamble. Let's hope for the former.
Grimsley.trainerWins: She stayed awake. The bet paid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: She dozed off. The bet failed.

Grimsley.greeting: Caitlin, let's play our cards with grace.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Played with grace, won with style.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Played with grace, lost with dignity.

Caitlin.greeting: Iris, our young Champion. Do try to sit still.
Caitlin.trainerWins: You sat still, and we won. Good.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: You didn't sit still, dear. Neither did our chances.

Caitlin.greeting: Iris asked me to teach her elegance. She fell asleep during lesson one. A promising start.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A promising student, a fine victory.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A promising student, a learning experience.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and its young Champion. Grace and energy.

Iris.greeting: Caitlin! You're so pretty! Can you teach me to be elegant after this?
Iris.trainerWins: Teach me elegance now! We won!

Iris.greeting: Caitlin's like a princess! I wanna be elegant like her! But also super strong!
Iris.trainerWins: Elegant AND strong! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: Neither elegant nor strong... we lost!

Iris.greeting: Caitlin, let's be elegant dragon princesses!
Iris.trainerWins: Elegant dragon princesses win!

Caitlin.greeting: Lenora, your museum must hold many treasures. Shall we add a victory?
Lenora gave me a private museum tour. I napped in the royal portrait gallery. Very fitting.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A victory fit for the royal gallery.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A defeat for the museum's basement.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Nacrene's museum. Elegance and heritage.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Elegance and heritage, preserved in victory.

Lenora.greeting: Caitlin. Your elegance belongs in a gallery. Let's begin.
Lenora.trainerWins: Gallery-worthy! History made!
Lenora.trainerLoses: A gallery of defeat.

Lenora.greeting: Caitlin belongs in a gallery herself! Let's make some history worthy of her!
Lenora.trainerWins: History made, with royal flair!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History made... with a royal stumble!

Lenora.greeting: Caitlin, let's create a moment for the history books!
Lenora.trainerWins: A moment for the history books!
Lenora.trainerLoses: A moment best left out of the books!

Caitlin.greeting: Marlon, you're very... relaxed. Please, focus.
Caitlin.trainerWins: You focused, and we won. Remarkable.

Caitlin.greeting: Marlon is so relaxed, he makes me look energetic. A first. Let's battle.
Unova's Elite Four and Humilau's surfer. Calm and calmer.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Calm and calmer, a serene victory.

Marlon.greeting: Caitlin, dude! You're even chiller than me! Let's go!
Marlon.trainerWins: Chill AND winning, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Too chill, dude. We lost.

Marlon.greeting: Caitlin's even chiller than me, dude! That's impressive! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Chill and victorious, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Too chill, man! We lost!

Marlon.greeting: Caitlin, let's ride this battle nice and easy!
Marlon.trainerWins: Nice and easy victory!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Too easy... for them!

Caitlin.greeting: Marshal, my stoic colleague. Let's be efficient.
Marshal and I sat through an entire Elite Four meeting without speaking. Bliss. Let's battle.
Unova's Elite Four, mind and fist. Grace and discipline.

Marshal.greeting: Caitlin. Efficiency suits us both. Begin.
Caitlin. Efficient. Quiet. Good partner.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Efficient defeat. Still no wasted words.

Marshal.greeting: Caitlin. Stay awake. Strike true.
Marshal.trainerWins: She stayed awake. She struck true.
Marshal.trainerLoses: She stayed awake. It was not enough.

Caitlin.greeting: Roxie, please lower your volume. Some of us were sleeping.
Caitlin.trainerWins: You lowered your volume, and we won.

Caitlin.greeting: Roxie's band played outside my castle window at dawn. I've never been so awake. Let's battle.
Unova's Elite Four and Virbank's rock star. Silence and noise.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Silence and noise, a surprising harmony.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Silence and noise, a dreadful discord.

Roxie.greeting: Caitlin! Wake up! It's time to rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Woke you up AND rocked!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Woke you up for a loss. Sorry!

Roxie.greeting: Caitlin needs to wake up! My music will do it! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: She's awake AND we won! Rock on!
Roxie.trainerLoses: She's awake... and we still lost!

Roxie.greeting: Caitlin, let's make this battle LOUD!
Roxie.trainerWins: LOUD and victorious! Caitlin's wide awake!
Roxie.trainerLoses: LOUD and defeated! Sorry, Caitlin's ears!

Caitlin.greeting: Sabrina, a fellow psychic. Our minds should align nicely.
Sabrina knew I'd be late before I did. She waited patiently. Let's battle.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: She foresaw the defeat too, I suspect.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Saffron's Gym. Psychic grace.

Sabrina.greeting: Caitlin. I foresaw your elegance. Let's begin.
Caitlin's mind is calm, even in sleep. I see our victory in her dreams.
Caitlin, follow my visions.

Caitlin.greeting: Skyla, your adventurous spirit is charming.
Skyla offered to fly me to the Battle Tree. I slept the entire flight. Very smooth.
Caitlin.trainerWins: A smooth flight, a smooth victory.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: A smooth flight, a rough landing.

Caitlin.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Mistralton's pilot. Grace and altitude.

Skyla.greeting: Caitlin! You're like a princess! Let's soar to victory!
Caitlin slept the whole flight! She's so calm! Let's soar to victory!
Skyla.trainerWins: Soared to victory! She's awake now!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Crashed... and she slept through it!

Skyla.greeting: Caitlin, let's fly high like royalty!

Marshal.greeting: Master! It is an honor to battle beside you. I will not disappoint.
Marshal.trainerWins: I did not disappoint you, Master.
Marshal.trainerLoses: I have disappointed you, Master. I will train harder.

Marshal.greeting: Master Alder taught me strength comes from bonds. Today, I'll show him I listened.
Marshal.trainerLoses: I listened, Master. Not enough yet.

Marshal.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and its former Champion. Master and student.

Alder.greeting: Marshal, my student! Ha ha! Show me how much you've grown!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! You've grown, Marshal! I'm proud!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Even I lose sometimes, Marshal!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Marshal's my best student! Let's show 'em how Unova fights!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! That's my student!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Still my best student!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Marshal, let your fists do the talking!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Fists said plenty!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Fists said too little!

Marshal.greeting: Bianca. Stay behind me. I will protect you.
Marshal.trainerLoses: I could not protect you. Forgive me.

Marshal.greeting: Bianca brought me a homemade lunch. It was burnt. I ate all of it. Let us begin.
Unova's Elite Four and Professor Juniper's assistant. Strength and heart.

Bianca.greeting: Marshal! You're so strong! I'll try my best too!
Bianca.trainerWins: Marshal kept me safe AND we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Marshal kept me safe... but we lost!

Bianca.greeting: Marshal ate my whole lunch even though it was burnt! He's so nice! Let's win for him!
Bianca.trainerWins: Won it for Marshal!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Lost it for Marshal... sorry!

Bianca.greeting: Marshal, I'll stay behind you! You protect, I'll cheer!
Bianca.trainerWins: Protected and cheered! Victory!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Protected and cheered... we lost!

Marshal.greeting: Brawly. A fighter who rides the waves. Your balance must be strong.
Brawly trains on the waves. I train under waterfalls. Water forges fighters.
Unova's Elite Four and Dewford's surfer. Discipline and flow.

Brawly.greeting: Marshal! Surfing's the best training! Let's crash this battle!
Marshal's so focused! Like a pro surfer waiting for the perfect wave! Let's ride!
Marshal, let's crash into them like a monster wave!

Marshal.greeting: Brycen. Your discipline is evident. Let us begin.
Brycen trains in the cold. As do I. Cold sharpens the mind.
Unova's Elite Four and Icirrus's Gym. Fists and frost.

Brycen.greeting: Marshal. Cold focus and strong fists. A good pairing.
Brycen.trainerWins: Cold focus, strong fists, a fine win.

Brycen.greeting: Marshal's discipline rivals any stunt man's. Unova's coldest fighters. Hm!
Marshal, strike through the ice. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: His fist went clean through the ice. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: His fist bounced off the ice. Hm.

Marshal.greeting: Burgh. Your art requires discipline, as does battle.
Burgh asked me to pose for a painting. I stood still for six hours. He was impressed.
Marshal.trainerWins: Six hours of stillness, one moment of victory.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Six hours of stillness, one moment of defeat.

Marshal.greeting: Unova's Elite Four and Castelia's painter. Discipline and art.

Burgh.greeting: Marshal! You're so stoic! Like a statue! Let's win!
Burgh.trainerWins: The stoic statue wins!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The statue crumbled!

Iris.trainerWins: A metal victory! Roxie, I'll buy you a new drum!
Iris.trainerLoses: A metal defeat! I'll still buy you a new drum!

Iris.greeting: Unova's Champion and Virbank's rock star! Dragons and drums!
Iris.trainerWins: Dragons and drums, the loudest victory ever!

Roxie.greeting: Iris! The Champion's a total rock star! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: The Champion shreds! What a show!

Roxie.greeting: Iris broke my drum! Total rock star move! Let's rock this battle!
Roxie.trainerWins: Rocked it harder than a broken drum!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Rocked and rolled... right off the stage!

Roxie.greeting: Iris, let's make this battle LOUD!
Roxie.trainerWins: So loud the whole tree shook! Victory!
Roxie.trainerLoses: So loud... and we still lost!

Iris.greeting: Skyla! Race you to the sky! My dragons are super fast!
Iris.trainerWins: Told you my dragons are fast! We won!

Iris.greeting: Skyla and I raced to Mistralton! My dragon won! She says it was a tie! Let's battle!
Iris.trainerWins: No tie this time! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: A tie again... except we lost!

Iris.greeting: Unova's Champion and Mistralton's pilot! Dragons and birds!
Iris.trainerWins: Dragons and birds, ruling every inch of sky!

Skyla.greeting: Iris! Your dragons and my birds! Let's soar!
Iris's dragons are so fast! But my birds are faster! Let's see!
Skyla.trainerWins: Fast dragons, faster birds, fastest win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Fast dragons, faster birds... still too slow!

Skyla.greeting: Iris, race you to victory!
Skyla.trainerWins: Photo finish, and we both won!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Photo finish, and we both lost!

Malva.greeting: Blaine, I'd interview you, but I suspect you'd answer in riddles.
Malva.trainerWins: Hot off the press: we won. Spare me the riddle.
Malva.trainerLoses: The headline writes itself: "Fire Masters Fizzle."

Malva.greeting: Blaine answered my interview questions with riddles. I printed them anyway. Readers loved it.
Malva.trainerWins: Riddles and a victory. Good copy.
Malva.trainerLoses: Riddles and a defeat. Still good copy.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Cinnabar's volcano. Fire of two regions.
Malva.trainerWins: Fire of two regions, scorching headlines.

Blaine.greeting: Malva! Quiz for the reporter: what's hotter than breaking news? My volcano! Hah!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz answer: our victory! Hotter than any headline!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Quiz: what melted today? Our chances!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Malva, quiz for the reporter: what headline do we get today?
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! "Fire Duo Wins!" Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! "Fire Duo Loses!" Incorrect!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Malva, let's give the cameras a volcanic eruption!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Volcanic eruption, on camera!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Volcanic fizzle, on camera!

Malva.greeting: Chili, a hothead from Unova. Try not to embarrass us on camera.
Malva.trainerWins: You didn't embarrass us. I'm almost impressed.
Malva.trainerLoses: You embarrassed us on camera. Lovely.

Malva.greeting: Chili asked if he'd be on the news. Only if he wins. Motivation, darling.
Malva.trainerLoses: He's on the news. Defeated. Unfortunate.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Striaton's hothead. Fire and fury.
Malva.trainerWins: Fire and fury, broadcast live to all of Kalos.
Malva.trainerLoses: Fire and fury, cut off the air mid-segment.

Chili.greeting: Malva! A fire master on TV! Let's make the headlines sizzle!
Malva says I'll be on TV if we win! I gotta win!
Chili.trainerLoses: We lost... I'm still on TV?!

Chili.greeting: Malva, let's make the headlines sizzle!

Malva.greeting: Dexio. Sycamore's assistant. Do try to keep up.
Malva.trainerLoses: You didn't keep up, and neither did I.

Malva.greeting: Dexio asked for an interview for Professor Sycamore's newsletter. I declined. Then I battled with him.
Kalos's Elite Four and Sycamore's assistant. Fire and focus.

Dexio.greeting: Malva. Your fire is formidable. I'll support you however I can.
Dexio.trainerWins: Your fire carried us, Malva! Thank you!
Dexio.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Malva. My support fell short.

Dexio.greeting: Malva's fire is formidable. I'll support her however I can.
Malva, I'll analyze. You incinerate.

Malva.greeting: Diantha. Kalos's darling Champion. Let's give the cameras a show.
Malva.trainerWins: The cameras got their show. And their winner.
Malva.trainerLoses: The cameras got a show, just not the one I wanted.

Malva.greeting: Diantha's face is on every billboard in Lumiose. Let's see if she battles as well as she poses.
Malva.trainerLoses: She poses better than she battles today.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and its Champion. Fire and fame.
Malva.trainerWins: Fire and fame, a blazing headline.

Diantha.greeting: Malva, you always know how to make the headlines. Shall we write tonight's?
Diantha.trainerWins: Tonight's headline: a win! Beautifully written, Malva.
Diantha.trainerLoses: Tonight's headline needs a rewrite, Malva.

Diantha.greeting: Malva always knows how to make headlines. Shall we write tonight's together?
Malva, let's give the cameras a show!

Malva.greeting: Drasna, so sweet and so terrifying. My favorite kind of colleague.
Drasna baked cookies for the Elite Four again. They were terrifyingly good. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four, fire and dragons. A deadly duo.

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Malva! The Kalos Elite Four together! How lovely!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my! The Elite Four of Kalos triumphs!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh dear! Even the Kalos Elite Four can lose!

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Malva! You're always so serious! Let's have a lovely battle!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, Malva almost smiled! Victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, Malva's frowning harder now!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Malva, let's show them how we do things in Kalos!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, Kalos style! Victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, Kalos style... defeat!

Malva.greeting: Flannery, Lavaridge's little flame. Let's see if you can keep up with me.
Malva.trainerWins: You kept up, little flame. Barely.
Malva.trainerLoses: You burned out. So did I.

Malva.greeting: Flannery asked me for advice on fire. I told her: burn hotter. She took it literally.
Malva.trainerLoses: She burned hotter, then burned out. Typical.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Lavaridge's Gym. Fire, refined and raw.
Malva.trainerWins: Refined and raw, a blazing win.

Flannery.greeting: Malva! A fire master from Kalos! I'll burn just as bright, you'll see!
Flannery.trainerWins: I burned just as bright! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I burned out first... sorry, Malva!

Flannery.greeting: Malva told me to burn hotter! I'm burning SO hot! Let's go!
Malva, let's make this battle an inferno!
Flannery.trainerWins: A total inferno! Did you see, Malva?!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The inferno fizzled! Don't look at me like that, Malva!

Malva.greeting: Kiawe, a fire dancer. Very telegenic. Don't let it go to your head.
Malva.trainerWins: Telegenic AND effective. Don't let it go to your head.
Malva.trainerLoses: Telegenic, but beaten. Don't let that go to your head either.

Malva.greeting: Kiawe's fire dance went viral on the Holo Caster. I may have posted it. Let's battle.
Malva.trainerWins: Viral, and now victorious. Good content.
Malva.trainerLoses: Viral, and now defeated. Still good content.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Wela Volcano's Captain. Fire on two islands.
Malva.trainerWins: Fire on two islands, a wildfire win.
Malva.trainerLoses: Fire on two islands, put out.

Kiawe.greeting: Malva. Your flames are fierce. Let our fire dance together.
Malva's flames are fierce! Let our fire dance together!
Malva, follow the rhythm of the flames!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Malva found the rhythm! Akala salutes her!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Malva refused the rhythm! Of course she did!

Malva.greeting: Siebold, my colleague. Try to battle, not just cook.
Malva.trainerWins: You battled. You didn't cook. Well done.
Malva.trainerLoses: Did you stop to cook mid-battle? We lost.

Malva.greeting: Siebold brought a soufflé to the battle. A soufflé. Let's get this over with before it falls.
Malva.trainerWins: The soufflé held, and so did we.
Malva.trainerLoses: The soufflé fell, and so did we.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four, fire and water. Steam, darling.

Siebold.greeting: Malva. Fire and water, like a well-seasoned broth. Let us begin.
Malva's fire and my water. Like a perfect steamed dish. Let us begin.
Malva, let us compose a balanced battle.
Siebold.trainerWins: Fire and water, balanced like a fine broth.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Too much fire, not enough water. Ruined.

Malva.greeting: Sina. Ice beside my fire. How... ironic.
Malva.trainerWins: My fire, your ice. A win, ironically.

Malva.greeting: Sina's ice melted the second she stood next to me. Not my fault. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four and Sycamore's assistant. Fire and ice. Ironic.

Sina.greeting: Malva! Don't melt my ice, okay? We're on the same team!
Sina.trainerWins: I didn't melt! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: I melted... and we lost!

Sina.greeting: Malva, don't melt my ice! We're on the same team!
Sina.trainerWins: Ice survived! Victory!
Sina.trainerLoses: Ice melted! Defeat!

Sina.greeting: Malva, let's make hot and cold work together!
Sina.trainerWins: Hot and cold, victorious!
Sina.trainerLoses: Hot and cold... lukewarm!

Malva.greeting: Wikstrom, please stop bowing to the camera. It isn't even on.
Malva.trainerLoses: Bow all you like. We still lost.

Malva.greeting: Wikstrom bowed to the camera again. It wasn't on. It's never on. Let's battle.
Malva.trainerWins: Victory. And the camera was on this time.
Malva.trainerLoses: Defeat. Thankfully, the camera was off.

Malva.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four, fire and steel. A forge.

Wikstrom.greeting: Malva! A knight's honor to battle beside you! Even off camera!
Wikstrom.trainerWins: For honor, and for victory! Even off camera!
Wikstrom.trainerLoses: Honor intact, Malva! Victory, not so much!

Wikstrom.greeting: Lady Malva! A knight's honor to battle beside you! Camera or no camera!
Lady Malva, let us charge as one!

Siebold.greeting: Chili, a chef of fire. Your passion is a spice all its own.
Siebold.trainerWins: Your passion proved a fine spice.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Too much spice spoils the dish, Chili.

Siebold.greeting: Chili's kitchen is chaos. Mine is order. Today, let's combine them.
Siebold.trainerWins: Chaos and order, a balanced victory.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Chaos and order, a kitchen disaster.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Striaton's chef. Two kitchens, one battle.
Siebold.trainerWins: Two kitchens, one feast of victory.

Chili.greeting: Siebold! A real chef from Kalos! Let's cook up something spicy!
Siebold's a real chef from Kalos! Let's cook up something spicy!
Chili.trainerWins: Spicy enough for a Kalos chef! Victory!
Chili.trainerLoses: Too spicy even for a Kalos chef!

Chili.greeting: Siebold, let's turn up the heat!
Chili.trainerWins: Turned up the heat, and the dish came out perfect!
Chili.trainerLoses: Turned up the heat... and burned the whole meal!

Siebold.greeting: Cilan, a connoisseur. Your palate must be exquisite.
Siebold.trainerLoses: The flavors did not come together, Cilan.

Siebold.greeting: Cilan and I debated the perfect broth temperature for three hours. We agreed on nothing. Let's battle.
Siebold.trainerWins: We agree on one thing now: victory.
Siebold.trainerLoses: We agree on one more thing: defeat.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Striaton's connoisseur. Two palates, one plate.

Cilan.greeting: Siebold! This battle has the aroma of a Kalosian feast! Let's begin!
Cilan.trainerWins: A Kalosian feast of victory! It's delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The feast went cold before we could taste victory!

Cilan.greeting: Siebold's cuisine is an art form! Battling beside him is like cooking in a master's kitchen! It's evaluation time!
Siebold, let's create a battle with the perfect balance of flavors!

Siebold.greeting: Crasher Wake, your water is wild. Mine is refined. Together, a balanced dish.
Siebold.trainerWins: Wild and refined. A balanced dish indeed.
Siebold.trainerLoses: The balance tipped. A spoiled dish.

Siebold.greeting: Crasher Wake splashed my entire mise en place across the kitchen. He'll repay me with a win.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Not repaid. And my kitchen is still wet.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Pastoria's wrestler. Refined water and raw water.
Siebold.trainerWins: Refined and raw, a balanced dish.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Refined and raw, a soggy mess.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahah! Siebold! Let's make a splash so big it fills a soup pot!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahah! A soup pot full of victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! The soup pot spilled over!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Sorry about the kitchen, Siebold! The Crasher Wake will cook up a win instead!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! A win, served piping hot!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The win got splashed too!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Siebold, let's make a splash so big it fills a soup pot!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The soup pot overflows with victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The soup pot tipped over!

Siebold.greeting: Cress, a fellow master of water and service. How elegant.
Cress serves tea with the precision of a fine kitchen. A fellow artisan. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four and Striaton's composed one. Water and service.

Cress.greeting: Siebold. Your cuisine is legendary. Let's serve them a defeat.
Siebold's cuisine is legendary in Kalos. I'm honored to serve beside him.
Cress.trainerWins: Served beside a legend, and victorious.
Cress.trainerLoses: Served beside a legend, yet defeated.

Cress.greeting: Siebold, let us serve them a refined defeat.

Siebold.greeting: Dexio. Professor Sycamore's assistant. I trust you're well fed.
Dexio ate at my restaurant and asked for the recipe. I declined. I will battle with him, though.
Siebold.trainerWins: Victory, and the recipe stays secret.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Defeat, and the recipe still stays secret.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and Sycamore's assistant. Cuisine and research.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Cuisine and research, a failed recipe.

Dexio.greeting: Siebold! I've eaten at your restaurant! It was incredible!
Dexio.trainerWins: I'll celebrate at your restaurant, Siebold!
Dexio.trainerLoses: I'll drown my sorrows in your cooking, Siebold!

Dexio.greeting: Siebold's restaurant was incredible! I'd battle beside him just to eat there again!
Siebold, let's analyze them like a recipe!

Siebold.greeting: Diantha, our Champion. Let us create a masterpiece.
Diantha dined at my restaurant before her premiere. She said the meal outshone the film. High praise.
Siebold.trainerWins: A victory to outshine any film.
Siebold.trainerLoses: A defeat to rival a bad review.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's Elite Four and its Champion. Cuisine and cinema.
Siebold.trainerWins: Cuisine and cinema, a five-star review.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Cuisine and cinema, panned by critics.

Diantha.greeting: Siebold, your cooking and battling are both works of art. Shall we?
Diantha.trainerWins: Art in every move, Siebold. We won.
Diantha.trainerLoses: The art was a little lopsided today, Siebold.

Diantha.greeting: Siebold's cooking and battling are both works of art! Shall we, darling?
Siebold, let's give them a performance as exquisite as your cuisine!

Siebold.greeting: Drasna, your kindness is like a warm soup. Let's begin.
Siebold.trainerWins: Warm as soup. And as satisfying.

Siebold.greeting: Drasna asks for my recipes and then bakes them better than I do. I forgive her. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four, water and dragons. A seasoned pairing.

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Siebold! I've missed your cooking! Let's win so you can make dinner!
Drasna.trainerWins: We won! Dinner time, Siebold!
Drasna.trainerLoses: We lost... still making dinner, Siebold?

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Siebold's soufflé rose higher than my dragons can fly! Let's win so he bakes another!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, another soufflé for the winners!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, the soufflé fell, and so did we!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Siebold, let's cook up a lovely victory together!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, a lovely dish of victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, the dish fell flat!

Siebold.greeting: Juan, an artist of water. I am honored.
Juan and I discussed the art of presentation for an entire evening. Let us present a victory.
Kalos's Elite Four and Sootopolis's former master. Water as art.

Juan.greeting: Siebold. A fellow artist. Let us make this battle a masterpiece.
Juan.trainerWins: A fellow artist. A fine composition.
Juan.trainerLoses: The composition was not to my taste.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Siebold! A fellow artist! Let us make this battle a masterpiece!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a masterpiece of water and taste!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the masterpiece was spoiled!

Juan.greeting: Siebold, let us paint and plate this battle with water!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, painted and plated to perfection!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, spilled on the canvas!

Siebold.greeting: Mallow, a young chef of Alola. Tell me, what is your specialty?
Siebold.trainerWins: A young chef with real skill. Victory.
Siebold.trainerLoses: A young chef learns from burnt dishes too.

Siebold.greeting: Mallow showed me her signature Alolan dish. Bold. Vivid. Promising. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four and the Lush Jungle's Captain. Refinement meets the wild.
Siebold.trainerWins: Refinement and wildness, a delicious victory.
Siebold.trainerLoses: Refinement and wildness, an inedible defeat.

Mallow.greeting: Siebold! A famous chef! Let's win, then cook together, okay?
Mallow.trainerWins: We won! Now let's cook together!
Mallow.trainerLoses: We lost... but let's still cook together!

Mallow.greeting: Siebold's a famous chef! Let's win, then cook together, okay?
Mallow.trainerWins: We won! Cooking time with Siebold!
Mallow.trainerLoses: We lost... still cooking together, right?

Mallow.greeting: Siebold, let's cook up a feast of victory!

Siebold.greeting: Marlon, your energy is like a fresh catch of the day.
Siebold.trainerWins: Fresh as the day's catch, Marlon.

Siebold.greeting: Marlon brought me a fish he caught himself. Fresh. I cooked it on the spot. Let's battle.
Kalos's Elite Four and Humilau's surfer. Refined water and wild surf.
Siebold.trainerWins: Refined and wild, a balanced victory.

Marlon.greeting: Siebold, dude! A chef who battles! Let's cook 'em!
Marlon.trainerWins: Cooked 'em, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: We got cooked, dude!

Marlon.greeting: Siebold cooked my fish into something amazing, dude! Let's cook up a win!
Marlon.trainerWins: Cooked up a win, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Overcooked it, man!

Marlon.greeting: Siebold, let's serve 'em a seafood surprise, dude!
Marlon.trainerWins: Seafood surprise served! Victory!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Seafood surprise... sent back!

Siebold.greeting: Misty, Cerulean's water master. Let us make waves together.
Siebold.trainerWins: Waves made. Dinner is on me.
Siebold.trainerLoses: The waves went flat. Dinner is still on me.

Siebold.greeting: Misty asked what water I cook with. Spring water from the Kalos mountains. She was impressed.
Kalos's Elite Four and Cerulean's Gym. Two masters of water.

Misty.greeting: Siebold! A water master who cooks! Let's win and grab dinner!
Misty.trainerWins: We won! You're cooking, right?
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost... can we still grab dinner?

Misty.greeting: Siebold's a water master who cooks! Let's win and grab dinner!
Misty.trainerWins: We won! Siebold's cooking tonight!
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost... but Siebold's still cooking, right?

Misty.greeting: Siebold, let's make a splash worthy of a five-star restaurant!
Misty.trainerWins: A five-star splash!
Misty.trainerLoses: A one-star belly flop!

Siebold.greeting: Sina. Ice and water, like a chilled consommé. Refreshing.
Sina asked me to make her shave ice. I made her a chilled consommé. She was confused but polite.
Kalos's Elite Four and Sycamore's assistant. Water and ice. A chilled course.

Sina.greeting: Siebold! Can you make me some shave ice after this? Please?
Sina.trainerWins: Shave ice time! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: We lost... I still want shave ice, though!

Sina.greeting: Siebold made me a fancy soup instead of shave ice! It was good though! Let's battle!
Sina.trainerWins: Fancy soup and a fancy win! Thanks, Siebold!
Sina.trainerLoses: Fancy soup, but still no shave ice... and a loss!

Sina.greeting: Siebold, let's turn them into shave ice!
Sina.trainerWins: Shave ice, Kalos style! Victory!
Sina.trainerLoses: The shave ice melted before we could serve it!

Siebold.greeting: Wikstrom, my colleague. Shall we serve our opponents a defeat?
Wikstrom asked me to cook him a "knight's feast." I made a balanced meal. He was disappointed.
Kalos's Elite Four, water and steel. A well-sharpened knife.

Wikstrom.greeting: Siebold! A knight and a chef! A feast of victory awaits!
Siebold! A knight and a chef! A feast of victory awaits! Huzzah!
Siebold, let us serve our opponents a defeat!
Byron! A fellow master of steel! Let us forge a victory!
Byron offered to forge me a new sword from Canalave steel! Let us earn it in battle! Huzzah!
Kalos's Elite Four and Canalave's mine! Knight and miner, steel and steel!

Byron.greeting: Gahaha! Wikstrom! A steel knight! Let's dig in!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! Forged and dug, a win!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! A steel knight! Wikstrom, my mine's steel would make you a fine blade!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! A fine blade for a fine win!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! The blade's still in the forge!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Wikstrom, let's build a fortress of steel!

Wikstrom.greeting: Colress, a man of science and steel. I shall protect you!
Wikstrom.trainerLoses: I failed to protect you, Colress!

Wikstrom.greeting: Colress offered to upgrade my armor with his technology! A knight must accept progress!
Kalos's Elite Four and Unova's scientist! Chivalry and science!

Colress.greeting: Wikstrom. Your armor is a fascinating feat of engineering.
Colress.trainerLoses: Even fine armor has stress points. Fascinating.

Colress.greeting: Wikstrom's armor is a fascinating feat of engineering. Let's test its limits.
Wikstrom, let's see what your steel can withstand.

Wikstrom.greeting: Dexio! A young scholar! Fear not, I shall defend you!
Wikstrom.trainerLoses: My defense failed you, young scholar!

Wikstrom.greeting: Dexio asked to see my sword technique for his research! A knight shares his art freely!
Kalos's Elite Four and Sycamore's assistant! Blade and research!

Dexio.greeting: Wikstrom! A real knight! Professor Sycamore won't believe this!
Dexio.trainerWins: Professor Sycamore will hear of this knight's victory!
Dexio.trainerLoses: Professor Sycamore won't believe we lost either!

Dexio.greeting: Wikstrom is a real knight! Professor Sycamore won't believe this! Let's battle!
Dexio.trainerWins: A knight's victory! I'm telling the professor!
Dexio.trainerLoses: A knight's defeat... I'm still telling the professor!

Dexio.greeting: Wikstrom, I'll analyze, you strike!

Wikstrom.greeting: Lady Diantha! It is my honor to fight at your side!
Wikstrom.trainerWins: My honor to win at your side, Lady Diantha!
Wikstrom.trainerLoses: My honor remains, though our victory does not!

Wikstrom.greeting: Lady Diantha knighted me in her last film! Today, I shall earn that title in battle!
Kalos's Elite Four and its Champion! Knight and queen!

Diantha.greeting: Wikstrom, you're always so gallant. Let's win this for Kalos!
Diantha.trainerWins: For Kalos, and for victory! Thank you, Wikstrom.
Diantha.trainerLoses: For Kalos, we tried. Thank you, Wikstrom.

Diantha.greeting: Wikstrom is always so gallant! He'd make the perfect leading man! Let's win for Kalos!
Wikstrom, let's give them a heroic finale!

Wikstrom.greeting: Lady Drasna! A knight shall protect you!
Lady Drasna baked my favorite pastries! A knight shall repay her kindness with victory!
Kalos's Elite Four, steel and dragons! Armor and fang!

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Wikstrom! You're always so chivalrous! Let's win!

Guzma.trainerLoses: Calculated... and big bad Guzma missed anyway!

Molayne.greeting: Jasmine, a steel master from Johto. Gentle, but strong. I like that.
Jasmine cares for her Steel types like I care for my telescope: gently, every single day. Let's battle.
Ula'ula's stargazer and Olivine's lighthouse keeper. Steel and light.

Jasmine.greeting: Molayne... you're so calm. I'll do my best beside you.
Jasmine.trainerWins: You stayed calm, and we won...
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Molayne... I tried.

Jasmine.greeting: Molayne is so calm... I feel calm beside him. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We did our best, and won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We did our best... it wasn't enough.

Jasmine.greeting: Molayne, let's shine like the lighthouse and the stars.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We shone together! Victory!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We dimmed... sorry, Molayne.

Molayne.greeting: Kiawe. Fire and steel. A forge, really.
Kiawe asked if my telescope could see Wela Volcano erupting. It can. It's spectacular. Let's battle.
Molayne.trainerWins: A victory as spectacular as the eruption.
Molayne.trainerLoses: A defeat as spectacular as the eruption.

Molayne.greeting: Ula'ula's stargazer and Akala's fire Captain. Steel and flame.
Molayne.trainerWins: Steel and flame, tempered to victory.

Kiawe.greeting: Molayne! Let's forge a victory in Wela's flames!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Forged a victory in Wela's flames!

Kiawe.greeting: Molayne's steel and my fire! A forge of victory!
Molayne, let's heat your steel until it glows!

Molayne.greeting: Professor Kukui. You built the League; I'll build us a strategy.
Professor Kukui asked me to calculate the perfect move. I did. He ignored it and improvised.
Ula'ula's stargazer and Alola's professor. Calculation and enthusiasm.
Molayne.trainerWins: Calculation and enthusiasm, a perfect sum.
Molayne.trainerLoses: Calculation and enthusiasm, a negative sum.

Kukui.greeting: Molayne! Woo! Engineered for victory!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... back to the drawing board!

Kukui.greeting: Molayne's got a strategy for everything! Woo! I'll just go with the flow!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... strategy and flow, both failed!

Kukui.greeting: Molayne, calculate us a winning move! Woo!

Molayne.greeting: Mallow. I'll trade you a look through the telescope for a plate of your cooking.
Mallow cooked for my entire observatory team. They've asked me to battle beside her more often.
Molayne.trainerLoses: A defeat worth a consolation feast.

Molayne.greeting: Ula'ula's stargazer and the Lush Jungle's Captain. Stars and supper.

Mallow.greeting: Molayne! Deal! I've always wanted to see the stars up close!
Mallow.trainerWins: We won! Show me the stars!
Mallow.trainerLoses: We lost... can I still see the stars?

Mallow.greeting: Molayne showed me the stars through his telescope! I'll cook him a star-shaped dessert if we win!
Molayne, let's cook up a stellar victory!

Molayne.greeting: Plumeria. Let's keep this efficient.
Plumeria called me "nerd" twelve times on the way here. I counted. Let's battle.
Ula'ula's stargazer and Team Skull's big sister. Efficiency and attitude.

Plumeria.greeting: Molayne. Fine by me, nerd.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Not bad, nerd.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Ugh. We lost, nerd.

Plumeria.greeting: Molayne counts everything. It's kinda creepy. Whatever. Let's win, nerd.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Won. Okay, nerd, you're useful.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Lost. Should've counted better, nerd.

Plumeria.greeting: Molayne, calculate the poison dose.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Perfect dose. Nice, nerd.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Wrong dose. Lame, nerd.

Kukui.greeting: Crasher Wake! A fellow masked wrestler! Woo! Let's put on a show!
Crasher Wake and I compared wrestling masks! His is cooler! Don't tell anyone! Woo!
Alola's professor and Pastoria's wrestler! Woo! A tag team for the ages!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! A tag team for the ages!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... a tag team for next week!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahah! Kukui! I know a wrestler when I see one! Let's slam them!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahah! Slammed them flat!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! They slammed us!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Kukui! I know a wrestler when I see one! That mask can't hide it!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Masked wrestlers, undefeated!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Masked wrestlers, unmasked!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Kukui, let's do a double body slam!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Double body slam, landed!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Double body slam, missed!

Kukui.greeting: Guzma! Let's show 'em Alola's tough guys can work together, yeah?
Guzma and I grew up together, yeah? He was always the tough one. Let's show 'em we can work together!
Alola's professor and Team Skull's boss! Old friends, new team!

Guzma.greeting: Kukui. Don't get cute, Professor. Just keep up.
Guzma.trainerWins: Kept up, Professor. Not bad.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Lost. Don't get cute about it.

Guzma.greeting: Kukui, don't bring up the old days, Professor. Just keep up.
Guzma.trainerWins: Kept up. Victory. Don't get mushy.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Didn't keep up. Defeat. Great.

Guzma.greeting: Kukui, I smash, you study. Got it?
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashed and studied! Victory!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Smashed... and studied our loss!

Kukui.greeting: Kiawe! Your fire dance is the best move in Alola! Woo!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! That fire dance is going in my research notes!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo! Even the best move in Alola can miss!

Kukui.greeting: Kiawe showed me a fire dance move I've never seen! I'm writing a paper on it! Woo!
Alola's professor and Akala's fire Captain! Research and rhythm!

Kiawe.greeting: Professor! I'll show you a move worth studying!
The professor filmed my fire dance in slow motion for his research! Let's give him more to film!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Maybe don't film this part, Professor!

Kiawe.greeting: Professor, follow my flames!

Kukui.greeting: Mallow! After this, let's grab a bite at your place! Woo!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! Victory bite at Aina's Kitchen!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo! Comfort food at Aina's Kitchen, then!

Kukui.greeting: Mallow made me a power breakfast before this battle! I've never felt more energized! Woo!
Alola's professor and the Lush Jungle's Captain! Science and supper!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! Science and supper, a perfect pair!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... science and supper, both cold!

Mallow.greeting: Professor Kukui! I'll cook you a victory feast!
Mallow.trainerLoses: A comfort feast, coming right up!

Mallow.greeting: Professor Kukui eats so fast! I'll cook him a victory feast if we win!
Professor, let's cook up a victory!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Burnt to a crisp, Professor! Sorry!

Kukui.greeting: Plumeria! Let's make this a good one, yeah?
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! A good one, just like I said!

Kukui.greeting: Plumeria helped me find a lost Team Skull grunt once. She's got a good heart, yeah?
Alola's professor and Team Skull's big sister! Unlikely allies!

Plumeria.greeting: Professor. Don't get preachy. Let's just win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: No sermon, Professor. Just a win. Nice.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Don't preach about this loss, Professor.

Plumeria.greeting: Kukui, don't get preachy. And don't tell anyone about the grunt thing.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Won. Still don't tell anyone.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Lost. Definitely don't tell anyone.

Plumeria.greeting: Kukui, let's poison 'em and study the results.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Poisoned and studied. Nice.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Studied our own defeat. Lame.

Archer.greeting: Ariana. Two executives, one goal: show them Team Rocket is still standing.
Archer.trainerWins: Team Rocket still stands. Tell everyone.
Archer.trainerLoses: Team Rocket stumbles. Tell no one.

Archer.greeting: Ariana and I kept Team Rocket alive for three years without the boss. Today, we prove it was worth it.
Archer.trainerLoses: Not worth it today. We regroup.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's two executives, together again. The organization's backbone.
Archer.trainerWins: The backbone of Team Rocket holds firm.
Archer.trainerLoses: The backbone of Team Rocket cracks.

Ariana.greeting: Archer. Try to keep up. I'm not carrying you through this one.
Ariana.trainerWins: Kept up, Archer. Barely.
Ariana.trainerLoses: I wasn't carrying you, Archer. Clearly.

Ariana.greeting: Archer thinks he's in charge. Cute. I'll let him think that while I win this.
Ariana.trainerWins: I won it. Archer can take the credit.
Ariana.trainerLoses: We lost. That's Archer's fault, obviously.

Ariana.greeting: Archer, try not to slow me down.
Ariana.trainerWins: He kept up. Barely. I'll allow it.
Ariana.trainerLoses: He slowed me down. I'll be telling the boss.

Archer.greeting: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your fists for our cause... just for today.
Archer.trainerWins: Your fists served our cause well. Just for today.
Archer.trainerLoses: Even your fists couldn't save our cause.

Archer.greeting: Bruno refused to join Team Rocket years ago. Today, he'll battle beside us. Progress.
Team Rocket's executive and the Elite Four's fighter. Strategy and strength.

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I fight beside you once, Rocket. Don't get used to it!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! Done. Don't call me again, Rocket!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! That's what fighting beside a Rocket gets me!

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! Rocket, I'll fight beside you once! Don't get comfortable! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Victory, but I'm still not joining!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Defeat, and I'm definitely not joining!

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Rocket, stay out of my way and we'll win!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Stayed out of my way! Victory!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Got in my way! Defeat!

Archer.greeting: The Azalea bug boy. Don't look at me like that; the well business was Proton's idea.
Archer.trainerWins: Victory. Now we part ways, as agreed.
Archer.trainerLoses: Defeat. Part ways, then. I won't follow.

Archer.greeting: The Azalea boy still glares at me about the well. That was years ago. Let's just win.
Archer.trainerWins: Victory. Can we move on now?

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Azalea's Gym Leader. An uneasy truce.
Archer.trainerWins: An uneasy truce, a steady victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: An uneasy truce, a shaky defeat.

Bugsy.greeting: Archer. I haven't forgotten what you did at the well in Azalea. Let's just win and part ways.
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won. Now leave Azalea alone.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost. And I still haven't forgotten the well.

Bugsy.greeting: Archer. I haven't forgotten the well. But for this battle, I'll set it aside.
Bugsy.trainerWins: Set aside, and victorious.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Set aside... and defeated anyway.

Bugsy.greeting: Archer, keep your Team Rocket tricks out of my bug research.
Bugsy.trainerWins: Kept out. Victory.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Kept out... defeated anyway.

Archer.greeting: Cianwood's brawler. Loud, but useful. Point that energy forward.
Chuck punched a Team Rocket grunt clear across Cianwood once. Point that energy forward today.
Team Rocket's executive and Cianwood's brawler. Cold calculation and raw power.

Chuck.greeting: Team Rocket?! WAHAHAH! Fine, I'll punch whoever's in front of me!
WAHAHAH! Team Rocket?! Fine! I'll punch whoever's in front of me! HYAH!
WAHAHAH! Archer, stay behind me! I'll do the punching!

Archer.greeting: The Blackthorn dragon tamer. Your cousin gave us a lot of trouble.
Archer.trainerWins: No trouble from you today. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: You gave the wrong people trouble.

Archer.greeting: Clair's cousin Lance destroyed our Mahogany operation. She's been glaring at me since we met.
Team Rocket's executive and Blackthorn's dragon master. Dark and dragon.

Clair.greeting: Archer. And I'll give you even more if you get in my way.
Clair.trainerWins: I didn't need to get in your way. Good.
Clair.trainerLoses: I should have just done it myself.

Clair.greeting: Archer. Lance gave you trouble. I'll give you more if you slow me down.
Clair.trainerWins: He didn't slow me down. Victory.
Clair.trainerLoses: He slowed me down. Of course.

Clair.greeting: Archer, stay out of my dragons' way.
Clair.trainerWins: He stayed clear of my dragons. Smart. Victory.
Clair.trainerLoses: He wandered into my dragons' path. Defeat.

Archer.greeting: Violet's bird keeper. Keep your flock in line and we'll get along.
Falkner's birds spotted our hideout in Violet City years ago. Sharp eyes. Today, let's use them.
Team Rocket's executive and Violet's bird keeper. Shadow and sky.

Falkner.greeting: My birds fly for Violet City, not for Team Rocket. But fine. Let's win.
Falkner.trainerWins: We won for Violet City. Not you.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Violet City's birds are grounded today.

Falkner.greeting: My birds fly for Violet City, not Team Rocket. But for this battle, they'll fly beside you.
Falkner.trainerWins: Flew beside him, and won.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Flew beside him... and fell.

Falkner.greeting: Archer, I'll scout from above. You strike from the shadows.
Falkner.trainerWins: Scouted and struck. Victory.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Scouted... and missed.

Archer.greeting: Boss! At last! Team Rocket's executive Archer, at your command!
Archer.trainerWins: Boss! Team Rocket wins! Did you see?
Archer.trainerLoses: Boss, I've failed you. Forgive me!

Archer.greeting: Boss! I held Team Rocket together for three years, waiting for your return! Today, I prove my loyalty!
Team Rocket's boss and his executive. The organization, reunited.

Giovanni.greeting: Archer. You held the organization together. Now show me it was worth it.
Giovanni.trainerWins: It was worth it, Archer. For now.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: That was not worth waiting for, Archer.

Giovanni.greeting: Archer kept my organization alive. Admirable. Now show me it was worth the wait.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Worth the wait. Well done, Archer.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Not worth the wait. Disappointing.

Giovanni.greeting: Archer, follow my lead. Precisely.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Followed imprecisely. Defeat.

Archer.greeting: Olivine's Gym Leader. Gentle souls make poor opponents, but adequate partners.
Jasmine asked me to promise I wouldn't do anything bad today. I promised. I keep my promises. Usually.
Archer.trainerWins: A promise kept, a victory won.
Archer.trainerLoses: A promise kept, a battle lost.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Olivine's gentle Leader. Steel nerves and steel armor.
Archer.trainerWins: Steel nerves and steel armor, unbroken.
Archer.trainerLoses: Steel nerves and steel armor, both dented.

Jasmine.greeting: Um... Archer, please don't do anything bad while we battle, okay?
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won, and you behaved... thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... but at least you behaved.

Jasmine.greeting: Archer was... polite to me today. Maybe people can change. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We did our best, and he behaved!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We did our best... at least he behaved.

Jasmine.greeting: Archer, my steel will protect us both. Please... battle fairly.
Jasmine.trainerWins: He battled fairly. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: He battled fairly. We lost anyway.

Archer.greeting: Karen of the Elite Four. Darkness suits us both, wouldn't you say?
Karen and I both prefer the night. That's where our similarities end, she reminded me. Twice.
Archer.trainerWins: The night belongs to us after all. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: The night turned on us both.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Johto's Elite Four. Two shades of darkness.
Archer.trainerWins: Two shades of darkness, and no light left for them.
Archer.trainerLoses: Two shades of darkness, and they found the light.

Karen.greeting: Archer. We share an affinity for the night, not a cause. Remember that.
Karen.trainerWins: The night was ours. The cause was not.
Karen.trainerLoses: The night slipped away from us.

Karen.greeting: Archer battles for his boss. I battle for my favorites. Let's see whose reason holds up.
Archer, strike in the dark. Don't make me regret standing next to you.

Archer.greeting: Koga, the poison ninja. Team Rocket could have used a man like you.
Archer.trainerWins: Team Rocket could still use a man like you.
Archer.trainerLoses: Even a ninja couldn't save us.

Archer.greeting: Koga turned down Team Rocket's offer years ago. A pity. Today, at least, he strikes with us.
Team Rocket's executive and the poison ninja. Shadows and venom.
Archer.trainerWins: Shadows and venom, a lethal victory.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! A ninja serves no criminal, Archer. But today, we strike together!
Fwahaha! Archer, a ninja serves no criminal! But this battle, I'll serve myself!
Fwahaha! Archer, you plan, I poison!

Archer.greeting: The Dragon Master who ruined our Mahogany operation. The irony isn't lost on me.
Archer.trainerWins: The irony of winning beside you is delicious.
Archer.trainerLoses: The irony of losing beside you is bitter.

Archer.greeting: Lance shut down our Mahogany operation single-handedly. I've had years to resent it. Let's battle.
Team Rocket's executive and the Dragon Master. Former enemies.

Lance.greeting: Archer. I'll be watching you every turn of this battle.
Lance.trainerWins: You behaved. We won. Don't mistake that for trust.
Lance.trainerLoses: I watched every turn. We still lost.

Lance.greeting: Archer, I'll be watching you every turn. One wrong move, and this alliance ends.
Lance.trainerWins: No wrong moves. Victory.

Lance.greeting: Archer, keep your strategy clean. My dragons will do the rest.
Lance.trainerWins: Clean strategy, clean victory.

Archer.greeting: Ecruteak's seer. Tell me, do you see Team Rocket's return?
Archer.trainerLoses: The seer was right. Nothing beyond this.

Archer.greeting: Morty claims to see the future. I asked if Team Rocket returns. He said "not today." Let's prove him wrong.
Team Rocket's executive and Ecruteak's seer. Ambition and vision.

Morty.greeting: Archer. I see this battle, and nothing beyond it for your team.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw victory. Nothing beyond it.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw defeat. I told you as much.

Morty.greeting: Archer, I see this battle. Beyond it, nothing for your team. Let's focus on now.
Morty.trainerWins: Now, victory. Beyond, still nothing.
Morty.trainerLoses: Now, defeat. Beyond, still nothing.

Morty.greeting: Archer, follow the spirits' path. Not your own.
Morty.trainerWins: He followed the spirits. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: He followed his own path. Defeat.

Archer.greeting: Petrel. Drop the disguises today, please. I need you as yourself.
Petrel disguised himself as the boss again this morning. I almost saluted. Drop it today.
Team Rocket's executives, the planner and the impersonator.

Petrel.greeting: Archer! Which self do you want? I have several!
Petrel.trainerWins: All my selves won! Thanks, Archer!
Petrel.trainerLoses: All of me lost! Which one was weakest?

Petrel.greeting: Archer wants the real me today! Which one is that again? Let's win!
Petrel.trainerWins: The real me won! I think!
Petrel.trainerLoses: The real me lost! Or was that a disguise?

Petrel.greeting: Archer, I'll pretend to be the challenger and confuse them!

Archer.greeting: Proton. Save the cruelty for our opponent.
Archer.trainerWins: You saved the cruelty for them. Good.

Archer.greeting: Proton enjoys cruelty a little too much. Today, aim all of it at the opponent.
Archer.trainerWins: Aimed exactly where I asked. Victory.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's planner and its cruelest executive. Head and fangs.
Archer.trainerWins: Head and fangs, a clean bite.

Proton.greeting: Archer. No promises. That's half the fun.
Archer wants me to behave. Where's the fun in that? Fine. For the boss.
Proton.trainerWins: For the boss! He'll love this!
Proton.trainerLoses: For the boss... he'll hate this.

Proton.greeting: Archer, let me handle the dirty work. You keep your hands clean.
Proton.trainerWins: Dirty work done, his hands still clean.
Proton.trainerLoses: Dirty work backfired. Now we're both filthy.

Archer.greeting: Mahogany's old Gym Leader. We were practically neighbors.
Pryce glared at me the whole way up. Our Mahogany hideout was under his town, after all.
Archer.trainerWins: Victory, and only a slightly softer glare.
Archer.trainerLoses: Defeat, and an even colder glare.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Mahogany's Gym Leader. Uneasy neighbors.

Pryce.greeting: Archer. Your hideout under my town was not neighborly. Let's just battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: We won. The hideout is still not forgiven.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We lost. Your hideout's karma, perhaps.

Pryce.greeting: Archer, your hideout under my town was unwelcome. Today, I'll tolerate you. Barely.
Pryce.trainerWins: Tolerated, and victorious. Don't push it.

Pryce.greeting: Archer, let the cold do its work. Don't interfere.
Pryce.trainerWins: He didn't interfere. The cold won.

Archer.greeting: Goldenrod's Gym Leader. No hard feelings about the Radio Tower, I trust.
Archer.trainerWins: No hard feelings, then. We won.

Archer.greeting: Whitney still hasn't forgiven us for the Radio Tower. I can't say I blame her. Let's battle.
Archer.trainerWins: Victory. Perhaps she'll forgive us now.

Archer.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Goldenrod's Gym Leader. Old grudges, new battle.

Whitney.greeting: Hard feelings? You took over our Radio Tower! ...Fine, let's just win!
Whitney.trainerWins: We won! Still mad about the Radio Tower, though!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We lost AND you took our Radio Tower! Waaah!

Whitney.greeting: Archer took over our Radio Tower! I'm still mad! But fine, let's win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We lost! Now I'm mad AND sad!

Whitney.greeting: Archer, no funny business! Just battle!
Whitney.trainerLoses: No funny business... and we lost!

Archer.greeting: The masked psychic. Read my mind, and you'll find nothing but strategy.
Will tried to read my mind. He found nothing but strategy. I'm proud of that.
Team Rocket's executive and Johto's masked psychic. Calculation and theater.
Archer.trainerWins: Calculation and theater, a flawless show.
Archer.trainerLoses: Calculation and theater, a failed act.

Will.greeting: Archer. Your mind is orderly. Unpleasantly so. Let us begin.
Will.trainerWins: An orderly mind, a clean victory.

Will.greeting: Archer's mind is orderly to the point of discomfort. Let us begin anyway.
Archer, I'll read their minds. You plan around them.

Ariana.greeting: Bruno. All that muscle, and still on the wrong side. Today it's my side.
Ariana.trainerWins: My side won, muscle man.
Ariana.trainerLoses: My side lost. Thanks for nothing.

Ariana.greeting: Bruno flexed at me in the elevator. I wasn't impressed. Let's see if his fists impress me more.
Ariana.trainerWins: His fists impressed me. A little.
Ariana.trainerLoses: His fists didn't impress anyone today.

Ariana.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and the Elite Four's muscle. Brains and brawn.
Ariana.trainerWins: Brains and brawn. I was the brains. Victory.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Brains and brawn, both outclassed.

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I stand beside you only because the draw says so!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! Even the draw can't make me like this!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! This is why I don't stand beside Rockets!

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I stand beside a Rocket only because the draw says so! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Victory, but I'm still not a Rocket!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Defeat, and I'm definitely not a Rocket!

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Rocket lady, stay back! I'll do the heavy lifting!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Heavy lifting, done!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Too heavy, even for me!

Ariana.greeting: Bugsy. Stop glaring. We're on the same team for once.
Ariana.trainerWins: Same team, same win. Stop glaring.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Glare all you want. We lost.

Ariana.greeting: Bugsy glared at me the whole way up. Still mad about Azalea. Get over it, kid.
Ariana.trainerWins: He didn't get over it, but we won.
Ariana.trainerLoses: He didn't get over it, and we lost.

Ariana.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Azalea's Gym Leader. The bug boy and the boss's favorite.
Ariana.trainerWins: The boss's favorite wins. Naturally.
Ariana.trainerLoses: The boss's favorite... let's not tell him.

Bugsy.greeting: Ariana. I'll battle with you. I won't like it.
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won. I still don't like it.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost. I like it even less.

Bugsy.greeting: Ariana, I'll battle with you. I won't like it. I'm doing this for my bugs.
Bugsy.trainerWins: My bugs earned this win, not her.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My bugs deserved better today.

Bugsy.greeting: Ariana, keep your Rocket tricks away from my bugs.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Sharp tongue, loud mouth, silent defeat.

Ariana.trainerLoses: The room didn't listen.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Commanded... and overthrown.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Two women who don't take orders, taking a loss.

Clair.greeting: Ariana. For once, I agree with a Rocket. Let's win.

Clair.trainerLoses: Plenty of regrets. As I feared.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Your birds failed us.

Ariana.greeting: Team Rocket's executive and Violet's bird keeper. Shadow and wing.
Ariana.trainerWins: Shadow and wing, soaring over them.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Shadow and wing, clipped together.

Falkner.trainerLoses: Hands to yourself, and we lost.

Falkner.greeting: Ariana, as long as you keep your hands to yourself, my birds will behave.

Falkner.trainerLoses: Hands kept... and we lost anyway.

Falkner.trainerLoses: Above and below, and they dodged both!

Ariana.trainerWins: Boss! It was worth the wait!
Ariana.trainerLoses: Boss, I'm sorry. We'll do better.

Ariana.trainerWins: For you, Boss. Victory.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Forgive me, Boss. We'll regroup.

Ariana.greeting: Team Rocket's boss and his executive. The world will remember to fear us.
Ariana.trainerWins: The world remembers. Victory.

Giovanni.trainerLoses: The world won't fear that, Ariana.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Sweet girl, sour defeat.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Sharp and soft, unbalanced.

Jasmine.trainerLoses: She battled kindly... we lost.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Respect isn't enough to win.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Two women of the night, outshone by morning.

Karen.trainerLoses: Her orders lost. Her favorites deserved better.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Poison misunderstood poison. Defeat.

Ariana.trainerWins: Venom twice over, and nothing left standing.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Venom twice over, and they shrugged it off.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Ariana, our poisons are alike, but our hearts are not.
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! Our poisons failed us both!

Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Poisoned from both sides! Victory!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! Cured from both sides! Defeat!

Ariana.trainerWins: Enemies for years, allies for one victory.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Enemies for years, allies for one defeat.

Lance.trainerLoses: We lost. At least you behaved.

Ariana.trainerLoses: He kept staring, and we lost. Creepy.

Ariana.trainerLoses: He saw my secrets. And we lost.

Ariana.trainerLoses: No impersonations. Defeat anyway.

Ariana.trainerLoses: Sharp and strange, an awkward loss.

Petrel.trainerLoses: We lost! But I didn't copy you, I swear!

Petrel.trainerLoses: They saw right through my disguise!

Ariana.trainerLoses: Cruel, but useless today.
