Proton.trainerWins: Cold and cruel, a chilling victory.

Pryce.greeting: Proton. Respect your elders, boy. Then win.
Proton, respect your elders, boy. Then win. In that order.
Proton, let the ice work. Keep your cruelty frozen.

Proton.greeting: Whitney. Don't you dare cry.
Whitney started tearing up the moment she saw me. I didn't even do anything yet.
Team Rocket's cruelest and Goldenrod's Gym Leader. Mean and sweet.
Proton.trainerWins: Mean and sweet, a sour victory.
Proton.trainerLoses: Mean and sweet, a bitter defeat.

Whitney.greeting: Proton! You're so mean! ...Let's win anyway!
Whitney.trainerLoses: You're mean AND we lost! Waaah!

Whitney.greeting: Proton is so mean! I'm not gonna cry! I'm gonna WIN!
Whitney.trainerWins: I didn't cry! We won! Take that, Proton!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I cried! We lost! This is your fault, Proton!

Whitney.greeting: Proton, be nice for once!
Whitney.trainerWins: He was nice! We won! Miracles happen!
Whitney.trainerLoses: He was mean! We lost! Of course!

Proton.greeting: Will. Fancy mask. Fancy moves. Fine.
Will said my thoughts are unpleasant. Good. That's the point. Let's battle.
Team Rocket's cruelest and Johto's masked psychic. Dread and illusion.
Proton.trainerWins: Dread and illusion, a nightmare for them.
Proton.trainerLoses: Dread and illusion, a nightmare for us.

Will.greeting: Proton. Your thoughts are... unpleasant. Let us begin.
Proton's mind is a dark place. I'll keep my distance and my focus.
Proton, I'll read them. You... do whatever it is you do.
Will.trainerWins: He did it. It worked. Victory.
Will.trainerLoses: He did it. It didn't work. Defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Bruno! Hoo hah! See, I can do you too!
Petrel.trainerWins: Hoo hah! I won as you!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Hoo hah... I lost as you!

Petrel.greeting: Bruno! Hoo hah! See, I can do you too! I've been practicing my flexing!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The flexing pulled a muscle!

Petrel.greeting: Team Rocket's master of disguise and the Elite Four's muscle! Two Brunos!

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! Stop that! Fight as yourself!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! You fought as yourself, finally!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! Fight as yourself and maybe you'll win!

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! Stop impersonating me! Fight as yourself! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! He fought as himself! Victory!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! He fought as me... badly! Defeat!

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Petrel, be yourself and punch!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! Punched as himself!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Punched as me, missed as him!

Petrel.greeting: Bugsy! I'm a bug researcher too. Totally. Trust me.
Bugsy! I'm a bug researcher today! Look, I have a magnifying glass and everything!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Azalea's bug expert! The real one and the fake one!

Bugsy.greeting: Petrel. I know it's you. I can tell by the hair.
Bugsy.trainerWins: The hair gave you away. The win is real, though.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: The hair gave you away, and we lost.

Bugsy.greeting: Petrel, I know it's you. I can tell by the hair. And the fact you're holding the magnifying glass backwards.
Bugsy.trainerWins: The fake researcher won. Huh.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: The fake researcher lost. As expected.

Bugsy.greeting: Petrel, just battle normally. Please.
Bugsy.trainerWins: He battled normally! We won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: He battled in disguise... we lost!

Petrel.greeting: Chuck! WAHAHAH! How's my impression?
Chuck! WAHAHAH! How's my impression? I even did push-ups this morning!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Cianwood's brawler! Two Chucks!
Petrel.trainerWins: Two Chucks, twice the shouting, one victory!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Two Chucks, twice the shouting, one defeat!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Not bad! Now punch like me too!
WAHAHAH! Not bad, Petrel! Now punch like me too! HYAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! He punched like me! Victory!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! He punched like Petrel! Defeat!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Petrel, let's yell our battle cries together!

Petrel.greeting: Clair! I could be a dragon tamer too, with the right cape.
Petrel.trainerWins: Cape or no cape, we won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I needed the cape after all!

Petrel.greeting: Clair! With the right cape, I could be a dragon tamer too! I brought one!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Blackthorn's dragon master! Real dragons, fake cape!
Petrel.trainerWins: Real dragons, fake cape, true victory!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Real dragons, fake cape, true defeat!

Clair.greeting: Petrel. You couldn't. Don't even try.
Clair.trainerWins: Don't even think of copying this win.
Clair.trainerLoses: We lost. You still couldn't be a dragon tamer.

Clair.greeting: Petrel, you couldn't be a dragon tamer. Put that cape away.
Petrel, stay behind my dragons. Don't touch the cape.

Petrel.greeting: Falkner! I once dressed as a bird keeper. Fooled everyone!
Falkner! I dressed as a bird keeper once and fooled everyone! Well, almost everyone!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Violet's bird keeper! Feathers, real and fake!
Petrel.trainerWins: Real and fake feathers, flying high!

Falkner.greeting: Petrel. You did not fool anyone. Let's just battle.
Falkner.trainerWins: You fooled no one. We still won.
Falkner.trainerLoses: No disguise could have saved that.

Falkner.greeting: Petrel, you did not fool anyone. My birds recognized you instantly. Let's just battle.
Falkner.trainerWins: My birds recognized victory, too.
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds recognized defeat.

Falkner.greeting: Petrel, leave the disguises to the birds.
Falkner.trainerWins: He left them. Victory.
Falkner.trainerLoses: He wore them. Defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Boss! I played you at the Mahogany hideout once! Nobody could tell! ...Well, almost nobody.
Boss! I played you at the Mahogany hideout once! Nobody could tell! Well, almost nobody!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Boss! Defeat... can I be you instead?

Petrel.greeting: Team Rocket's boss and his master of disguise! The real boss and the fake one!
Petrel.trainerWins: Real boss and fake boss, both victorious!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Real boss and fake boss, both defeated!

Giovanni.greeting: Petrel. Never do that again. Now, battle.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Good. You were yourself. You won.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Be yourself next time, and win.

Giovanni.greeting: Petrel, never impersonate me again. Now, battle as yourself.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: He battled as himself. Disappointing.

Giovanni.greeting: Petrel, follow my lead. Do not copy it.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Copied, not followed. Defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Jasmine! I could dress as a lighthouse keeper!
Jasmine! I could dress as a lighthouse keeper! Want to see? I've got a lantern!
Petrel.trainerWins: The lantern guided us to victory!

Petrel.greeting: Team Rocket's master of disguise and Olivine's gentle Leader! Two lighthouse keepers!

Jasmine.greeting: Petrel... please just be yourself. It's okay.
Jasmine.trainerWins: You were yourself, and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: You were yourself. That's okay, even though we lost.

Jasmine.greeting: Petrel... please just be yourself. It's okay. People like you as you are.
Jasmine.trainerWins: He was himself. We won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: He was a lighthouse keeper... we lost.

Jasmine.greeting: Petrel, let's do our best. As ourselves.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Our best, as ourselves. Victory!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Our best, as ourselves... defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Karen! Want me to dress as you? I've got the attitude down!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I didn't copy you! We lost!

Petrel.greeting: Karen! Want me to dress as you? I've got the attitude down! Watch: "Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon."
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Johto's Elite Four! Two Karens!
Petrel.trainerWins: Two Karens, too strong to lose!

Karen.greeting: Petrel. No. Never.
Karen.trainerWins: Good. Never copy me. We won.

Karen.greeting: Petrel. No. Never. Do not dress as me.
Karen.trainerWins: He didn't dress as me. We won. Good.
Karen.trainerLoses: He dressed as me. We lost. Of course.

Karen.greeting: Petrel, battle with your favorites. Not your costumes.

Petrel.greeting: Koga! Disguise and stealth! We're basically the same!
Koga! Disguise and stealth! We're basically the same, right? Ninja buddies!
Petrel.trainerWins: Ninja buddies, victorious! I knew it!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Ninja buddies... the ninja's disappointed in me!

Petrel.greeting: Team Rocket's master of disguise and the poison ninja! Masters of deception!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! A ninja's shadow is not a costume, Petrel!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! A shadow, not a costume, won today!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Petrel, a ninja's shadow is not a costume! But your spirit is amusing!
Fwahaha! Petrel, vanish with me! No costume required!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Vanished without a costume! Victory!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! He brought a costume anyway! Defeat!

Petrel.greeting: Lance! I'm also a dragon master today. Just go with it.
Lance! I'm also a dragon master today! I've got a cape and everything! Just go with it!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and the real Dragon Master! Capes for everyone!
Petrel.trainerWins: Capes for everyone, victory for us!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Capes for everyone, defeat for us!

Lance.greeting: Petrel. I'll go with you winning. Not the disguise.
Lance.trainerWins: You won. The disguise did not.
Lance.trainerLoses: You lost. The disguise didn't help.

Lance.greeting: Petrel, I'll go with you winning. Not with the disguise.
Lance.trainerWins: He won. The disguise stays questionable.
Lance.trainerLoses: He lost. The disguise didn't help.

Lance.greeting: Petrel, let my dragons do the work. Lose the cape.
Lance.trainerWins: Cape lost, battle won.

Petrel.greeting: Morty! Can you see through my disguise?
Petrel.trainerWins: You can't see through my win!
Petrel.trainerLoses: You saw right through that loss.

Petrel.greeting: Morty! Can you see through my disguise? I'm dressed as a ghost today!
Petrel.trainerWins: He saw through it! We won anyway!
Petrel.trainerLoses: He saw through it! We lost!

Petrel.greeting: Team Rocket's master of disguise and Ecruteak's seer! Fake ghost, real ghosts!
Petrel.trainerWins: Fake ghost and real ghosts, victorious!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Fake ghost and real ghosts, exorcised!

Morty.greeting: Petrel. I see you. I always see you.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw you. And I saw victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw you, and I saw defeat.

Morty.greeting: Petrel, I see you. I always see you. Even dressed as a ghost.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw through the costume, and saw victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw through the costume, and saw defeat.

Morty.greeting: Petrel, let the real spirits lead, not your costume.
Morty.trainerWins: The real spirits led us to victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: The fake ghost led us astray.

Petrel.greeting: Pryce! I'm wearing a scarf! We match!
Pryce! I'm wearing a scarf! We match! Ice buddies!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Mahogany's ice master! Old and new scarves!
Petrel.trainerWins: Old and new scarves, warm victory!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Old and new scarves, cold defeat!

Pryce.greeting: Petrel. We do not match. Battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: We still don't match. We won.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We still don't match. We lost.

Pryce.greeting: Petrel. We do not match. Take off that scarf and battle.
Petrel, let the cold work. Not the costume.

Petrel.greeting: Whitney! I'm your number one fan! Or am I?
Petrel.trainerWins: Your number one fan won! Or did I?
Petrel.trainerLoses: Your number one fan lost! Or did I?

Petrel.greeting: Whitney! I'm your number one fan! Or am I? I might be the Radio Tower director!
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Goldenrod's Gym Leader! Fan and star!

Whitney.greeting: Petrel! Wait, are you the guy from the Radio Tower?!
Whitney.trainerWins: You ARE the Radio Tower guy! ...We won, though!
Whitney.trainerLoses: You're the Radio Tower guy AND we lost!

Whitney.greeting: Petrel! Wait, you were the guy at the Radio Tower! I knew it! Fine, let's win!
Whitney.trainerWins: We won! Still mad about the Radio Tower!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We lost! Still mad about the Radio Tower!

Whitney.greeting: Petrel, no disguises! Just battle!
Whitney.trainerWins: No disguises, just a big win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: He wore a disguise anyway! And we lost!

Petrel.greeting: Will! Masks! We both love masks!
Will! Masks! We both love masks! Want to trade?
Team Rocket's master of disguise and Johto's masked psychic! Mask buddies!

Will.greeting: Petrel. My mask hides nothing. Yours hides everything.
Petrel, my mask hides nothing. Yours hides everything. Let us begin.
Petrel, I'll read them. You... confuse them.
Will.trainerWins: Read and confused. A strange, effective victory.
Will.trainerLoses: Read and confused... mostly ourselves. Defeat.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Read my feelings if you like. You'll find only resolve.
The Salon Maiden reads feelings. I've never let anyone read mine. Today, I'll make an exception.
Team Magma's leader and the Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Land and mind.

Anabel.greeting: Maxie. Resolve, yes... and something heavier underneath. Let's begin.
Anabel.trainerWins: Resolve, and something heavier. Still a win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: That heaviness weighed us down, Maxie.

Anabel.greeting: Maxie's resolve is like bedrock. Beneath it, something heavier. Let's battle.
Maxie, let me read them. Your Pokémon will shape the field.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie. Our goals are opposites, but our enemy today is the same. Don't get in my way.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: You stayed out of my way. A rare success.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: You got in my way, Archie. As always.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie and I nearly destroyed Hoenn arguing over land and sea. Today, we argue over who wins.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: We both won. I'll take credit.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: We both lost. I'll blame Archie.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Magma and Team Aqua. Land and sea. Uneasy allies.

Archie (RSE).greeting: Maxie! Still dreaming of dry land? Fine, I'll put up with you for one battle.
Archie (RSE).trainerWins: Bwahaha! Put up with you, and we won!
Archie (RSE).trainerLoses: Bwahaha! That's what I get for working with you!

Archie (RSE).greeting: Maxie wants more land. I want more sea. Today, we both want a win! Bwahaha!
Archie (RSE).trainerLoses: Bwahaha! Land and sea, both sunk!

Archie (RSE).greeting: Bwahaha! Maxie, you raise the land, I'll flood it!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie. You seem... changed. No matter. Battle well and keep your distance.
This Archie seems... different. Rougher. Wilder. No matter. Battle well and keep your distance.
Team Magma's leader and a different Team Aqua's leader. Land meets a stranger sea.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Land and a strange sea, victorious.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Land and a strange sea, both drowned.

Archie (ORAS).greeting: Bwahaha! Maxie, you haven't changed a bit! Same scowl, same glasses!
Archie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Bwahaha! Same scowl, but a loss!

Archie (ORAS).greeting: Bwahaha! Maxie, you haven't changed a bit! Same scowl, same glasses! Let's go!
Bwahaha! Maxie, let's make the land and sea shake!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Dewford's surfer. All that water. How wasteful.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: A waste of water, but a fine result.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Brawly surfs on what I'd turn into land. A waste of good ground. Let's battle.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: A waste of ground, but a victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: A waste of ground, and a defeat.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Magma's leader and Dewford's surfer. Land and wave.

Brawly.greeting: Whoa, Team Magma? Okay, dude, but the ocean stays where it is!
Brawly.trainerWins: The ocean stays, and we win, dude!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The ocean stays, and we wipe out!

Brawly.greeting: Whoa, Team Magma? Okay, dude, but the ocean stays where it is! Let's ride!
Maxie, let's crash into them like a wave on a beach you made!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Elite Four's old sailor. You love the sea. I love the land. Today, we love winning.
Drake loves the sea. I love the land. Today, we both love winning.
Team Magma's leader and the Elite Four's old sailor. Land and sea, for once agreeing.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Land and sea agreed on victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Land and sea agreed on defeat.

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Maxie, a landlubber! Fine, let's make 'em walk the plank!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Walked the plank, they did!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Maxie gets seasick just looking at my boat! Today, he battles on solid ground beside me!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Solid ground, solid win, landlubber!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Even solid ground couldn't save us!

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Maxie, let's build an island and sail around it!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Island built, sailed to victory!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Lavaridge's Gym Leader. Mt. Chimney's heat runs in your blood. Use it.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Mt. Chimney's heat, put to good use.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Flannery's grandfather once chased Team Magma off Mt. Chimney with a broom. She has his temper. Useful.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Her temper, aimed at me. Defeat.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Magma's leader and Lavaridge's Gym Leader. Magma and hot springs.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Magma and hot springs, boiling over with victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Magma and hot springs, cooled to defeat.

Flannery.greeting: Maxie! You messed with Mt. Chimney once! Behave, or I'll burn you too!
Flannery.trainerWins: I didn't need to burn you! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I should have burned you instead!

Flannery.greeting: Maxie messed with Mt. Chimney! Grandpa would be furious! But fine, I'll battle! For the mountain!
Maxie, let's make Mt. Chimney proud! No machines!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The ice-cold Elite Four. A cold head is useful. Stay that way.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: A cold head served us well.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Glacia called my plans "hot-headed." Perhaps. Today, a cooler head prevails.
Team Magma's leader and the Elite Four's ice queen. Magma and frost.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Magma and frost, forged into obsidian. Victory.

Glacia.greeting: Maxie. Your plans were rather hot-headed. Let's keep this battle cool.
Maxie's ambition burns too hot for my taste. Let's keep this battle cool.
Maxie, try not to melt anything.
Glacia.trainerWins: Nothing melted, not even my patience. Victory.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Sootopolis's Gym Leader. Your city nearly sank because of Archie, not me.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Your city survived, and we won.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Juan reminded me Sootopolis nearly sank. That was Archie's doing, I told him. He didn't look convinced.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Victory. Perhaps he believes me now.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Defeat. He definitely doesn't believe me.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Magma's leader and Sootopolis's maestro. Land and water.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Land and water, eroding each other.

Juan.greeting: Maxie. My city remembers both of you, I assure you. Let us battle.
Juan.trainerWins: My city's memories include this win, Maxie.
Juan.trainerLoses: My city will not remember this kindly.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Maxie. My city remembers both of you. But art is forgiveness. Let us create.
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, an unforgiving defeat!

Juan.greeting: Maxie, let us shape this battle as water shapes stone.
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, shaped poorly!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie's lackey. Keep your shouting down and your fists up.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Too much shouting, not enough fist.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Matt shouted "BWAHAHA" at me in the elevator four times. I did not respond. Keep your fists up today.
Team Magma's leader and Team Aqua's muscle. An absurd alliance.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: An absurd alliance, an effective victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: An absurd alliance, an absurd defeat.

Matt (Team Aqua).greeting: BWAHAHA! Team Magma's boss?! Fine! My fists are always up!
BWAHAHA! Team Magma's boss on my team?! The boss would laugh! Fine! My fists are always up!
BWAHAHA! Maxie, I'll punch, you plan!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Petalburg's Gym Leader. A father with discipline. Good.
Norman's child stopped Team Magma. I'm told they get it from their father. Let's see.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: They get it from him. Victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: They didn't get it from him today.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Magma's leader and Petalburg's Gym Leader. Ambition and discipline.

Norman.greeting: Maxie. I'll keep my eye on you. Now, let's battle.
Norman.trainerWins: I watched you, and we won.
Norman.trainerLoses: I watched you, and we lost.

Norman.greeting: Maxie, I'll keep my eye on you. My child taught you a lesson once. Today, let's teach someone else.
Norman.trainerLoses: Lesson learned. Defeat.

Norman.greeting: Maxie, battle with honor today. That's all I ask.
Norman.trainerWins: He kept his honor, and we won.
Norman.trainerLoses: He kept his honor. That counts, even in defeat.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Mt. Pyre girl. Yes, we took the orb. Let's not discuss it.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: We didn't discuss the orb. We won.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Phoebe reminded me we took the orb from Mt. Pyre. Twice. I'd rather not discuss it.
Team Magma's leader and Mt. Pyre's ghost girl. The mountain and its keeper.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: The mountain's keeper loses. Also fitting.

Phoebe.greeting: Maxie! The spirits are still mad at you! ...Okay, let's battle anyway.
Phoebe.trainerWins: The spirits are a little less mad now!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are even madder now!

Phoebe.greeting: Maxie! The spirits are still mad at you! But they'll cheer if we win! Ahaha!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are even madder! Defeat!

Phoebe.greeting: Maxie, apologize to the spirits, then let's win!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The scholar of Rustboro. Study the earth, and you'll understand my goals.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Understanding the earth leads to victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: The earth gave way beneath us.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Roxanne called my goals "scientifically reckless." She brought citations. I was impressed.
Team Magma's leader and Rustboro's scholar. Ambition and research.

Roxanne.greeting: Maxie. I've studied geology. Your goals are scientifically reckless.
Maxie's geology is advanced, but his ethics need work! Let's at least battle well!
Maxie, let's apply proper scientific method to this battle!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Aqua's admin. Keep your sea talk to yourself.
Shelly laughed at my glasses. Twice. Keep your sea talk to yourself today, admin.
Team Magma's leader and Team Aqua's admin. Land and sea, bickering.

Shelly.greeting: Ahahaha! Maxie! You're even grumpier up close!
Ahahaha! Maxie's even grumpier up close! I'll battle with him just to annoy him!
Ahahaha! Maxie, try to keep up with the tide!
Shelly.trainerWins: Ahahaha! The landlubber kept up with the tide!
Shelly.trainerLoses: Ahahaha! The landlubber sank like a rock!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Elite Four's punk. Your attitude is... tolerable today.
Sidney called me "glasses guy" and asked if I knew how to have fun. I do. It involves winning.
Team Magma's leader and the Elite Four's punk. Order and noise.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Order and noise, an unlikely victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Order and noise, a predictable defeat.

Sidney.greeting: Hey hey, Maxie! Glasses guy! Let's have a wild one!
Sidney.trainerWins: Wild one, glasses guy! We won!
Sidney.trainerLoses: Wild one, glasses guy! We lost!

Sidney.greeting: Maxie wouldn't laugh at any of my jokes! Not one! Let's see if a win cracks him!
Sidney.trainerLoses: Not even a smirk! And we lost!

Sidney.greeting: Maxie, loosen up! It's just a battle!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Steven Stone. You've interfered with Team Magma more than once.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Even you couldn't interfere with that loss.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Steven Stone interfered with Team Magma at every turn. Today, I'll let him help me instead.
Team Magma's leader and Hoenn's Champion. Land and stone.

Steven.greeting: Maxie. And I'll keep doing it. For today, let's just win.
Steven.trainerWins: We won. I'll still be watching you.
Steven.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll keep watching anyway.

Elesa.greeting: N, let's light up this battle like the Ferris wheel at night!
Elesa.trainerWins: Lit up like the Ferris wheel!
Elesa.trainerLoses: The lights went out on the wheel!

N.greeting: Ghetsis. You raised me. You used me. Today, I'll battle beside you. Only today.
N.trainerWins: We won. I did it my way, not yours.
N.trainerLoses: We lost. I did it my way, and I don't regret it.

N.greeting: Ghetsis raised me in a room full of toys and lies. Today, I battle beside him. Only today.
N.trainerWins: We won. I won't do this again.
N.trainerLoses: We lost. My friends seem relieved.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and the man who made him one. Truth and deceit.
N.trainerWins: Truth outlasted deceit. Victory.
N.trainerLoses: Deceit outlasted truth today.

Ghetsis.greeting: N. Do as I say, as you always did. Win.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: As expected. You did as I said.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Failure. You never did learn obedience.

Ghetsis.greeting: N, do as I say. As you always did. Win, and nothing more.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: He did as I said. Victory.

Ghetsis.greeting: N, obey. For one battle, obey.

N.greeting: Grimsley. Your partners are tired of your gambling, but they love you anyway.
N.trainerWins: Your partners are glad you bet on them.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners forgive you. They always do.

N.greeting: Grimsley's partners are tired of his gambling, but they love him anyway. They told me so.
N.trainerWins: Love won the bet.
N.trainerLoses: Love lost the bet, but stayed.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and the Elite Four's gambler. Truth and risk.
N.trainerWins: Truth and risk, rewarded.
N.trainerLoses: Truth and risk, punished.

Grimsley.greeting: N. Then I'll bet on them. Let's battle.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The bet on them paid off.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even my best bet lost today.

Grimsley.greeting: N says my Pokémon love me despite my gambling. Then I'll bet everything on them.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Everything on them. Paid out.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Everything on them. Lost. Still worth it.

Grimsley.greeting: N, tell my partners I'm betting on them today.
Grimsley.trainerWins: He told them. They won.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: He told them. They lost. Unlucky.

N.greeting: Iris. Your dragons are so happy. You must be a wonderful partner.
N.trainerWins: Your dragons are dancing. They're so proud.
N.trainerLoses: Your dragons say it's okay. They still love you.

N.greeting: Iris's dragons are so happy. She must be a wonderful partner. I wanted to tell her myself.
N.trainerWins: Her dragons are roaring with joy. Victory.
N.trainerLoses: Her dragons are still smiling. Even now.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Unova's young Champion. Truth and dragons.
N.trainerWins: Truth and dragons, roaring victory.
N.trainerLoses: Truth and dragons, quiet defeat.

Iris.greeting: N! You can talk to Pokémon? That's so cool! Let's win!
Iris.trainerWins: My dragons are happy? Yay! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: Tell my dragons I'm sorry, okay?

Iris.greeting: N can talk to Pokémon?! That's so cool! Ask my dragons if they like me! Then let's win!
Iris.trainerWins: They like me! And we won!
Iris.trainerLoses: They still like me! Even though we lost!

Iris.greeting: N, let's make my dragons proud!
Iris.trainerWins: They're so proud! Victory!

N.greeting: Lenora. I'm sorry about the Dragon Skull. Team Plasma had no right.
N.trainerWins: That's better history. I'm glad.
N.trainerLoses: History isn't always kind. I'm still sorry.

N.greeting: Lenora's museum lost its skull because of my team. I've apologized. She accepted. I want to do more.
N.trainerWins: Doing more, starting with victory.
N.trainerLoses: Doing more, starting with... defeat.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Nacrene's museum director. A wrong, made right.
N.trainerWins: A wrong made right, with a victory.
N.trainerLoses: A wrong made right, despite defeat.

Lenora.greeting: N. Thank you. Let's make some better history today.
Lenora.trainerWins: Better history, made together.
Lenora.trainerLoses: History's lessons are hard sometimes.

Lenora.greeting: N's apology was sincere. Let's make better history today, together.
Lenora.trainerWins: Better history, made together!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History... rewritten later!

Lenora.greeting: N, let's write a new chapter. A kinder one.
Lenora.trainerWins: A kinder chapter, and a victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: A kinder chapter, and a lesson!

N.greeting: Marlon. Your partners ride the waves with you. They're so free.
N.trainerWins: Your partners felt free out there.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners say the waves will come again.

N.greeting: Marlon's partners ride the waves with him like friends, not tools. They're so free.
N.trainerWins: Free and victorious.
N.trainerLoses: Free, even in defeat.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Humilau's surfer. His friends call the sea their second home.
N.trainerWins: Their second home brought them victory.
N.trainerLoses: Their second home was rough today.

Marlon.greeting: N, dude! You totally get it! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Totally got it, dude! We won!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out, but you still get it!

Marlon.greeting: N totally gets my Pokémon, dude! He says they love surfing! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: N was right, they love it! Victory, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: N says they're still stoked, even after that!

Marlon.greeting: N, tell my Pokémon to ride the biggest wave of their lives!
Marlon.trainerWins: They rode it! N, tell 'em they're gnarly!
Marlon.trainerLoses: They wiped out! N, tell 'em it's okay!

N.greeting: Marshal. I defeated your master once. Your partners still remember.
N.trainerWins: As allies, we won. Your partners are glad.
N.trainerLoses: As allies, we lost. They're still glad.

N.greeting: I defeated Marshal's master at the League. His partners still remember. So does he.
N.trainerWins: Remembered, and victorious.
N.trainerLoses: Remembered, and defeated.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Alder's student. Old wounds, new trust.
N.trainerWins: New trust, earned in victory.
N.trainerLoses: New trust, tested in defeat.

Marshal.greeting: N. And I remember. Let us fight as allies now.
N. I remember. But we fight as allies now.
Marshal.trainerWins: Allies, and victorious. Master would approve.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Allies, and defeated. Master would understand.

Marshal.greeting: N. Speak to my partners. They will listen to you.
Marshal.trainerWins: They listened, and fought with heart. Victory.
Marshal.trainerLoses: They listened. It was not enough.

N.greeting: Roxie. Your partners love your music. It makes them feel brave.
N.trainerWins: Your partners felt brave the whole time.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners were brave. Even in defeat.

N.greeting: Roxie's partners love her music. It makes them feel brave. I told her, and she turned up the volume.
N.trainerWins: Brave and loud, and victorious.
N.trainerLoses: Brave and loud, and defeated.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Virbank's rock star. Truth and noise.
N.trainerWins: Truth and noise, a victorious anthem.
N.trainerLoses: Truth and noise, a sad ballad.

Roxie.greeting: N! Really?! Let's rock out, then!
Roxie.trainerWins: Rocked out! They felt brave? Awesome!
Roxie.trainerLoses: They were brave! We just lost!

Roxie.greeting: N says my music makes my Pokémon brave! I'm gonna play LOUDER! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Louder music, braver Pokémon, victory!

Roxie.greeting: N, tell my Pokémon this is their concert!
Roxie.trainerWins: Their concert, their victory!

N.greeting: Shauntal. You write about Pokémon and people. I'd like to read one.
N.trainerWins: A happy chapter. I'd like to read it.
N.trainerLoses: A sad chapter. I'd still read it.

N.greeting: Shauntal writes about Pokémon and people. I'd like to read one of her books. She said I'm in the next one.
N.trainerWins: A chapter with a happy ending.
N.trainerLoses: A chapter with a twist.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Unova's ghost writer. Truth and fiction.
N.trainerWins: Truth and fiction, a bestseller.
N.trainerLoses: Truth and fiction, out of print.

Shauntal.greeting: N! The King of Team Plasma, in my novel! Let's battle first!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The King and I, victorious! Into the novel!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The King's chapter ends in defeat!

Shauntal.greeting: N, the former King of Team Plasma, in my novel! The tragic prince! Let's write him a victory!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The tragic prince wins! What a chapter!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The tragic prince falls! Even more tragic!

Shauntal.greeting: N, let's write the climax together!
Shauntal.trainerWins: A thrilling climax! Victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: A tragic climax! Defeat!

N.greeting: Skyla. Your birds love the sky as much as you do.
N.trainerWins: Your birds are singing. They love the win.
N.trainerLoses: Your birds are quiet. They'll sing again.

N.greeting: Skyla's birds love the sky as much as she does. They told me she sings to them on long flights.
N.trainerWins: Sung to victory.
N.trainerLoses: Sung through defeat.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and Mistralton's pilot. Her birds feel free in the clouds.
N.trainerWins: Free in the clouds, victorious.
N.trainerLoses: Free in the clouds, but grounded today.

Skyla.greeting: N! The sky's big enough for everyone's dreams! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerWins: Big sky, big dreams, big win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Dreams still big, even after that!

Skyla.greeting: N says my birds like my singing! Nobody else does! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerWins: Soared with a song in our hearts! Victory!

Skyla.greeting: N, ask my birds how high they want to fly today!

N.greeting: Zinzolin. You never really listened to me. Will you now?
N.trainerWins: You listened. We won.
N.trainerLoses: You didn't listen. We lost.

N.greeting: Zinzolin never listened to me when I was king. Today, perhaps he will.
N.trainerWins: He listened, for once. Victory.
N.trainerLoses: He didn't listen. Some things never change.

N.greeting: Team Plasma's former king and its coldest sage. Old loyalties, slowly thawing.
N.trainerWins: Thawed loyalties, warm victory.
N.trainerLoses: Old loyalties, frozen in defeat.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord N. I will... for this one battle.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: I listened, Lord N. And we won.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: I listened, Lord N. Yet we lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord N. I will listen... for this one battle. It's colder without your orders.
Lord N, give the order. I'll freeze them solid, as I froze Opelucid.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Frozen solid on Lord N's order. Victory.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: They thawed despite Lord N's order. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Alder. The old Champion. Your free spirit was always a weakness.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Your free spirit failed us. As I knew it would.

Ghetsis.greeting: Alder, the Champion who wandered while Unova burned. Today, your wandering finally serves a purpose: mine.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Your purpose served mine. As it should.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Even as my tool, you disappoint, old man.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and Unova's faded Champion. One rises, one fades.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: The one who rises claims victory.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The faded one dragged us down.

Alder.greeting: Ghetsis. And your greed was always yours. Let's just win this.
Alder.trainerWins: Ha! Greed didn't ruin it this time!
Alder.trainerLoses: Greed and freedom both lost today.

Alder.greeting: Ghetsis. I'll battle beside you for my partners' sake. Not yours. Never yours.
Alder.trainerWins: For my partners! Ha! Victory!
Alder.trainerLoses: For my partners... we'll do better without him!

Alder.greeting: Ghetsis, keep your hands off my Pokémon and we'll get along fine!
Alder.trainerWins: Hands off, battle won! Ha!
Alder.trainerLoses: Hands off, battle lost! Still worth it!

Ghetsis.greeting: Bianca. Juniper's little helper. Stay out of my way.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You stayed out of my way. Adequate.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You were in my way. Pathetic.

Ghetsis.greeting: Bianca, Juniper's trembling little helper. Stay out of my way, girl, and you may be useful.
Team Plasma's true ruler and a scared little research assistant. How amusing.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Even the scared ones serve me.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The scared one cost me. Naturally.

Bianca.greeting: Ghetsis... you're so scary! But I'll battle! For my partners!
Bianca.trainerWins: I battled for my partners! And we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I tried my best for my partners...

Bianca.greeting: Ghetsis is so scary! My knees are shaking! But I'll battle for my partners! Not for him!
Bianca.trainerWins: For my partners! We won! Take that!
Bianca.trainerLoses: For my partners... I'm sorry, everyone!

Bianca.greeting: Ghetsis, please be nice to my Pokémon! Please!
Bianca.trainerWins: He didn't hurt them! And we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: He scared them... and we lost!

Ghetsis.greeting: Brycen. A retired actor. How fitting that you play hero now.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: A poor performance. Even for an actor.

Ghetsis.greeting: Brycen, a retired actor playing hero. How fitting. Let's see if he can play a winner for me.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: He played the part I wrote. Victory.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and Icirrus's washed-up star. A villain needs a supporting cast.

Brycen.greeting: Ghetsis. I play nothing. Let us battle.
Ghetsis, I play no part for you. I battle for my partners. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: My partners won. Not you. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: My partners lost. Not for you. Hm.

Brycen.greeting: Ghetsis, let us end this scene quickly. I'd rather not share the stage. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Scene ended. Victory. Leave the stage. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Scene ended. Defeat. Leave anyway. Hm.

Ghetsis.greeting: Burgh. Your art will never capture true power.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Your art is all you'll have left.

Ghetsis.greeting: Burgh paints pretty pictures of insects. Art will never capture true power. I'll show him what power looks like.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Castelia's dabbler. Power and pigment.

Burgh.greeting: Ghetsis. True power isn't something I'd want to paint.
Burgh.trainerWins: I won't paint this. Not even the victory.
Burgh.trainerLoses: I'll paint this loss. Without you in it.

Burgh.greeting: Ghetsis, true power isn't something I'd ever want to paint! I'll battle, but my art stays mine!
Burgh.trainerWins: A victory painted my way!
Burgh.trainerLoses: A defeat... but at least it's not his painting!

Burgh.greeting: Ghetsis, let my bugs show you what real beauty is!
Burgh.trainerWins: Real beauty won! Paint that, Ghetsis!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Real beauty lost... but it's still beautiful!

Ghetsis.greeting: Caitlin. Try to stay awake. I won't carry you.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You fell asleep. I knew it.

Ghetsis.greeting: Caitlin, the sleepy princess. Try to stay awake. I won't carry you through this.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: She stayed awake long enough to be useful.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and the Battle Castle's lady. Power and privilege.

Caitlin.greeting: Ghetsis. Your voice is enough to keep anyone awake. Unfortunately.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Awake, and victorious. Your voice did help.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Your voice kept me awake for this? Tiresome.

Caitlin.greeting: Ghetsis's voice could keep anyone awake. Unfortunately. Let's battle.
Ghetsis, please stop speaking. I'm trying to concentrate.

Ghetsis.greeting: Cheren. You stood against Team Plasma twice. A persistent boy.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Your lesson was irrelevant. We won.

Ghetsis.greeting: Cheren stood against Team Plasma twice. A persistent boy. Annoyingly persistent.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Aspertia's schoolteacher. Power and principle.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Principle cost us this battle. Revolting.

Cheren.greeting: Ghetsis. I'm a teacher now. Today's lesson: you don't win alone.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson learned: nobody wins alone.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even teachers lose. Lesson noted.

Cheren.greeting: Ghetsis, I'm a teacher now. Today's lesson for you: you don't win alone.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson proven. He didn't win alone.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Lesson ignored. He lost anyway.

Cheren.greeting: Ghetsis, follow my strategy. Just this once.
Cheren.trainerWins: He followed it, grudgingly. Victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: He ignored it, arrogantly. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Chili. Control your temper, or I'll control it for you.
Chili, control that temper, or I'll control it for you. I've controlled far greater things.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Striaton's hotheaded waiter. A leash for the flame.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The flame slipped its leash. Defeat.

Chili.greeting: Ghetsis! Just try it! ...After we win!
Ghetsis thinks he can control me?! Ha! Nobody controls my fire! But fine, let's win!
Chili.trainerLoses: My fire... burned out! Not his fault! Mostly!

Chili.greeting: Ghetsis, step back and watch real passion!
Chili.trainerWins: Real passion won! Watch and learn!

Ghetsis.greeting: Cilan. Spare me your commentary.
Cilan, spare me your culinary commentary. I didn't come here to be served opinions.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Striaton's critic. Power and palate.

Cilan.greeting: Ghetsis. This battle has a bitter aftertaste already.
Cilan.trainerWins: A sweet victory, with a bitter aftertaste!
Cilan.trainerLoses: A bitter defeat, with a bitter aftertaste.

Cilan.greeting: Ghetsis's presence has a bitter, overcooked aftertaste! But let's battle anyway! It's evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: Evaluation: a victory despite the bitterness!

Cilan.greeting: Ghetsis, let's serve them a dish they'll never forget!
Cilan.trainerWins: A dish they'll never forget! Delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: A dish we'll never forget! Disgusting!

Ghetsis.greeting: Clay. Driftveil's mine boss. Useful muscle.
Clay, Driftveil's mine boss. Useful muscle for today. Do as you're told.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: He did as he pleased. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and a stubborn miner. Power and pickaxe.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: The pickaxe struck where I pointed.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The pickaxe struck the wrong vein.

Clay.greeting: Ghetsis. I ain't your muscle. Let's just get this done.
Clay.trainerWins: Done. And I ain't your muscle.
Clay.trainerLoses: Done. Don't call me again.

Clay.greeting: Ghetsis, I ain't your muscle and I ain't takin' orders! Let's just get this done and go home!
Clay.trainerWins: Done, and I'm goin' home! Hmph!
Clay.trainerLoses: Lost, and I'm still goin' home! Hmph!

Clay.greeting: Ghetsis, stay outta my way and let my Ground types work!
Clay.trainerWins: They worked! Victory! Now scram!
Clay.trainerLoses: They worked... we lost anyway! Hmph!

Ghetsis.greeting: Colress. My scientist. Prove your research was worth funding.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Your research was worth funding after all.

Ghetsis.greeting: Colress, my former scientist. Prove your research was worth every coin I poured into it.
Team Plasma's true ruler and his wayward genius. Ambition and analysis.

Colress.greeting: Ghetsis. My research belongs to no one now. But I'll battle.
Colress.trainerWins: My research, my win. Not yours.
Colress.trainerLoses: My research belongs to no one. Neither does this loss.

Colress.greeting: Ghetsis, my research belongs to no one now. But I'll battle, for the data alone.
Colress.trainerWins: Data collected: Pokémon prevail, not Ghetsis.
Colress.trainerLoses: Data collected: defeat. Still more useful than him.

Colress.greeting: Ghetsis, let's see what Pokémon can truly do when nobody controls them.

Ghetsis.greeting: Cress. Serve us a victory.
Cress, serve us a victory. As you serve tea, without complaint.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Striaton's composed server. Master and servant.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The servant failed the master. Defeat.

Cress.greeting: Ghetsis. I'll serve, but not you. Let's begin.
Cress.trainerWins: I served a win. Not for you.

Cress.greeting: Ghetsis, I'll serve, but not you. My partners deserve my service. Let's begin.
Cress.trainerWins: My partners were well served. Victory.

Cress.greeting: Ghetsis, let us battle with dignity. Mine, at least.

Ghetsis.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's mayor. Your city froze once. Remember?
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Opelucid remembers. So do I. Victory.

Ghetsis.greeting: Drayden, your city froze once. You remember who did it, I'm sure. Let's battle anyway.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: He remembers, and he served me well.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: He remembers, and he failed me.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and Opelucid's mayor. The one who froze it, and the one who thawed it.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: The one who froze it wins again.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The one who thawed it wins again. Infuriating.

Drayden.greeting: Ghetsis. I remember who froze it. Let us battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: We won. I still remember who froze it.
Drayden.trainerLoses: We lost. The city will not forget either.

Drayden.greeting: Ghetsis, I remember who froze Opelucid. I battle for my dragons today. Nothing more.
Drayden.trainerWins: My dragons won. Not you.
Drayden.trainerLoses: My dragons lost. Not for you.

Drayden.greeting: Ghetsis, keep your schemes away from my dragons.
Drayden.trainerWins: No schemes. Victory.
Drayden.trainerLoses: One scheme too many. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Elesa. Glamour is a tool. Use it.
Elesa, glamour is a tool. Use it as one. For me.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Nimbasa's model. Power in the spotlight.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Power in the spotlight, blinding them.

Elesa.greeting: Ghetsis. My glamour isn't for you. Let's battle.
Elesa.trainerWins: My glamour won. Not for you.

Elesa.greeting: Ghetsis, my glamour is for my fans and my Pokémon. Never for you. Let's battle.
Elesa.trainerWins: For my fans! Victory!

Elesa.greeting: Ghetsis, stand back. Let my Pokémon dazzle them.
Elesa.trainerWins: He stood back. We dazzled. Victory!
Elesa.trainerLoses: He stepped forward. We fizzled. Defeat!

Ghetsis.greeting: Grimsley. A gambler. You'll lose eventually.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You'll lose eventually. Not today, it seems.

Ghetsis.greeting: Grimsley, a gambler. Gamblers always lose eventually. I'll make sure it isn't today.
Team Plasma's true ruler and the Elite Four's gambler. Power and chance.

Grimsley.greeting: Ghetsis. Not today. I'm betting against you.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Bet against you, and still won.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Bet against you. Lost both ways.

Grimsley.greeting: Ghetsis, I'd usually bet against you. Today, we play the same table. I don't like it.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The table paid out. I still don't like it.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The table took everything. I like that even less.

Grimsley.greeting: Ghetsis, let's play one hand together. Just one.
Grimsley.trainerWins: One hand, won. Never again.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: One hand, lost. Never again.

Ghetsis.greeting: Iris. A child Champion. Pathetic.
Iris, a child wearing a Champion's crown. Pathetic. But her dragons are powerful. Use them.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Unova's child Champion. Power and naïveté.

Iris.greeting: Ghetsis! I'm not pathetic! I'll show you!
Iris.trainerWins: See? Not pathetic! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: I'm not pathetic! I'll beat you next time!

Iris.greeting: Ghetsis called me pathetic! I'm not pathetic! My dragons are gonna show him!
Iris.trainerWins: My dragons showed him! Victory!
Iris.trainerLoses: My dragons tried! He's still mean!

Iris.greeting: Ghetsis, watch my dragons and stop being mean!
Iris.trainerWins: He watched! We won! Still mean!
Iris.trainerLoses: He watched us lose! Still mean!

Ghetsis.greeting: Lenora. Your museum's skull made a fine gift.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: A fine gift, and a fine win.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The skull is cursed. As are we.

Ghetsis.greeting: Lenora's museum skull made a fine gift to Team Plasma. She still resents it. Good.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Nacrene's museum keeper. History is written by the victors.

Lenora.greeting: Ghetsis. It was never yours to give. Let's battle.
Lenora.trainerWins: We won. The skull's still not yours.
Lenora.trainerLoses: We lost. The skull is still not yours.

Lenora.greeting: Ghetsis stole from my museum! I'll battle beside him, but my exhibits stay locked!
Lenora.trainerWins: Exhibits locked, battle won!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Exhibits locked, battle lost!

Lenora.greeting: Ghetsis, keep your hands off my exhibits, and away from my Pokémon!
Lenora.trainerWins: Hands off! Victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Hands off... still lost!

Ghetsis.greeting: Marlon. Your carefree attitude disgusts me.
Marlon showed up barefoot with sand in his hair. His carefree attitude disgusts me. Battle, surfer.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Humilau's beach bum. Control and chaos.

Marlon.greeting: Ghetsis, dude. Lighten up! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Lightened up, dude! We won!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Should've lightened up, dude.

Marlon.greeting: Ghetsis is so uptight, dude! Lighten up! The sea doesn't care about your plans! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Rode it without him! Victory, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out! His bad vibes, man!

Marlon.greeting: Ghetsis, chill out and let the waves do their thing, man!
Marlon.trainerWins: The waves did their thing! Victory!
Marlon.trainerLoses: The waves did... the wrong thing!

Ghetsis.greeting: Marshal. Alder's student. Weak, like his master.
Marshal, Alder's loyal student. As weak as his master, I'd wager.
Team Plasma's true ruler and the Elite Four's silent fist. Power and discipline.

Marshal.greeting: Ghetsis. My master is stronger than you'll ever be.
Marshal.trainerWins: My master is stronger. And so am I.
Marshal.trainerLoses: My master would have won this.

Marshal.greeting: Ghetsis. My master is stronger than you'll ever be. I fight for him today. Not you.
Ghetsis. Stand aside. I will strike.
Marshal.trainerWins: Struck true. Victory. Stand aside still.

Ghetsis.greeting: Roxie. Turn your noise down.
Roxie, turn your noise down. Your guitar is an insult to my ears.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Virbank's punk rocker. Order and noise.

Roxie.greeting: Ghetsis! Turn it down? Never! This one's for every Pokémon you hurt!
Roxie.trainerWins: That one was for them! We won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: I'll keep playing for them, even after this!

Roxie.greeting: Turn it down? Never! This battle's for every Pokémon Team Plasma ever hurt! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: For every hurt Pokémon! Victory!
Roxie.trainerLoses: For every hurt Pokémon... I'll play louder next time!

Roxie.greeting: Ghetsis, plug your ears! I'm turning it up!
Roxie.trainerWins: Turned it up and won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Turned it up and lost! Still loud!

Ghetsis.greeting: Shauntal. Write about me. Make me the hero.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Even villains can be heroes. Not today.

Ghetsis.greeting: Shauntal, write about me. Make me the hero of your novel, or don't write at all.
Team Plasma's true ruler and Unova's ghost writer. Power and pen.

Shauntal.greeting: Ghetsis. I'll write you as the villain. Let's battle.
Shauntal.trainerWins: The villain won. That's... a plot twist.
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The villain lost. As he should.

Shauntal.greeting: Ghetsis, I'll write you as the villain. You're perfect for it. Let's battle.
Shauntal.trainerWins: The villain won this chapter! Ugh!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The villain lost this chapter! Good!

Shauntal.greeting: Ghetsis, this chapter needs a twist. Lose gracefully.
Shauntal.trainerWins: No twist. Victory.
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The twist! Defeat! Perfect!

Ghetsis.greeting: Skyla. Fly where I tell you.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You flew where I told you. Victory.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You flew where you wanted. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Skyla, fly where I tell you. That is all I require.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: She flew where she pleased. Defeat.

Ghetsis.greeting: Team Plasma's true ruler and Mistralton's pilot. Command and freedom.

Skyla.greeting: Ghetsis! I fly where I want! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerWins: I flew where I wanted, and we won!
Skyla.trainerLoses: I flew where I wanted... we lost!

Skyla.greeting: Ghetsis! I fly where I want! My birds aren't anyone's tools! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Flew where we wanted... and crashed!

Skyla.greeting: Ghetsis, watch real flying!

Ghetsis.greeting: Zinzolin. My fellow Sage. Let us remind them who we are.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: They don't remember us, it seems.

Ghetsis.greeting: Zinzolin, my fellow Sage. Loyal to the end. Let us remind them who Team Plasma's Sages are.
Team Plasma's true ruler and his frozen Sage. Power and frost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord Ghetsis. As you wish.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: As you wished, Lord Ghetsis. Victory.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord Ghetsis. As you wish. My ice serves you, as it froze Opelucid for you.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: My ice served you well, Lord Ghetsis.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: My ice melted, Lord Ghetsis. Forgive me.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord Ghetsis, I'll freeze them. You crush them.
Alder. The free-spirited former Champion. How chilly of you to join me.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: How chilly of you to win with me.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: The cold has no mercy, even for us.

Zinzolin.greeting: Alder wore his scarf to the battle. Wise. It's about to get very, very cold.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Unova's wandering Champion. Frost on the open road.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Frost on the road, and they slipped.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Frost on the road, and we slipped.

Alder.greeting: Zinzolin. You froze Opelucid. I haven't forgotten. Let's battle.
Alder.trainerWins: Won. I still haven't forgotten Opelucid.
Alder.trainerLoses: Lost. Opelucid's still not forgotten.

Alder.greeting: Zinzolin froze Opelucid! I haven't forgotten! But my partners want to battle, so I'll battle! Ha!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha! My partners won! Still haven't forgotten!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha! My partners lost! Still mad at you!

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Zinzolin, warm up a little! Smile!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Almost a smile! Victory!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Frozen frown! Defeat!

Zinzolin.greeting: Bianca. Juniper's assistant. Stand behind me, child.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: You stood in front of me. Defeat.

Zinzolin.greeting: Bianca shivered the moment she stood near me. Good. The cold builds character, child.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Juniper's assistant. Winter and wonder.

Bianca.greeting: Zinzolin! I'm not a child! Let's battle!
Bianca.trainerWins: I'm not a child! We won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I'm still not a child! Even if we lost!

Bianca.greeting: Zinzolin keeps calling me a child! I'm Professor Juniper's assistant! I'll prove it!
Bianca.trainerWins: Proved it! We won! Not a child!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Didn't prove it... but still not a child!

Bianca.greeting: Zinzolin, please don't freeze my Pokémon's toes!
Bianca.trainerWins: No frozen toes! Victory!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Frozen toes! Defeat! Brrr!

Zinzolin.greeting: Brycen. A fellow lover of ice. Finally, someone civilized.
Brycen, a fellow lover of ice. Finally, someone civilized to battle beside.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Icirrus's ice master. Two kinds of cold.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Two kinds of cold, freezing victory.

Brycen.greeting: Zinzolin. Ice is not for crimes. Let us battle.
Brycen.trainerLoses: Ice can't be used for crimes, or for winning, it seems.

Brycen.greeting: Zinzolin, ice is not for crimes. I'll battle beside you, but my ice is for honor. Hm!
Zinzolin, freeze them with honor. Hm!

Zinzolin.greeting: Burgh. Paint us a frozen landscape.
Burgh's colors are too warm. I asked him to paint something frozen. He painted me sneezing.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Castelia's painter. Frost on the canvas.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Frost on the canvas, beautifully still.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Frost on the canvas, dripping away.

Burgh.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll paint you losing. Let's battle!
Burgh.trainerWins: Painted you winning. Not losing. Strange!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Painted you losing! Didn't expect myself in the picture!

Burgh.greeting: Zinzolin wants a frozen painting! I'll paint him a winter scene... with us winning!
Burgh.trainerWins: The winter scene's finished, and we won!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The winter scene's got a sad ending!

Burgh.greeting: Zinzolin, let my bugs add a splash of warmth!
Burgh.trainerWins: A splash of warmth, a burst of victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: A splash of warmth... melted his ice!

Zinzolin.greeting: Caitlin. Elegance and ice. A fine pairing.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: A fine pairing, as I said.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: A poor pairing, in the end.

Zinzolin.greeting: Caitlin, elegance and ice. A fine pairing, if she'd only accept the cold.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and the Battle Castle's lady. Frost and grace.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Frost and grace, a chilling victory.

Caitlin.greeting: Zinzolin. Elegance, yes. Ice, no thank you.
Zinzolin, elegance, yes. Ice, no thank you. It ruins my nap.
Zinzolin, keep your cold away from me.

Zinzolin.greeting: Cheren. The teacher. Teach them about cold.
Cheren lectured me about Opelucid for twenty minutes. I let him. The cold is patient.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Aspertia's teacher. A cold classroom.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: A cold classroom, a passing grade.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: A cold classroom, a failing grade.

Cheren.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll teach them about teamwork. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Teamwork taught. Victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Teamwork taught. Not learned.

Cheren.greeting: Zinzolin, today's lesson isn't about cold. It's about working together. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Teamwork, even with Zinzolin. Lesson complete.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Teamwork with Zinzolin. Lesson failed.

Cheren.greeting: Zinzolin, follow my plan. No freezing cities.
Cheren.trainerWins: No cities frozen, one battle won.
Cheren.trainerLoses: No cities frozen, one battle lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Chili. You're too hot for my taste.
Chili stood next to me and my ice started sweating. Keep your distance, young man.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: He kept his distance. A cool victory.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: He came closer. A soggy defeat.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Striaton's hothead. A battle of temperatures.

Chili.greeting: Zinzolin! Good! Let's burn 'em!
Zinzolin thinks I'm too hot?! Good! I'll burn 'em, he'll freeze 'em! Hot and cold!
Chili.trainerLoses: Hot and cold... just made a puddle!

Chili.greeting: Zinzolin, let me warm you up a little!
Chili.trainerWins: He warmed up! A little! Victory!

Zinzolin.greeting: Cilan. Spare me your culinary metaphors.
Cilan asked if my ice could chill his desserts. I said yes, after we win.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Striaton's connoisseur. A frozen course.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: A frozen course, melted on the plate.

Cilan.greeting: Zinzolin. This battle is... a cold dish. Let's begin.
Zinzolin's battles have the crisp bite of a frozen sorbet! It's evaluation time!
Zinzolin, let's serve them a dish best eaten cold!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Served to us cold! Bitter defeat!

Zinzolin.greeting: Clay. Driftveil's miner. Dig us a victory.
Clay, Driftveil's miner. Dig us a victory. Through frozen ground, if need be.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Driftveil's miner. Ice and earth.

Clay.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll dig, but not for you. Let's get to work.
Clay.trainerWins: Dug the win. Not for you.
Clay.trainerLoses: Dug. Still lost.

Clay.greeting: Zinzolin, I'll dig, but not for you! For Driftveil! Let's get to work!
Clay.trainerWins: For Driftveil! Victory!
Clay.trainerLoses: For Driftveil... sorry, folks!

Clay.greeting: Zinzolin, freeze it, I'll dig it!
Clay.trainerWins: Frozen and dug! Victory!
Clay.trainerLoses: Frozen, couldn't dig! Defeat!

Zinzolin.greeting: Colress. Your science froze Opelucid. Well done.
Colress's science froze Opelucid. Well done, I told him. He didn't seem pleased.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and its reformed scientist. Ice and innovation.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Ice and innovation, a frozen triumph.

Colress.greeting: Zinzolin. That was not my finest moment. Let's battle.
Colress.trainerWins: Not my finest moment, but a fine win.

Colress.greeting: Zinzolin, that was not my finest moment. Today, let's use science for better ends.
Zinzolin, let's test your ice under controlled conditions.

Zinzolin.greeting: Cress. Cold water. I approve.
Cress, cold water. I approve. Your composure is almost frozen.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Striaton's composed one. Ice and still water.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Ice and still water, a frozen lake.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Ice and still water, a puddle.

Cress.greeting: Zinzolin. Your approval is unnecessary. Let's begin.
Zinzolin, your approval is unnecessary. But let's begin.
Zinzolin, let us remain composed. Coldly.

Zinzolin.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's mayor. Your city looked lovely frozen.
Drayden, Opelucid's mayor. Your city looked lovely frozen. I still think about it fondly.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: A lovely victory, frozen in memory.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and the mayor of the city he froze. Ice meets dragonfire.

Drayden.greeting: Zinzolin. You'll pay for that someday. Today, we battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: We won. You will still pay.
Drayden.trainerLoses: We lost. And you will still pay.

Drayden.greeting: Zinzolin, you'll answer for Opelucid someday. Today, I battle for my dragons. Nothing more.
Drayden.trainerWins: My dragons won. You still owe Opelucid.
Drayden.trainerLoses: My dragons lost. You still owe Opelucid.

Drayden.greeting: Zinzolin, keep your frost away from my dragons' wings.
Drayden.trainerWins: Their wings stayed clear. Victory.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Frost on their wings. Defeat.

Zinzolin.greeting: Elesa. Electric glamour. How warm.
Elesa, electric glamour. How warm. How unpleasant.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Nimbasa's star. Ice and spotlight.

Elesa.greeting: Zinzolin. My spotlight melts ice. Stay out of it.
Elesa.trainerWins: Stayed out of my spotlight. Thank you.

Elesa.greeting: Zinzolin, my spotlight melts ice! Stay out of it! Let's battle!
Elesa.trainerWins: Spotlight on! Victory!

Elesa.greeting: Zinzolin, let's give them a shocking freeze!
Elesa.trainerWins: Shocking freeze! Victory!

Zinzolin.greeting: Grimsley. Gamble on the cold.
Grimsley bet me his coat that the cold would lose. He's shivering already.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: His coat is mine, and so is the victory.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and the Elite Four's gambler. Cold odds.

Grimsley.greeting: Zinzolin. I gamble on myself. Let's battle.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Bet on myself. Won.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Bet on myself. Lost.

Grimsley.greeting: Zinzolin, I gamble on myself. Not on your ice. But let's play this hand.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Played my hand, won the pot.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Played my hand, lost my coat.

Grimsley.greeting: Zinzolin, let's go all in on the cold.
Grimsley.trainerWins: All in, and it paid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: All in, and it melted.

Zinzolin.greeting: Iris. Opelucid's girl. Your city froze beautifully.
Iris remembers Opelucid frozen. She glares at me constantly. Fitting, for a Champion.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: She glared the whole battle, and we won.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: She glared the whole battle, and we lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Opelucid's young Champion. Old frost, young fire.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Old frost and young fire, a strange victory.

Iris.greeting: Zinzolin! That was mean! Let's win anyway!
Iris.trainerWins: That was still mean! But we won!

Iris.greeting: Zinzolin froze my city! That was SO mean! But my dragons will win anyway!
Iris.trainerWins: My dragons won! Still mad at you!
Iris.trainerLoses: My dragons lost! Even madder now!

Iris.greeting: Zinzolin, keep your ice away from my dragons!
Iris.trainerWins: He kept it away! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: He froze my dragon's tail! We lost!

Zinzolin.greeting: Lenora. Your museum. Cold and quiet. I like it.
Lenora's museum is cold and quiet. I find it soothing. She finds me unsettling.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Nacrene's museum keeper. Frost preserves everything.

Lenora.greeting: Zinzolin. It's for history, not for you.
Lenora.trainerWins: For history, not for you. A win.
Lenora.trainerLoses: For history. Not a win.

Lenora.greeting: Zinzolin likes my museum because it's cold! That's not what it's for! But let's battle!
Lenora.trainerWins: History preserved, battle won!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History preserved, battle lost!

Lenora.greeting: Zinzolin, no frost on my exhibits!
Lenora.trainerWins: No frost! Victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Frost everywhere! Defeat!

Zinzolin.greeting: Marlon. The sea is too warm. Cool down.
Marlon's sea is far too warm. I suggested he cool it down. He offered me sunscreen.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Humilau's surfer. Frozen waves.

Marlon.greeting: Zinzolin, dude. Chill out. Let's ride.
Marlon.trainerWins: Chilled out, dude. We won.
Marlon.trainerLoses: Froze up, dude. Bummer.

Marlon.greeting: Zinzolin's so cold, dude! Chill out! Wait, that's his whole thing! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Chilled out and rode to victory!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Too chill! Wiped out!

Marlon.greeting: Zinzolin, freeze the waves, I'll surf 'em!
Marlon.trainerWins: Ice surfing! Gnarly win!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Slipped off the ice, dude!

Zinzolin.greeting: Marshal. Alder's student. Strong and silent. Good.
Marshal said four words to me before this battle. I appreciated every one.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and the Elite Four's silent fighter. Frost and fists.

Marshal.greeting: Zinzolin. Silence suits me. Strike when I strike.
Zinzolin. Cold. Quiet. Acceptable partner.
Zinzolin. Freeze them. I finish.

Zinzolin.greeting: Roxie. Too loud. Too warm.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Loud and warm, and somehow victorious.

Zinzolin.greeting: Roxie's amplifier melted the frost on my coat. Unacceptable. Battle quietly, if you can.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: She battled quietly. A miracle. Victory.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: She battled loudly. A disaster. Defeat.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Virbank's rock star. A frozen silence, a burning noise.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Silence and noise, an icy harmony.

Roxie.greeting: Zinzolin! Too loud? I'm just getting started! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Just getting started, and we won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Just getting started, and we lost!

Roxie.greeting: Zinzolin thinks I'm too loud?! I'm just getting started! This one's gonna be LOUD!
Roxie.trainerWins: So loud his frost melted! Victory!

Roxie.greeting: Zinzolin, plug your ears and freeze 'em!
Roxie.trainerWins: Plugged and frozen! Victory!

Zinzolin.greeting: Shauntal. Write about the cold.
Shauntal, write about the cold. It deserves a novel.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: The cold novel, out of print.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Unova's ghost writer. Ice and ink.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Ice and ink, a chilling tale.

Shauntal.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll write about you losing. Let's battle.
Shauntal.trainerWins: I wrote you winning? A plot twist!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: I wrote you losing. As predicted!

Shauntal.greeting: Zinzolin, I'll write about you losing! A cold-hearted villain gets what he deserves!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The villain won?! Rewrite!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The villain lost! Perfect ending!

Shauntal.greeting: Zinzolin, let's write a frozen chapter!
Shauntal.trainerWins: A frozen chapter! Victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: A melted chapter! Defeat!

Zinzolin.greeting: Skyla. The cold sky. Lovely.
Skyla, the cold sky at high altitude. Lovely. I'd stay up there forever.
Team Plasma's frozen Sage and Mistralton's pilot. Ice and altitude.

Skyla.greeting: Zinzolin! The sky's lovely when it's warm, too! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Grounded, even in this lovely sky!

Skyla.greeting: Zinzolin likes the cold sky! The sky's lovely when it's warm, too! Let's soar!
Zinzolin, let's fly through a blizzard!

Lysandre.greeting: Bryony. Elegant and merciless. Exactly as I like it.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Merciless, as I like. Well done.

Lysandre.greeting: Bryony is elegant and merciless. Exactly as a member of Team Flare should be.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Elegant, merciless and victorious. A beautiful result.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: Elegant and merciless, yet defeated. Unacceptable.

Lysandre.greeting: Team Flare's leader and his most elegant scientist. A beautiful world requires beautiful battles.
Lysandre.trainerWins: A beautiful battle, a beautiful victory.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: An ugly battle, an ugly defeat.

Bryony.greeting: Lysandre. Your praise is the only kind worth having.
Lysandre's praise is the only kind worth having. I intend to earn more of it today.
Lysandre, let me calculate their weakness. You strike.

Lysandre.greeting: Dexio. Sycamore's assistant. My old friend chose his students well.
Lysandre.trainerWins: My old friend's students. Well chosen.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: Sycamore's student. Tell him I said hello.

Lysandre.greeting: Dexio, Sycamore's assistant. My old friend chose his students well. Let's see how well.
Team Flare's leader and Sycamore's assistant. An old friendship, echoed.

Dexio.greeting: Lysandre... the Professor still talks about you. Let's just battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: We won. I'll tell the Professor.
Dexio.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll tell the Professor that too.

Dexio.greeting: Lysandre... the Professor still talks about you. With sadness. Let's just battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: Battled, and won. The Professor would be relieved.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Battled, and lost. The Professor would sigh.

Dexio.greeting: Lysandre, let's battle for the Professor's sake.

Lysandre.greeting: Diantha. You once came to my café for a quiet coffee. Today, a loud battle.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: A loud defeat. Coffee to console us?

Lysandre.greeting: Diantha once came to my café for a quiet coffee. Today, a loud battle. I prefer this.
Lysandre.trainerWins: A loud victory, better than coffee.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: A loud defeat, worse than cold coffee.

Lysandre.greeting: Team Flare's leader and Kalos's Champion. Beauty, on screen and in battle.

Diantha.greeting: Lysandre. I'll take the battle, as long as no world-ending weapon is involved.
Diantha.trainerWins: No weapons, just a win. I'll take it.
Diantha.trainerLoses: No weapons, and still a loss.

Diantha.greeting: Lysandre, I'll take the battle, as long as no world-ending weapon is involved. Promise?
Lysandre, let's make this battle beautiful. The kind that doesn't destroy anything.

Lysandre.greeting: Drasna. Your gentleness hides great strength. A beautiful contradiction.
Drasna offered me a cookie and told me to "stop scowling, dear." Nobody has said that to me in thirty years.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: A bitter defeat. No cookie can fix it.

Lysandre.greeting: Team Flare's leader and Kalos's gentle dragon master. A beautiful contradiction.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lysandre. You do say the loveliest things for a villain.
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my! Lovely things AND a victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh dear! Lovely things, but a loss!

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lysandre says such lovely things for a villain! Let's have a beautiful battle, dear!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, a beautiful victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, a beautiful... defeat.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lysandre, let's show them how lovely dragons can be!
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my, lovely and victorious!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my, lovely, but outmatched!

Lysandre.greeting: Mable. Team Flare's researcher. Put that mind to work.
Mable's research on Mega Evolution impressed me. Today, put that mind to work in battle.
