Hau.trainerWins: We won! That was out of this world!

Hau.greeting: Molayne showed me a planet through his telescope! It had rings! I want to battle there someday!
Hau.trainerWins: Battling on a ringed planet... someday! Victory now!
Hau.trainerLoses: Not on a ringed planet... and not today!

Hau.greeting: Ula'ula's stargazer and the Kahuna's grandson! Stars and smiles!
Hau.trainerWins: Stars and smiles, shining bright!

Molayne.greeting: Hau, the moon has very little gravity... but we'll win right here, I'm sure.
Molayne.trainerWins: Calculated and confirmed. A fine result.
Molayne.trainerLoses: An unexpected orbit. I'll study what went wrong.

Molayne.greeting: Hau wants to battle on Saturn. Physically impossible. Spiritually, admirable. Let's battle here.
Hau, aim like you're aiming for the ringed planet.
Molayne.trainerWins: He aimed for the rings, and hit victory.
Molayne.trainerLoses: He aimed for the rings, and missed everything.

Hau.greeting: Lillie's mom? Whoa. Uh, nice to meet you! Let's battle!
Hau.trainerWins: We won! Wait till Lillie hears about this!

Hau.greeting: Lillie's mom gave me a fancy cookie! It had gold leaf on it! I ate it in one bite! Was that okay?
Hau.trainerWins: One-bite victory!

Hau.greeting: Aether's President and Lillie's best friend! Fancy and fun!
Hau.trainerWins: Fancy and fun, victorious!

Lusamine.greeting: Lillie's little friend. How charming. Do try to keep up.
Lusamine.trainerWins: Beautiful. You were almost as lovely as I was.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Such an unlovely result. We shan't speak of it.

Lusamine.greeting: Lillie's friend ate a gold-leaf cookie in one bite. Charmingly uncivilized. Let's battle.
Hau, try to battle beautifully. For Lillie.

Hau.greeting: Faba's kinda grumpy, huh? Don't worry, I'll cheer him up with a win!
Hau.trainerWins: We won! See? Now you're smiling, Faba!

Hau.greeting: Faba frowned at me the whole elevator ride! I told him a joke! He didn't laugh! I'll cheer him up with a win!
Hau.trainerWins: He almost smiled! Victory!

Hau.greeting: Aether's Branch Chief and the Kahuna's grandson! Grumpy and happy!
Hau.trainerWins: Grumpy and happy, victorious!

Faba.greeting: Cheer me up? I am the Aether Foundation's finest mind, you child!
Faba.trainerWins: I am not smiling. This is my victory face.
Faba.trainerLoses: Grumpy?! I am furious! There's a difference!

Faba.greeting: The child told me a joke about malasadas. I, Faba, did not find it amusing. Let us battle.
Faba.trainerWins: I, Faba, am amused by victory.
Faba.trainerLoses: I, Faba, am not amused by defeat.

Faba.greeting: Child, follow my lead. Quietly.

Mallow.greeting: Lana's my best friend, and she's more dangerous than she looks! Right, Lana?
Mallow.trainerWins: We won! Lana, let's make seafood stew to celebrate!

Mallow.greeting: Lana pranked me by hiding a fish in my soup pot! I screamed! Then I cooked it! It was delicious!
Mallow.trainerWins: A delicious prank, a delicious victory!
Mallow.trainerLoses: A delicious prank, a bitter defeat!

Mallow.greeting: The Lush Jungle's chef and Brooklet Hill's Captain! Best friends!

Lana.greeting: Mallow, you'll scare them. ...Good. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: Victory and stew. My two favorite things.
Lana.trainerLoses: Hugs, then a rematch. In that order.

Lana.greeting: Mallow cooked the fish I hid in her pot. I didn't think that through. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: The prank backfired. The battle didn't.
Lana.trainerLoses: The prank backfired. So did the battle.

Lana.greeting: Mallow, I'll catch them. You cook them.

Kiawe.greeting: Lana and I are both captains of Akala. Fire and water, together at last!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Steam and fury! A magnificent victory!

Kiawe.greeting: Lana told me Wela Volcano was once underwater. I believed her for three days. She was teasing.
Akala's fire and water Captains, side by side! Steam rises!

Lana.greeting: Kiawe gets dramatic. Don't worry, I'll keep his flames from boiling over.
Lana.trainerWins: See? I kept him cool. Mostly.
Lana.trainerLoses: We fizzled out. Literally, in Kiawe's case.

Lana.greeting: Kiawe believed Wela Volcano was underwater. For three days. He's very serious. Let's battle.
Kiawe, don't boil my water this time. Last time, my fish got a sauna.
Lana.trainerWins: No sauna for my fish. Victory.
Lana.trainerLoses: My fish got another sauna. Defeat.

Lana.greeting: Kahuna Olivia oversees the trials on Akala. Battling beside her is a big deal.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. I'll tell everyone Olivia did most of it. She didn't.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll go fishing until I feel better.

Lana.greeting: Olivia gave me a pearl from Akala's beach. I told everyone I took it from a giant clam. She knew I was lying.
Lana.trainerLoses: A cracked pearl of a defeat.

Lana.greeting: Akala's Kahuna and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Rocks and tides.
Lana.trainerWins: The tide polished the rocks. Victory.
Lana.trainerLoses: The tide wore the rocks away. Defeat.

Olivia.greeting: Lana's my quiet little shark. Never underestimate her, honey.
Olivia.trainerWins: Polished and sparkling! Akala's finest, right here.
Olivia.trainerLoses: Rough waters today. We'll find calmer seas.

Olivia.greeting: Lana said she got the pearl from a giant clam! Cute! I found it on the beach! Let's battle!
Lana, let's make this battle a gem worth framing!

Lana.greeting: Kahuna Hala's laugh can be heard from Melemele to Akala. Hopefully it scares you.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Kahuna Hala laughed so hard I think the water rippled.
Lana.trainerLoses: The tide went out on us.

Lana.greeting: Kahuna Hala asked me to tell his grandson a bedtime story. I told one about a fish that ate a boat. Hau didn't sleep.
Melemele's Kahuna and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Laughter and tall tales.

Hala.greeting: Ho ho! Little Lana, with stories bigger than the ocean! Let's battle!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoo hah! A splendid catch, Lana!
Hala.trainerLoses: Ho ho! The sea gives and the sea takes!

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Lana's bedtime story kept Hau up all night! Ho ho! Let's battle, little storyteller!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! A sleepless defeat!

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Lana, tell them a scary story while I slam them!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Neither scared nor slammed!

Lana.greeting: Acerola and I trade ghost stories. Mine are better. Mostly because they're true.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. That's the scariest story of all, for you.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. That's a story I won't be telling.

Lana.greeting: Acerola tried to scare me with a ghost. I told her the ghost owed me money. The ghost left.
Brooklet Hill's Captain and Ula'ula's ghost princess. Tall tales and ghost tales.
Lana.trainerWins: Tall tales and ghost tales, victorious.
Lana.trainerLoses: Tall tales and ghost tales, debunked.

Acerola.greeting: Lana's stories are totally made up! Mine are the real spooky ones!
Acerola.trainerWins: Ehehe! Spooked and soaked! Great teamwork, Lana!
Acerola.trainerLoses: Aww... Let's make up a story where we won!

Acerola.greeting: Lana told my ghost it owed her money! It ran away! Hee hee! That was so funny! Let's battle!
Acerola.trainerWins: Hee hee! Funny victory!

Acerola.greeting: Lana, let's spook them with a fish story!
Acerola.trainerWins: Spooked! Victory! Hee hee!

Lana.greeting: Kahili flies all over the world. I asked her to bring me back a fish. She never does.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Now will you bring me a fish?
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. And still no fish.

Lana.greeting: Kahili brought me a souvenir from her trip. It was a keychain shaped like a fish. Close enough.
The Elite Four's golfer and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Fairways and waterways.
Lana.trainerWins: Fairways and waterways, a smooth victory.

Kahili.greeting: Lana, they won't let fish on planes. Shall we play this round?
Kahili.trainerWins: Straight down the fairway. Nicely played, Lana.
Kahili.trainerLoses: A water hazard. Fitting, with you here.

Kahili.greeting: Lana asked for a real fish. I brought a keychain. She accepted it. Let's play this round.
Lana, aim straight. Like a fishing line.
Kahili.trainerWins: Straight as a fishing line. Victory.
Kahili.trainerLoses: Tangled like a fishing line. Defeat.

Lana.greeting: Molayne says the tides follow the moon. I say the fish follow me.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. The tide was on our side.

Lana.greeting: Molayne tried to explain tides to me with diagrams. I told him the fish explained it better. He was confused.
Ula'ula's stargazer and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Moon and tides.
Lana.trainerWins: Moon and tides, a rising victory.

Molayne.greeting: Lana, that's not how tides work... but let's battle anyway.
Molayne.trainerWins: Exactly as the tide tables predicted. Well done.
Molayne.trainerLoses: A miscalculation. Even the ocean surprises me.

Molayne.greeting: Lana says fish explain tides. They don't. But her confidence is impressive. Let's battle.
Lana, let's calculate the tides of victory.

Lana.greeting: Professor Kukui wrestles in a mask. I wasn't supposed to tell anyone. Oops.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Your secret is safe. Mostly.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Maybe the mask would've helped.

Lana.greeting: Professor Kukui asked me to stop telling people about the mask. I told three more people.
Alola's professor and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Secrets and stories.

Kukui.greeting: Wh-what mask? I don't know what you're talking about! Let's battle, yeah!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! A splash of a victory, Lana!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Wiped out by the wave, cousin! We'll ride the next one!

Kukui.greeting: Lana keeps telling everyone about the... about nothing! There's no mask! Let's battle, yeah!
Lana, please keep the secret this time! Woo!

Lana.greeting: Team Skull grunts used to make a mess of my trial site. Plumeria owes me.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Now we're even, Plumeria.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Now you owe me twice.

Lana.greeting: Plumeria's grunts left trash at my trial site. She made them clean it up. With toothbrushes. I respect that.
Team Skull's big sister and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Poison and water.
Lana.trainerWins: Poison and water, a toxic tide.

Plumeria.greeting: I don't owe anybody, kid. But fine, I'll fight with you.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Huh. You're tougher than you look, kid.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Ugh, don't keep score, kid.

Plumeria.greeting: Lana told me my grunts trashed her trial site. They cleaned it with toothbrushes. Now let's win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Clean site, clean win.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Clean site, messy loss.

Plumeria.greeting: Kid, let's poison the water. Their water.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Their water, poisoned. Victory.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Our water, poisoned. Defeat.

Lana.greeting: Guzma never finished the island challenge. I'm a captain. You can guess who's in charge here.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Good job following orders, Guzma.

Lana.greeting: Guzma tried to fish at Brooklet Hill. He caught nothing. I caught three. He was very upset.
Team Skull's boss and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Destruction and fishing.
Lana.trainerWins: Destruction and fishing, a big catch.

Guzma.greeting: Tch. Bossin' me around, kid? Just battle!
Guzma.trainerWins: Hah! Big bad Guzma, winning with a captain! What a world.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Guzma! What is wrong with... no, seriously, what went wrong?!

Guzma.greeting: Lana caught three fish and I caught nothin'! Big bad Guzma's still mad! Let's smash 'em!
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashed 'em! Still mad about the fish!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Got smashed! Still mad about the fish!

Guzma.greeting: Lana, I smash, you fish. Got it?
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashed and fished! Victory!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Smashed... and the fish got away!

Lana.greeting: Lusamine's daughter is my friend. So I'll be nice. Probably.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Lillie will be happy.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll tell Lillie it was your fault.

Lana.greeting: Lusamine asked if I had any beautiful fish. I showed her my rod. She was not impressed.
Aether's President and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Beauty and bait.
Lana.trainerLoses: Beauty and bait, the one that got away.

Lusamine.greeting: A captain? How quaint. Very well, show me your beauty.
Lusamine.trainerWins: Lovely. I suppose captains can be beautiful too.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Hideous. Let us never repeat this.

Lusamine.greeting: The little captain showed me her fishing rod. How... rustic. Let's battle beautifully.
Lana, battle beautifully. If you can.

Lana.greeting: Faba thinks he's a genius. I think he'd make a good fish story.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. See, Faba? Even geniuses need captains.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. That's going in my fish stories.

Lana.greeting: Faba asked me to stop calling him a fish story. I called him a fish story again. He sighed.
Aether's Branch Chief and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Science and stories.

Faba.greeting: I am the Aether Foundation's greatest scientist! Not a fish story!
Faba.trainerWins: A triumph of science! And... seawater, apparently.
Faba.trainerLoses: This defeat will be redacted from all Foundation records!

Faba.greeting: The captain called me a fish story again. I, Faba, am a scientist! Let us battle!
Faba.trainerWins: I, Faba, the scientist, am victorious!
Faba.trainerLoses: I, Faba, the fish story, am defeated!

Faba.greeting: Captain, follow my scientific method.

Misty.greeting: A fellow water lover! Lana, let's show this challenger the power of the deep!
Misty.trainerWins: Splash attack! That's how water trainers win!
Misty.trainerLoses: Ugh, washed out! That's not fair!

Misty.greeting: Lana and I had a fishing contest in Cerulean! She caught a boot! I caught a bicycle! We called it a tie!
Misty.trainerWins: A tie in fishing, a win in battle!
Misty.trainerLoses: A tie in fishing, a loss in battle!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean's mermaid and Brooklet Hill's Captain! Two water girls with terrible fishing luck!
Misty.trainerWins: Terrible fishing luck, great battling luck!
Misty.trainerLoses: Terrible fishing luck AND battling luck!

Lana.greeting: Misty's a Gym Leader from far away. She agreed my fishing stories are true. I like her.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Misty, let's go fishing after this.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. The water was cold today.

Lana.greeting: Misty caught a bicycle. I caught a boot. We both lost that day. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: No boots, no bicycles. Just victory.

Lana.greeting: Misty, let's reel them in like the biggest fish in Cerulean.
Lana.trainerWins: Reeled in. The biggest catch yet.
Lana.trainerLoses: The big one got away. Again.

Juan.greeting: Ah, a young maiden of the sea. Lana, shall we perform a duet of water?
Juan.trainerWins: Superb! A performance of water and grace!
Juan.trainerLoses: Alas, our duet ended on a sour note.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Lana told me a tale of a fish that sang opera. I was moved to tears. She was teasing.
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, an operatic defeat!

Juan.greeting: Sootopolis's maestro and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Art and tales.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, art and tales, a masterpiece!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, art and tales, a fiction!

Lana.greeting: Juan talks like a poem. I don't understand it, but I like it.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. I think that was art.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. That was sad art.

Lana.greeting: Juan cried at my singing fish story. He's very emotional. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: He cried again. Happy tears. Victory.
Lana.trainerLoses: He cried again. Sad tears. Defeat.

Lana.greeting: Juan, sing them a sad song.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahaha! The tiny captain and the mighty Crasher Wake! Prepare to be washed away!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahaha! A tidal wave of victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Gwaah! The tide has turned against us!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Lana told me she wrestled a giant fish! The Crasher Wake respects that! Even if it's not true!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! A giant victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! A giant defeat!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! The tiny Captain and the mighty Crasher Wake! Water wrestling!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Water wrestling champions!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Water wrestling, pinned!

Lana.greeting: He's very loud. I'll be the quiet one. Let's go.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. At least it's quieter now.

Lana.greeting: Crasher Wake believed I wrestled a giant fish. He wants a rematch with the fish. There is no fish.
Crasher Wake, splash them. I'll reel them in.

Marlon.greeting: Yo, Lana! You fish, I surf. Together we're like the whole ocean, man!
Marlon.trainerWins: Whoa! Totally gnarly win, little dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out! No worries, the waves always come back.

Marlon.greeting: Lana told me there's a wave at Brooklet Hill that's a mile high! Dude, I believe her!
Marlon.trainerWins: Mile-high wave, mile-high win!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Mile-high wave... wiped out!

Marlon.greeting: Humilau's surfer and Brooklet Hill's Captain! The whole ocean!
Marlon.trainerWins: The whole ocean, dude! Victory!
Marlon.trainerLoses: The whole ocean... dried up, man!

Lana.greeting: Marlon is so relaxed it's almost suspicious. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Marlon didn't even break a sweat.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Marlon's still smiling. How?

Lana.greeting: Marlon believed the mile-high wave. He packed his surfboard. There is no wave. Let's battle.
Marlon, surf on their tears.

Cress.greeting: A captain of the waters! Lana, let us serve this challenger a refreshing defeat.
Cress.trainerWins: Served chilled and garnished with victory. Exquisite.
Cress.trainerLoses: A spilled glass... How unbecoming of me.

Cress.greeting: Lana asked me to serve her a fish dish. I did. She said she'd caught a bigger fish yesterday.
Striaton's composed one and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Refined water and wild tides.
Cress.trainerLoses: Refined and wild, both washed out.

Lana.greeting: Cress works at a restaurant, like Mallow. But he's fancier.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Cress, do you serve fish?
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. That dish didn't taste good.

Lana.greeting: Cress served me fish. Very fancy. I told him I'd caught a bigger one. He believed me. Let's battle.
Cress, serve them a defeat. With garnish. And a lemon wedge.
Lana.trainerWins: Served with garnish and lemon. Victory.
Lana.trainerLoses: They served it to us instead. Defeat.

Wallace.greeting: Lana, your quiet grace is like still water. Let's create something beautiful!
Wallace.trainerWins: Ah, a dazzling victory! Like sunlight on the waves.
Wallace.trainerLoses: Even still water ripples when struck. Beautifully fought.

Wallace.greeting: Lana told me her fishing rod was enchanted by a sea goddess. Exquisite story! I believed every word!
Sootopolis's Champion and Brooklet Hill's Captain. Elegance and enchantment!
Wallace.trainerWins: Elegance and enchantment, a dazzling, glittering win!
Wallace.trainerLoses: Elegance and enchantment, a tragic, soggy loss!

Lana.greeting: Wallace is very sparkly. I'll try to keep up.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. That was very sparkly.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. The sparkles didn't help.

Lana.greeting: Wallace believed my enchanted fishing rod story. He sparkles when he believes things. Let's battle.
Wallace, sparkle at them. I'll fish while they're distracted.
Lana.trainerWins: They were distracted. I caught them. Victory.

Siebold.greeting: Lana, I hear you're quite the fisher. A chef appreciates a fine catch. Shall we?
Siebold.trainerWins: A perfectly plated victory. Bon appétit.

Siebold.greeting: Lana brought me a fish she swore was twelve feet long. It was twelve inches. Still, a beautiful specimen.
Siebold.trainerWins: A beautiful specimen of a victory.
Siebold.trainerLoses: A modest catch of a defeat.

Siebold.greeting: Kalos's chef and Brooklet Hill's Captain. The catch and the kitchen.
Siebold.trainerWins: Caught and cooked, a perfect dish.

Lana.greeting: Siebold cooks fish. I catch fish. This is a perfect team.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Now cook my catch, Siebold.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. No fish dinner tonight.

Lana.greeting: Siebold measured my fish. Twelve inches. I said it shrank when he looked at it. He almost believed me.
Siebold, I'll catch them. You plate them.

Cynthia.greeting: Marley rarely speaks, but her team speaks volumes. I'm glad to battle beside her.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Beautifully done, Marley. Sinnoh's quiet strength shines.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A loss, but a lesson. Isn't that right, Marley?

Cynthia.greeting: Marley handed me a note before the battle. It said "good luck." In very small handwriting. I treasured it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A small note, a big victory.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A small note, a gentle defeat.

Cynthia.greeting: Sinnoh's Champion and the Battle Zone's quiet star. Few words, strong hearts.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Few words, one victory.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Few words, one defeat.

Roark.greeting: Marley's as quiet as a mine shaft at night. Don't let that fool you!
Roark.trainerWins: Struck gold! Great work, Marley!
Roark.trainerLoses: Cave-in! We'll dig our way back.

Roark.greeting: Marley visited the Oreburgh mine and didn't say a word for an hour. The echo was beautiful.
Roark.trainerWins: A quiet mine, a loud victory!
Roark.trainerLoses: A quiet mine, a silent defeat!

Roark.greeting: Oreburgh's miner and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Rock and silence!
Roark.trainerWins: Rock and silence, solid victory!

Gardenia.greeting: Marley, you're so quiet you'd fit right in at the Old Chateau... Eek, don't remind me!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won! And no ghosts showed up! Perfect!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Wilted! Ugh, I need some sunshine.

Gardenia.greeting: Marley sat in my greenhouse for three hours without moving. My plants grew so much! I think they liked her!
Eterna's gardener and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Flowers and stillness!

Fantina.greeting: Ah, Marley! So mysterieuse! Together we will be magnifique!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non! This was not très bien at all!

Fantina.greeting: Marley watched my contest performance from the front row. She clapped once. Very softly. I was moved.
Fantina.trainerWins: One soft clap, one grand victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: One soft clap, one quiet defeat!

Fantina.greeting: Hearthome's dancer and ze silent star! Dance and silence!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Dance and silence, hélas!

Maylene.greeting: Marley! Let's go barefoot and fight with everything we've got!
Maylene.trainerWins: We won! That was a great workout!
Maylene.trainerLoses: We lost... I need to train more!

Maylene.greeting: Marley took off one shoe for my barefoot training. Just one. It's progress!
Veilstone's fighter and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Fists and focus!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahaha! The silent maiden and the roaring wave! What a tag team!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahaha! Crushed like a wave on the rocks!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Gwaaah! Pinned down for the count!

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! Marley flinched every time I laughed! So I laughed quieter! Like this! wahahah!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Quiet laugh, loud victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: wahahah... quiet laugh, quiet defeat...

Crasher Wake.greeting: WAHAHAH! The roaring wave and the silent shore! Tag team!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Wave and shore, victorious!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Wave and shore, washed out!

Byron.greeting: Gahahaha! The quiet girl from the Battle Zone! Let's hammer this out!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahaha! A victory as hard as steel!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Marley stared at my mustache for ten minutes! Finally she said "...big." Best compliment ever!
Gahahah! Canalave's miner and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Loud and soft!

Candice.greeting: Focus, Marley! Let's show 'em the power of a cool head!
Candice.trainerWins: Yes! Total focus! That's the spirit!
Candice.trainerLoses: We lost our focus! Ugh, more training!

Candice.greeting: Marley taught ME how to focus! She sat completely still for an hour! I lasted four seconds!
Candice.trainerWins: Four seconds of focus, one victory!
Candice.trainerLoses: Four seconds of focus, not enough!

Candice.greeting: Snowpoint's ice and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Cold and calm!
Candice.trainerWins: Cold and calm, a frozen victory!

Volkner.greeting: Marley doesn't waste words. I don't waste energy. Let's get this over with... in a good way.
Volkner.trainerWins: Hm. That actually wasn't boring.
Volkner.trainerLoses: A spark finally... and we lost. Typical.

Volkner.greeting: Marley and I sat in silence for twenty minutes before the battle. Best conversation I've had in months.
Volkner.trainerWins: Twenty silent minutes, then a victory.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Twenty silent minutes, then a defeat.

Volkner.greeting: Sunyshore's Gym and the Battle Zone's quiet star. Two people who say little.
Volkner.trainerWins: Said little. Won much.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Said little. Lost much.

Aaron.greeting: Marley's like a bug hiding in the grass. Quiet, until she strikes!
Aaron.trainerWins: Beautiful! Like a butterfly's wings!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Squashed... That's how it goes sometimes.

Aaron.greeting: Marley found a tiny beetle and held it for an hour without saying anything. Bugs love quiet people!
Aaron.trainerWins: Bugs love Marley! Victory!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Bugs love Marley... still lost!

Aaron.greeting: The Sinnoh Elite Four's bug master and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Bugs and silence!
Aaron.trainerWins: Bugs and silence, victorious!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Bugs and silence, squashed!

Bertha.greeting: Well, aren't you a quiet one, dear? Let's show them what we've got.
Bertha.trainerWins: Ahaha! Well done, dear! Have a cookie.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Oh my. Well, no cookies for us today.

Bertha.greeting: Marley let me braid her hair. She didn't say a word, but she smiled the whole time. Such a sweet girl.
Bertha.trainerWins: A sweet girl, a sweet victory, dear.
Bertha.trainerLoses: A sweet girl, a gentle defeat, dear.

Bertha.greeting: The League's grandma and the Battle Zone's quiet one. Warm and still.
Bertha.trainerWins: Warm and still, a gentle victory.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Warm and still, a quiet defeat.

Flint.greeting: Marley! Let's set this battle on fire! Burn, baby, burn!
Flint.trainerWins: That's what I'm talking about! We're on fire!

Flint.greeting: Marley got a little too close to my fire during the warm-up. She said "...hot." Then stepped back. Smart kid!
Flint.trainerLoses: Hot and... not smart enough! Defeat!

Flint.greeting: Sinnoh's Elite Four flame and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Fire and calm!

Lucian.greeting: Marley and I both appreciate silence. A quiet mind sees the battle clearly.
Lucian.trainerWins: A satisfying ending, like a good novel.
Lucian.trainerLoses: An unexpected twist. I didn't see it coming.

Lucian.greeting: Marley sat beside me while I read. She turned the pages for me. Silently. Perfectly.
Sinnoh's Elite Four reader and the Battle Zone's quiet one. A library of two.
Lucian.trainerLoses: A library of two, closed early.

Cyrus.greeting: Silence. No wasted emotion. Marley, you'd fit perfectly in a world without spirit.
Marley shows no emotion. Efficient. But she insists she has spirit. Curious.
Team Galactic's leader and the Battle Zone's quiet one. Silence of two kinds.

Mars.greeting: Ugh, why am I stuck with the quiet girl? Fine, just keep up!
Mars.trainerWins: Ha! That's how Team Galactic does it!
Mars.trainerLoses: Seriously?! This is so not fair!

Mars.greeting: Hi there! Marley won't talk to me! I've told her four jokes! She hasn't laughed once! Hehe!
Team Galactic's chatterbox and the Battle Zone's quiet girl! Loud and soft!

Jupiter.greeting: Hmph. A quiet partner. At least you won't bore me with chatter.
Marley stared at my hair for a full minute. Then said "...purple." I'm aware.
Team Galactic's commander and the Battle Zone's quiet one. No chatter. Good.

Saturn.greeting: You're quiet. Good. Let's handle this efficiently.
Marley and I exchanged exactly three words before the battle. It was the most efficient conversation I've ever had.
Team Galactic's commander and the Battle Zone's quiet star. Efficiency, perfected.

Charon.greeting: Kehehe! A silent girl! Perfect for a scientist's assistant!
Kehehe! Marley wouldn't let me measure her Pokémon! She just shook her head! Very firmly!
Charon.trainerWins: Kehehe! Firm head shake, firm victory!
Charon.trainerLoses: Kehehe! Firm head shake, soft defeat!

Charon.greeting: Team Galactic's scientist and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Science and silence!

Misty.greeting: Lillie! You went to Kanto, right? Next time, come swimming in Cerulean with me!
Misty.trainerWins: Splashed 'em good! Nice work, Lillie!
Misty.trainerLoses: Grr! We'll get 'em next time, Lillie. Don't you dare cry!

Misty.greeting: Lillie asked me to teach her to swim! She floated for three seconds before panicking! But she tried!
Misty.trainerWins: Three seconds of floating, one victory!
Misty.trainerLoses: Three seconds of floating, then sinking!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean's mermaid and Alola's brave girl! Water and courage!
Misty.trainerWins: Water and courage, making waves!
Misty.trainerLoses: Water and courage, washed out!

Lillie.greeting: Misty is so confident. Battling beside her makes me feel like I can do anything!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I think I'm getting as bold as you, Misty.
Lillie.trainerLoses: I won't cry, Misty. I promise! ...Maybe a little.

Lillie.greeting: Misty taught me to float! I only lasted three seconds, but I'm going to practice! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Practiced and won!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Practiced... still sinking!

Lillie.greeting: Misty, let's make a big splash together!
Lillie.trainerWins: A big splash! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: A small splash... defeat!

Erika.greeting: Ah, Lillie... You smell faintly of Alolan flowers. How lovely. Shall we battle... after a short nap?
Erika.trainerWins: Oh my, we won? How delightful. I barely had to wake up.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh dear... I must have dozed off at the worst moment.

Erika.greeting: Lillie brought me a flower from Alola. A white one. I pressed it in my favorite book. Let's battle.
Erika.trainerWins: A pressed flower, a fresh victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: A pressed flower, a faded defeat.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's garden and Alola's bloom. Flowers of two regions.
Erika.trainerWins: Flowers of two regions, blooming.
Erika.trainerLoses: Flowers of two regions, wilted.

Lillie.greeting: Erika's garden in Celadon is beautiful. Please don't fall asleep during the battle, Erika!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! And Erika stayed awake the whole time!
Lillie.trainerLoses: We lost... Erika, are you sleeping? Erika?

Lillie.greeting: Erika pressed my Alolan flower in her favorite book! I'm so happy! Let's battle! Please stay awake!
Lillie.trainerWins: Erika stayed awake the whole time! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Erika napped through the ending! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Erika, let's grow a victory together! Awake!
Lillie.trainerWins: Grew it awake! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Grew it asleep! Defeat!

Sabrina.greeting: I foresaw a shy girl from Alola who would find her courage. That girl is you, Lillie.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Exactly as I foresaw. Your courage did not waver.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Even I cannot see every ending. Hold your head high, Lillie.

Sabrina.greeting: Lillie's mind was full of doubt when we met. Today, it's full of courage. I can hear the difference.
Saffron's psychic and Alola's brave daughter. Mind and heart.

Lillie.greeting: Sabrina knew my name before I said it. That's a little scary... but also amazing!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! Did you see that coming too, Sabrina?
Lillie.trainerLoses: Sabrina, why didn't you warn me we'd lose?

Lillie.greeting: Sabrina said she can hear my courage! I didn't know courage made a sound! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: My courage was loud! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: My courage was too quiet! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Sabrina, can you hear what I'm planning?
Lillie.trainerWins: She heard. We won.
Lillie.trainerLoses: She heard. It didn't work.

Janine.greeting: Lillie! I'll teach you ninja tricks! Rule one: never let them see you coming!
Janine.trainerWins: Ninja victory! You were great, Lillie!
Janine.trainerLoses: Argh! My father would scold me for that one...

Janine.greeting: Lillie tried a ninja vanishing trick and hid behind a lamp post. She was very visible. But very confident!
Janine.trainerWins: Visible but victorious!

Janine.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and Alola's newest ninja student! Shadows and courage!
Janine.trainerWins: Shadows and courage, victorious!

Lillie.greeting: Janine says I'd make a good ninja because I'm so quiet. I'll do my best!
Lillie.trainerWins: We did it! Was that ninja-like enough, Janine?
Lillie.trainerLoses: I don't think I'm a very good ninja after all...

Lillie.greeting: Janine taught me to vanish! I hid behind a lamp post! She found me immediately! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Found but victorious!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Found and defeated!

Lillie.greeting: Janine, let's strike from the shadows! I'll pick a better hiding spot this time!
Lillie.trainerWins: A better hiding spot, and a victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Another lamp post! Spotted! Defeat!

Whitney.greeting: Lillie's so cute! Don't you dare make her cry, okay? That's my job! Kidding!
Whitney.trainerWins: Yay! We won! Lillie, let's go shopping in Goldenrod!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Waaah! We lost! Lillie, I'm gonna cry!

Whitney.greeting: Lillie and I had a sleepover! She told me about Alola all night! I cried at the sad parts!
Goldenrod's cutest and Alola's bravest! Cute and courageous!

Lillie.greeting: Whitney is so cheerful! I hope she doesn't cry if we lose...
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! No tears today, Whitney!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Oh no, Whitney's crying... There, there!

Lillie.greeting: Whitney cried at my stories! Even the happy ones! She's so kind! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Happy tears! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Sad tears! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Whitney, let's be brave together! No crying!
Lillie.trainerWins: No crying! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Crying! Both of us! Defeat!

Jasmine.greeting: Um... Lillie and I are both a little shy. But we'll be brave together, okay?
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... I'm so glad. Thank you, Lillie.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Um... I'm sorry, Lillie. We'll try again, okay?

Jasmine.greeting: Lillie and I sat by the lighthouse and didn't talk for an hour. It was the nicest hour I've had in a while.
Jasmine.trainerWins: A quiet hour, a bright victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: A quiet hour, a gentle defeat.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine's lighthouse and Alola's light... two quiet girls.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Two quiet girls, one loud victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Two quiet girls, one quiet defeat.

Lillie.greeting: Jasmine understands how hard it is to speak up. Let's show them how strong quiet girls can be!
Lillie.trainerWins: We did it, Jasmine! Quiet but strong!
Lillie.trainerLoses: It's okay, Jasmine. We were brave, and that's what matters.

Lillie.greeting: Jasmine and I watched the sea together! We didn't need to talk! It was perfect! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: A perfect hour, a perfect win!
Lillie.trainerLoses: A perfect hour... a sad loss!

Lillie.greeting: Jasmine, let's shine together! Quietly!
Lillie.trainerWins: Shone quietly! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Dimmed quietly... defeat.

Clair.greeting: Hmph. Lillie, is it? Show me you're more than a sheltered president's daughter.
Clair.trainerWins: Not bad. You've earned a little respect, Lillie.
Clair.trainerLoses: Tch. Don't tell my cousin about this.

Clair.greeting: Lillie asked me to teach her to stand tall. I showed her once. She hasn't slouched since.
Blackthorn's dragon master and Alola's sheltered princess. Not so sheltered now.

Lillie.greeting: Clair is so proud and strong. I want to show her I can be strong too!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! Clair, did you see? I'm not so sheltered after all!
Lillie.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Clair. I'll get stronger, I promise.

Lillie.greeting: Clair taught me to stand tall! I practice every morning! Now I'll battle tall too!
Lillie.trainerWins: Stood tall! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Stood tall... still lost!

Lillie.greeting: Clair, I'll prove I'm strong! Watch!
Lillie.trainerWins: She proved it. Victory.
Lillie.trainerLoses: She tried. Defeat.

Roxanne.greeting: Lillie, you remind me of my best students: curious and diligent! Let's apply what you've learned.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Full marks! A textbook victory, Lillie!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Hmm. We'll need to review the material, Lillie.

Roxanne.greeting: Lillie filled an entire notebook during my lecture. Twelve pages. With diagrams. My best student ever!
Rustboro's teacher and Alola's diligent student! Study and courage!

Lillie.greeting: Roxanne is a teacher! I brought my notebook, just in case.
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I'll write down everything you taught me, Roxanne!
Lillie.trainerLoses: I think I'll need to study for a retest...

Lillie.greeting: Roxanne's lecture was so interesting! I wrote twelve pages! Let's put it into practice!
Lillie.trainerWins: Practiced my notes! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: My notes failed! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Roxanne, page seven has a good strategy!
Lillie.trainerWins: Page seven worked! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Page seven failed! Defeat!

Flannery.greeting: Lillie! We're both trying to be stronger than we look! Let's turn up the heat!
Flannery.trainerWins: We did it! That was super hot, Lillie!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Ugh! I tried so hard to be cool... I mean hot!

Flannery.greeting: Lillie tried my hot springs and turned bright red in thirty seconds! But she stayed in! Tough kid!
Lavaridge's firecracker and Alola's tough girl! Fire and grit!

Lillie.greeting: Flannery is so passionate. I'm getting fired up just standing beside her!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I feel all warm inside, Flannery!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Our flames went out... but we'll light them again!

Lillie.greeting: Flannery's hot springs were SO hot! I stayed in for a whole minute! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: A whole minute! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Too hot... defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Flannery, let's heat things up! I can take it now!
Lillie.trainerWins: She took it! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Too hot to handle! Defeat!

Winona.greeting: Lillie, you've spread your wings at last. Let us soar through this battle together.
Winona.trainerWins: A beautiful flight. Well done, Lillie.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our wings were clipped today. We'll fly again.

Winona.greeting: Lillie rode with me over Fortree's treetops. She was terrified, then delighted. I'll never forget her face.
Fortree's skies and Alola's newest flier. Wings, newly spread.

Lillie.greeting: Winona is so graceful. I hope I can be that elegant someday.
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! It felt like flying, Winona!
Lillie.trainerLoses: We fell from the sky... but I'm not afraid of heights anymore.

Lillie.greeting: Winona flew me over the treetops! I was so scared! Then it was wonderful! Let's soar!
Lillie.trainerWins: Soared! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Fell! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Winona, let's fly over them!
Lillie.trainerWins: Flew over them! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Flew into them! Defeat!

Gardenia.greeting: Lillie loves flowers too! Let's grow a big, beautiful victory together!
Lillie and I planted a garden at Professor Kukui's lab! The flowers bloomed in a week! Alolan soil is amazing!
Eterna's gardener and Alola's flower girl! Two gardens!

Lillie.greeting: Gardenia knows so much about plants. Maybe she can help the garden at the lab grow!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! Our victory bloomed so nicely, Gardenia!
Lillie.trainerLoses: We'll plant new seeds and try again, Gardenia!

Lillie.greeting: Gardenia helped me plant a garden at the lab! The Professor tripped over it twice! Let's grow a win!
Lillie.trainerWins: The lab garden and a win, both growing!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Tripped over the garden... and a loss!

Lillie.greeting: Gardenia, let's grow something beautiful!
Lillie.trainerWins: Something beautiful! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Something wilted! Defeat!

Maylene.greeting: Lillie! You've got a fighting spirit, I can tell! Let's give it everything!
Maylene.trainerWins: Yes! That was a great workout, Lillie!
Maylene.trainerLoses: We lost... Let's train together, Lillie!

Maylene.greeting: Lillie did one push-up! Then collapsed! Then did another! That's the spirit!
Veilstone's fighter and Alola's determined girl! Fists and grit!

Lillie.greeting: Maylene trains barefoot every day. I'm not that brave yet, but I'll fight with my shoes on!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I think my legs are shaking, Maylene!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Maybe I should try training barefoot too...

Lillie.greeting: Maylene made me do push-ups! I did two! Okay, one and a half! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: One and a half push-ups, one victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: One and a half push-ups... defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Maylene, let's give it everything! Even push-ups!
Lillie.trainerWins: Everything! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Everything... defeat!

Candice.greeting: Lillie, focus! When your mind is clear, nothing can stop you!
Candice.trainerLoses: We lost our focus... Snowpoint training, here we come!

Candice.greeting: Lillie asked me to teach her how to focus! I said "FOCUS!" really loud! She jumped! But it worked!
Snowpoint's ice and Alola's brave girl! Cold and courageous!

Lillie.greeting: Candice is always so focused! I'll try my hardest to keep up!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I stayed focused the whole time, Candice!
Lillie.trainerLoses: I think my focus melted, Candice...

Lillie.greeting: Candice yelled FOCUS at me and I jumped! But then I focused! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Focused! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Jumped again! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Candice, let's FOCUS! ...Was that loud enough?
Lillie.trainerWins: Loud enough! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Not loud enough! Defeat!

Elesa.greeting: Lillie, your new look is darling. Let's make this battle our runway!
Elesa.trainerWins: A dazzling show! You were radiant, Lillie.
Elesa.trainerLoses: The spotlight faded on us. We'll shine brighter next time.

Elesa.greeting: Lillie tried on one of my runway outfits. She looked stunning. She didn't believe me. I'll prove it with a win.
Elesa.trainerWins: Stunning AND victorious!

Elesa.greeting: Nimbasa's star and Alola's rising star. Glamour and growth.
Elesa.trainerWins: Glamour and growth, dazzling!

Lillie.greeting: Elesa said my new outfit suits me! Let's show everyone how much I've changed!
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! I felt like a model on a runway, Elesa!
Lillie.trainerLoses: I tripped on the runway, didn't I?

Lillie.greeting: Elesa let me try on her outfit! She said I looked stunning! I don't believe her, but let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Maybe stunning! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Not stunning... defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Elesa, let's walk the runway to victory!
Lillie.trainerWins: Walked to victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Tripped on the runway! Defeat!

Skyla.greeting: Lillie! I can fly you anywhere! Kanto, Unova... but first, let's win this!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Turbulence! Buckle up, we'll try again!

Skyla.greeting: Lillie asked if planes are safer than flying on a Pokémon! I said both are great! She still held on tight!
Mistralton's pilot and Alola's brave passenger! Takeoff!

Lillie.greeting: Skyla is a real pilot! Maybe someday she'll fly me back to Alola.
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! That was a perfect landing, Skyla!
Lillie.trainerLoses: That was a bumpy flight, Skyla...

Lillie.greeting: Skyla's plane was so loud! I held on to my seat the whole time! Let's battle!
Lillie.trainerWins: Held on and won!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Held on... and lost!

Lillie.greeting: Skyla, let's soar! I won't hold my seat this time!
Lillie.trainerWins: Didn't hold the seat! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Held the seat! Defeat!

Roxie.greeting: Lillie, you're too sweet! Let's add some noise to that sweetness! Rock on!
Roxie.trainerWins: Yeah! That's how you rock out, Lillie!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Aw, man! The amp blew out!

Roxie.greeting: Lillie came to my concert and covered her ears the whole time! But she was smiling! That counts!
Roxie.trainerWins: Smiling and victorious!

Roxie.greeting: Virbank's rock star and Alola's sweetest fan! Loud and sweet!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loud and sweet, a hit!

Lillie.greeting: Roxie is so loud! I'll try to be loud too... Rock on? Is that right?
Lillie.trainerWins: We won! Rock on, Roxie! ...Did I say it right?
Lillie.trainerLoses: I think we played the wrong song, Roxie...

Lillie.greeting: Roxie's concert was SO loud! I covered my ears, but I loved it! Rock on! Is that right?
Lillie.trainerWins: Rock on! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Rock... off? Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Roxie, let's rock! I'll try to be loud!
Lillie.trainerWins: She was loud! Victory!
Lillie.trainerLoses: She was quiet! Defeat!

Lillie.greeting: Marley doesn't say much, but I understand her. I used to be quiet too.
Lillie.trainerWins: We won, Marley! Quietly and bravely!
Lillie.trainerLoses: It's okay, Marley. We can be quiet about this one.

Lillie.greeting: Marley and I shared an umbrella in the rain. Neither of us said a word the whole walk. It was lovely.
Lillie.trainerWins: A lovely walk, a lovely victory.
Lillie.trainerLoses: A lovely walk... a rainy defeat.

Lillie.greeting: Two girls who used to be quiet. Now we battle side by side.
Lillie.trainerWins: Side by side, victorious!
Lillie.trainerLoses: Side by side... we'll try again!

Erika.greeting: Lana, your seaside stories always lull me to sleep... in the nicest way. Let us battle.
Erika.trainerWins: Oh my, how lovely. A victory as gentle as the tide.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh dear, the tide went out on us...

Erika.greeting: Lana told me a story about a sleepy fish who dreamed of flowers. I fell asleep halfway. It was perfect.
Erika.trainerWins: A dreamy victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: A sleepy defeat.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's garden and Brooklet Hill's waters. Blossoms by the brook.
Erika.trainerWins: Blossoms by the brook, blooming.
Erika.trainerLoses: Blossoms by the brook, washed away.

Lana.greeting: Erika falls asleep during my stories. Rude. But she's strong, so I forgive her.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Erika's still asleep. I'll tell her later.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Erika slept through it, I think.

Lana.greeting: Erika fell asleep during my sleepy fish story. That's the point of the story. So I win. Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: I win twice. Story and battle.
Lana.trainerLoses: I win the story. Not the battle.

Lana.greeting: Erika, stay awake. Just for this one.

Sabrina.greeting: Lana's tall tales cannot fool me. I see the truth... and the truth is, we'll win.
Sabrina.trainerWins: As I predicted. The truth always surfaces.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: A future I did not see. Interesting.

Sabrina.greeting: Lana tried to tell me a fish story. I finished it for her before she started. She was annoyed.
Saffron's psychic and Brooklet Hill's storyteller. Truth and tales.

Lana.greeting: Sabrina reads minds. That makes my fish stories way less fun.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Sabrina knew. Of course she knew.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Sabrina, you could've warned me.

Lana.greeting: Sabrina finished my story before I told it. That's cheating. I'll beat her at battling instead. With her.
Lana.trainerWins: Beat the challenger, not Sabrina. Victory.

Lana.greeting: Sabrina, don't read my mind. Read theirs.

Janine.greeting: Lana, you'd make a great ninja! Nobody ever knows what you're thinking!
Janine.trainerWins: Ninja and fisher, perfect stealth combo!
Janine.trainerLoses: Ugh, they saw right through our tricks!

Janine.greeting: Lana snuck up on me at the beach! A ninja, ambushed by a fishing Captain! I demand a rematch after this!
Janine.trainerWins: A rematch later, a victory now!
Janine.trainerLoses: A rematch later, a defeat now!

Janine.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and Brooklet Hill's sneaky Captain! Two masters of surprise!
Janine.trainerWins: Two masters of surprise, victorious!

Lana.greeting: Janine and I both like surprising people. Let's surprise you.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. That wasn't the surprise I wanted.

Lana.greeting: I snuck up on Janine. She screamed. Ninjas aren't supposed to scream. Let's battle.
Janine, sneak left. I'll sneak right.

Whitney.greeting: Lana's so cute and tiny! Let's win so I can buy you something nice in Goldenrod!
Whitney.trainerWins: Yay! We won! Lana, you're the best!

Whitney.greeting: Lana told me a fish once stole her lunch! I believed her! Then she said she was teasing! Waaah!
Goldenrod's crybaby and Brooklet Hill's teaser! Tears and tall tales!

Lana.greeting: Whitney cries when she loses. Let's not make her cry.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. No crying. Mission accomplished.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. She's crying. I'm going fishing.

Lana.greeting: Whitney cried when I said a fish stole my lunch. Then cried again when I said I was teasing. Let's battle.
Whitney, no crying until after we win.

Jasmine.greeting: Lana, the sea by Olivine's lighthouse is lovely. Maybe we can fish there someday?
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... That was nice, Lana.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Um... we lost. That's okay, Lana.

Jasmine.greeting: Lana and I fished off Olivine's pier. She caught three fish. I caught a seashell. She said it was the best catch.
Jasmine.trainerWins: A seashell and a victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: A seashell and a defeat.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine's lighthouse and Brooklet Hill's waters... the sea at night.
Jasmine.trainerWins: The sea at night, calm and victorious.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The sea at night, rough and defeated.

Lana.greeting: Jasmine is quiet like me. We get along well. ...Let's battle.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Quiet girls win quietly.

Lana.greeting: Jasmine caught a seashell. I told her it was legendary. She kept it. It's on her lighthouse windowsill now.
Lana.trainerWins: A legendary seashell, a legendary win.
Lana.trainerLoses: A legendary seashell, a normal defeat.

Lana.greeting: Jasmine, I'll fish them out. You light the way.

Clair.greeting: A water girl, hm? Dragons rule the seas too, Lana. Try to keep up.
Clair.trainerWins: Of course we won. You did well enough, Lana.
Clair.trainerLoses: Impossible. Don't speak of this, Lana.

Clair.greeting: Lana told me dragons originally came from the sea. She was clearly lying. I almost believed her.
Blackthorn's dragons and Brooklet Hill's waters. Sea serpents.

Lana.greeting: Clair is very proud. I'll fish her a compliment later.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll keep it a secret. Maybe.

Lana.greeting: Clair almost believed dragons came from the sea. She'll deny it. I saw her face. Let's battle.
Clair, let your dragons swim. Just this once.

Roxanne.greeting: Lana, I've read about Alola's captains! I'd love to see your trial knowledge in action!
Roxanne.trainerWins: Excellent! That deserves a gold star, Lana!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Hmm. We'll need to revise our strategy.

Roxanne.greeting: Lana's fish stories are scientifically impossible! I wrote a paper debunking them! She gave it an A!
Rustboro's scholar and Brooklet Hill's storyteller! Facts and fiction!

Lana.greeting: Roxanne takes notes on everything. Including my fish stories. Uh-oh.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Do I get a gold star?
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Don't write that down, Roxanne.

Lana.greeting: Roxanne wrote a paper debunking my stories. I graded it. A-plus. She was very confused. Let's battle.
Roxanne, debunk the challenger.

Flannery.greeting: Lana! Fire and water, that's a hot spring! Let's make this battle steamy!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Aww, the hot spring went cold!

Flannery.greeting: Lana dumped a bucket of water on my campfire! For "safety"! I was so mad! Then she laughed!
Lavaridge's fire and Brooklet Hill's water! Steam!

Lana.greeting: Flannery is from a town with hot springs. I like the water there. Let's go.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Time for a soak.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. The water's lukewarm now.

Lana.greeting: I put out Flannery's campfire with a bucket. She turned red. Redder than her hair. Let's battle.
Flannery, I'll douse. You burn. Then we see.

Winona.greeting: Lana, the sky and the sea meet at the horizon. Let us meet this challenge together.
Winona.trainerLoses: A storm caught us. We'll find calmer skies.

Winona.greeting: Lana asked if my birds could catch fish. They can. She was delighted. They brought her three.
Winona.trainerWins: My birds' fishing paid off. Victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: My birds caught fish, not a win.

Winona.greeting: Fortree's skies and Brooklet Hill's waters. Horizon to horizon.

Lana.greeting: Winona talks about the sky a lot. I talk about the sea. Together we cover everything.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Sky and sea, undefeated.

Lana.greeting: Winona's birds caught me three fish. I like her birds more than most people. Let's battle.
Winona, your birds dive. I reel.

Gardenia.greeting: Lana, plants need water to grow! Let's grow a huge win together!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won! Thanks for the watering, Lana!

Gardenia.greeting: Lana watered my plants with seawater! They wilted! She said she was helping! I'm not sure she was!
Eterna's gardener and Brooklet Hill's Captain! Plants and water! Fresh water, please!

Lana.greeting: Gardenia waters her plants. I'm the water. That makes me important.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Too much water, maybe.

Lana.greeting: I watered Gardenia's plants with seawater. They didn't like it. Neither did Gardenia. Let's battle.
Gardenia, I'll water. You grow. Fresh water. Promise.

Maylene.greeting: Lana! Let's train by the sea! Waves make great training partners!
Maylene.trainerWins: Yes! We crushed it! Lana, you're tough!
Maylene.trainerLoses: We lost? More training! Let's go!

Maylene.greeting: Lana challenged me to punch a wave! I did! The wave won! She's been laughing ever since!
Maylene.trainerWins: Beat the challenger, not the wave!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Lost to the wave AND the challenger!

Maylene.greeting: Veilstone's fighter and Brooklet Hill's Captain! Fists and tides!
Maylene.trainerWins: Fists and tides, a crashing victory!

Lana.greeting: Maylene punched a wave once. The wave won. Don't tell her I said that.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Maylene didn't punch any waves this time.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. The wave wins again.

Lana.greeting: Maylene punched a wave. It splashed her face. I'll never forget it. Let's battle.
Maylene, punch them, not the water.

Candice.greeting: Lana! Ice is just water with more focus! Let's go!
Lana and I made an ice sculpture of a fish! It melted in Alola in ten minutes! But it was SO pretty!
Snowpoint's ice and Brooklet Hill's water! Ice is just focused water!

Lana.greeting: Candice says that a lot. I don't think it's true. But I like her.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Frozen solid, like I planned.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. My fishing hole froze over.

Lana.greeting: Candice's ice fish melted. I told her it swam away. She believed me for a minute. Let's battle.
Candice, freeze them. I'll fish them out.

Elesa.greeting: Lana, your style is so natural. Let's make waves on the runway!
Elesa.trainerWins: A dazzling performance! Lana, you sparkled.
Elesa.trainerLoses: The lights dimmed on us today...

Elesa.greeting: Lana posed for a photo with a fish. She held it like a trophy. The photo was more stunning than any runway shot.
Elesa.trainerWins: A trophy victory!

Elesa.greeting: Nimbasa's runway and Brooklet Hill's pier. Glamour and the great outdoors.
Elesa.trainerWins: Glamour outdoors, dazzling victory!

Lana.greeting: Elesa says I'd be a good model. I said I'd rather fish. She laughed.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Can I go fishing now?
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Modeling is harder than fishing.

Lana.greeting: Elesa took my photo with a fish. She says it's art. I say it's a fish. Let's battle.
Elesa, take a photo when we win.

Skyla.greeting: Lana! I'll fly you over the ocean so you can spot the biggest fish! After we win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Crash landing! We'll take off again!

Skyla.greeting: Lana fished out of my plane window! Mid-flight! She caught a bird's feather! She called it a sky fish!
Mistralton's skies and Brooklet Hill's waters! Fishing from the clouds!
Skyla.trainerWins: Fishing from the clouds, a catch!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Fishing from the clouds, empty line!

Lana.greeting: Skyla promised me a ride in her plane. I want to fish from the sky.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. Now the plane ride.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. No plane ride today.

Lana.greeting: I fished from Skyla's plane. I caught a feather. Sky fish. Very rare. Let's battle.
Skyla, fly low. I'll fish them out.

Roxie.greeting: Lana! Let's make some noise! Even fish can headbang!
Roxie.trainerWins: Yeah! Encore! You rock, Lana!

Roxie.greeting: Lana brought a fish to my concert and held it up during the guitar solo! The crowd went wild!
Roxie.trainerWins: Fish solo, wild victory!

Roxie.greeting: Virbank's stage and Brooklet Hill's pier! Rock and reel!
Roxie.trainerWins: Rock and reel, a catchy hit!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Rock and reel, the one that got away!

Lana.greeting: Roxie is very loud. The fish don't like her. But I do.
Lana.trainerWins: We won. The fish are dancing.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Too much noise scared off the luck.

Lana.greeting: I held a fish up at Roxie's concert. The fish didn't like the music. The crowd did. Let's battle.
Roxie, play loud. Scare the fish toward me.
Marley and I don't talk much. We just sit by the water. It's nice.
Lana.trainerLoses: We lost. Back to the water.

Lana.greeting: Marley and I sat on the pier for three hours. She caught nothing. I caught nothing. Best day ever.
Brooklet Hill's Captain and the Battle Zone's quiet star. Two quiet girls by the water.
Lana.trainerWins: The quietest win on the pier.
Lana.trainerLoses: The quietest loss on the pier.

Misty.greeting: Marley, you're so quiet! Let's make a big splash so they notice us!
Misty.trainerWins: Splashed! See, Marley? Big entrance!
Misty.trainerLoses: Ugh! Soaked and beaten!

Misty.greeting: Marley jumped into the Cerulean pool fully dressed because I dared her. She didn't even flinch! Respect!
Misty.trainerWins: Fully dressed, fully victorious!
Misty.trainerLoses: Fully dressed, fully defeated!

Misty.greeting: Cerulean's mermaid and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Splash and silence!
Misty.trainerWins: Splash and silence, victorious!
Misty.trainerLoses: Splash and silence, washed out!

Erika.greeting: Marley, you're as calm as a quiet garden. I find that very soothing... yawn.
Erika.trainerWins: Oh, we won? How pleasant.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh... I must have napped.

Erika.greeting: Marley and I napped under the same tree in Celadon. She guarded me the whole time. Such a sweet girl.
Erika.trainerWins: A guarded nap, a guarded victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: A guarded nap, an unguarded defeat.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's garden and the Battle Zone's quiet guardian. A peaceful pair.
Erika.trainerWins: A peaceful pair, a peaceful victory.
Erika.trainerLoses: A peaceful pair, a peaceful defeat.

Sabrina.greeting: Marley speaks little, but her mind is loud to me. She is ready.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Our minds were in harmony. Victory was certain.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Our thoughts were not enough today.

Sabrina.greeting: Marley's thoughts are surprisingly loud. Today she thought "please don't lose" forty times.
Saffron's psychic and the Battle Zone's quiet one. Loud minds, soft voices.

Janine.greeting: Marley, you're so quiet you'd be a perfect ninja!
Janine.trainerWins: Silent strike! Ninja success!

Janine.greeting: Marley stood so still behind me, I didn't know she was there for ten minutes. A natural ninja!
Janine.trainerWins: A natural ninja victory!

Janine.greeting: Fuchsia's ninja and the Battle Zone's silent shadow! Two shadows!
Janine.trainerWins: Two shadows, one victory!

Whitney.greeting: Marley! You never smile! Let's win so you'll smile, okay?
Marley smiled at me! Just a little! I cried because it was so cute! Let's battle!
Goldenrod's crybaby and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Loud and soft!

Jasmine.greeting: Marley and I don't talk much... but that's okay. We understand each other.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... Thank you, Marley.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Um... next time, Marley.

Jasmine.greeting: Marley and I sat on the lighthouse stairs and watched the sunset. Neither of us said anything. It was perfect.
Jasmine.trainerWins: A perfect sunset, a perfect victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: A perfect sunset... and a defeat.

Jasmine.greeting: Olivine's lighthouse and the Battle Zone's quiet one... two shy girls.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Two shy girls, one brave victory.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Two shy girls, one quiet defeat.

Clair.greeting: Marley. Silent, but fierce. I respect that.
Clair.trainerWins: A dragon's victory. Well done, Marley.
Clair.trainerLoses: Hmph. Not a word of this, Marley.

Clair.greeting: Marley stared at my dragons for ten minutes. Then said "...cool." Highest praise I've ever received.
Blackthorn's dragon master and the Battle Zone's silent admirer. Fierce and quiet.

Roxanne.greeting: Marley, quiet students often learn the most. Let's show what we know!
Roxanne.trainerWins: A perfect score! Well done, Marley!

Roxanne.greeting: Marley sat in my classroom and took perfect notes without saying a single word. My best silent student!
Rustboro's teacher and the Battle Zone's quiet student! Lessons and silence!

Flannery.greeting: Marley! Don't be so cool! Get fired up with me!
Marley sat in my hot springs for an hour without flinching! I lasted twenty minutes! She's tougher than me!
Lavaridge's firecracker and the Battle Zone's quiet one! Fire and ice cool!

Winona.greeting: Marley, quiet as a feather on the wind. Let us fly.
Marley rode on my bird and didn't make a sound the entire flight. My bird thought she'd fallen off.
Fortree's skies and the Battle Zone's silent passenger. Feathers and stillness.

Elesa.greeting: Marley, that mysterious aura of yours is stunning. Let's light up the stage!
Elesa.trainerWins: Electrifying! Marley, you were a star.
Elesa.trainerLoses: The lights went out on us...

Elesa.greeting: Marley wore one of my outfits and stood perfectly still. The photographer said she was the best model he'd ever seen.
Elesa.trainerWins: The best model, the best victory!

Elesa.greeting: Nimbasa's star and the Battle Zone's mysterious model. Sparkle and mystery.
Elesa.trainerWins: Sparkle and mystery, dazzling!

Skyla.greeting: Marley! Wanna come flying with me after this? It's so peaceful up there!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Engine trouble! We'll get 'em next time!

Skyla.greeting: Marley fell asleep on my plane during a loop-the-loop! Asleep! During a loop! She's unbelievable!
Mistralton's pilot and the Battle Zone's sleepiest passenger! Wake up for takeoff!
Skyla.trainerWins: She woke up for the win!

Roxie.greeting: Marley, you're so quiet! Let's crank up the volume together!
Roxie.trainerWins: That's a hit! Encore, Marley!

Roxie.greeting: Marley came to my concert and wore earmuffs! In the front row! She nodded to the beat though!
Roxie.trainerWins: Earmuffs and victory!

Roxie.greeting: Virbank's rock star and the Battle Zone's earmuffed fan! Loud and quiet!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loud and quiet, a hit!

Mallow.greeting: Marley, you look hungry! Let's win, then I'll cook you something amazing!
Mallow.trainerWins: Victory! Now, what would you like to eat, Marley?
Mallow.trainerLoses: We lost, but there's always dessert!

Mallow.greeting: Marley ate four plates of my curry without saying a word! Then she said "...more." Best compliment ever!
The Lush Jungle's chef and the Battle Zone's hungriest! Food and fight!
Mallow.trainerWins: Food and fight, a feast of victory!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Food and fight, an empty plate!

customNote: Marques and Thomas (custom battle-50 trainers, written by the user) always appear together: give them the same number of sets, in matching order, so each pair of lines goes together (the same set index is picked for both).
duosNote: Team-up lines for a trainer and their Multi Battle partner (Izzy and Kaito always battle alongside Tai as opponents), three sets each in matching order: used whenever the two battle together. Add an entry for each new partner (Mimi, Joe...).

Tai.greeting: Izzy's got the brains, I've got the guts! Let's show this world what the DigiDestined can do!
Tai.trainerWins: Told you charging in works, Izzy! ...Okay, your plan helped. A little.
Tai.trainerLoses: Alright, Izzy, what went wrong? ...No, the short version!

Tai.greeting: Izzy's been studying this world since we landed. Me? I've been battling in it. Ready?
Tai.trainerWins: Brains and courage! Unbeatable combo, right, Izzy?
Tai.trainerLoses: Guess courage wasn't enough today. Izzy, crunch the numbers.

Tai.greeting: Whatever pulled us into this world, Izzy will figure it out. Until then, we fight together!
Tai.trainerWins: Another win for the DigiDestined! Write that one down, Izzy!
Tai.trainerLoses: We'll be back. Izzy's already planning the rematch, I can tell.

Izzy.greeting: Tai charges in, I calculate the odds. Statistically, you're in trouble. Prodigious!
Izzy.trainerWins: The data doesn't lie, Tai. ...Okay, your courage helped too.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Tai, next time, please let me finish explaining the plan first.

Izzy.greeting: I research this world, Tai battles in it. Together, we're a complete data set!
Izzy.trainerWins: Theory and practice in perfect harmony! Nice work, Tai.
Izzy.trainerLoses: An anomaly. I'll analyze it... once Tai stops sulking.

Izzy.greeting: Our partners changed when we crossed over, but our teamwork didn't. Right, Tai?
Izzy.trainerWins: Courage and Knowledge, perfectly synchronized. Prodigious!
Izzy.trainerLoses: Tai, I think our variables need recalibrating.

Tai.greeting: Kaito's from another world, but our partners started out exactly alike. And he treats me like his mentor! Let's go!
Tai.trainerWins: Two paths, one win! Nice backup, Kaito!
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, charging in wasn't the move. Kaito, don't apologize, that one's on me!

Tai.greeting: We only met when we both got zapped into this world, and Kaito already looks up to me. Gotta live up to that!
Tai.trainerWins: Courage and a choice. Turns out that's a great combo!
Tai.trainerLoses: Chin up, Kaito. Even mentors lose sometimes. We'll get them next time.

Tai.greeting: Kaito keeps watching how I battle like there's a test later. Fine by me. Let's show him how it's done!
Tai.trainerWins: See, Kaito? Trust your partner, then charge! You're getting it.
Tai.trainerLoses: Even the guy you look up to loses sometimes, Kaito. What counts is getting back up.

Kaito.greeting: We met the day we both landed in this world. Tai fights like he was born to lead. I'm taking notes.
Kaito.trainerWins: Nice backup? You did the hard part, Tai. ...I'm still learning from you.
Kaito.trainerLoses: I won't say it. You stood in front of all of us. Next time, I'll cover you better.

Kaito.greeting: Tai looked at my partner and didn't flinch. Most people do. I'd follow someone like that anywhere.
Kaito.trainerWins: Courage like his is rare. I'm glad this world dropped me next to him.
Kaito.trainerLoses: I am planning the rematch. And I'm asking Tai how he stays so steady.

Kaito.greeting: I've only known Tai since we were both pulled into this world, and I already know who I want to learn from.
Kaito.trainerWins: So that's how you lead from the front. ...Thanks for showing me, Tai.
Kaito.trainerLoses: Getting back up. Right. I'll remember that one, Tai.

Takato.greeting: Henry and I got pulled into this world together. With him thinking and me charging in, we've got this!
Takato.trainerWins: Teamwork! Henry, that plan was perfect!
Takato.trainerLoses: Sorry, Henry... I charged in too fast again.

Takato.greeting: Henry's the smartest guy I know. If he says we can win, then we can win!
Takato.trainerWins: Told you we could win! Well... you told me. Same thing!
Takato.trainerLoses: Henry's already making a new plan. I can tell.

Takato.greeting: Our partners are best friends, so we're a team too. Let's go, Henry!
Takato.trainerLoses: We'll get them next time. Right, Henry?

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Takato charges in, I think it through. Somehow it works. Shall we, Takato?
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Your instinct and my plan. A good balance, Takato.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: It's okay, Takato. We'll rethink it and come back.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Even in a strange world, I'm glad Takato's beside me. Let's keep it fair and focused.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: I only made the plan. You were the brave one, Takato.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Every loss teaches something. I'm already rewriting our approach.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Takato's heart and my head. Our partners know the rest. Ready.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: ...I don't really do high fives, Takato. Fine. Just this once.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: We will, Takato. Momentai, as my partner would say.

Takato.greeting: Rika's the toughest Tamer I know. Don't tell her I said that... She heard, didn't she?
Takato.trainerWins: Rika, that was amazing! ...Sorry, sorry, I'll stop cheering.
Takato.trainerLoses: Sorry, Rika! I'll do better, I swear!

Takato.greeting: Rika and I are stuck in another world together. At least I know she won't let us lose!
Takato.trainerWins: We make a great team, Rika! ...Right?
Takato.trainerLoses: Rika's mad. Really mad. I'm hiding behind my partner.

Takato.greeting: Rika calls me Gogglehead, but she's battling with me anyway. She must like me a little!
Takato.trainerWins: See, Rika? Goggleheads can win too!
Takato.trainerLoses: Okay, okay, I'll listen to you next time, Rika.

Rika.greeting: Ugh, I'm stuck with Gogglehead. Fine. Try to keep up, Takato.
Rika.trainerWins: You actually helped. Don't make a big deal out of it, Takato.

Rika.greeting: A whole new world, and I still end up next to Takato. Whatever. Let's win this fast.
Rika.trainerWins: Fast enough. Good job. ...Don't look at me like that.
Rika.trainerLoses: Stop apologizing, Takato. Just win next time.

Rika.greeting: If Gogglehead gets in my way, I'm leaving him behind. Let's go.
Rika.trainerWins: Not bad, Gogglehead. Not bad at all.
Rika.trainerLoses: Next time we do it my way, Gogglehead. No arguments.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Rika and I both landed in this world with our partners. Let's battle with honor, Rika.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Well fought, Rika. Your partner moves beautifully.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Our timing was off. Let's study what went wrong, Rika.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Rika plays to win. I play to keep things fair. Somehow we balance out.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Balanced and decisive. Thank you, Rika.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Even the Queen loses sometimes. So do I.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Rika's partner and mine have trained together. Let's see how far teamwork goes.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Teamwork goes far, it seems. Nicely done, Rika.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: I'll ask my partner for a new plan. He'll just tell me to relax.

Rika.greeting: Honor? Sure, Henry. I just want to win. Keep up.
Rika.trainerWins: ...Fine. Your partner's not bad either, Henry.
Rika.trainerLoses: Study it yourself, Henry. I'm busy being annoyed.

Rika.greeting: Henry overthinks everything, but at least he doesn't panic. Let's go.
Rika.trainerWins: Decisive. That's the only way I battle.
Rika.trainerLoses: Don't you dare say "even the Queen," Henry.

Rika.greeting: Our partners train together. We don't. Let's see if that matters.
Rika.trainerWins: Guess it mattered. Whatever. Good job, Henry.
Rika.trainerLoses: If your partner tells you to relax one more time, Henry...

Tai.greeting: Takato got pulled here from his own world, just like me. And the kid's got goggles too. I like him already!
Tai.trainerWins: Nice work, Takato! Those goggles are working for you!
Tai.trainerLoses: Chin up, Takato. Even legends lose. We'll get them next time!

Tai.greeting: Two worlds, two Tamers, one tree! Takato and I didn't ask to be brought here, but we're making the most of it!
Tai.trainerWins: That's how you make the most of it! High five, Takato!
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, that one stung. Takato, you were great, though!

Tai.greeting: Takato keeps calling me "the legendary Tai." I'm just a guy with goggles! ...But let's give you a legendary battle.
Tai.trainerLoses: So much for legendary. Let's keep that between us, Takato.

Takato.greeting: I'm actually teaming up with THE Tai! I've worn goggles because of you for as long as I can remember!
Takato.trainerWins: We won together! Tai, can I get your autograph?!
Takato.trainerLoses: I let you down, Tai... I'll be braver next time, I promise!

Takato.greeting: Tai and I both got pulled here from our own worlds. I never thought I'd meet my hero like this!
Takato.trainerWins: A high five from Tai! I'm never washing this hand!
Takato.trainerLoses: Tai said I was great?! ...Wait, we lost. Still counts!

Takato.greeting: The legendary Tai is my partner! I've dreamed about this! Don't hold back, okay? Because we won't!
Takato.trainerWins: Legendary! Totally legendary! Did you see us?!
Takato.trainerLoses: Even losing next to Tai is kind of amazing. ...Kind of.

Colress.greeting: A boy who crossed over from another world, laptop and all! Izzy, your data could rewrite my research. Shall we?
Colress.trainerWins: Splendid! Izzy's predictions and my analysis, perfectly in sync. More data for both of us!
Colress.trainerLoses: A setback! Fascinating, though. Izzy, we must analyze every turn of this.

Colress.greeting: Izzy says his world is made of data. I say every world is, if you look closely enough. Let us look closely.
Colress.trainerWins: As expected: understanding a thing is the first step to mastering it.
Colress.trainerLoses: Hmm! A variable from your world I hadn't accounted for, Izzy. How thrilling.

Colress.greeting: Izzy calculates, I theorize. Together, we bring out every last drop of our partners' potential!
Colress.trainerWins: Potential, fully realized! Izzy, that was a beautiful equation.
Colress.trainerLoses: Our potential wasn't enough today. Then we refine the formula!

Izzy.greeting: Colress wants to study how I crossed over from my world. I want to study him back. A prodigious partnership!
Izzy.trainerWins: Prodigious! I'm logging this as our first joint publication, Colress.
Izzy.trainerLoses: An anomaly in our results. Colress, I've already started the post-battle analysis.

Izzy.greeting: Colress thinks the rift that brought me here from my world can be measured. So do I. But first, a field test!
Izzy.trainerWins: Field test successful! Colress, we may need a bigger hard drive.
Izzy.trainerLoses: The field test failed, but the data is priceless. Right, Colress?

Izzy.greeting: Colress talks about potential the way I talk about computers. I like him already. Let's run the numbers!
Izzy.trainerWins: The numbers don't lie. Nice work, Colress!
Izzy.trainerLoses: The numbers lied. Or I mistyped. Colress, can you check my math?

Cheren.greeting: Izzy came here from another world and still finds time to study. I respect that. Let's be methodical.
Cheren.trainerWins: A methodical win. Good work, Izzy. My students could learn from you.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We were methodical and still lost. There's a lesson in that. Let's find it, Izzy.

Cheren.greeting: Izzy, you were pulled out of your world into ours. Show me how you adapt. That's real strength.
Cheren.trainerWins: That's what I mean by strength: adapting. Well done, Izzy.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even adapting has its limits. We'll grow past them, Izzy.

Cheren.greeting: Izzy plans three moves ahead. I plan four. Between us, nothing is left to chance.
Cheren.trainerWins: Four moves ahead, as planned. Thank you, Izzy.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Four moves ahead, and I still missed one. Interesting.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren asked me to teach his class about the world I came from. Today's lesson: teamwork across worlds!
Izzy.trainerWins: Lesson learned! Cheren, can I tell your students about this battle?
Izzy.trainerLoses: Today's lesson didn't go to plan. Cheren, I'll revise the curriculum.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren keeps asking what strength means. In the world I'm from, it's knowledge. Let's test that hypothesis!
Izzy.trainerWins: Hypothesis confirmed: knowledge is strength! Right, Cheren?
Izzy.trainerLoses: Hypothesis inconclusive. Cheren, I propose a rematch for more data.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren's a teacher and I'm a programmer. We both love a good logic problem. You're today's!
Izzy.trainerWins: Problem solved! Cheren, that was textbook.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Problem unsolved... for now. Cheren, let's debug our strategy.

Elio.trainerLoses: Champion or not, you beat us fair and square.

May.trainerLoses: We'll mark this spot on the map: where you beat us.

Kris.trainerWins: Neighborly teamwork wins the day!

Dawn.greeting: May's a ball of energy, and I'm all about the finish. Perfect combination!

Dawn.greeting: Our Contest outfits match today. That's half the battle won already!
Dawn.trainerLoses: Matching outfits didn't help this time. Oh well!

Rosa.greeting: May's energy is perfect for an action scene. Places, everyone!

May.greeting: Hoenn adventurer and Galar Champion. That's a pretty great team!
