Kris.trainerLoses: Elio's still calm. I'm the one who's sulking!

Kris.greeting: Alola's Champion is my partner today. I'm going to need a souvenir!
Kris.trainerWins: Best souvenir ever: a win with Elio!
Kris.trainerLoses: Souvenir of defeat. I'll keep it anyway.

Kris.greeting: Elio taught me to say Alola. I taught him to never stop running!
Kris.trainerWins: Alola and never stop running! It worked!
Kris.trainerLoses: Alola... and maybe stop for a breather.

Elio.greeting: May's been telling me about Hoenn all day. Let's give her a new story!
Elio.trainerWins: New story: Alola and Hoenn win together!
Elio.trainerLoses: New story: you beat us. May will tell it well.

Elio.greeting: May's battles are full of flair. Mine are full of Z-Moves. Watch out!
Elio.trainerWins: Flair and Z-Moves for the win!
Elio.trainerLoses: Flair and Z-Moves weren't enough. Nice!

Elio.greeting: Alola, May! Let's show them some island spirit.
Elio.trainerWins: Island spirit! You're a natural, May.
Elio.trainerLoses: Island spirit, still beaten. Respect!

May.greeting: Elio said Alola has volcanoes and beaches. Hoenn does too! We're practically cousins.
May.trainerWins: Island cousins, winning together!
May.trainerLoses: Island cousins, losing together. At least it's together!

May.greeting: Elio's quiet, but he battles like a tidal wave!
May.trainerWins: Tidal wave unleashed! Go, Elio!
May.trainerLoses: Our tidal wave hit a wall. Impressive wall!

May.greeting: Alola's Champion and Hoenn's explorer! Let's explore some victory.
May.trainerWins: Victory explored and conquered!
May.trainerLoses: We'll explore a rematch next time.

Elio.greeting: Dawn says there's no need to worry. With her beside me, I believe it!
Elio.trainerWins: No worries at all! Thanks, Dawn!
Elio.trainerLoses: Okay, now there's a little need to worry.

Elio.greeting: Dawn's Contest moves are beautiful. My job is making sure they hit hard too!
Elio.trainerWins: Beautiful and hard-hitting! Perfect.
Elio.trainerLoses: Beautiful, but not quite hard enough.

Elio.greeting: Sinnoh and Alola, side by side. Alola!
Elio.trainerWins: Alola, victory! Great job, Dawn.
Elio.trainerLoses: Alola... and congratulations to you!

Dawn.greeting: Elio's Z-Moves sparkle almost as much as a Contest finale!
Dawn.trainerLoses: No finale for us today. You shone brighter.

Dawn.greeting: Elio and I both helped professors fill their Pokédex. Let's add a victory entry!
Alola sunshine and Sinnoh snow! What a pair we make.
Dawn.trainerLoses: What a pair... of runners-up. Well done!

Elio.greeting: Rosa says this battle's being filmed. Do I look okay? Alola!
Elio.trainerWins: Great take! Thanks, Rosa!
Elio.trainerLoses: Can we do another take?

Elio.greeting: Rosa plans everything like a script. I just go with the flow. Opposites attract!
Elio.trainerWins: Script plus flow equals win!
Elio.trainerLoses: The flow went your way today.

Elio.greeting: Unova's star and Alola's Champion! Ready, Rosa?
Elio.trainerWins: Star-studded victory!
Elio.trainerLoses: Star-studded, but beaten. Congrats!

Rosa.greeting: Elio's my leading man today. Professional, calm and very good at battling!
Rosa.trainerLoses: Even leading men lose sometimes. Bravo, you!

Rosa.greeting: Elio wanted to know if Pokéstar Studios has a Z-Move scene. It does now!
Rosa.trainerWins: The Z-Move scene was a hit!
Rosa.trainerLoses: The Z-Move scene needs a reshoot.

Rosa.greeting: A Champion and a movie star. The tabloids are going to love this!
Rosa.trainerWins: Headline: Champion and Star Win Big!
Rosa.trainerLoses: Headline: Champion and Star Defeated! Ouch.

Elio.greeting: Two Champions on one side! Alola and Galar, ready for anything.
Elio.trainerWins: Champions together! Great job, Gloria.
Elio.trainerLoses: Two Champions, one loss. You're amazing!

Elio.greeting: Gloria's going to cook curry after this. I'll bring malasadas!
Elio.trainerWins: Curry and malasadas: the victory feast!
Elio.trainerLoses: Feast of consolation, then. Want to join?

Elio.greeting: Gloria battles in stadiums, and I battled on islands. Let's see how a crowd likes island spirit!
Elio.trainerWins: The crowd loves island spirit!
Elio.trainerLoses: The crowd loves you more. Fair!

Gloria.greeting: Elio's the calmest Champion I've ever met. I'm the loudest. Let's do this!
Gloria.trainerWins: Calm and loud, Champions both! Cheers, Elio!
Gloria.trainerLoses: Calm, loud and beaten. Brilliant match!

Gloria.greeting: Elio promised malasadas if we win. I promised curry. Very motivated!
Alola's first Champion and Galar's newest! Let's give them a match for the history books.
Gloria.trainerLoses: History books will remember you instead.
